texts.en:
"I imagine your self-interest will provide sufficient motivation. As you well know, we pay in credits. The prospect of the continuity of technological civilization is an added benefit, is it not?"

"Unless," she pauses, then looks at you over her AR-spex, speaking evenly, "I've gravely misjudged you, and your heart is set on liquidating your fleet, donating the proceeds to charity, and taking up with a flagellant order on Hesperus... no, I've got it- you've been doing a lot of reading; well, watching dark-channel holovids mostly- and have half a mind to enlist as a political enforcer smashing teeth in for the next 1000-cycle reign of some new 'Lion of Sindria'. Did I get it right?"

Your shields hold firm under the broadside of sarcasm deployed by the Provost.
texts.zh:
我觉得你的自身利益就是你最好的动力。你明明很懂，我们以信用点支付。反正对你来说，技术文明的传承和延续只是顺便，不是吗？

“除非...” 她顿了一下，一边隔着 AR 眼镜仔细打量着你，一边不紧不慢地说到，“除非我完全看错你了。搞不好其实你心意已决，打算彻底变卖你的舰队，把全部收益捐给施善会，然后去 Hesperus 加入某个自笞者修会...不，我懂了。你看了很多宣传，大部分都是什么地下频道里的全息视频之类的。你现在完全按耐不住自己想要加入政法部队的冲动，要为维护 “辛达瑞亚之狮” 的千年统治而大杀四方。我猜对了么？”

犹如用护盾牢牢地挡下了激烈的侧舷排炮火力一般，你面不改色地接下了院长的一连串冷嘲热讽。

options.en: Tell me more.
Let her continue her speech
What do you need me for?
Point made. What do you need me for?
options.zh: 明白了，那么为什么需要我呢？

options.en: And why should I help you?
I guess we'll just have to see.
options.zh: 那我们只能走一步看一步了。

texts.en:
"Your tasks will not be so simple from here on out. I expect you to self-adapt to circumstances in pursuit of the objectives I lay out. And."

She pauses for a moment, considering, before continuing in a tone colder than before, "No matter what you have to do, as long as you pursue the mission goal, I will see that you are rewarded. Securing the future is worth... everything."
texts.zh:
"从此以后，你的任务就不会这么简单了。我期望你能够紧跟我设定的每一个目标，自己主动地去随机应变。还有..."

她停顿了一会儿，思索些许，然后换上了更为冷厉的语气继续说道："不管你采取了什么你认为必要的措施，只要你贯彻了任务的最终目标，我就会确保你得到报酬。为了确保未来... 一切都值得。"

options.en: What do you need done?
I'm not willing to sacrifice all sense of morality for your 'future'.
options.zh: 我不愿意为了你的 '未来' 牺牲我所有的道德底线。

options.en: I'm willing to do whatever it takes to safeguard the future.
options.zh: 为了守住未来，我愿意不惜一切代价。

options.en: And what if I don't want to help you?

texts.en:
"My predecessor, Provost Tomas Kallichore, led a series of misguided hyperspace manipulation experiments. Ah, how to put it in layman's terms?"

Baird looks troubled to have to do this, sighs, then speaks: "Captain. Your ships fly through hyperspace with special engines. The Gate network of the Domain was similar, but also very different. Kallichore thought there might be a way to use starship hyperdrives to re-open the Gates."

"Obviously it went terribly wrong, and the Galatia system was cut off from hyperspace when the jump-points were disrupted beyond usability. Though we hear some yahoo found a way to cross unstable jump-points; an act well beyond irresponsible considering the chance of a cascading resonance event- ah, I apologize. That is irrelevant."
texts.zh:
"我的前任，Tomas Kallichore 院长，领导了一系列错误的超空间操纵实验。呃，怎么说得通俗一点呢？"

看起来这确实让 Baird 很伤脑筋，她叹了口气，然后开口："舰长，你的舰船全都利用着特殊的引擎以在超空间航行，这和 人之领 的星门网络有点类似，但也非常不同。而 Kallichore 当时认为可能有办法利用星舰的超空间引擎来 重新打开星门。"

"显然这些实验出了大问题，当跳跃点被扰乱到无法使用时，Galatia 星系也与超空间隔绝了。虽然我们听说一些疯子找到了穿越不稳定跳跃点的方法，但考虑到可能引发级联共振事件的风险，这种行为已经不能只用不负责任来形容了 —— 啊，抱歉，这与当前的话题没什么关系。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"What matters is that once the mess was finally cleared up, the Hegemony descended on the Galatia Academy with a technological inspection fleet. They tore the place apart, arrested the heads of the hyperphysics department and several labs, and of course took Provost Kallichore in for questioning."

She turns away. "And, with little delay, sentencing."

"He was a fool, and too trusting," Baird says with contempt. "We lost good people and good research. Scientific breakthroughs are built on the development of theory and, yes, even negative results."
texts.zh:
"重要的是，当这个烂摊子最终收拾干净的时候，霸主就派遣了科技审查舰队来到 Galatia 学院。他们把这个地方拆得七零八落，逮捕了超空间物理学部门和几个实验室的负责人，当然还有 Kallichore 院长，一并抓去审问。"

她面向一旁。"然后，几乎马上就判刑了。"

"他是个傻瓜，而且太信任别人了，" Baird 轻蔑地说。"我们失去了优秀的人和优秀的研究资料。科学突破建立在理论发展上以及，没错，甚至是负面的成果。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I need you to recover Kallichore's secret archive. We need his data from that experiment, and all the others that led up to it. The Hegemony will have kept it. They keep everything. Evidence, you see."

"We shall also need Academician Scylla Coureuse. She was a hyperspace physics researcher, the keystone of the theory team behind the jump-point experiments. The Hegemony, small-minded as they are, only arrested team leaders in the first sweep. They didn't understand that the underlying theory being tested was largely written by one particular academician who was... not suitable for leadership."

"I need you to find her."
texts.zh:
"我需要你找回 Kallichore 的秘密档案。我们需要他那次实验的数据，以及所有导致那次实验的其他前置数据。霸主肯定会把这些资料留在手上。他们保存一切。作为证据，你懂的。"

"此外我们还需要 Scylla Coureuse 院士。她是一位超空间物理学研究员，跳跃点实验背后理论小组的基石。霸主向来目光短浅，在一开始只逮捕了项目负责人。他们想不到，当时测试的基础理论主要是由一位... 不适合担任领导的院士撰写的"

"我需要你找到她。"

options.en: How can I get the Kallichore Archive from the Hegemony?
options.zh: 我怎样才能从 霸主 手上拿到 Kallichore 的档案？

options.en: Do you have any leads on this Scylla Coureuse?
options.zh: 关于这个 Scylla Coureuse，你有什么线索吗？

texts.en:
"Following the aftermath of the Galatia Experiment, the Hegemony technological inspectors seized everything, all of our records and data."

"The most direct approach would involve accessing the data vaults of the Ministry of Technology Standards. They're who you might call the 'AI Inspectors', and they serve that role, among others, for the Hegemony. It would not be trivial." An amused look crosses her face. "But their security has been breached before..."

"I have an old... acquaintance who has been climbing the Tri-Tachyon executive ladder. His name is Rayan Arroyo, and he is based out of Eochu Bres. He may be compelled to assist us with a human asset on this front. I'll forward you the contact information." She taps for a moment on her desk-interface.
texts.zh:
"Galatia 实验之后。霸主 的科技审查员查封了一切，包括我们所有的数据与记录。"

"最直接的方法是进入科技标准部的数据库。他们是你可能称之为 'AI 稽查员' 的人，并同时在其他职位服役。这可不是小事，" 她看起来有些想笑，"但曾经也有人办到过。"

"我的确有个...老熟人，他在 速子科技 的行政梯队中上升很快。他的名字叫 Rayan Arroyo，在 Eochu Bres 办公。或许我们能说服他在这一目标上提供人力支援。我会把联络信息转发给你。" 她在她的桌面终端上敲了一会儿。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Let us say that Arroyo's future career opportunities are on the line," she says.

"Mention me to him," she says. "If you are firm but discreet, I believe you will find him more than willing to assist."
texts.zh:
"这么说吧，这事关乎他未来的职业生涯。" 她说道。

"向他报我的名字，" 她接着说，"如果你的态度足够强硬而谨慎，我相信你会发现他非常乐意提供帮助。"

options.en: Rayan Arroyo. Got it.
You want me to blackmail a Tri-Tachyon executive?
options.zh: 你想让我去勒索一位 速子科技 的高管？

texts.en:
"He compromised corporate security to advance his career over a rival. He understands the value of the deal he made with me."

She almost smiles.

"You will find him quite cooperative once you get past his inflated sense of self-importance."
texts.zh:
"他为了在竞争中胜出，不惜损害公司安全来推动自己的职业生涯。他很清楚与我达成的这笔交易的价值。"

她几乎要露出笑容。

"一旦你忽略他那膨胀的自我感，就会发现他其实相当配合。"

options.en: Do you have any leads on this Scylla Coureuse?
options.zh: 你有关于 Scylla Coureuse 的任何线索么？

options.en: How can I get the Kallichore Archive from the Hegemony?
options.zh: 我该如何从 霸主 手上拿到 Kallichore 的档案？

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"As for the prodigy of Galatia..." Baird trails off.

Is that regret? The look quickly disappears.
texts.zh:
"至于 Galatia 的那位奇才..." Baird 欲言又止。

她脸上的是遗憾吗？这个表情很快就消失了。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Coureuse was always an odd fit. Brilliant, yes, but she had a way of being distracted with involvement in, hmm, antagonistic subcultures." Baird waves a hand, dismissing the matter as sociological fluff. "Perhaps the Hegemony crackdown cured her of that childish affectation."

"Her family and, presumably, friends," you wonder for a moment if Baird has any of those, "-are from Fikenhild, in the Westernesse system. You could start there."
texts.zh:
"Coureuse 一直都是个异类。她确实才华横溢，但她总是会分心于参与...嗯...制造对立的亚文化中。" Baird 挥了挥手，仿佛这些不过是社会学上的细枝末节。"或许 霸主 的镇压使她摆脱了那种幼稚的影响。"

"她的家人，以及想必还有朋友，" 听到这里，你忽然好奇 Baird 自己是否也有这类关系，"都来自 Westernesse 星系的 Fikenhild，你可以从那里开始找。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Baird thinks for a moment. "If you are observed looking for Coureuse, you may be contacted by others who are looking for her. That could be useful. You could cut a deal, get some leads."

"Alternatively, her department was operating experimental packages in the $gaFC_starName system. We have detected some ongoing telemetry that suggests these instruments are still in use, though it isn't clear by whom." She taps her desk interface, "I've sent you the coordinates."

The provost looks at you over her spectacles. "How do you want to handle this, captain? Are you a diplomat or an explorer? Do you want to find the probes in the $gaFC_starName system or talk your way through this on Fikenhild?"
texts.zh:
Baird 沉思了片刻，"如果有人发现你在寻找 Coureuse，其他也在找她的人可能会联系你。这可能会对你有所帮助。你可以试着做笔交易，换点线索。"

"此外，她所在的部门曾在 $gaFC_starName 星系部署实验组件。我们侦测到某些仍在传回的遥测数据，表明这些仪器仍在使用中，尽管使用者身份不明。" 她轻点桌面界面，"坐标已经发送给你了。"

院长透过眼镜审视着你。"你打算如何处理此事，舰长？是当外交官还是探险家？你是想去 $gaFC_starName 星系搜寻探测器，还是想在 Fikenhild 靠口才解决这件事？"

texts.en:
"Your status in the Persean League could be useful. Officials might be willing to assist you. The League intelligence apparatus might even provide assistance." She gives you a knowing look. "If they think they're working for the benefit of the League, that is."

"Alternatively, her department was operating experimental packages in the $gaFC_starName system. We have detected some ongoing telemetry that suggests these instruments are still in use, though it isn't clear by whom." She taps her desk interface, "I've sent you the coordinates."

The provost looks at you over her spectacles. "How do you want to handle this, captain? Are you a diplomat or an explorer? Do you want to find the probes in the $gaFC_starName system or talk your way through this on Fikenhild?"
texts.zh:
"你在 英仙座联盟 的地位或许能派上用场。官员们可能会愿意协助你。联盟情报机构甚至可能会提供支持。" 她投来心照不宣的目光，"前提是他们认为这是在为联盟的利益服务。"

"此外，她所在的部门曾在 $gaFC_starName 星系部署实验组件。我们侦测到某些仍在传回的遥测数据，表明这些仪器仍在使用中，尽管使用者身份不明。" 她轻点桌面界面，"坐标已经发送给你了。"

院长透过眼镜审视着你。"你打算如何处理此事，舰长？是当外交官还是探险家？你是想去 $gaFC_starName 星系搜寻探测器，还是想在 Fikenhild 靠口才解决这件事？"

options.en: Take the diplomatic path
Take the exploration path
Take the diplomatic path
Take the exploration path

texts.en:
Baird nods, "I thought so. There's no problem you don't believe you can talk your way through, is there."

"If you want to change your approach, you must let me know so that I can ensure you have all the information you require."
texts.zh:
Baird 点点头，"我想也是。在你看来，这世上没有不能用你口才解决的问题，对吧。"

"如果你想换一个方法，你必须让我知道，这样我才能确保你掌握所有必要的信息。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"When you do find Scylla Coureuse, I expect her to be unwilling to cooperate. I have provided you with an encrypted message. It is an, ah, a personal appeal from myself to her," she says.

"It should prove persuasive."
texts.zh:
"当你真的找到 Scylla Coureuse 时，我预计她不会很配合。我已经向你提供了一份加密信息。这是一个，啊，我以个人名义对她发出的呼吁。" 她说道。

"这应该有些说服力。"

options.en: I'm sure it will.
options.zh: 我相信这会起到作用的。

options.en: Will I be blackmailing Coureuse for you?
options.zh: 需要我帮你去威逼利诱 Coureuse 吗？

texts.en:
"Indeed," says Baird, looking at you closely. "Her trepidation is a rational response to previous events; the investigations, arrests, the show-trial of Kallichore. But conditions have changed, and she is needed if we are to escape from stagnant local maxima."

Baird turns to the window. "I will call, Scylla will answer," she says. A proclamation?
texts.zh:
"确实，" Baird 说道，一边仔细看着你。"她的惶恐不安是对之前情况的合理反应，Kallichore 被调查、逮捕、公开审判。但现在情况变了，如果我们要突破停滞不前的上限，就必须要找到她。"

Baird 转向窗户。"我将呼吁，而 Scylla 将会响应，" 她说道。这是一句宣告吗？

texts.en:
"You need not be so conspiratorial, captain," Baird admonishes, "Not everything is cloak and dagger, blackmail and bribes."

"Our wayward academician has avoided all contact with the Galatia Academy since the Hegemony arrested her colleagues. I appreciate the rational response to a campaign of scientific suppression, but now she is needed for the role she was always meant to play."
texts.zh:
"你大可不必这么热衷于阴谋论，舰长。" Baird 告诫道，"世上并不只有敲诈勒索和阴谋诡计。"

"自从 霸主 逮捕了她的同事后，我们的这位倔强的学者就避免了与 Galatia 学院的所有接触。我欣赏她对那场压迫科学的运动的理性反应，但现在需要她发挥她应有的作用，一如既往。"

texts.en:
Baird nods, "Of course. You are, at heart, a... an adventurer, shall we say, aren't you."

"If you want to change your approach, you must let me know so that I can ensure you have all the information you require."
texts.zh:
Baird 点点头，"当然。你本质上是一个...一个冒险家，不是么。"

"如果你想换一个方法，你必须让我知道，这样我才能确保你掌握所有必要的信息。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Find the Kallichore Archive. Find Scylla Coureuse. Once you have accomplished both of these missions, the project can proceed to the next phase."

Baird smiles, "And that's when things get exciting."
texts.zh:
"找到 Kallichore 的档案以及 Scylla Coureuse 本人。一旦你完成了这两项任务，项目就可以进入下一阶段。"

Baird 微笑着，继续道，"到那时，事情就会变得有趣了。"

options.en: So that's all?
So what is 'the project'?
options.zh: 所以这项目到底是什么？

texts.en:
She turns to her desk display and starts inputting a command sequence, done with you for now.

"Good day, captain," she says without looking up, "You may check in with me via comms for additional analysis as the operation develops, though I expect you to use your initiative."

"Oh, and I've re-authorized Academician Sebestyen with mission assignment access for your file. Carrying out his little jobs might be a good cover for your real work, and allows us to funnel additional credits to you."

You feel the subtle movement of air as the doors open silently behind you. Mirror-masked guards flank a junior agent who waits to escort you back to your shuttle.
texts.zh:
她转向她办公桌上的显示器，开始输入某个命令序列，看来她和你的谈话暂时结束了。

"祝你好运，舰长，" 她头也不抬地说，"行动开展的同时，你随时可以通过通讯器与我联系，以获得其他建议，尽管我希望你能更多地发挥你的主观能动性。"

"哦，还有，我已经重新授权 Sebestyen 院士向你发布任务。处理他的琐事应该能很好地掩盖你的真实任务，同时也能让我们有渠道向你输送额外的星币。"

你察觉到一丝动静，门在你身后无声地打开。一位初级代理站在戴着镜面面罩的警卫身边，等待着送你回到穿梭机上。

texts.en: Baird's smile does not reach her eyes. "You'll see."
texts.zh: Baird 笑了，但她的眼睛中却没一丝笑意。"你会知道的。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Not at all. I," she says this with emphasis. "I was simply attentive when a certain Tri-Tachyon executive compromised corporate security to advance his career over a rival."

"He understands the value of the deal he made and he has come out ahead compared to the alternative. You will find him quite cooperative."
texts.zh:
"不完全是。我，" 她说这句话时加重了语气，"我只是单纯地注意到一位 速子科技 的高管为了在事业上超过竞争对手而损害了公司安全。"

"他明白这个交易的价值，何况比起其他选择，他已经算是赚的盆满钵满了。你会发现他相当愿意合作。"

texts.en:
"Of course not."

She puts on a smile that isn't entirely friendly.

"And I would never ask it of you. This is exactly why I want to give you so much leeway- so you can do this your way. The right way. You've shown that it works; I cannot deny the evidence in front of my eyes."
texts.zh:
"当然不了。"

她摆出一个并不完全友好的笑容。

"我也不会要求你这样做。这正是我想给你这么多周旋余地的原因 —— 让你能用你的方法来办事。正确的方法。你已经证明了你方法的可行性；我不能否认放在我眼前的证据。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Of course you are."

She smiles, and you almost believe it.

"That's why I asked you to help: the ability to set your feelings aside and view the situation objectively. You know what it takes to lead and to prevail. I've seen it."
texts.zh:
"当然了。"

她微笑着，你差点就相信她的说辞。

"这就是为什么我请你帮忙：你拥有将个人情感放在一旁，客观看待事态的能力。怎么带队，怎么取胜，你心里有数。我很清楚。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Ah, the skeptic; of course. As an intellectual, I respect that you don't simply accept my demands due to my authority. I wouldn't have called you here if I wanted an obsequious minion to leap at my every request. I already have those."

"To your question: you would miss out on the opportunity of your life."

She speaks almost casually, like it doesn't matter what you think. But there's an edge to her voice that suggests she does care, very much. "Whatever your feelings, first hear what I have to say and then consider - rationally - what is best. I am confident that you will discover that our interests align."

"So. Hear me out."
texts.zh:
"啊，怀疑主义者；当然。作为一个知识分子，我尊重你不因为我有权力就接受我的要求。如果我想要一个言听计从的谄媚奴才，我也不会叫你来。何况我不缺那种人。"

"现在来回答你的问题：你会错过一生仅有一次的机遇。"

她说得很随意，就像你怎么想并不重要。但她的声音里有一丝紧张，表明她确实在乎，非常在乎。"不管你怎么想，先听听我要说的，然后 —— 理性地 —— 考虑一下何为最佳。我相信你会发现我们的利益是一致的。"

"那么。请听我说完。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You have proven yourself to be... capable," she says.

"These people," she waves a hand to indicate the Galatia Academy, "are very good at very specific things over which they have obsessed all their lives. But they've kept themselves too long in the ivory tower. They're soft. The world is out there," her voice rises, "And we must change it."

She lowers her voice again, speaking directly to you, "And that is why I need you."
texts.zh:
"你已经证明自己...能力卓越。" 她开口说道。

"这些人，" 她单手一挥，暗指整个 Galatia 学院，"他们心无旁骛，在自己的专业领域有很高的造诣。然而，他们呆在象牙塔里闭门不出，久而久之就变得畏手畏脚，明明大千世界近在眼前。" 她的声音越发高亢，"因而，我们必须做出改变。"

她接着又把声音放低，直接对着你说道："那，就是我需要你的原因。"

texts.en:
"I imagine your self-interest would provide sufficient motivation. As you well know, we pay in credits. The prospect of the continuity of technological civilization is an added benefit, is it not?"

"Unless," she pauses, then looks at you over her AR-spex, speaking evenly, "I've gravely misjudged you, and your heart is set on liquidating your fleet, donating the proceeds to charity, and taking up with a flagellant order on Hesperus... no, I've got it- you've been doing a lot of reading; well, watching dark-channel holovids mostly- and have half a mind to enlist as a political enforcer smashing teeth in for the 1000-cycle reign of the 'Lion of Sindria'. Did I get it right?"

Your shields hold firm under the broadside of sarcasm deployed by the Provost.
texts.zh:
我觉得你的自身利益就是你最好的动力。你明明很懂，我们以信用点支付。反正对你来说，技术文明的传承和延续只是顺便，不是吗？

“除非...” 她顿了一下，一边隔着 AR 眼镜仔细打量着你，一边不紧不慢地说到，“除非我完全看错你了。搞不好其实你心意已决，打算彻底变卖你的舰队，把全部收益捐给施善会，然后去 Hesperus 加入某个自笞者修会...不，我懂了。你看了很多宣传，大部分都是什么地下频道里的全息视频之类的。你现在完全按耐不住自己想要加入政法部队的冲动，要为维护 “辛达瑞亚之狮” 的千年统治而大杀四方。我猜对了么？”

犹如用护盾牢牢地挡下了激烈的侧舷排炮火力一般，你面不改色地接下了院长的一连串冷嘲热讽。

texts.en:
"I imagine your self-interest will provide sufficient motivation. As you well know, we pay in credits. The prospect of the continuity of technological civilization is an added benefit, is it not?"

"Unless," she pauses, then looks at you over her AR-spex, speaking evenly, "I've gravely misjudged you, and your heart is set on liquidating your fleet, donating the proceeds to charity, and taking up with a flagellant order on Hesperus... no, I've got it- you've been doing a lot of reading; well, watching dark-channel holovids mostly- and have half a mind to enlist as a political enforcer smashing teeth in for the next 1000-cycle reign of some new 'Lion of Sindria'. Did I get it right?"

Your shields hold firm under the broadside of sarcasm deployed by the Provost.
texts.zh:
我觉得你的自身利益就是你最好的动力。你明明很懂，我们以信用点支付。反正对你来说，技术文明的传承和延续只是顺便，不是吗？

“除非...” 她顿了一下，一边隔着 AR 眼镜仔细打量着你，一边不紧不慢地说到，“除非我完全看错你了。搞不好其实你心意已决，打算彻底变卖你的舰队，把全部收益捐给施善会，然后去 Hesperus 加入某个自笞者修会...不，我懂了。你看了很多宣传，大部分都是什么地下频道里的全息视频之类的。你现在完全按耐不住自己想要加入政法部队的冲动，要为维护 “辛达瑞亚之狮” 的千年统治而大杀四方。我猜对了么？”

犹如用护盾牢牢地挡下了激烈的侧舷排炮火力一般，你面不改色地接下了院长的一连串冷嘲热讽。

texts.en: "Indeed." She leans back, interpreting your response as a stand-down.
texts.zh: "确实如此。" 她向后靠去，将你的回答视为一种退让。

options.en: Tell Dolos I found the sons.
options.zh: 转告 Dolos，我找到那几个儿子了。

texts.en:
An annoyed look flashes on his face.

"Wasting my time may be seen as hindering official duties of an officer of the Ministry of Internal Security which, in turn, may be treated as an act of terroristic insubordination and-"

He pauses, reaching for his ear. Indignant expression frozen.

"I-" His voice catches, and he clears his throat. The blood has drained from his face.

"Acknowledged. Forwarding comms."
texts.zh:
他脸上掠过一丝不耐。

"浪费我的时间，可视为妨碍内部安全部军官执行公务，而妨碍公务，又可视为恐怖性质的抗命行为，按律可——"

他忽然顿住，抬手摸向耳边，愤愤的表情僵在脸上。

"我——" 他嗓音一卡，清了清嗓子，脸上一下没了血色。

"明白。正在转接通讯。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
A silhouette appears.

Macario moves forward, revealing an amused smirk.

He moves to speak and an odd sound seems to escape from his mouth before he can contain it.

A cough; a pause. He looks up and begins again.

"My, my, we've been busy busy, Captain $playerLastName. I've been watching you, of course."

He inhales sharply. "Closely."
texts.zh:
一道剪影浮现出来。

Macario 向前一步，脸上挂着一抹似笑非笑。

他刚要开口，一声怪响没憋住先从嘴里溜了出来。

一声咳，一顿。他抬起头，重新来过。

"哎呀呀，可真够忙的，$playerLastName 舰长。我自然一直看着你呢。"

他猛地吸了口气。"看得紧紧的。"

options.en: I need to know what you're doing. What's your goal?
options.zh: 我得知道你在搞什么。你到底要什么？

options.en: I want you to leave me alone. I don't care about any of this.
options.zh: 别来烦我。这些事我根本不在乎。

options.en: I want you to pay me to forget about all of this...
options.zh: 想让我把这一切都忘干净，拿钱来...

options.en: Macario. We need to save the Sindrian Diktat - together.
options.zh: Macario。要救辛达强权，你我得联手。

options.en: Have you betrayed Philip Andrada? Are you behind the assassins?
options.zh: 你背叛了 Philip Andrada？那些刺客是你派来的？

options.en: I'm going to stop whatever you're doing, Dolos.
options.zh: 不管你在捣什么鬼，我都会拦下来，Dolos。

texts.en: "Shh, shh." He hushes you, like an infant. "Nothing you say matters. So much rotting air."
texts.zh: "嘘，嘘。\" 他像哄婴儿似的叫你别出声。\"你说什么都没分量。净是些发臭的废气。"

texts.en: "You lied to me, $playerName. Of course I could tell. Every time," his voice is thin, animated by hate. "You fool. You insect. You pathetic, faithless spacer."
texts.zh: "你对我撒了谎，$playerName。我当然看得出来。每一次都看得出来，\" 他的嗓音尖细，字字浸着恨意。\"蠢货。区区虫子。你这可悲又不忠的太空人。"

texts.en:
"You will receive what you deserve..."

He trails off, mouth hanging open. Idly, he wipes a drop of spittle with the sleeve of his uniform.

Then he turns away, as if he's forgotten he was talking to you.
texts.zh:
"你会得到你应得的..."

他的话断了，嘴还张着。他随手用制服袖子抹去嘴角一点唾沫。

随后他转过身去，像是已经忘了还在跟你说话。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: The comms go dark.
texts.zh: 通讯画面一黑。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

options.en: I've already confirmed all entries. They're real.
options.zh: 每一条我都核实过了。他们是真的。

texts.en:
"Good initiative, $titleHeg," he says, allowing himself to produce a surprised look. "Maybe I've grown to used to the Hegemony speed of doing things."

"Which, speaking of, brings me to the matter of some outfitting I had intended you receive to assist you in your investigation of the clones"
texts.zh:
"有主动精神，$titleHeg，\"他说，允许自己露出一点意外的神情。\"也许是我太习惯霸主办事的那个速度了。"

"说到这个，正好，我原本就打算给你一批装备补给，好协助你调查那些克隆体。"

options.en: Outfitting?

texts.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "Now about the clones."
texts.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"那么，说说那些克隆体。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en: He consider for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

options.en: What should I do?
Isn't... Ragnar Station a bit of a backwater?
options.zh: Ragnar 空间站...不算是有点偏僻吗？

options.en: I found Hector. Irkalla was a trap. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到了 Hector。Irkalla 是个陷阱。 (解释)

options.en: Achilles could be a problem. He's smart; navy-trained. And he keeps a cool head.
options.zh: Achilles 可能会是个麻烦。他聪明，受过海军训练，而且沉得住气。

options.en: Achilles could be a reformer. He'd be better for the Sector than Philip ever was.
options.zh: Achilles 说不定是个改革者。对这个星域来说，他会比 Philip 强得多。

options.en: Jason Andrada was on Qaras. He was dead when I arrived.
options.zh: Jason Andrada 在 Qaras 上。我赶到的时候他已经死了。

options.en: I found Pericles. Someone shot him.
options.zh: 我找到了 Pericles。有人开枪打死了他。

options.en: Let's talk about something else. (back)

texts.en:
"Find them," he says. "Didn't I say that already?"

"I don't think this is a pack of lies from Dolos Macario, not this time. But confirmation doesn't hurt. And I'd prefer it if someone with a little more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."
texts.zh:
"找出他们，\"他说，\"我不是已经说过了？"

"我不觉得这是 Dolos Macario 编的一整套谎话，这次不像。不过确认一下也没有坏处。而且我更希望派个比霸主一贯的'精锐'稍微懂点分寸的人去查，\"他拿起数据板，嫌恶地看了一眼，\"去查这一串穷乡僻壤。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en:
"You've done good work for the Hegemony," he says, and taps at his datapad. "For your trouble."

"And you're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主干得不错，\"他说着，在数据平板上敲了几下。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"而在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"You've served the Hegemony," he says, and taps the datapad. "For your trouble."

"You're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主效过力，\"他说着，敲了敲数据平板。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"Ragnar Complex," he corrects you. "I'm not posted here to enjoy myself, captain."

"This place," he gestures toward his surroundings, "has certain advantages. Foremost being that none of my former contingent from the Eventide class are particularly interested in taking this dishonorable post, nor are they asking to be invited for an official inspection of a fleet of mildly radioactive hulks."

He stares off into what you assume is a bulkhead, for a moment. Considering his alternatives, perhaps.

"Enough about me," he says finally.
texts.zh:
"是 Ragnar 综合设施，\"他纠正你，\"我被派到这儿可不是来享乐的，舰长。"

"这地方，\"他朝四周示意，\"有它的好处。最主要的是，我原先带的、从 Eventide 那个阶层出身的那批人，没谁特别想接这个不光彩的差事，也没谁主动要求被请来对一支轻度放射性的废船舰队做正式视察。"

他朝某个方向望了一会儿 —— 你猜那是一道舱壁。也许是在掂量自己还有别的什么出路。

"不说我了，"他最后说。

texts.en:
You explain about the automated defenses and the personalized, pre-recorded messages. Your name could have been subbed into his speeches by an algorithm, but you suspect this was meant for you.

Rao nods, listening.

"Think he's Macario's pick?"
texts.zh:
你讲了那些自动防御系统，以及那些针对个人预先录好的讯息。你的名字也许只是被算法替换进了他的演讲，但你怀疑那本是说给你听的。

Rao 点着头，听你说完。

"你觉得他是 Macario 选中的人？"

options.en: Probably. Hector seems to believe everything Macario told him.
options.zh: 多半是。Macario 说的每一句，Hector 似乎都信。

options.en: I'm not sure. Hector talks like a true believer in Andradism.
options.zh: 我不确定。Hector 说话的样子，像是个真心信仰 Andrada 主义的信徒。

options.en: I don't think so. Hector seems sheltered. How could he lead an empire?
options.zh: 我不这么认为。Hector 像是被养在温室里的人。他怎么可能领导一个帝国？

texts.en: "Just imagine," he says, then shakes his head.
texts.zh: "想想那会成什么样。"他说着，摇了摇头。

texts.en:
"If Macario had direct control over every aspect of his upbringing, and ensured that everything he knows is what Macario wishes for him to know... and never more than Macario himself."

Rao returns his speculative look to meet yours.

"This is good. We'll work with it."
texts.zh:
"如果 Macario 直接控制了他成长的每一个方面，确保他所知的一切都是 Macario 希望他知道的...而且绝不超过 Macario 本人所知的范围。"

Rao 收回审视的目光，与你对上视线。

"这很好。我们就按这个来做。"

options.en: How is this good?

texts.en:
"Put some kid raised in an asteroid eating nothing but Andradaism in charge of an empire?"

He smiles. Like someone who's seen their opponent's force disposition - and has a plan.

"Good work, $titleHeg."
texts.zh:
"让一个在小行星上长大、从小只吃 Andrada 主义那一套的孩子去掌管一个帝国？"

他笑了。像是已经看清了对手的兵力部署 —— 而且心里有了主意。

"干得好，$titleHeg。"

texts.en: "Would that not serve?" His tone is rhetorical.
texts.zh: "那样岂不更好？"他的语气是反问。

texts.en: "With the help of Dolos Macario, I expect," he says.
texts.zh: "我猜，是在 Dolos Macario 的扶助之下。"他说。

texts.en:
Rao grunts acknowledgement.

"From the sounds of it they've had that one in their pocket for a great many cycles. Fortuna Kato might have had Fleet Intel help at the start, might have not... It's not the worst case we anticipated, but it's close."

He idly squeezes one hand into a fist.

"Remember, $titleHeg, we don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
texts.zh:
Rao 哼了一声，表示知道了。

"听这情形，他们把那东西攥在手里已经很多个星历年了。Fortuna Kato 一开始也许得到过舰队情报部的协助，也许没有...这还不是我们预料中最糟的情况，但也差不远了。"

他随手攥紧一只拳头。

"记住，$titleHeg，我们不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

options.en: I understand and agree.
I understand and agree. (lie)
You may have to compromise at some point, admiral...
options.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将...

texts.en: He gives you a quick look, then nods, satisfied.
texts.zh: 他飞快地看了你一眼，然后点头，颇为满意。

texts.en: He gives you a long look, then nods, unsatisfied somehow.
texts.zh: 他久久地看着你，然后点头，却总像有些不满意。

texts.en:
"I'll leave this business of 'compromise' to the diplomats, $titleHeg." He says, emphasizing your presumed rank.

"This is not a matter open to discussion," he growls.
texts.zh:
"'妥协'这种事，我留给外交官去办，$titleHeg。"他说着，特意强调了你那个想当然的军衔。

"这件事没有商量的余地，"他低吼道。

texts.en:
Orcus gives you a baleful look. "I need not remind you of our position."

"We - the Hegemony - don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
texts.zh:
Orcus 阴冷地看了你一眼。"用不着我提醒你我们的处境。"

"我们 —— 霸主 —— 不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

options.en: I understand and agree.
I understand and agree. (lie)
You may have to compromise at some point, admiral.
options.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将。

texts.en: "Dead." Rao's expression doesn't change. "How?"
texts.zh: "死了。\"Rao 神色不变，\"怎么死的？"

options.en: Looks like an accidental shooting.

texts.en: "Looks like?"
texts.zh: "看起来像？"

options.en: It does. But there were... others trying to track down Jason. (explain)
options.zh: 确实像。但还有...别的人也在追查 Jason。 (解释)

texts.en: You explain how someone paid to have you questioned, and perhaps killed, by a local goon. It did not go well for said goon.
texts.zh: 你说明有人出钱，让当地一个混混来审问你，或许还要你的命。那个混混的下场不太好。

texts.en: A Diktat agent, or what appears to be one, paid for the job. You found their apartment, and a comms log of them paying for documents that confirm Jason's death. The agent then fled the planet.
texts.zh: 一名辛达强权的特工 —— 至少看起来是 —— 付了这笔钱。你找到了他的住处，还有一份通讯记录，显示他出钱买了确认 Jason 死亡的文件。之后那名特工逃出了这颗行星。

texts.en: You managed to catch their shuttle, you explain. And you explain about the hidden poison capsule, and their Sindrian Diktat uniform.
texts.zh: 你说明自己截住了他们的穿梭机，又说到那枚暗藏的毒囊，还有他们身上辛达强权的制服。

texts.en: "So who hired the hitman?"
texts.zh: "那杀手是谁雇的？"

texts.en:
"Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left is hiding."

Rao rubs his chin.

"At least he's off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
texts.zh:
"也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

Rao 摩挲着下巴。

"至少他出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

texts.en:
"An inside job, huh." Rao smirks, rubbing his chin. "Or maybe an attempt at one. Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left was hiding."

"At least he's off the board."
texts.zh:
"内部人干的，嗯。\"Rao 咧嘴一笑，摩挲着下巴，\"或者只是有人想这么干。也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

"至少他出局了。"

options.en: I don't know.

texts.en:
He blinks, giving you a questioning look.

"I'd think you would want to know who was trying to kill you, $titleHeg." Rao shrugs. "And I'd be interested in why."

"At least the kid is off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，疑惑地看着你。

"我以为你会想知道是谁想杀你，$titleHeg。\"Rao 耸耸肩，\"而我也想知道为什么。"

"至少那小子出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

texts.en: "Someone," Rao says, not quite asking a question. "Did you find out who?"
texts.zh: "有人干的，\"Rao 说，语气不太像在提问，\"查出是谁了吗？"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "for some reason, you tried to shoot Maeus Moroz."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He is," his look shifts to you for a moment, "or was, useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"出于某种原因，你试图对 Maeus Moroz 开枪。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他是个，\"他的目光在你身上停了一瞬，\"或者说，曾是个有用的人。"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you shot Maeus."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
texts.zh:

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

texts.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you destroyed the fleet of Maeus Moroz in space."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"你在太空里摧毁了 Maeus Moroz 的舰队。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

options.en: No. His... adoptive father, Maeus Moroz, didn't either.
options.zh: 没有。他的...养父 Maeus Moroz 也没查出来。

texts.en:
His look hardens into a warning.

"You're asking a dangerous question, $titleHeg. In this business I should think you would know better than that."
texts.zh:
他的眼神沉下来，成了警告。

"你在问一个危险的问题，$titleHeg。干我们这行，我以为你该比这更懂分寸。"

options.en: I understand.
I just need to know what you're doing so I can do my job.
options.zh: 我只是需要知道你在做什么，好让我能办我的事。

options.en: I'm not here to act as your assassin, Orcus.
options.zh: 我不是来给你当刺客的，Orcus。

texts.en: "Good. We'll speak no more of it."
texts.zh: "很好。这件事到此为止。"

texts.en:
"You 'need to know' enough to do your part, $titleHeg," he says. "And no more. This is the Hegemony and that is how this works here."

"Take a shift to cool off," he says, dismissing you as he reaches for the comms cut-off. "The discussion is over. We will not speak of it again."

The link snaps to a Hegemony crest.
texts.zh:
"你知道的'足够'让你做好你那份事就够了，$titleHeg，\"他说，\"不能更多。这里是霸主，这里的规矩就是这样。"

"去轮一班岗，冷静一下，\"他说着伸手去切通讯，把你打发了，\"谈话结束了。这件事我们不会再提。"

通讯一断，画面定格在霸主的徽记上。

His eyes lock on to you. The question is all in his look.

texts.en:
"My organization... would like to ensure that you are able to investigate these files." He pauses, picking up a datapad. "As a free agent, naturally, under no particular orders from Fleet Intelligence."

"To those ends, I must inform you that we have discovered a storage bay - under your name - which contains supplies and fuel."

He sets the datapad down and puts his hands together, the very image of professionalism.
texts.zh:
"我所在的机构...希望确保你有条件去查清这些文件。\"他顿了顿，拿起一块数据板。\"当然是以自由行动者的身份，不受舰队情报部的任何具体指令。"

"为此，我必须告知你：我们发现了一个登记在你名下的储藏舱，里面备有补给与燃料。"

他放下数据板，双手交叠，一副十足的职业做派。

texts.en:
"Hector and..." He pauses, and makes a small gesture with one hand.

"And whoever will stand against him. Askonia will suffer, again. One hopes it will not spread."
texts.zh:
"Hector 还有..."他顿了顿，一只手做了个不大的手势。

"还有所有会站出来对抗他的人。Askonia 又要遭难了。但愿这场祸事不会蔓延。"

options.en: Are you doing something to stop it?
options.zh: 你们在做些什么来阻止它吗？

options.en: Can it be stopped?
If there's a war, I intend to win it.
options.zh: 若真有战争，我要赢下它。

texts.en:
His half-smile dims.

"At this point I believe that stopping it is beyond the range of scenarios we shall see play out. But trust that all my efforts shall be to the security and safety of the Persean League - and, indeed, the entire Sector."

"Whether you believe that," his expression is ironic, "depends on many things, of course. But I must content myself with saying so."
texts.zh:
他的半笑淡了下去。

"到了这一步，我认为阻止它已不在我们所能看到的那些可能之内。但请相信，我所做的一切都是为了英仙座联盟的安全 —— 也是为了整个星域。"

"你信不信这话，\"他神情带着讥诮，\"自然取决于许多东西。但我只能把话说到这里。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow, his amused half-smile firmly in place.

"A spirited assertion, but that may not be up to you. War is a sort of negotiation, $titlePL, and direct force is but one aspect."

He gives you an indulgent look. "But you don't need me to tell you that. You are successful and... potent."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉，那副带着玩味的半笑稳稳挂着。

"说得有气势，可这恐怕不由你说了算。战争是一种谈判，$titlePL，直接动武只是其中一个方面。"

他宽容地看了你一眼。"不过这话不必我来告诉你。你的事业有成，而且...手段了得。"

texts.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力。"

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

I serve the Persean League - and the Prime Demarchon is the foremost executive servant of the League, and it is to him I report concerning certain... critical matters."

"It is my duty," he concludes, somewhat crisply.
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力 —— 而大统领是联盟最高层的行政长官，某些...关键事务，我正是向他汇报。"

"这是我的职责，"他收尾时语气颇为干脆。

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

texts.en:
"Officially," he says, "I shall make no recommendation regarding your involvement into the alleged contents of these files in accordance with present Persean League policy of non-intervention in matters regarding... certain trade partners, as guided by our executive leadership."

He puts his hands together, clearing his throat, and pauses for a moment. Then looks up at you.
texts.zh:
"就官方而言，\"他说，\"对你是否介入这些文件所称的内容，我不作任何建议。按英仙座联盟现行政策，凡涉及...某些贸易伙伴之事，一律不予干预 —— 此为我们的行政领导层所定。"

他双手交叠，清了清嗓子，停了一停，然后抬眼看你。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You have made a career of taking independent initiative. With provocative results. I will follow your actions with great interest and assist in defending the stability and security of the Persean League now and in the future."

The holo flickers for a moment, but you'd swear he winked.
texts.zh:
"你这一路走来，靠的就是自行其是。结果也足够惹眼。我会密切关注你的行动，并为捍卫英仙座联盟眼下与将来的稳定和安全提供协助。"

全息影像闪了一下，但你敢发誓，他眨了下眼。

options.en: I think I understand.

texts.en:
"That is alleged."

Siyavong's expression tightens.
texts.zh:
"那只是指控。"

Siyavong 的神情绷紧了。

options.en: It says you - your organization - knows about him. And intervened.
options.zh: 文件里说，你 —— 你的机构 —— 知道他的事，而且插了手。

texts.en:
"How interesting," he says as if he isn't interested at all.

"I will only comment that, in general terms, it is my duty to protect citizens of the Persean League." A pause. "Whatever their alleged genetic source."
texts.zh:
"有意思，"他说这话时仿佛一点也不觉得有意思。

"我只说一点，泛泛而论：保护英仙座联盟的公民是我的职责。\"一顿。\"无论他们所称的基因来源是什么。"

options.en: I'm going to find him and speak with him.
So he's safe?
I'll ask no more about him. For now.
options.zh: 关于他的事我不再多问。至少现在不问。

texts.en: "I will not stand in the way of the free association of citizens of the Persean League," he says.
texts.zh: "我不会妨碍英仙座联盟公民之间的自由交往，"他说。

texts.en: Saying nothing, he nods very slowly.
texts.zh: 他什么也没说，只是极缓地点了点头。

texts.en: "Good."
texts.zh: "很好。"

texts.en:
"I suspect you are correct, captain," Siyavong says. He is not overtly worried about the notion, by all appearances.

"And even if we did not see evidence, it is the first reaction I would anticipate from... many interested parties."
texts.zh:
"我猜你说得对，舰长，"Siyavong 说。从表面上看，他并不为这个念头担忧。

"就算我们看不到证据，这也是我能想到的...许多有关各方的第一反应。"

texts.en: "If that satisfaction might quell your insistence, then I suppose we must," he says, looking unimpressed.
texts.zh: "如果这点满足能让你不再坚持，那我想我们也只能如此，"他说，看起来并不买账。

texts.en:
He coughs, falsely. "Now this was an illuminating aside," Siyavong says with a distinct undercurrent of annoyance.

"Let's move toward a less gruesome topic, shall we?"
texts.zh:
他假咳了一声。"这一岔话倒真是让人长了见识，"Siyavong 说，底下明显压着一层恼意。

"我们换个不那么血腥的话题，好吗？"

options.en: Do you know who is doing it?
Do you want me to confront Admiral Rao?
options.zh: 你要我去当面质问 Rao 上将？

options.en: Is League Fleet Intelligence targeting Andradas?
options.zh: 是联盟舰队情报部在针对 Andrada 家的人？

options.en: Would you like me to take out the Andradas?
options.zh: 要不要我把 Andrada 家的人一个个除掉？

options.en: Let's talk about something else.

texts.en:
"Specifically? In some cases. There are many assassins and mere murderers-for-hire in the Persean Sector."

"Who sees that they are paid, and by whom, and who allows it? Those are more difficult questions with more complex answers."

He raises a palm at you.

"Allow me to draw a hypothetical."
texts.zh:
"具体而言？有些是。英仙座星域里从来不缺刺客，也不缺只图钱的杀手。"

"谁负责付钱、付给谁、谁又默许这一切？这些问题更难，答案也更复杂。"

他朝你抬起一只手。

"让我假设一种情形。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"The Hegemony considers the Sindrian Diktat as fundamentally criminal in the highest degree - Philip Andrada is mutiny embodied. Agents of the Hegemony - and those who gives orders to said agents, say one Orcus Rao who is busier by far than an admiral assigned to a holding-before-retirement posting ought to be - will seek to undermine Andradism by any means available."

"Ideally they'd put Andrada on trial, have a full show of 'legitimacy' of the laws of the Human Domain and so forth."

"Not so easily arranged, as you may imagine. And now Andrada has produced clones to inherit his mutinous polity?" Siyavong shakes his head in mock-sympathy. "A clone is not guilty of the father's crimes. And yet..."
texts.zh:
"在霸主看来，辛达强权从根子上就是最高等级的犯罪 —— Philip Andrada 本身就是叛乱的化身。霸主的特工，以及给这些特工下命令的人 —— 比如那位 Orcus Rao，他忙得远超过一个被安排到退休前闲置职位上的上将该有的程度 —— 会想尽一切手段挖空 Andrada 主义。"

"最理想的做法是把 Andrada 送上法庭，把人之领律法的【合法性】好好演上一场，诸如此类。"

"当然，这事没那么容易办成，你大概也想得到。况且如今 Andrada 还造出了克隆体，要继承他那个叛逆的政体？\"Siyavong 装出一副同情的样子摇了摇头。\"克隆体并没有犯下父亲的罪。可话又说回来..."

options.en: You're suggesting that Orcus Rao has ordered illegal assassinations?
options.zh: 你是在说 Orcus Rao 下令进行非法暗杀？

texts.en:
"Clearly he has," Siyavong says, matter-of-fact, "ever."

"Of our Andrada clones, however? I could not provide you with hard evidence of it."

"Could he? Would he? Yes and yes. Did he?"

His knowing smile reforms.
texts.zh:
"显然有，\"Siyavong 说，语气平淡，\"从来都有。"

"不过说到我们这些 Andrada 克隆体？我拿不出确凿的证据。"

"他做得到吗？他会做吗？两个问题的答案都是肯定的。那他做了吗？"

他那副心知肚明的笑容又挂了起来。

texts.en:
His brow furrows.

"Would you not, please? It is... unnecessary."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉头。

"能不能请你别去？这...没有必要。"

options.en: I understand.
If you insist, then I won't confront Orcus Rao. (lie)
options.zh: 既然你坚持，那我就不去质问 Orcus Rao 了。 (说谎)

texts.en: He gives you a look meant to hide a vast skepticism.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼，那眼神是要掩住满腹的怀疑。

texts.en: He gives you a concerned look.
texts.zh: 他有些担忧地看了你一眼。

texts.en:
"Fleet Intelligence? No."

He gives you a warning look.

"And it would be impolitic for me to participate in speculation about certain other parties within the Persean League. Whatever you may choose to believe, I am bound by certain legal strictures as concerns citizens of the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"舰队情报部？不是。"

他给了你一个警告的眼神。

"再者，参与对英仙座联盟内某些其他势力的揣测，对我而言并不明智。不管你愿意相信什么，凡涉及英仙座联盟公民，我都要受某些法律条文的约束。"

options.en: But the Gens are not?

texts.en:
He drops his hint of a smile.

"I said no such thing and I would thank you not to share irresponsible 'deductions' of this sort."

"Perhaps another topic interests you, captain?"
texts.zh:
他连那点笑意也收了起来。

"我没说过这种话。这类不负责任的【推断】，还请你别到处去讲。"

"也许你更想聊点别的，舰长？"

texts.en:
"No, thank you," he says, uncomfortably. "I don't believe that would be helpful at this juncture."

He produces a strained smile.

"It was thoughtful of you to ask before... anything."
texts.zh:
"不了，谢谢，\"他说，有些不自在。\"我不认为在目前这个节骨眼上，那样做会有什么好处。"

他挤出一个勉强的笑。

"你能在做任何事之前先来问一声... 想得很周到。"

texts.en: "Please," he says.
texts.zh: "拜托了，"他说。

texts.en:
"We don't," Siyavong says. "The word you'll find for the situation is 'fraught' due, as per our previous conversation, various factors."

He gives you a cool look.

"Have patience."
texts.zh:
"我们不知道，\"Siyavong 说。\"你会用来形容这局面的词是【棘手】—— 原因嘛，如我们上次所谈，种种因素叠加。"

他冷冷地看了你一眼。

"耐心些。"

options.en: Patience for what?
For Achilles to make his move?

texts.en:
"You'll know."

He re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
"到时候你就知道。"

他重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

Then re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
他什么也没说。

然后重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
You elaborate about the palatial asteroid, Hector's words, and the trap he left for you.

"So Hector is his pick." He nods to himself. "And how long has it been so, I wonder, with all the recent... stirrings."

He puts his hands together, polite and collected. "I do not imagine Macario's influence has improved Hector's character. There'll be a war before this is over, that much is clear."
texts.zh:
你把那座宫殿般的岩质小行星、Hector 的话，还有他给你设下的那个圈套，都讲了一遍。

"所以 Hector 才是他的选择。\"他自顾自地点了点头。\"我倒想知道，最近这些...骚动之下，这种局面已经持续多久了。"

他把双手叠在一起，礼貌而镇定。"我不觉得 Macario 的插手会让 Hector 的品性变好。这事了结之前必有一战，这一点很清楚。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says. "Perhaps more than you."

"You understand there was an attack? Several assassins. Armed."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，\"他说。\"也许比你知道得还多。"

"你该明白，那是一次袭击。好几名刺客，全副武装。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says.

"It could have gone rather worse, don't you think? Poor timing, nonetheless."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，"他说。

"本来可能会糟得多，你不觉得吗？话虽如此，这时机实在不巧。"

texts.en:
"We know," he says. "It could not have gone much worse, I would say. Very poor timing on your part."

Siyavong watches you.

"At least you survived the attack."
texts.zh:
"我们知道，\"他说。\"依我看，事情糟得不能再糟了。你挑的时机实在不巧。"

Siyavong 看着你。

"至少你在那场袭击里活了下来。"

options.en: Um. Is he alright?
At least that.
Are you implying I was involved?
options.zh: 你是在暗示这事跟我有关？

options.en: That's one less Andrada clone to menace the Sector.
options.zh: 星域里少了一个祸害人的 Andrada 克隆体。

texts.en:
He says nothing for a couple seconds. Then looks away.

"No. He is not." His eyes meet yours. "The details are considered classified. But you may assume that he is not relevant to the crisis growing in Askonia."
texts.zh:
他沉默了几秒，然后把目光移开。

"不。他不好。\"他直视你的眼睛。\"细节属于机密。不过你可以认为，他已与 Askonia 日益扩大的危机无关了。"

texts.en:
"Indeed. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"的确。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"More than that, $playerSirOrMadam. Because of course you were involved - you were right beside Hercules as he was killed."

Then he lets it go.

"But no, we understand the situation. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"不止如此，$playerSirOrMadam。因为你当然牵涉其中 —— Hercules 被杀的时候，你就在他旁边。"

然后他松了口。

"不过算了，我们了解情况。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"That is one way of looking at it," he says with frictionless self-control. "I was relieved, of course, to hear you were entirely unharmed."

"I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming about the details of the situation, particularly given the Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy..."

He puts his hands together neatly. "In any case, Provost Baird appreciates that interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."
texts.zh:
"也可以这么说，\"他说，克制得滴水不漏。\"听说你毫发无伤，我当然松了口气。"

"我不能说安全主管把事情的细节讲得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的人在场..."

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。"无论如何，Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

options.en: I told him to trust Provost Baird.
options.zh: 我让他去信 Baird 院长。

options.en: I let Provost Baird take care of him.
options.zh: 我把他交给 Baird 院长照看。

options.en: I told Hercules the Persean League would protect him. Did he contact you?
options.zh: 我告诉 Hercules，英仙座联盟会保护他。他联系过你们吗？

options.en: I told him to talk to the hacker, Gargoyle, to help him escape.
options.zh: 我让他去找那个黑客 Gargoyle，想办法脱身。

options.en: I offered him asylum on my own colony.
options.zh: 我提出可以让他在我自己的殖民地上避难。

options.en: I gave him credits to help him escape.
options.zh: 我给了他一笔星币，帮他逃走。

options.en: Well. Hope he's doing okay...

texts.en:
Siyavong does something halfway between taking a deep breath and a sigh.

"Interesting," he says after a moment.
texts.zh:
Siyavong 做了个介于深吸气与叹气之间的动作。

"有意思，"他过了一会才说。

options.en: Why is that interesting?

texts.en: "I don't know, captain," he says with exacting neutrality. "I'm sure we'll find out before long. Perhaps."
texts.zh: "我不知道，舰长，\"他说，语气中立得一丝不苟。\"我想不用多久就会知道了。也许吧。"

texts.en:
Siyavong's half-smile fades somewhat.

"No. He's disappeared."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 脸上那点半笑淡了下去。

"不。他不见了。"

options.en: Disappeared as in dead, or...

texts.en: He looks at you for a long moment. You can see the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes.
texts.zh: 他久久地看着你。你能看见他眼角的皱纹。

texts.en: "I couldn't say."
texts.zh: "我说不好。"

texts.en:
Something small breaks. Finlay's smile drops.

"Hercules is dead, captain. Targeted killing. He made it as far as Ancyra. Same organization as the first attempt - behind the proverbial trigger, that is. The identity of the client is less certain."
texts.zh:
某样很小的东西碎了。Finlay 的笑容落了下去。

"Hercules 死了，舰长。是定点清除。他一路逃到了 Ancyra。还是同一个组织，和第一次动手的那批人一样 —— 扣下扳机的那些。至于委托人是谁，就不那么确定了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He rubs one of his eyes.

"I liked him. Hercules. He seemed like a thoughtful young man."
texts.zh:
他揉了揉一只眼睛。

"我挺喜欢他。Hercules。看着像个有想法的年轻人。"

options.en: Why are you telling me this?
He was an Andrada.
I liked him too.

texts.en:
Siyavong taps something on his console, then adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"I don't believe I said anything. Now, where we were?"
texts.zh:
Siyavong 在控制台上点了点什么，然后调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我想我什么也没说过。那么，我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
"Indeed."

Siyavong adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"Where were we?"
texts.zh:
"的确。"

Siyavong 调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
He nods, looking down.

"So. Where were we."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，垂着眼。

"那么。我们刚才说到哪儿了。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting? Why?

texts.en:
"It explains why we can't find Hercules."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么我们找不到 Hercules。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting why?

texts.en:
"It explains why he booked transport to where he did."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么他订了去那个地方的船票。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en: "Ah." Siyavong's eyes light up. "That explains it."
texts.zh: "啊。\"Siyavong 的眼睛亮了起来。\"这就说得通了。"

options.en: That explains what?

texts.en:
"Yes," Siyavong says with no particular emphasis.

He watches you closely.
texts.zh:
"是，"Siyavong 说，语气听不出任何强调。

他紧紧地看着你。

texts.en:
Your inquiry is rapidly answered.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. No change in the situation. Operation is ongoing."
texts.zh:
你的询问很快得到了答复。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。情况没有变化。行动仍在进行。"

options.en: Good. Keep it up and tell me if you find anything.
options.zh: 很好。继续，有发现就报我。

options.en: I want you to go quiet, don't attract attention. But keep the line open if he comms.
options.zh: 我要你们静下来，别引人注意。但他要是来通讯，线得通着。

texts.en: "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam. Will do."
texts.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam。照办。"

options.en: Cut the link

texts.en:
Nothing, then, from Hercules. Wherever he is.

If he's even still alive.
texts.zh:
那么，Hercules 那边什么也没有。不管他身在何处。

如果他还活着的话。

texts.en: "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam. Will do."
texts.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam。照办。"

options.en: Cut the link

texts.en:
Your inquiry is rapidly answered.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Successful contact was initiated by the subject and pick-up arrangements were made." A nervous look. "It was a short timescale, very recent... we had to act before we could confirm with you."

"But he didn't show. No further contact attempt was made. And no hard confirmation on who contacted us - they just... claimed to be Hercules. Text only. We have no additional information on the situation."
texts.zh:
你的询问很快得到了答复。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。目标主动发起了通讯，联系成功，接应安排也已定下。\"对方不安地瞥了一眼。\"时间非常紧，就在不久前...我们来不及先向你确认就动手了。"

"可他没有出现。之后也没再尝试联系。而且我们无法确认对方是谁——那人只是...自称 Hercules。只有文字。关于目前的情况，我们没有更多情报。"

options.en: You acted appropriately. Continue the operation, but be very careful.
options.zh: 你们的处置是对的。行动继续，但务必谨慎。

options.en: Disappointing. I want to be contacted as soon as anything changes!
options.zh: 让人失望。一有变化，立刻通知我！

texts.en: "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam. Will do."
texts.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam。照办。"

options.en: Cut the link

texts.en: "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam. Acknowledged. Will do."
texts.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam。明白。照办。"

options.en: Cut the link
Yes.

texts.en: She nods, and puts her fist under her chin. Eyes closed, thinking. But only for a moment.
texts.zh: 她点了点头，一拳抵住下巴。闭上眼，思索。但只有片刻。

texts.en:
"I can deploy a fleet to battle, balance my sabotaged logistics." It seems like she's speaking to herself. "This..."

Hyder trails off. Eyes searching. Like she can't bring herself to ask.

The next step.
texts.zh:
"我可以派一支舰队去作战，可以平衡被人动了手脚的后勤。\"听上去她像是在自言自语。\"可这个..."

Hyder 话音渐止。目光四下搜寻。像是怎么也开不了口问出来。

下一步。

texts.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
texts.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

texts.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
texts.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

options.en: Let me be candid - Orcus Rao sent me to discover your intentions.
options.zh: 我就直说了——Orcus Rao 派我来探你的意图。

options.en: Another clone, heir, then. One could be a man of character and ability.
options.zh: 那就换个克隆体，换个继承人。总该有一个是有品性、有本事的。

options.en: Maybe a schemer. A spymaster, a sneak, a rogue. Everything you're not.
options.zh: 也许要个阴谋家。一个间谍头子、一个暗探、一个无赖。所有你不是的东西。

options.en: I suspect Macario plans to eliminate you. You've got to be ready.
options.zh: 我怀疑 Macario 打算除掉你。你得做好准备。

options.en: This is your chance! If you seize the initiative, you could become Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 这是你的机会！只要抓住先机，你就能成为最高元首。

options.en: Turn yourself over to the Hegemony. I'll get Orcus Rao's assurance of a fair trial. Maybe a deal.
options.zh: 向霸主自首。我会拿到 Orcus Rao 的保证，给你一场公正的审判。也许还能谈个交易。

options.en: Turn yourself in to the Hegemony. You'll get a fair trial, or a deal from... from Orcus Rao.
options.zh: 向霸主自首。你会得到公正的审判，或者...或者从 Orcus Rao 那里得到一个交易。

options.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Achilles Andrada. (explain)
options.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Achilles Andrada。 (解释)

options.en: You should back Achilles Andrada. He is the better man.
options.zh: 你应该支持 Achilles Andrada。他才是更合适的人。

options.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Hector Andrada. (explain)
options.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Hector Andrada。 (解释)

options.en: You must stand by Hector Andrada. He is the rightful heir.
options.zh: 你必须站在 Hector Andrada 这边。他才是名正言顺的继承人。

options.en: Duty and honor above all. Stand by your oath to the Sindrian Diktat!
options.zh: 责任与荣誉高于一切。守住你对辛达强权的誓言！

options.en: I'm not here to tell you what to do. Just a warning about what is to come.
options.zh: 我不是来教你怎么做的。只是提醒你，接下来要发生什么。

texts.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
texts.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

options.en: Maybe. But his loyalty to the Hegemony is greater than his hatred for you.
options.zh: 也许。但他对霸主的忠诚，胜过对你的恨意。

options.en: It doesn't matter what he thinks. It matters what you are going to do.
options.zh: 他怎么想无关紧要。重要的是你打算怎么做。

texts.en:
She looks into the feed.

"And what good does that do me?"
texts.zh:
她望向通讯画面。

"那对我有什么好处？"

texts.en:
"Yes." She looks directly into the feed.

Uncertain. And working hard not to show it.
texts.zh:
"是。"她直直望向通讯画面。

心里没底。而且正竭力不露出来。

texts.en: "Who did you have in mind?" She looks skeptical.
texts.zh: "你心里想的是谁？"她神情怀疑。

options.en: Hercules. A historian. Young, but... he's smart, and stable.
options.zh: Hercules。一个历史学者。年轻，可是...他聪明，也稳重。

options.en: I'm, uh, not sure. It was just a thought.
options.zh: 我，呃，还没想好。只是随口一提。

texts.en:
"A historian?"

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh:
"历史学者？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

texts.en:
"An academician."

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh:
"一位院士？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

texts.en: "How many capital ships does he have?"
texts.zh: "他手上有多少主力舰？"

options.en: Well... zero. So far.

texts.en:
Her expression doesn't visibly change, but somehow Hyder looks even less impressed now than she did before.

She closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose, as if warding off an impending headache.
texts.zh:
她的表情看不出变化，可 Hyder 现在似乎比刚才更不以为然了。

她闭上眼，揉了揉鼻梁，像是在压住一场快要发作的头痛。

texts.en: She doesn't look impressed.
texts.zh: 她看上去并不以为然。

texts.en: Hyder folds her arms, giving you an impatient look.
texts.zh: Hyder 抱起双臂，不耐烦地看着你。

texts.en:
She looks entirely skeptical of the notion.

"Elaborate."
texts.zh:
她对这个说法显然满心怀疑。

"说下去。"

options.en: K-O Jove. He's a sort of information broker and spy on Qaras...
options.zh: K-O Jove。他算是 Qaras 上的情报贩子，也干间谍的活儿...

options.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
options.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

options.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
options.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

options.en: Faro Inesis. He's... an agent, of sorts, for an arm of Tri-Tachyon. He'll do it for credits.
options.zh: Faro Inesis。他算是...速子科技某个分支机构的代理人。给星币他就办事。

options.en: Finlay Siyavong. He's a Persean League agent...
options.zh: Finlay Siyavong。他是英仙座联盟的特工...

options.en: Arnaud Iscare. He's a reputable Charterist...
options.zh: Arnaud Iscare。他是个口碑不错的宪章派...

options.en: Perhaps this wasn't such a good idea...
options.zh: 也许这主意本来就不怎么样...

texts.en:
"A criminal and a pirate, you mean," she says, interrupting. "From Qaras, a notorious and lawless gathering of spacer trash of the worst kind."

"I'll hear no more of it."
texts.zh:
"你是说，一个罪犯、一个海盗，\"她打断你。\"从 Qaras 来的——那地方声名狼藉、无法无天，聚着最下等的太空渣滓。"

"这事我不想再听了。"

texts.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
texts.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

texts.en: "The Hegemony already sentenced me for... mutiny," she speaks robotically. "They abhor mutiny, as well they should."
texts.zh: "霸主已经以...叛乱罪判过我，\"她机械地说。\"他们痛恨叛乱，这理所应当。"

options.en: Let me try. I'll speak to him, get a deal.
options.zh: 让我试试。我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。

options.en: I'll speak to him, get a deal. Anything is possible.
options.zh: 我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。什么事都有可能。

texts.en:
Hyder takes a deep breath, composing herself.

"I will hear your offer. But I agree to nothing."
texts.zh:
Hyder 深吸一口气，稳住心神。

"你的提议我可以听。但我什么都没答应。"

options.en: In the meantime, watch yourself. Macario...

texts.en:
She places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank you captain, your report will be given due consideration by the appropriate authorities. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."

Her expression is grimly neutral.

"That will be all."
texts.zh:
她双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长。你的报告会由有关部门予以适当考虑。荣耀归于辛达强权。"

她的神情冷硬，毫无波澜。

"就到这里。"

texts.en: Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.
texts.zh: 你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

texts.en:
"This'll take a minute," says Tech. "It's big. Don't know what Rao's cooked up, considering, uh."

With an apologetic look your tech officer shuts up and adopts a stiff at-attention posture as if to make up for the breach of protocol.
texts.zh:
"这要花上一分钟，\"技术官说，\"东西很大。考虑到眼下的情况，真不知道 Rao 都捣鼓了些什么，呃。"

你的技术军官带着歉意看了你一眼，闭上嘴，摆出一副僵硬的立正姿势，仿佛想以此弥补方才的失礼。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"That's it, ah, $playerSirOrMadam," Tech reports. "Confirmation ping returns true. Lots of traffic..."

A quick salute and they retreat to their post in a secondary ops-lab.
texts.zh:

一个干脆的敬礼之后，他们退回了副行动室的岗位。

texts.en:
The connection stutters through a series of hyperwave adjustment cycles, then proceeds to a holding signal- awaiting pickup.

After a moment, Hyder herself appears, at attention.

A look of shock flashes across her face as she registers it is indeed you she is looking at, not a lieutenant star marshal ensconced in the star fortress orbiting Sindria, as she expected.
texts.zh:
连接在一连串超波校准周期中卡顿地推进，随后转入等待接通的保持信号。

片刻之后，Hyder 本人出现在画面中，站得笔直。

当她看清屏幕对面确实是你，而不是她预想中那位驻守 Sindria 轨道恒星要塞的低阶星际元帅时，脸上闪过一丝震惊。

options.en: Deputy Star Marshal Hyder. We have much to discuss.
options.zh: 副星际元帅 Hyder。我们有很多事要谈。

options.en: Hi, remember me?

texts.en: She swats the privacy field control, and a vague blurriness grows around her.
texts.zh: 她啪地拍下隐私场控制键，一层朦胧的模糊在她周围弥漫开来。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you all but declared yourself Supreme Executor the last time we spoke. You have no tact and less honor. You're nothing but Macario's pet imp, sent to tempt and corrupt."

"And now, what has happened? He's cut you loose? Declared you terrorist and murderer - for all I know it's true. Maybe it doesn't-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得上次谈话时，你几乎就要自封最高元首了。你毫无分寸，更无荣誉可言。你不过是 Macario 养的一只小恶魔，被派来引诱和腐蚀别人。"

"现在呢，出什么事了？他把你甩了？宣布你是恐怖分子和杀人犯——就我所知，这或许是真的。也许这并不——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you were Macario's lickspittle. Now he's cut you loose, it appears. Declared you his nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"I don't trust a word you-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得你是 Macario 的跟屁虫。现在看样子，他把你甩了。宣布你是他的死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"你说的每一个字我都不信——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"You." She spits the word. "Macario's lickspittle."

"I see he's cut you loose, declared you his nemesis. A terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"Now you hack our comms? Not only do you have no honor, you waste your-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
texts.zh:
"你。\"她把这个字吐了出来，\"Macario 的跟屁虫。"

"我看出来了，他把你甩了，宣布你是他的死敌。恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"现在你还来黑我们的通讯？你不但毫无荣誉，还白白浪费你的——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

texts.en:
"Last we spoke you were acting as Macario's minion. Now you're declared his arch-nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. To speak with you is treason."

"Was betrayal your reward? Not that I believe Dolos, of course."

Her expression doesn't soften.

"Not the way he tells it, anyway. Were the killings just a job? Or are you another convenient Spider's patsy whose worth is spent?"
texts.zh:
"上次我们说话时，你还是 Macario 的走狗。如今你被宣布为他的头号死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。跟你说话就是叛国。"

"背叛就是你的报酬？当然，我并不相信 Dolos 的说辞。"

她的神色没有缓和。

"至少不像他说的那样。那些谋杀只是一桩差事吗？还是说，你又是蜘蛛随手用完即弃的替罪羊，价值已经耗尽？"

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName." She pauses, then takes a deep breath.

"I do not believe Macario. At least, I don't believe whatever has happened went the way he tells it. The entire announcement... secret heirs, after all this time?"

She looks at you, suspicious, but clearly wanting answers.
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"她顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario。至少，我不信发生的一切真像他说的那样。整场宣告...秘密继承人，过了这么久才冒出来？"

她看着你，满腹狐疑，可显然是在等一个答案。

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "...secret heirs, hidden conspiracies suddenly revealed? After all this time?"
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"...秘密继承人、暗藏的阴谋突然被揭穿？过了这么多年？"

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "if the files you gave me are all true..."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"要是你给我的那些档案都是真的..."

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"Much has happened. Philip, declared dead. Macario presenting this... clone of Philip as successor. Your files were real."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"发生了很多事。Philip，被宣布死亡。Macario 把 Philip 的...那个克隆体推出来当继承人。你的档案是真的。"
