"重武器。补给。星币。\" 她一笑。\"若圣灵催你行这份善举的话。"

texts.en: She dips her head. "And I would like to accept your help, with thanks and prayer."
texts.zh: 她欠了欠身。"你的援手，我领了，连同谢意与祷告一并收下。"

texts.en: "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat are no longer so inpenetrable as they once were thanks to the heavy weapons you've provided to the fighting Faithful."
texts.zh: "多亏你给奋战的信众送来的那些重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器，再不像从前那般牢不可破了。"

texts.en: "The credits you've already provided allow us great flexibility in our operations. All and sundry must be purchased - and smuggled - to say nothing of bribing the faithless servants of Andrada.
texts.zh: "你先前给的那些星币，让我们的行事宽绰了不少。样样杂件都得买进来 —— 还得偷运进来 —— 更别提拿钱去打通 Andrada 那些不信神的爪牙了。"

texts.en: "The supplies you've given to the Self Defense Covenant feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and... gives us time." She clasps her hands together. "When the time is right, our righteous uprising will break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun."
texts.zh: "你给自卫公约的补给，让饥者得食、伤者得治，还...替我们争来了时间。\" 她双手合十。\"待时机一到，我们这场义举便会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。"

texts.en: "The supplies you've given to the Self Defense Covenant will feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and give us time." She clasps her hands together. "Our righteous uprising even now breaks open the darkness like the dawning of the sun."
texts.zh: "你给自卫公约的补给，将让饥者得食、伤者得治，替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"我们这场义举此刻正像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。"

options.en: Give 50 units of heavy armaments
Give 100,000 credits
Give 250 units of supplies
Maybe another time.

texts.en:
"You give us hammer and sword alike, captain," she says. "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat shall prove less inpenetrable than the Lion might wish thanks to these heavy weapons."

"Take care for yourself also. A cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"舰长，锤与剑你都一并给了我们，\" 她说道。\"有了这批重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器，怕是再不会如辛达瑞亚之狮所愿那般牢不可破。"

"你自己也当心。这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

texts.en:
"You provide us hammer and sword alike, captain," she says. "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat - whether by one name or another - shall prove themselves less inpenetrable than the Lion's cubs might wish thanks to these heavy weapons."

"Take care for yourself also. A cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"舰长，锤与剑你都一并供给我们，\" 她说道。\"有了这批重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器 —— 不管它改叫什么名号 —— 怕是不会再如那几头狮崽所愿那般牢不可破。"

"你自己也当心。这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You have given us all we have asked. The United Front is pledged to a general uprising when the opportunity presents itself. There are dark rumors from Sindria, from the den of the beast himself..."

Her look is of weariness, of a burden long carried and not soon relieved.

"Now, we wait - and pray. And once more, you have my thanks."
texts.zh:
"我们开口要的，你都给齐了。统一战线已立誓，只待时机一到便全面起事。Sindria 那边传来些不祥的风声，就从那头野兽自己的窝里..."

她神情倦怠，像是扛了太久的一副担子，一时半会儿还卸不下来。

"眼下，我们等 —— 也祷告。再者，多谢你了。"

texts.en:
"You have given us all we have asked. The Faithful spill their blood daily for this uprising... and spend their lives, a currency too dear to long contemplate."

Her look is of weariness, of a burden long carried and not soon relieved.

"But we fight," she straightens her posture, hands together. "And pray. You you have my thanks and blessing, captain."
texts.zh:
"我们开口要的，你都给齐了。信众们日日为这场起事流血...连性命也一并花出去，这代价太重，教人不敢细想。"

她神情倦怠，像是扛了太久的一副担子，一时半会儿还卸不下来。

"可我们仍在打，\" 她双手合十，挺直了身子。\"也仍在祷告。舰长，我的谢意与祝福都给你。"

texts.en:
"You have my deepest graditude, $playerName," she says.

"These credits open great possibilities, for all and sundry must be purchased - and smuggled - to bolster our cause." She pauses. "To say nothing of bribing the faithless servants of Andrada to free our walkers and whisper to us the Lion's secrets..."
texts.zh:
"$playerName，我真是感激不尽，" 她说道。

"有了这批星币，局面就活了 —— 各样东西都得买、都得偷运进来，才撑得起我们的事。\" 她顿了顿。\"更别说还得拿钱去打通 Andrada 那些不信神的爪牙，放我们的人出来，再替我们套出辛达瑞亚之狮的秘密..."

texts.en:
She looks down, frowning, at her battered datapad.

"It will, however, take some time to distribute these funds without attracting the attention of the Spider."
texts.zh:
她皱着眉，低头盯着那台破旧的数据平板。

"只不过，要把这笔钱散出去又不惊动辛达瑞亚之蛛，总得费些时日。"

texts.en:
She looks down, frowning, at her battered datapad.

It will take some effort, however, to distribute these funds without attracting the attention of the... new authorities." She sighs. "Whatever they call one Diktat or the other, they are truly the sons of their father."
texts.zh:
她皱着眉，低头盯着那台破旧的数据平板。

"只不过，要把这笔钱散出去又不惊动...新当局，总得费些手脚。" 她叹了口气。"管它叫这个辛达强权还是那个辛达强权，骨子里都是一父所生的儿子。"

texts.en:
"You are truly given by Providence," she says.

"These supplies will feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and... give us time." She clasps her hands together. "When the time is right, our uprising will break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun. So I pray."

"And you, captain. Ware the Diktat patrols - a cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden, despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"你真是天意所赐，" 她说道。

"这批补给会让饥者得食、伤者得治，还...替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"待时机一到，我们的起事便会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。我如此祈盼。"

"还有你，舰长。当心辛达强权的巡逻队 —— 这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

texts.en:
"You are truly a gift of Providence," she says.

"These supplies shall feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and give us time." She clasps her hands together. "Our uprising shall break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun. So I pray."

"And you, captain. Ware the Diktat patrols - whether one Diktat or the other, a shipment of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"你真是天意送来的礼，" 她说道。

"这批补给将让饥者得食、伤者得治，替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"我们的起事终会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。我如此祈盼。"

"还有你，舰长。当心辛达强权的巡逻队 —— 不管换了这个还是那个，这么大一船货，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

texts.en:
The comm-link only holds briefly on the crest of the Hegemony navy before Admiral Rao appears.

"$TitleHeg," he says. "Back around Ragnar long? I hope not." The hint of a smile flickers.
texts.zh:
通讯链接在霸主海军的徽标上只停了片刻，Rao 上将便现了身。

"$TitleHeg，" 他开口道。"回 Ragnar 这一带待很久了？但愿没有。" 一丝笑意一闪而过。

texts.en:
The link opens with a surprisingly brief wait for an officer of Rao's rank. He appears with the hint of an amused smile.

"$PlayerName! I see you've carried out my orders to the letter. Great work," he says, seemingly earnest.

"Perhaps I should award you a medal for your service?"
texts.zh:
通讯链接以惊人的速度接通了 —— 对 Rao 这个级别的军官而言，等待时间称得上是极短。他出现在画面中，带着一丝玩味的笑意。

"$PlayerName！看来你严格执行了我的命令。干得漂亮，" 他说道，听来颇为诚恳。

"或许该为你颁发一枚勋章以示嘉奖？"

options.en: What in the worlds are you talking about?
Yes, I think a medal would be in order.
options.zh: 是的，我想一枚勋章是应该的。

texts.en:
His eyes glitter frostily.

"I'm talking about a liar." His finger flicks to point at you.

"The one with the gall to open a comm link to my face after I received a most fascinating report from one of our fleet commanders about an encounter during an emergency intercept near Tse Franchise Station."
texts.zh:
他的眼睛冷冽地闪着寒光。

"我说的是个骗子。" 他手指一弹，指向你。

"一个在我收到某位舰队指挥官关于 Tse 特许经营空间站附近紧急拦截遭遇战的精彩报告后，竟敢当面与我通讯的家伙。"

options.en: Oh, I remember now.
That must have been a different $playerName.
options.zh: 那肯定是另一个叫 $playerName 的家伙。

texts.en:
"I'm glad to hear it, captain," he says. "Now we may speak plainly."

"From captain to... what have they made me, an $rank? My, it makes you wonder who's in charge, doesn't it."
texts.zh:
"很高兴听你这么说，舰长，" 他说道，"现在我们可以有话直说了。"

"从舰长到...他们给我安了个什么头衔，$rank？呵，这让人不禁想问到底是哪些家伙在掌权，不是吗。"

options.en: Let him get to his point, whatever it is
options.zh: 等他把话说完，不管他要说什么

options.en: That'd be the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud.
options.zh: 那应该是至高霸主，Baikal Daud。

texts.en:
"You played it well," he says.

"Outsmarted a puffed-up uniform of the sort Eventide seems to spawn more of each cycle. You remind me a bit of myself when I was younger and didn't have to sit at a desk."

He pauses a moment, studying you. "I had the thought..."
texts.zh:
"你演得很出色，" 他说道。

"骗过了 Eventide 每个星历年都在量产的那种华而不实的制服官僚。你让我想起了年轻时的自己，那时我还不用坐在办公桌后面。"

他停顿片刻，审视着你。"我有个想法..."

options.en: Yes?

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain, that's true. But," he takes on an avuncular tone, "I don't think you've got enough experience to handle what I've got in mind."

"Put yourself out there, take on some jobs. We may speak again on this later."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"你确实很有潜力，舰长。但是，" 他的语气转为长辈式的教诲，"我认为你尚且缺乏足够经验，不足以处理我所构思的事情。"

"去历练吧，承接些任务。我们或许可以日后再议此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en: "You've got promise, captain." He pauses. "And I believe you have the experience to handle what I've got in mind."
texts.zh: "你很有潜力，舰长。" 他停顿片刻，"而且我相信，以你的经验足以胜任我心中的计划。"

texts.en:
"You've got promise, captain. You know how to slip out of a trap. You know how to use any means available to win."

He pauses. "It speaks well for what I have in mind.""
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你懂得如何挣脱陷阱，懂得如何不择手段地取得胜利。"

他停顿片刻，"这正契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain. Especially if your captaining is anything like your swordplay. You spilled blood for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长，尤其是你那与自身剑术造诣相当益彰的指挥才能。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You have promise, captain. You were brave enough to take up the sword with full knowledge of the art, fight... and lose. Your blood was spilled for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
texts.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你足够勇敢，在通晓剑艺的情况下执剑应战...并败北。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

texts.en:
"You've found lucrative employment of a sort with the Tri-Tachyon corporation, however."

He leans back. "We could discuss this matter again if that situation were to change."
texts.zh:
"然而，你已经在 速子科技 找到某种利润丰厚的差事了。"

他向后靠去，"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

texts.en:
"Huh." He chews on his lip.

"Why not ask your boss, Dolos Macario, for a job? I'm sure he's got some dissidents to space."
texts.zh:
"呵。" 他咬着嘴唇说道。

"为什么不向你老板 Dolos Macario 讨个差事？我很确信他总有些异见分子需要处理。"

texts.en: "You're already signed up with the Hegemony. Good. That saves me a lot of bureaucratic nonsense."
texts.zh: "你已经登记加入 霸主 了，很好，这省去我不少官僚程序的麻烦。"

texts.en:
"As you bear the commission of the Persean League..." He makes a half-shrug. "I can't have you in a position of divided loyalty."

"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"既然你已经持有 英仙座联盟 的雇佣协议了..." 他半耸着肩膀，"我不能让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug. "Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... well, we can't very well divide your loyalties."

"Besides," a fleeting smile appears. "I see you've fallen into Reynard Hannan's orbit. An ego of that size produces a gravity well which is very difficult to escape."
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅...但我们很难要求你分割忠诚。"

"况且，" 他的脸上浮现出一抹转瞬即逝的微笑，"我看你已经坠入 Reynard Hannan 的引力范围了。如此庞大的自我意识所产生的重力井，想必是极难挣脱的。"

texts.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug.

"But perhaps," he looks aside. "We might have a mutual friend on Kazeron?"
texts.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

他微微耸肩。

"不过或许，" 他侧目看去，"我们在 Kazeron 有共同的朋友？"

texts.en:
"Although the Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..."

He makes a half-shrug.

"You've chosen your path. I couldn't possibly distract you from your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"虽然 霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..."

他半耸着肩膀。

"但你已经选择了自己的道路，我哪敢打扰你那些烦人的信仰事务。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug.

"I suppose," he says slowly, "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸着肩膀。

"我想，" 他缓缓说道，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug, then pauses to look right at you.

"It's the guns you've given Standfast," his words are precise, "that convince me of your dedication."

He looks away, casual again. "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
texts.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸肩膀。

"是你提供给 Standfast 的那些军火，" 他字句精准，"让我确信了你的诚意。"

他移开视线，恢复了随意的姿态，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

options.en: And what do you have in mind?
And what do you have in mind?
And what do you have in mind?
And what do you have in mind?
My membership in the Persean League is my business.
options.zh: 加入 英仙座联盟 是我的个人事务。

options.en: Reynard is insufferable, but I could not get a better deal.
options.zh: Reynard 令人难以忍受，但我找不到更优的选择了。

options.en: Reynard is a great man. I follow him gladly.
options.zh: Reynard 是个伟大的人，我十分乐意追随他。

options.en: I'm sure I couldn't say.
Horus Yaribay, you mean. And his desire for unification with the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你是指 Horus Yaribay，以及他渴望与 霸主 合并的意愿。

options.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
options.zh: 我目前不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

options.en: Continue
What'd you have in mind?
Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

options.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
options.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

options.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
options.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

texts.en:
"I'd like to offer you work. You don't have to salute me, and I'll make sure you're paid promptly."

He leans forward, his hands together. "What do you think? Could be fun. Play your cards right, and you'll be a legend."
texts.zh:
"我想给你提供工作。你不必向我敬礼，而我也会确保报酬能够及时支付。"

他倾身向前，双手交握，"你意下如何？这或许会很有趣。如果你打得一手好牌的话，就将会成为传奇。"

options.en: What sort of work do you need done?
options.zh: 你需要完成什么样的工作？

options.en: You show little respect for your fellow officers of the Hegemony.
options.zh: 你对 霸主 的同僚军官显得缺乏敬意。

options.en: What are these 'unique circumstances'? What is your goal?
options.zh: 这些 '特殊情况' 具体指什么？你的目标是什么？

options.en: Is this about taking down the Sindrian Diktat?
options.zh: 这是为了推翻 辛达强权 吗？

options.en: Why is it personal with Andrada?
options.zh: 你为什么和 Andrada 有私人恩怨？

options.en: I accept.
I'm not so sure about this.

texts.en:
"A proper officer of the Hegemony is taught to leap toward the enemy, blazing guns. Once the noise quiets down, they'll wait, slack-jawed, for the medals to be pinned to their uniforms."

"Such is the way of the Domain, which we must uphold."

He half-raises a finger, a quirk on his lips. "Officially," he concludes.
texts.zh:
"正统的 霸主 军官被教导要随着枪口的火光冲向敌阵。待硝烟散去，他们便张着嘴等待勋章别上军装。"

"此乃 人之领 之道，我等必须恪守。"

他微抬手指，嘴角轻扬，"官方说法如此，" 他总结道。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Baikal was kind enough to find me a place where I could get important work done. I deal with... let us call them 'unique circumstances'. And for this I find it necessary to associate with energetic freelancers."

"I'll ensure you're paid promptly for a roster of small merc jobs."

"Then, perhaps something big will come up. When it does, I want to know I can count on you."
texts.zh:
"Baikal 好意为我寻得一处能处理重要事务的地方。我要处理的是...不妨让我们称之为 '特殊情况'。为此，我需要有活力的自由职业者。"

"我会确保你接手的小型雇佣任务都能及时获得报酬。"

"届时，或许会有重大机遇降临。当那一刻来临时，我希望能与你建立信任。"

texts.en:
"The truth makes few friends." Rao produces a wry smile.

"I never could stand a fool, especially when that fool is an honorable member of the Strategic Assembly. So," he holds his hand out to indicate his surroundings, Ragnar Complex.

"It's not so bad."
texts.zh:
"真相鲜少赢得朋友。" Rao 露出讥诮的微笑。

"我向来无法容忍蠢材，尤其当他们是战略指挥部的成员时。所以，" 他伸手示意周围的环境 —— Ragnar 综合设施。

"这里还不算太糟。"

texts.en:
"I'm offering you the chance to be the grit that throws history off its axis."

He lets his sly smile fade. "There are many bodies of power turning just now. Grinding away, warships and bombings and riots and resources."

"The Persean Sector needs change, or it will grind what's left of us to dust."
texts.zh:
"我正在给予你成为历史转折点的机会。"

他慢慢收起他那狡黠的微笑，"此刻正有许多权力机构正在运转。缓慢地碾磨着 —— 战舰、轰炸、暴动、资源。"

"英仙座星域需要变革，否则它将把我们仅存的一切碾作尘埃。"

texts.en:
A cold, quick expression passes over his face.

"Let us say that I'd be as satisfied as any Hegemony officer to cut down that pompous traitor. Setting aside even the matter of honor, I have a personal dislike of the man."
texts.zh:
一抹冰冷而迅疾的神色掠过他的脸庞。

"可以说，与任何 霸主 军官一样，能除掉那个自负的叛徒会令我深感快意。即便撇开荣誉问题不谈，我个人也极度厌恶此人。"

texts.en:
Rao lets out a slow breath. "That's talk for old comrades, over drink."

He leans back, not quite committing to a frown.

"Patience, captain."
texts.zh:
Rao 缓缓呼出一口气，"那是老战友间把酒言欢时的谈资。"

他向后靠去，眉间并未完全皱起。

"耐心些，舰长。"

texts.en: "Good," his approval comes with his sly smile. "Have your people set up secure comms. We'll show the Strategic Assembly how it's done."
texts.zh: "很好，" 他的赞许伴随着狡黠的笑容，"让你的人建立安全通讯，我们将向战略指挥部展示该如何行事。"

texts.en:
"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
texts.zh:
"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

texts.en:
"Of course."

He sits back, face falling into shadow.
texts.zh:
"当然。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

texts.en:
"Nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
texts.zh:
"无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en: "But you made the deal," Rao says impishly. "You didn't have to."
texts.zh: "但交易是你自己达成的，"Rao 狡黠地说道，"你本可拒绝。"

options.en: I don't need to explain myself to you.
I have a plan to get out of it. You'll see.
options.zh: 我有脱身的计划，你很快就会看到的。

options.en: Is the Hegemony offering its protection against the League?
options.zh: 霸主 这是要提供针对联盟的庇护吗？

texts.en:
"Then nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
texts.zh:
"那便无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
Rao holds a finger to his cheek for a moment, thinking.

"It could be earned," he says. "But that's up to you."
texts.zh:
Rao 将手指轻抵脸颊片刻，一边陷入了沉思。

"或许可以争取，" 他说道，"但这取决于你。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"What admirable loyalty! How Reynard earns it, I've never understood. I must study his leadership closely, for I obviously have much to learn." The sarcasm runs thick.

Rao sits back, face falling into shadow.
texts.zh:
"多么可敬的忠诚！我始终不明白 Reynard 是如何赢得这份忠诚的。我必须仔细研究他的领导艺术，显然我还有很多需要学习。" 话语中夹杂着明显的讽刺意味。

Rao 向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "I understand. Keeping with his trust is more important than serving that goal." He leans back, "It's interesting."
texts.zh: "我理解。维护他的信任可比服务那个目标更重要。" 他向后靠去，"这很有趣。"

options.en: Speculate if you like, I have nothing to say.
options.zh: 你尽管猜测，而我就无可奉告了。

options.en: Hypothetically, I would require the consent of the third party before discussing anything.
options.zh: 在假设的情况下，我在讨论任何事情之前都需要获得第三方的同意。

options.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
options.zh: 我目前还不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

texts.en: Rao raises an eyebrow, his expression amused.
texts.zh: Rao 扬起一侧眉毛，神色玩味。

texts.en:
He smiles coyly, leaving your statement deliberately unanswered.

"It is possible our work together would serve certain common goals."
texts.zh:
他狡黠地微笑着，刻意不回应你的陈述。

"我们的合作或许能服务于某些共同的目标。"

options.en: What'd you have in mind?
Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
options.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

texts.en:
"Ludd, I think, doesn't need self-appointed curates to shield the Faith from my little comments," he says, his eyes suddenly sharp. "Pray on the matter. I insist."

He leans back, and his face falls into shadow.
texts.zh:
"我认为卢德并不需要自封的祭司来替信仰挡下我的几句闲言碎语，" 他说道，眼神也突然锐利起来，"为此祈祷吧，我坚持如此。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

options.en: Continue
Who is Dolos?
Look, I just take Diktat money. I'm a merc. Like you were.
options.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

options.en: I take it that's a 'no', then.
options.zh: 那么，我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

options.en: I just take Diktat money. I'm a mercenary. Like you were.
options.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

options.en: You're a worm compared to the genius of Dolos Macario!
options.zh: 和 Dolos Macario 的才智相比，你不过是条蛆虫！

options.en: I take it that's a 'no'.
options.zh: 我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

texts.en:
"He calls himself the 'The Spider of Sindria', but that's not right," Rao says. "He's a self-satisfied little worm that's chewed his way into the rotten heart of the Sindrian Diktat. You should meet him."

Rao's smile is cold.

"Go. Meet him. Go on, now." He makes a shoo motion, then slaps the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"虽然他自称 '辛达瑞亚之蛛'，但其实这并不恰当，" Rao说道，"他不过就是条自鸣得意的蛆虫，啃噬着 辛达强权 那腐烂的心脏，你该去见见他。"

Rao 的笑容十分冰冷。

"去啊，去见他，现在就去。" 他做了个驱赶的手势，随即切断了通讯。

texts.en:
"You're not like me," he says. "I was a mercenary, yes. But that was not all I was. And it is not all I am."

"I am a Rao," his voice is full and strong. "I am an officer of the Hegemony Navy despite the best efforts of a few among us who love rules and uniforms more than they love the service and the cause."

He sits back down, a piercing and newly earnest look fixed on you.
texts.zh:
"你可和我不一样，" 他说道，"我确实曾是佣兵。但那并非是我的全部过去，也并非是我的全部现在。"

"我是 Rao 家族的一员，" 他的声音饱满有力，"尽管某些将规章与制服盖过效忠与事业的同僚百般阻挠，我仍是 霸主 海军的军官。"

他重新落座，用锐利而真挚的目光锁定着你。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You are what you do, not the lies you tell yourself."

He reaches for an interface, pauses, then speaks.

"Now go away."
texts.zh:
"你的所作所为造就了你，而非自我欺骗的谎言。"

他伸手触向操作界面，在停顿片刻后，方才开口道。

"现在离开吧。"

texts.en:
"Correct," he says icily.

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"没错，" 他冷冰冰地说道。

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

texts.en:
"Hah," Orcus Rao says, rolling his eyes. "We got another one."

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"哈，" Orcus Rao 翻了个白眼，"又来了个这样的。"

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

texts.en:
"One should think," he says pointedly. "But never mind- what I mean to say is that you played the ruse well."

"Better than a puffed-up uniform of the sort Eventide seems to spawn each cycle would. You remind me a bit of myself when I was younger and didn't have to sit at a desk."
texts.zh:
"理应如此，" 他意味深长地说，"不过算了 —— 我想说的是你这场戏演得很漂亮。"

"比 Eventide 每个星历年都在量产的那种华而不实的制服官僚强得多。你让我想起了年轻时的自己，那时我还不用坐在办公桌后面。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Rao laughs, though there's more of an edge...

You take a moment to try to form a judgement - if he really thinks this is funny, he can't be too angry, right? Or is he one of those officers that keeps others off guard with calculated shifts in mood? From what you know - mostly holodocs - Rao has a cunning streak and a bit of a mixed reputation among the more respectable segments of the Hegemony.

Rao takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
Rao 笑了，但笑意中带着几分锋芒...

你稍作停顿试图判断 —— 如果他真觉得这事好笑，那他应该没太生气吧？还是说他属于那种靠刻意转换情绪来让人防不胜防的军官？据你所知 —— 主要来自全息纪录片 —— Rao 心机深沉，在 霸主 的体面圈子里口碑有些两极分化。

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"No." His amused tone grows a touch of frost.

He looks aside as he speaks. "I think not. They don't give medals for lying in the Hegemony..."

Then he holds a finger to his lips, thoughtfully. "No, that's not true. Not at all. They don't give medals for lying TO the Hegemony."

He smiles again, turning back to you.
texts.zh:
"不。" 他戏谑的语气里，此刻透出一丝寒意。

他侧目说道："我不这么认为。霸主 可不会为撒谎者颁发勋章..."

随后他若有所思地将手指按在唇上，"不，这不准确，完全不对。应该是他们不会为欺骗 霸主 者颁发勋章。"

他再次露出微笑，一边转回来面向你。

options.en: When did I ever lie to the Hegemony? (feign innocence)
options.zh: 我什么时候欺骗过 霸主？ (佯装无辜)

options.en: Is this about that fleet looking for Gargoyle after I left Tse Franchise Station?
options.zh: 是说我离开 Tse 特许经营空间站后，那支追捕 Gargoyle 的舰队的事吗？

texts.en:
He breaks out in a hearty laugh, taking a moment before he rubs his eyes.

"Yes, yes, very good." Rao lets his hands fall deliberately to his console.

"You lied when you encountered the absolute oaf in command of the fleet ordered to intercept you, transporting a hacker wanted by the Hegemony, away from Tse Franchise Station."
texts.zh:
他放声大笑，缓了片刻后才揉了揉眼睛。

"好，好，很好。" Rao 刻意将双手落在控制台上。

"当你遭遇那支奉命拦截你的舰队指挥官 —— 那个十足的蠢货时，你撒谎了，那时你正运送着 霸主 通缉的黑客离开 Tse 特许经营空间站。"

options.en: Oh, I remember now.
That must have been a different $playerName.
options.zh: 那肯定是另一个叫 $playerName 的家伙。

texts.en: "It is, yes," he says. "And the absolute oaf in command who believed your ruse."
texts.zh: "是的，没错，" 他说道，"还有那个相信你谎言的彻头彻尾的蠢材指挥官。"

options.en: Withhold comment
Well. Sorry.
Don't blame them too much, I can be pretty convincing when I want to be.
options.zh: 别太责怪他们，我想我说服别人时还是很有说服力的。

texts.en:
He waves the thought away, then takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
他挥手驱散了这个念头，随后深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Don't apologize for winning," he says. "It's unbecoming."

Rao takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
"别为胜利道歉，" 他说道，"这有失体面。"

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He snorts at that.

Rao takes a quiet moment then drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
texts.zh:
他对此嗤之以鼻。

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

options.en: Continue
I think you might have work for me.
options.zh: 我认为你可能有任务交给我。

options.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

texts.en:
"I don't have a reputation for being stickler for regulations, but I need you to hold a Hegemony commission before we have operational discussions concerning these matters."

He lets a hand drop on his desk.

"No exceptions."
texts.zh:
"我向来不以严守条令出名，但在我们就这些事展开作战层面的讨论之前，我需要你持有霸主委任状。"

他把一只手拍到桌上。

"没有例外。"

texts.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
texts.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

texts.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
texts.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

options.en: What should I do?
I've done some investigating. They're real.
options.zh: 我查过一些。他们是真的。

options.en: I've already confirmed all entries. They're real.
options.zh: 每一条我都核实过了。他们是真的。

texts.en:
"Find them," he says.

"I don't think this is the usual pack of lies from Dolos Macario. Not this time. But we need confirmation, and I'd prefer it be done with more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."

He looks you over with a lingering look of disapproval.

"We should make sure you're prepared."
texts.zh:
"找到他们。"他说。

"我不认为这又是 Dolos Macario 那套惯常的谎话。这次不像。但我们需要确证，而且我希望办得比霸主那些惯常的【精锐】更讲究些，\"他拿起数据平板，厌恶地看了一眼，\"别让他们在这串穷乡僻壤里到处乱戳。"

他上下打量你，目光里留着久久不散的不满。

"我们得确保你准备妥当。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "That's it. Find all those clones, sons, whatever they are."
texts.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"就这样。把那些克隆体、儿子，随他们是什么，全都找出来。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en:
He nods.

"Then we should make sure you're outfitted."
texts.zh:
他点了点头。

"那我们就得确保你的装备齐备。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The comm-link connects to the office of Admiral Orcus Rao.

"Ah," the old war hero looks you over. "If it isn't $PlayerName, scourge of the Persean Sector, terrorist leader and serial murderer of Andrada-clones."

He seems rather amused at the situation.
texts.zh:
通讯链路接通了 Orcus Rao 上将的办公室。

"啊，\"这位年迈的战争英雄打量着你，\"这不是 $PlayerName 吗——英仙座星域的祸害、恐怖分子头目，还有 Andrada 克隆体连环杀手。"

他似乎觉得这局面相当有趣。

texts.en: "And you've gone elsewhere to solve your problems, I hear." His tone grows a cold irony. "$TitleHeg."
texts.zh: "我听说，你跑到别处去解决你的问题了。\"他的语气里透出一股冷冷的讥讽。\"$TitleHeg。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"There are many mercs in space, of course," he says. "Even a few commissioned with the Hegemony. One or two might actually believe in what I'm trying to do here."

He holds his look through the link for a moment then hits the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"太空里当然有很多雇佣兵，\"他说，\"甚至有几个人拿着霸主的委任状。说不定还有一两个是真心相信我在这里想做的事。"

他隔着链路盯了你片刻，然后按下切断键。

options.en: Cut the comm link
I'm here about Macario. Specifically, how to take him out.
options.zh: 我来是为了 Macario 的事。具体说，是怎么除掉他。

options.en: Not bad for a bit of space trash, is it.
options.zh: 对一坨太空垃圾来说，干得不赖，是吧。

options.en: Laugh it up, Rao. It isn't your head in the crosshairs.
options.zh: 笑吧，Rao。准星套着的可不是你的脑袋。

texts.en:
He nods.

"He's making his move. Big moves involve big risks. Replacing Philip Andrada with a clone... that's a very big move."
texts.zh:
他点点头。

"他在动手了。大动作意味着大风险。用一个克隆体替换 Philip Andrada...那可是个极大的动作。"

options.en: I talked to Hyder. Said you might make her an offer.
options.zh: 我跟 Hyder 谈过了。她说你也许会给她开个条件。

options.en: I talked to Hyder. Said you might make her an offer.
options.zh: 我跟 Hyder 谈过了。她说你也许会给她开个条件。

options.en: So what's your plan and how does it involve the destruction of Dolos Macario?
options.zh: 那你的计划是什么？其中又怎么安排除掉 Dolos Macario？

options.en: So what's your plan and how can I help save the Persean Sector from Dolos Macario?
options.zh: 那你的计划是什么？我该怎么帮忙，把英仙座星域从 Dolos Macario 手里救出来？

options.en: So what's your plan?
What's the Hegemony's goal here? What's your endgame?
options.zh: 霸主在这里的目标是什么？你的终局又是什么？

options.en: Will you provide me with supplies to run to the rebels?
options.zh: 你会给我补给，让我运去给叛军吗？

options.en: Count me in, admiral.
You're on your own for this one. I have other plans.
options.zh: 这件事你自己想办法吧。我有别的打算。

texts.en: You can tell from his expression that Rao did not expect this.
texts.zh: 从他的表情你能看出，Rao 没料到这一手。

texts.en:
He rubs his face, idly, with one hand.

"A deal, huh. You know she had a trial? Mutiny on the battlefield, premeditated, in active combat? By an officer?"

"The sentence is death."

He considers this for a moment, then half-raises a single finger. "Almost."

He sits back, considering.
texts.zh:
他一只手随意地搓了搓脸。

"交易，是吗。你知道她受过审判吧？战阵哗变，有预谋，发生在实战之中，而且是一名军官？"

"判决是死刑。"

他斟酌了片刻，竖起半根手指。"差一点。"

他向后靠去，陷入思索。

options.en: You're telling me you can cut her a deal?
options.zh: 你是说，你能给她谈成一笔交易？

texts.en:
"No." He crosses his arms. "And Hyder knows it. She knows the trial was held 25 cycles ago and she was sentenced to death in absentia. Execution of the sentence pending, obviously."

"That's all I can offer."
texts.zh:
"不能。\"他抱起双臂。\"Hyder 也知道。她知道那场审判是 25 个星历年之前的事，她被缺席判处死刑。判决待执行，这不用说。"

"我能给的只有这些。"

options.en: But?
You don't have authority. But someone else does.
options.zh: 你没有这个权限。但别人有。

texts.en:
He gives you a weary look.

"The High Hegemon could make an exception."
texts.zh:
他疲惫地看你一眼。

"至高霸主可以破例。"

texts.en: "Question is, will he. And is there time."
texts.zh: "问题是他肯不肯。还有来不来得及。"

options.en: So you just need to contact the High Hegemon? Sounds easy enough.
options.zh: 所以你只需要联系上至高霸主？听起来够简单。

options.en: I'm guessing it isn't as easy as sending the High Hegemon a request.
options.zh: 我猜，不会像给至高霸主递份申请那么容易。

texts.en: "Sounds easy," he says in a tone that makes it clear it isn't.
texts.zh: "听着是简单，"他说，那语气分明表示一点都不简单。

options.en: What's the problem?

texts.en:
"Political considerations. Daud needs to run a tight ship because he's already, well." Rao stops himself. "Well, I'll worry about that. Above your pay grade."

He takes a deep breath. "It should suffice to say I'd be more than pleased to shoot Hyder myself and the entire Hegemony navy would buy my drinks afterward."

"With a word Daud might take one capable commander from the enemy but he'd have told every faithless turncoat with mutiny rotting in their heart that they might be forgiven. That is unacceptable both as a matter utility and of honor."
texts.zh:
"政治上的考量。Daud 必须把船管得滴水不漏，因为他本来就，呃。\"Rao 打住了。\"算了，这我来操心。超出你的级别。"

他深吸一口气。"说得够清楚就是：我巴不得亲手毙了 Hyder，完事之后整支霸主海军都会请我喝酒。"

"Daud 一句话，或许能从敌人那边拉走一位能干的指挥官，但他同时也等于告诉每一个心怀叛念、哗变之毒烂在心里的不忠之徒：他们可以被赦免。无论从实利还是荣誉上讲，这都不能接受。"

options.en: Fair enough.
After all that bother you put me through, you're not going to try?
options.zh: 你让我费了这么多周折，现在连试都不肯试？

options.en: What of Askonia? If the Lion's Guard and navy are united under Hector, the Diktat is stronger.
options.zh: 那 Askonia 呢？狮心卫队和海军要是都归到 Hector 麾下，强权就更强了。

texts.en: "Eh, fairs got nothing to do with it. Never did," he says, and sighs. "I'll put in the request. But damn the stars, it hurts me to be the one to do it."
texts.zh: "唉，公不公平跟这事没关系。从来就没关系，\"他说着叹了口气。\"我会去提这个请求。可该死的星海啊，偏偏要由我来提，真叫我难受。"

texts.en:
"Time is going to be tight. I can't say what the turnaround will be, it all depends on how the weather is in the Strategic Council. And with Askonia going critical..."

He shakes his head.

"We have agents on Nortia. She can surrender herself there."
texts.zh:
"时间会很紧。我说不准回复要多久，全看战略委员会里的风向。何况 Askonia 眼看就要到临界点..."

他摇了摇头。

"我们在 Nortia 有自己人。她可以在那里自首。"

options.en: Can I give Hyder your guarantee of clemency?
options.zh: 我可以把你的免罪保证转告 Hyder 吗？

texts.en:
He pauses, putting one fist in his other hand.

"No. Only that I'll try."
texts.zh:
他顿了顿，一只拳头抵进另一只手心里。

"不行。我只能保证我会去试。"

options.en: I suppose I'll have to say the same to you.
options.zh: 看来我也只能对你说同样的话了。

texts.en:
Rao gives you a weary look, then glances at his datapad.

"Next order of business. We'll see what the folks down in MINCOM can do about your little reputation problem while we're at it."
texts.zh:
Rao 疲惫地看了你一眼，随即瞄了瞄手里的数据板。

"下一件事。顺便看看 MINCOM 那帮人能对你那点名声道上的小麻烦做点什么。"

texts.en: He gives you a weary look. "Let's get back to the plan."
texts.zh: 他疲惫地看了你一眼。"回到计划上来。"

texts.en: Rao gives you a weary look, then glances at his datapad. "Next order of business."
texts.zh: Rao 疲惫地看了你一眼，随即瞄了瞄手里的数据板。"下一件事。"

options.en: I, uh, can't wait to see.
options.zh: 我，呃，真是等不及想看了。

texts.en:
"I'm sure it'll be worth the wait," his smile is quick, then gone.

"That's it. You're outside the chain of command so use best judgement."

A pause. "I'll tell you if you screw up, though. So don't screw up. Good hunting."
texts.zh:
"我保证值得等。"他的笑容一闪即逝。

"就这样。你不在指挥链里，自己拿主意。"

他顿了顿。"不过你要是搞砸了，我会告诉你的。所以别搞砸。狩猎顺利。"

options.en: It will be.

texts.en:
You close the link and consider your next move.

Your quartermaster has a particularly eager look you suspect has to do with the cargo bay Rao assigned to you, though they are polite enough not to interrupt your next command.
texts.zh:
你切断通讯，思量下一步。

你的军需官一脸格外热切，你猜这跟 Rao 划给你的那个货舱有关；不过对方很懂规矩，没有打断你接下来的命令。

texts.en:
"It's simple enough," he begins.

"The Strategic Assembly doesn't want to send in the navy. It'd look bad. No risk of mutiny - things are different now - but because that's how we got this problem in the first place. Appearances."

He snorts dismissively.

"So instead we're arming and supplying rebels, with priority given to the Charterists out of Nortia. They're ostensibly for full independence but the diplomats say the ACA leadership is 'open-minded'. Whatever that means."
texts.zh:
"很简单，"他开口道。

"战略议会不想派海军。那不好看。倒不是怕哗变——如今情况不同了——而是因为当初就是这么搞出这个烂摊子的。面子问题。"

他不屑地哼了一声。

"所以我们改为武装并补给叛军，优先照顾 Nortia 的宪章派。他们名义上是要完全独立，但外交官们说 ACA 的领导层'思想开明'。管他什么意思。"

options.en: What do you need me for, then?

texts.en: "Someone's got to make sure the supplies get through." He smirks. "Looks better if there's a little distance between us, too. You may have a commission, but it's a layer of deniability."
texts.zh: "总得有人确保补给送进去。\"他得意地一笑。\"我们之间有点距离，看起来也更好。你也许有一纸委任状，但那也是一层能让你撇清干系的缓冲。"

texts.en:
"Second... strategic says there's definitely going to be a fight between the Andrada clones, Hector and Achilles. War between their backers, more like."

His hand balls into a fist, perhaps unconsciously.

"We'll talk more about them when it starts to heat up."
texts.zh:
"第二...战略部门说，Andrada 家的克隆体之间，Hector 和 Achilles，必定会有一战。更确切地说，是他们背后靠山之间的战争。"

他的手握成了拳，也许是无意识的。

"等事情热起来，我们再细谈他们。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You're not navy, captain. And we're not in the midst of battle. Your commission gives you a great deal of leeway when it comes to how you interact with the chain of command, and I want to acknowledge that to you."

He pauses.

"Now that I've said that, are you in?"
texts.zh:
"你不是海军的人，舰长。而且我们也不在战斗之中。你的委任状让你在如何对待指挥链这件事上有很大的余地，这一点我要跟你说明白。"

他顿了顿。

"话我已经说清楚了，你入伙吗？"

texts.en:
"The Charterists are up and running, fully supplied."

His eyes meet yours through the link. "Good work."
texts.zh:
"宪章派已经运转起来，补给充足。"

他的目光透过通讯链路与你的相接。"干得好。"

texts.en:
"You made contact with the Charterists and started supplying them with material."

His eyes flick up to meet yours through the link.

"Good. Keep it going."
texts.zh:
"你已经和宪章派接上了头，开始给他们供物资。"

他的目光透过通讯链路抬起来，与你相接。

"很好。接着干。"

texts.en:
"You haven't made any deliveries to the Charterist contact on Nortia."

His eyes flick up to meet yours through the link.

"That's disappointing. That pack of play-terrorists is what guarantees a post-crisis Askonia that isn't dominated by the Sindrian Mutiny. And that's only because I'm not allowed to go in there myself and solve this problem the old fashioned way with the pride of the Fourteenth."

"Get on it, and don't screw it up."
texts.zh:
"你还没给 Nortia 上的宪章派联络人送过任何东西。"

他的目光透过通讯链路抬起来，与你相接。

"这很让人失望。那帮玩票的恐怖分子，是危机之后 Askonia 不被'辛达叛乱'把持的唯一保障。而这仅仅是因为，上头不许我亲自带着第十四战斗群的骄傲开进去，用老办法把问题解决掉。"

"去办，别搞砸了。"

texts.en:
"Remember, you need to contact our Charterist contact on Nortia as soon as possible and get the supplies flowing," he says.

"The rebels are key to our strategy in Askonia."
texts.zh:
"记住，你得尽快联系上我们在 Nortia 的宪章派联络人，让补给流动起来，"他说。

"叛军是我们在 Askonia 战略的关键。"

texts.en:
"The Strategic Assembly doesn't want to send in the navy. It'd look bad. No risk of mutiny - things are different now - but because that's how we got this problem in the first place. Appearances."

He snorts dismissively.

"So instead we're arming and supplying rebels, with priority given to the Charterists out of Nortia. They're ostensibly for full independence but the diplomats say the ACA leadership is 'open-minded'. Whatever that means."
texts.zh:
"战略议会不想派海军进去。那样不好看。不是怕哗变——现在情况不一样了——而是因为这问题最初就是那么来的。面子。"

他不以为然地哼了一声。

"所以我们就改成武装叛军、给他们供补给，优先照顾 Nortia 出来的宪章派。他们名义上是要完全独立，但外交官们说 ACA 的领导层'思想开明'。管他什么意思。"

options.en: Continue
Continue
Continue
Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"Next-" He draws a breath and is interrupted by a comms ping.

Rao gives you a knowing look. "About time. I think you're going to want to see this too."

A new feed appears - a fresh-faced young Hegemony lieutenant. Rao's got his command face on.

"Lieutenant! I gave explicit orders not to interrupt this meeting unless extremely specific conditions were met."
texts.zh:
"下一件——"他吸了口气，被一声通讯提示音打断。

Rao 意味深长地看你一眼。"总算来了。我想你也会想看看这个。"

一条新的信息流接入——一名面容青涩的年轻霸主上尉。Rao 已经换上了那副指挥官的脸色。

"上尉！我下过明确的命令，除非满足极其具体的条件，不许打断这场会议。"

texts.en: "Next." He doesn't glance at his datapad this time. "My favorite part: taking out hostiles."
texts.zh: "下一件。\"这次他没看数据板。\"我最喜欢的环节：清除敌对目标。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Sir! Admiral Rao, sir," the lieutenant says, just managing not to stammer.

"The conditions you specified are met precisely: high bandwidth hyperwave with Sindrian Diktat priority override code direct from the Zagan system. Sir. Like you said."

"Acknowledged, lieutenant," Rao says, voice gravelly with the threat of a senior officer's rebuke. No ironic smile. "Patch it to this feed. Dismissed."

"Sir!" The lieutenant disappears.

Rao winks at you then sets priority to the third input feed.
texts.zh:
"长官！Rao 上将，长官，"上尉说，勉强没有结巴。

"您指定的条件全部精确满足：高带宽超波通讯，带辛达强权优先覆盖码，直接从 Zagan 星系发来。长官。跟您说的一样。"

"收到，上尉，\"Rao 说，嗓音沙哑，透着资深军官训斥人的威胁。没有一丝带刺的笑意。\"接到这条信息流上。解散。"

"是，长官！"上尉消失了。

Rao 朝你眨眨眼，然后把优先级切到第三条输入信息流。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I want you to run supplies, fuel, and credits to our Charterist contact on Nortia. Despite your commission, they say it looks better if it's done indirectly. Gives the Charterists credibility with the so-called 'United Front' that's planning a system-wide uprising."

"I'll let our people know to set up a meeting."
texts.zh:
"我要你把补给、燃料和星币送到我们在 Nortia 的宪章派联络人手上。虽说你带着委任状，他们说这事办得间接些更好看。这也能给宪章派在所谓'联合阵线'那里挣点信誉——那帮人正筹划一场全星系起义。"

"我会通知我们的人安排一次会面。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He sighs.

"I am going to try. I need to ensure that all parties lose the civil war and that's not going to happen if their forces are united."
texts.zh:
他叹了口气。

"我会去试。我得确保内战里哪一方都赢不了，可他们的兵力要是合到一处，这就办不到了。"

texts.en: "My thinking exactly," he says. "So I'll put in the request. But damn the stars, it hurts me to be the one to do it."
texts.zh: "我正是这么想的，\"他说。\"所以我会去提这个请求。可该死的星海啊，偏偏要由我来提，真叫我难受。"

texts.en: "No."
texts.zh: "不必了。"

texts.en:
He makes a sly smile.

"You're starting to understand how the Hegemony works, captain." A weary look replaces the smile. "Only the High Hegemon can make an exception."
texts.zh:
他狡黠地笑了笑。

"你开始明白霸主是怎么运转的了，舰长。\"笑容褪成一脸倦意。\"只有至高霸主才能破例。"

texts.en: This earns you a grim smile.
texts.zh: 这话换来他一个阴沉的笑。

texts.en: This earns you an approving look.
texts.zh: 这话换来他一个赞许的眼神。

texts.en: He nods, acknowledging your directness.
texts.zh: 他点点头，认可你的直率。

texts.en:
Rao raises some fingers so he can tick them off for you.

"Take out Philip Andrada and everything that looks like him."

One finger down.

"Andrada must be brought low. An 'earned defeat' to prove that he's not some invincible genius, nor are his genes." He pauses with an impatient look. "Now I don't need some clever scheme to prove any of that to myself, but this is what the propaganda department says is going to stick."

"Next, total collapse of the Sindrian Mutiny government." Another finger down. "To be replaced by independent polities 'well-disposed to negotiate with the Hegemony'."

"Yes," he says with a look. "The diplomats are insisting on a soft approach. Even Daud's on-board."
texts.zh:
Rao 抬起几根手指，准备一条一条数给你听。

"除掉 Philip Andrada，还有一切长得像他的东西。"

一根手指按下。

"必须把 Andrada 打下去。一场'实打实的败仗'，证明他不是什么无敌的天才，他的基因也不是。\"他顿了顿，神情不耐。\"我自己不需要什么精妙方案来证明这些，但宣传部门说，只有这个说法才立得住。"

"下一步，辛达叛乱政府彻底垮台。\"又一根手指按下。\"由'对霸主抱有好意、愿意谈判'的独立政权取而代之。"

"对，\"他看了你一眼，\"外交官们坚持要软着来。连 Daud 都点头了。"

options.en: Is that all?

texts.en:
"Pretty much," he says, then indicates the remaining fingers.

"But while we're at it: no Persean League expansion." Tick. "No Pather takeovers." Tick.

He closes the fist and frowns. "And no more planet-killers. I don't believe I need to explain why."
texts.zh:
"差不多吧，"他说着，指了指剩下的手指。

"不过既然说到这儿：不许英仙座联盟扩张。"算一条。"不许左径接手。"算一条。

他握紧拳头，皱起眉头。"还有，别再弄什么行星杀手。我想我不需要解释原因。"

texts.en: "Yes," he says. "If you agree to the plan."
texts.zh: "会，\"他说，\"前提是你同意这个计划。"

texts.en:
"Good." His grin is restrained, but genuine.

"I knew you'd be onboard from the first time we spoke."
texts.zh:
"很好。"他笑得很克制，却是真心的。

"第一次谈话我就知道你会入伙。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"First - let's get you running those supplies, fuel, and credits to our Charterist contact on Nortia. His name is Arnaud Iscare. I'll let our people know to set up a meeting."

"They like to use spacer bars. Can find all kinds of scum up to no good," he says with a wink.
texts.zh:
"首先——你把补给、燃料和星币送去给我们在 Nortia 的宪章派联络人。他叫 Arnaud Iscare。我会让人安排一次会面。"

"他们喜欢在船员酒吧碰头。那种地方，什么下三滥的勾当都能碰上，"他说着眨了眨眼。

options.en: What other rebel groups would I, we, be supporting?
options.zh: 我——我们还要支持哪些叛军组织？

texts.en: "As many as you can." He leans back. "Andrada's made enemies. But remember the ACA is first priority."
texts.zh: "能拉多少拉多少。\"他向后靠去。\"Andrada 树敌不少。但记住，宪章派联盟才是头等大事。"

texts.en: "Our intel says you've met Moyra Standfast already." He makes a quick smile acknowledging his spying. "On Volturn. She's a fighter. Supply her a little, but not too much - we don't want the Church taking over. And she's no Pather, but that's a risk too if the Volturnian Self Defense Covenant got out of hand."
texts.zh: "我们的情报说，你已经见过 Moyra Standfast 了。\"他飞快地笑了一下，算是承认自己在刺探。\"在 Volturn。她是个能打的人。给她一点支援，但别太多——我们不想让教会接手。她不是左径的人，可要是 Volturn 自卫公约失控，那也一样是个风险。"

texts.en:
"The Volturnian Self Defense Covenant on Volturn is a Luddic-aligned insurrection. Moyra Standfast, the local curate sacraria, might deny it, but she's in charge."

"Hard to get to the shrine though. The Mutiny has had it locked down for cycles while they purge Luddics. We've got a comms ID, but not sure how you'll get her to trust you."

He shrugs. "Religion isn't my field. Figure it out."

"If, and I mean if you make contact, don't give her too much. We don't want the Church taking over. She's no Pather, but I don't want to see the VSDC get out of hand."
texts.zh:
"Volturn 上的自卫公约是一支亲卢德的叛乱势力。当地的助理祭司 Moyra Standfast 也许不会承认，但说了算的是她。"

"不过那座圣殿不好接近。叛乱当局已经把它封了好几个星历年，一边还在清洗卢德信徒。我们有个通讯 ID，但不确定你怎么才能让她信任你。"

他耸了耸肩。"宗教不归我管。你自己想办法。"

"要是——我是说要是——你跟她接上了头，别给她太多。我们不想让教会接手。她不是左径的人，但我不想看到自卫公约失控。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"On Umbra there's a stray kid from Gens Kato, Imoinu Kato. She's more disciplined than the other pirates pretending to be revolutionaries. You could give her a taste of what's required to tear down the Diktat, but no further."

He sweeps a hand in a spacer's cut-off hand-signal.

"She's an ANTI, through and through, fundamentally opposed to the Hegemony. And when, not if, she loses control, it's going to be the pirates in charge of anything left over."
texts.zh:
"Umbra 上有个 Kato 氏族流落在外的孩子，Imoinu Kato。她比那些装成革命者的海盗有纪律得多。你可以让她尝到一点推翻辛达强权需要什么滋味，但到此为止。"

他挥了下手，比出一个船员之间表示"到此为止"的手势。

"她是个彻头彻尾的 ANTI，从根本上反对霸主。而等她失控——不是如果——剩下的一切就都归海盗管了。"

texts.en:
"There's Imoinu Kato. You've contacted her on Umbra. Yes," he smirks, "we have informants. So does half the Sector - the so-called ARC is leaky as half the old hulls orbiting Ragnar."

"Just don't forget that she's a radicalized ANTI. Give her a taste of what's required to tear down the Diktat, but no further. She's anti-Hegemony, and when - not if - she loses control, it's going to be pirates in charge of anything left standing."

"It'd be embarrassing if our own materiel was used against us. So don't let it happen."
texts.zh:
"有 Imoinu Kato。你在 Umbra 上联系过她。没错，\"他咧嘴一笑，\"我们有线人。星域里一半势力都有——那个所谓的 ARC，漏得跟 Ragnar 轨道上那半数旧船壳一样。"

"只是别忘了，她是个激进化了的 ANTI。让她尝到一点推翻辛达强权需要什么滋味，但别过界。她反霸主，而等她——不是如果——失控，剩下的一切都会落到海盗手里。"

"要是我们自己的物资被拿去打我们自己，那就太难看了。所以别让这种事发生。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"Tri-Tachyon has been supporting the Sindrian Mutiny, but they've always believed loyalty is negotiable. Your friend Rayan Arroyo is no exception, though we don't think he has much taste for black ops."

"But he does own a personal logistics network that could be turned to smuggling."

Rao shrugs.
texts.zh:
"速子科技一直在支持辛达叛乱，但他们向来认为忠诚是可以谈的。你那位朋友 Rayan Arroyo 也不例外，不过我们觉得他对黑色行动没什么兴趣。"

"但他手上确实有一套私人后勤网络，可以拿来走货。"

Rao 耸了耸肩。

texts.en:
"Tri-Tachyon has been supporting the Sindrian Mutiny, but they've always believed loyalty is negotiable. Our friend Provost Baird has a compromised contact in their executive class named Arroyo. But he isn't a fighter."

Rao shrugs. "Has a private logistics network, though. You'd have to get to him through Baird and the Galatia Academy."
texts.zh:
"速子科技一直在支持辛达叛乱，但他们向来认为忠诚是可以谈的。我们的朋友、院长 Baird 在他们高管层里有个被抓住把柄的联系人，叫 Arroyo。不过他不是能打的人。"

Rao 耸了耸肩。"不过他有一套私人后勤网络。你得通过 Baird 和 Galatia 学院才能搭上他。"

texts.en:
"We know you've made contact with Faro Inesis."

Rao's tone grows darker. "Connected to more than a few suspected TT black sites and reports of illegal tech. He's a canny operator with an impressive network, but he'd have to go against the company line to be of use to us."

"Me, I don't think he'll cross Director Glamor-Rotanev. That's going too high up. But you could try an angle... if you have one."
texts.zh:
"我们知道你跟 Faro Inesis 接上了头。"

Rao 的语气沉了下来。"他跟不止一处疑似速子科技的秘密站点有关联，还有关于非法技术的报告。他是个精明的操盘手，网络也很可观，但要为我们所用，他就得违背公司的立场。"

"要我说，我不觉得他会去顶总监 Glamor-Rotanev。那等于往上捅得太高。不过你可以找个切入点...如果你有的话。"

texts.en: "There are other TT operatives with their fingers in highly illegal operations... from the point of view of the Hegemony, anyway. They're good at their work, but I don't think they can be trusted and I don't think they'll help. But if you found an angle..." He shrugs. "We'll work with what we can get."
texts.zh: "速子科技还有别的特工把手伸进了高度非法的买卖...至少从霸主的立场看是这样。他们干得不错，但我不觉得他们可信，也不觉得他们会帮忙。不过你要是找到切入点...\"他耸了耸肩。\"能拿到什么，我们就用什么。"

options.en: This all sounds pretty expensive...
options.zh: 这一套听起来都挺费钱的...

texts.en:
Rao laughs.

"Yes, I'll have our quartermaster transfer some supplies and fuel to a storage bay in your name to pass on to rebels. And a little extra for your own operations. Ah, and," he taps a command, "credits of course."

He winks, now in full avuncular spirit.

"If you need more logistics to haul it all, I'm sure we've got some old hulls lined up for civilian resale in the shipyard."
texts.zh:
Rao 笑了。

"当然，我让军需官把一批补给和燃料转到一个挂你名字的仓库隔间，由你交给叛军。另外多备一点，供你自己行动用。啊，还有，\"他点了一下指令，\"星币，当然。"

他眨了眨眼，一副十足的长辈做派。

"要是你需要更多运力来拉这些东西，船坞里肯定有几条旧船壳排着队，等着当民用品转卖。"

texts.en: He checks a datapad. "Right. Looks like you've already given generously to our friends on Nortia. Can't procure quite so much as I'd hoped - didn't fill out the forms beforehand, right? - but we won't leave you wanting."
texts.zh: 他看了一眼数据板。"好。看来你已经对我们 Nortia 的朋友慷慨过了。那我能调拨的就没预想的多——事先没填表，对吧？——不过不会让你空手。"

texts.en: He checks a datapad. "Right. Looks like you've already given a bit to our friends on Nortia. Can't procure quite as much as I'd hoped - didn't fill out the forms beforehand, right? - but we won't leave you wanting."
texts.zh: 他看了一眼数据板。"好。看来你已经给我们 Nortia 的朋友送过一些了。那我能调拨的就没预想的多——事先没填表，对吧？——不过不会让你空手。"

options.en: Thanks.

texts.en:
"Now here's the fun part," he taps at his datapad again and an overlay of the Askonia system appears in your shared comms volume.

"See that comms relay? I want you to hack in and upload a software package. Got some pre-set activation signals for sleeper agents and a little extra business the techs have cooked up to give the mutineers trouble."

He looks at you over the datapad. "I don't worry about how it works, just that it does what they tell me it'll do."
texts.zh:
"接下来是有意思的部分，"他又点了点数据板，你们共用的通讯空间里浮出 Askonia 星系的投影。

"看到那个通讯中继站了吗？我要你黑进去，上传一个软件包。里面有几组预设的激活信号，发给潜伏特工，还有技术人员鼓捣出来的一点小玩意，专门给叛军添乱。"

他从数据板上方看向你。"我不操心它怎么起作用，只要它真像他们说的那样管用就行。"

Anything else?

texts.en:
"Maybe." He sets down the datapad.

"I want to discuss Oxana Hyder. As relates to," he makes a broad motion with his hand. "This."
texts.zh:
"也许有。"他放下数据板。

"我想谈谈 Oxana Hyder。跟，\"他抬手画了个大圈，\"这个，有关。"

texts.en: "No." He smirks. "You've got enough to remember as is."
texts.zh: "没有。\"他笑了笑。\"你眼下要记的东西已经够多了。"

options.en: I tried to talk to her. She didn't want to listen. At all.
options.zh: 我试着跟她谈过。她根本不想听。一点都不想。

options.en: I tried to talk to her. She said she doesn't trust me. At all.
options.zh: 我试着跟她谈过。她说她不信我。一点都不信。

options.en: Ah. I tried to talk to her and she... didn't listen.
options.zh: 啊。我试过跟她谈，可她...没听进去。

options.en: Yes, I spoke to her about the seven heirs of Andrada.
options.zh: 谈过，我跟她说了 Andrada 那七个继承人的事。

options.en: Uh, what about her? I haven't told her anything. (lie)
options.zh: 呃，她怎么了？我什么都没跟她说过。 (说谎)

options.en: She's in charge of the Diktat navy, right?
options.zh: 辛达强权的海军归她管，对吧？

texts.en:
Rao stares at you for another second.

"Not what I wanted to hear."
texts.zh:
Rao 又盯着你看了两秒。

"这可不是我想听到的。"

texts.en:
"So you screwed up." He raises a hand. "I don't want an explanation, it doesn't matter now."

"Hyder is probably the most competent, most senior brass in the Sindrian Diktat navy and she has command of their primary system defense fleet on a technicality. Could tip the outcome of a civil war. Dangerous place to be," he says, matter-of-fact. "She's probably also smart enough to realize it."

"We'll see what must be done," he concludes.
texts.zh:
"这么说，你搞砸了。\"他抬起一只手。\"别解释，现在已经没意义了。"

"Hyder 大概是辛达强权海军里最能干、资历最老的高级军官，而且凭着一条技术性条款，握着他们主力星系防御舰队的指挥权。她足以左右一场内战的结局。那是个危险的位置，\"他说得平平淡淡，\"她大概也聪明到能意识到这一点。"

"该做什么，到时候就知道。"他这样收尾。

options.en: 'What must be done'?

texts.en:
"Don't worry about it," he says. "Yet."

"That's what Command is for. They'll fill my workstation with projection reports and contingency plans, I'll salute and make the right noises, then we'll do whatever we have to do."

He picks up his datapad and gives it a glance.
texts.zh:
"别操心，\"他说，\"暂时。"

"这就是司令部存在的意义。他们会用推演报告和应急预案把我的工作台堆满，我敬个礼，说几句该说的话，然后该干什么干什么。"

他拿起数据板，扫了一眼。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "By the way, we'll see what the folks down in MINCOM can do about your little reputational problem while we're at it."
texts.zh: "顺便说一句，你那个小小的名声问题，我们也看看 MINCOM 那帮人能怎么处理。"

options.en: I, uh, can't wait to see.
options.zh: 我，呃，真是等不及想看了。

options.zh: 她担心 Macario 在背后操纵，又拿不准该怎么办。

options.en: She wanted me to confirm all seven files before speaking to her again. I haven't, yet.
options.zh: 她要我先核实全部七份档案，再去跟她谈。我还没核完。

options.en: I told her I'd ask you for some kind of... deal.
options.zh: 我跟她说，我会来问你要某种...条件。

texts.en:
"I see." He looks down for a moment, brow furrowed.

"We're interested in where she'll go when the conflict goes hot," he says, looking up.

"So it sounds like you're due for another friendly chat."
texts.zh:
"明白了。"他低头看了片刻，眉头紧锁。

"我们关心的是，冲突烧起来以后她会站哪边。"他抬起头说。

"所以听起来，你该再去跟她友好地聊一次。"

options.en: With the entire Diktat Navy out to shoot me on-sight?
options.zh: 在辛达强权整个海军都盯着要当场击毙我的情况下？

texts.en:
"Yep," Rao says with a smirk.

"You'll be at the comm relay installing the hack anyway. Use it to contact her."
texts.zh:
"没错。"Rao 咧嘴一笑。

"反正你也要去通讯中继站装那套东西。顺便用它联系她。"

options.en: And what do you want me to say?
Got it.

texts.en:
"Well..." He leans back, putting his hands behind his head.

"I'm not in a position to offer anything except enforcement of her sentence for conspiracy to mutiny concurrent with combat operations during a state of emergency, then enacting said mutiny during- etcetera..."

His eyes shift back to the comms-feed. "The Hegemony has a dim view of her acts during the First Askonia Crisis, you see."

"And she's smart enough to know not to accept anything from me anyway. So." He leans forward again. "Have a 'chat'. If she trusts you, maybe we'll get something to work with. If not."

He shrugs.
texts.zh:
"这个嘛..."他向后靠去，双手枕在脑后。

"我没什么能开出的条件，只有执行对她的判决：在紧急状态下的作战行动期间阴谋煽动叛乱，随后又真的发动了那场叛乱——诸如此类..."

他的目光移回通讯画面。"你知道，霸主对她在第一次 Askonia 危机期间的所作所为评价很低。"

"再说她也聪明得很，知道不该接我给的任何东西。所以，\"他又向前倾身，\"去'聊一聊'。要是她信你，也许我们能拿到点有用的东西。要是不信。"

他耸了耸肩。

options.en: If not?

texts.en:
"From the outside it looks like she's the most competent brass the Sindrian Diktat navy has in the roster, and she has command of their primary system defense fleet on a technicality. Could tip the outcome of a civil war, if you ask me. Dangerous place to be," he says, matter-of-fact. "She's probably also smart enough to realize it."

"We'll see," he concludes.
texts.zh:
"从外面看，她像是辛达强权海军名册上最能干的高级军官，而且凭着一条技术性条款，握着他们主力星系防御舰队的指挥权。照我看，她足以左右一场内战的结局。那是个危险的位置，\"他说得平平淡淡，\"她大概也聪明到能意识到这一点。"

"到时候看吧。"他这样收尾。

texts.zh: "很好。"他说着，拿起数据板扫了一眼。

Rao raises an eyebrow.

"Then maybe you should have a chat with her."
texts.zh:
Rao 挑起一边眉毛。

"那你也许真该去跟她聊聊。"

options.en: With the entire Diktat Navy out to shoot me on-sight?
options.zh: 在辛达强权整个海军都盯着要当场击毙我的情况下？

texts.en:
"It'd be useful if she wasn't."

Rao lets the statement hang in the air for a second.

"I'm not saying take her out and I'm not saying we're taking options off the table. We're interested in where she'll go when the conflict goes hot. So talk to her."
texts.zh:
"她不管那支舰队的话，对我们倒有用。"

Rao 让这句话在空气里悬了一秒。

"我不是说要把她做掉，也没说排除这个选项。我们关心的是冲突烧起来后她会站哪边。所以，去跟她谈。"

options.en: With the entire Diktat Navy out to shoot me on-sight?
options.zh: 在辛达强权整个海军都盯着要当场击毙我的情况下？

texts.en:
"You're sure about this, captain? I'm not going to take away your commission if you don't go along. But that's not the answer I wanted to hear."

His expression is cool.
texts.zh:
"你确定要这样吗，舰长？你不配合，我也不会撤你的委任。可这不是我想听到的答案。"

他的神情冷了下来。

options.en: I'm sure.
I'm sure. Good luck, though.

You know what, you're right. About all of it. I accept your plan.
#sdse_talkToRaoAccept1lie:"You know what, you're right. About all of it. I accept your plan." (lie)
options.zh:
你知道吗，你说得对。全都对。我接受你的计划。
#sdse_talkToRaoAccept1lie:"你知道吗，你说得对。全都对。我接受你的计划。"(说谎)

texts.en:
He's silent for a moment, a look somewhere between disappointment and an anger he's learned to set aside in the moment.

"Like I said, your commission means you don't have to take my orders - in this situation. The Hegemony Navy won't hold your refusal against you."

"As for me? We've got nothing more to talk about," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off. "And forget about Hyder. I'll deal with her myself."
texts.zh:
他沉默了片刻，神情介于失望与愤怒之间——那愤怒他已经学会在这一刻压下去。

"我说过了，你的委任状意味着你不必听我的命令——在这种情况下。霸主海军不会因为你的拒绝而记恨你。"

"至于我？我们没什么好谈的了，\"他说着，伸手去关通讯。\"还有，Hyder 的事你别管了。我自己处理。"

texts.en:
You've chosen not to follow Rao's orders - the Hegemony's orders, really.

There may be other contacts out there. But if you don't take the initiative, you will simply have to wait for Hector or Achilles to make their first move and react as you see fit.
texts.zh:
你选择不服从 Rao 的命令——严格说，是霸主的命令。

外面也许还有别的联络人。但如果你不主动出击，就只能等 Hector 或 Achilles 先落子，再相机应对。

options.en: It'll have to do

texts.en:
"Not at all," he says with a grin.

It drops as he speaks his next words.

"Macario's making his move. Big moves involve big risks, and replacing Philip Andrada is... a very big move."
texts.zh:
"一点也不，"他咧嘴一笑。

说到下一句时，笑容消失了。

"Macario 在动手了。大动作意味着大风险，而替换 Philip Andrada 是个...极大的动作。"

texts.en:
"It's been there before, captain," he says.

He drops the smile.

"Macario is making his move. Big moves involve big risks, and replacing Philip Andrada is a very big move."
texts.zh:
"我的脑袋以前也被套进准星过，舰长，"他说。

他收起了笑容。

"Macario 在动手了。大动作意味着大风险，而替换 Philip Andrada 就是个极大的动作。"

texts.en:
The comm-link connects to the office of Admiral Orcus Rao.

"Ah," the old war hero looks you over. "If it isn't $PlayerName, scourge of the Persean Sector, terrorist leader and serial murderer of Andrada clones."

He seems rather amused at the situation.
texts.zh:
通讯链路接通了 Orcus Rao 上将的办公室。

"啊，\"这位年迈的战争英雄打量着你，\"这不是 $PlayerName 吗——英仙座星域的祸害、恐怖分子头目，还有 Andrada 克隆体连环杀手。"

他似乎觉得这局面相当有趣。

texts.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.

"Askonia is going hot," he says.
texts.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不多费口舌寒暄。

"Askonia 要打起来了，"他说。

He doesn't waste words on greetings.

通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不在寒暄上浪费口舌。

texts.en: "Askonia is getting hot," he says.
texts.zh: "Askonia 要热起来了。"他说。

texts.en: "Askonia is getting hot," he says. "What's the read on Hyder?"
texts.zh: "Askonia 要热起来了。\"他说，\"Hyder 那边什么情况？"

options.en: Are you spying on me?
She's conflicted. I told her I'd ask if you could cut her a deal.
options.zh: 她很矛盾。我跟她说，我会来问你能否给她一条出路。

options.en: We spoke. She seems unsure of what to do.
options.zh: 我们谈过了。她似乎拿不准该怎么办。

options.en: We spoke. I suggested that she back Achilles.
options.zh: 我们谈过了。我建议她支持 Achilles。

options.en: She, uh, does not wish to speak with me again. Ever.
options.zh: 她，呃，不想再跟我说话了。永远不想。

options.en: I didn't contact her.

texts.en:
"Captain." He lets out a breath. "I'm spying on the Sindrian Diktat. When you go and hack their high-level comms relay and call the seniormost naval commander of any ability, I hear about it."

"Now let's return to the important question: Hyder."
texts.zh:
"舰长。\"他吐出一口气。\"我在监视辛达强权。你跑去黑进他们的高层通讯中继站，又去联络他们最有本事的海军指挥官——这种事会传到我耳朵里。"

"现在回到关键问题：Hyder。"

texts.en: He stares. "And?"
texts.zh: 他盯着你。"然后呢？"

options.en: I told her it wasn't up to me, it was up to her.
options.zh: 我告诉她，这事不由我决定，由她决定。

texts.en:
Rao snorts, looking away with obvious impatience.

"I suppose I could have been more explicit about 'using initiative'. But fine, the deed is done. Or not done." He looks back. "She's unsure."

"Which clone do you think she'll support? Or another option?"
texts.zh:
Rao 嗤了一声，把目光移开，明显不耐烦。

"我大概该把'发挥主动性'说得更明白些。不过算了，事已至此。或者说什么都没成。\"他看回来。\"她在犹豫。"

"你觉得她会支持哪个克隆体？还是另有选择？"

options.en: Achilles. He's a real naval officer, she'll respect that.
options.zh: Achilles。他是真正的海军军官，她会敬重这一点。

options.en: She's a follower. Hector declared first and foremost. He'll appear legitimate.
options.zh: 她是个随大流的人。Hector 最先也最张扬地表明了立场。他会显得名正言顺。

options.en: I'm not sure.

texts.en: "It's as good a theory as any," he says. "I'll just hope the betrayal is as messy as the first time she turned-coat."
texts.zh: "这说法倒也不比别的差，\"他说。\"我只希望她这回倒戈，闹得跟第一次一样难看。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He grunts acknowledgement.

"Maybe we'll get lucky and Macario will be stupid enough to have her purged."
texts.zh:
他咕哝一声，算是认可。

"也许运气好，Macario 会蠢到把她清洗掉。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Not sure?" He gives you a deadpan look.

"Well I am sure. Sure that you've got through a lot of effort to arrive exactly where we started," he spits, clearly displeased. "And now I'm starting to question my own judgement," he says under his breath.
texts.zh:
"不确定？"他面无表情地看你一眼。

"那我就确定了。确定你费了一大圈力气，正好回到我们出发的地方，"他啐道，显然很不高兴。"而且我现在开始怀疑自己的判断了，"他低声说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Achilles?" You almost miss his flash of anger.

"Explain."
texts.zh:
"Achilles？"你差点没捕捉到他眼中一闪而过的怒意。

"解释。"

options.en: Dividing the navy and Lion's Guard between the heirs means there's no clear victor.
options.zh: 把海军和狮心卫队分给不同的继承人，就没有明确的赢家。

options.en: I figure we need to get as much of the Diktat navy out from under Macario's influence as possible.
options.zh: 我觉得，得尽量把强权海军从 Macario 的影响下拉出来。

options.en: Honestly? Achilles is the better man. If someone has to win, it should be him.
options.zh: 说实话？Achilles 是更合适的人。如果非得有人赢，那该是他。

texts.en:
He grunts an acknowledgement.

"Not bad for an auxiliary," he concedes. "That is, if Hyder cares to listen to the advice of some spacer merc."
texts.zh:
他咕哝一声，算是认可。

"对一个编外人员来说，不算差，\"他让步道。\"前提是 Hyder 愿意听一个太空雇佣兵的建议。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Fair enough. Split their forces and reduce Macario's hard-power. Just don't let your personal feelings about Macario get in the way of the mission."

"We're here to take down the Sindrian Diktat." He forms a wry smile. "But once it's over, I'll open the airlock if you want to give him a push."

"But let's not get ahead of ourselves. This all depends on if Hyder takes the advice of some spacer merc."
texts.zh:
"说得过去。拆散他们的兵力，削弱 Macario 的硬实力。只是别让你对 Macario 的私人感情妨碍任务。"

"我们是来扳倒辛达强权的。\"他挤出一个苦笑。\"不过等事情了结，你要是想推他一把，气闸我来开。"

"但别想得太远。这一切都取决于 Hyder 肯不肯听一个太空雇佣兵的建议。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"The 'better man'? Listen to yourself. And if he actually is, it'll only make things worse if he's in charge."

"The mission is to take down the Sindrian Diktat, not choose which fancy-lad clone sits in front of the flag."

He closes his eyes, then takes a deep breath and slowly unclenches his fists.

"Stay on target, $titleHeg. And let's not get ahead of ourselves. This all depends on if Hyder takes the advice of some spacer merc."
texts.zh:
"'更合适的人'？听听你自己在说什么。他要真是，那让他掌权只会更糟。"

"任务是扳倒辛达强权，不是挑哪个公子哥克隆体坐到帅旗前面。"

他闭上眼，深吸一口气，慢慢松开拳头。

"盯住目标，$titleHeg。也别想得太远。这一切都取决于 Hyder 肯不肯听一个太空雇佣兵的建议。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Ever?" He narrows his eyes. "What did you do?"
texts.zh: "永远？\"他眯起眼。\"你做了什么？"

options.en: I believe she didn't trust me already. Due to our previous interaction.
options.zh: 我想她本来就不信任我。因为我们之前那次接触。

texts.en:
"I see." He looks away with a sigh. Thinking for a moment.

"That is unfortunate," he says finally. "I had hoped that your earlier contact could be leveraged toward some kind of negotiation. Clearly this was misjudged."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。"他叹了口气，把目光移开。思索片刻。

"这很不幸，\"他终于开口。\"我原本希望，凭你先前的接触，能促成某种谈判。显然我判断错了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "You didn't." He fixes his expression and takes a deep breath. Clearly angry, but not finding a use for expressing that anger... yet.
texts.zh: "你没有。"他收起表情，深吸一口气。分明是怒了，只是还找不到由头把这股火发出来... 暂时。

texts.en:
"You understand that you bear a commission of the Hegemony, $titleHeg?"

Rao looks well beyond displeased.

"Do you understand that your conduct while bearing that commission reflects upon the Hegemony, $titleHeg? And that pledging support for the clone of a traitor is so far beyond any reasonable act that I would never have expected to have to explicitly forbid it?"

He holds up a finger. "Do not answer. I'm not interested in excuses."
texts.zh:
"你明白自己持有霸主的委任状吗，$titleHeg？"

Rao 的表情远不止是不悦。

"你明白带着这份委任状时，你的一举一动都关系到霸主的颜面吗，$titleHeg？你明白公开支持一个叛徒的克隆体，已经越出任何合理的界限，我压根没想到自己还得明令禁止这种事吗？"

他竖起一根手指。"别回答。我对借口没兴趣。"

options.en: Say nothing

texts.en:
"I'll not belabor it. You screwed up." He takes a deep breath, eyes closed. "I don't want to see your face right now."

His hand reaches for his comms interface and- the link cuts.
texts.zh:
"我不再多说。你搞砸了。\"他闭上眼，深吸一口气。\"我现在不想看到你的脸。"

他的手伸向通讯界面，然后——链路断了。

texts.en:
"I'll not belabor it. You screwed up." He takes a deep breath, eyes closed. "I don't want to see your face right now."

Eyes open.

"But the war won't wait for that."
texts.zh:
"我不再多说。你搞砸了。\"他闭上眼，深吸一口气。\"我现在不想看到你的脸。"

他睁开眼。

"可战争不会等我消了这口气。"

texts.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.
texts.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不在寒暄上浪费口舌。

options.en: Let's talk about Askonia.

texts.en:
"What about it?" He crosses his arms.

"Should be simple. I want to see uprisings across the system and anything those Andrada-clones think they're building going down in flames."
texts.zh:
"谈它什么？"他抱起手臂。

"应该很简单。我要看到整个星系起义四起，还有那些 Andrada 克隆体自以为在建的东西全都烧成灰。"

options.en: Do you want me to attack the heirs' fleets directly?
options.zh: 你要我直接去打继承人们的舰队？

options.en: Let's talk about something else. (back)

texts.en:
"If you can," he says.

"Raid their outposts and infrastructure. Put the spaceports and industries out of commission. If you can pick off patrols, merchant fleets - anything - that's what I want to see."

Rao smirks.

"I'm not allowed to order Hegemony-flagged fleets to directly do what has to be done, so it's up to you."
texts.zh:
"能打就打，"他说。

"袭扰他们的前哨和基础设施。让那些太空港和工业设施停摆。要是能顺手干掉巡逻队、商船队——什么都行——那就是我要看到的。"

Rao 勾了勾嘴角。

"我不能下令挂霸主旗的舰队去直接干这些必须干的事，所以只能靠你了。"

options.en: Heard anything from Hyder about the offer?
options.zh: 关于那个提议，Hyder 那边有消息吗？

texts.en:
"Nothing yet from my agents on Nortia, no."

His look is distant.
texts.zh:
"Nortia 上的手下还没有消息，没有。"

他的目光飘远了。

texts.en: "Not from Hyder," he says flatly. "She was arrested by Macario's goons."
texts.zh: "不是 Hyder 的消息，\"他平板地说，\"她被 Macario 的打手抓了。"

texts.en: "That means she's done. Gone. Out of the picture." He takes a deep breath. "Don't know what the Spider is going to have done to her, but it's not the justice she deserved."
texts.zh: "也就是说她完了。没了。出局了。\"他深吸一口气，\"不知道'蜘蛛'会对她做什么，但那不是她该得的正义。"

options.en: What did she deserve?
She deserved a second chance.

texts.en: "Execution," he says. "Clean and earned."
texts.zh: "处决，\"他说，\"干净，而且是她挣来的。"

texts.en:
He looks away.

"The matter is concluded. Doesn't matter what either of us wants now."
texts.zh:
他把目光移开。

"这事已经了结。现在你我想要什么都不重要了。"

texts.en:
"A soft and easy sentiment for one who wasn't involved." He gives you a hard look. "Who wasn't betrayed. Whose comrades weren't murdered by cold-blooded treachery."

"I'll let those fool's words pass," Rao says. "Because you weren't there."
texts.zh:
"对一个没被卷进去的人来说，这话说得又软又轻巧。\"他狠狠地看了你一眼，\"你没被背叛。你的同袍没被冷血的背信杀掉。"

"这些蠢话我就不计较了，\"Rao 说，\"因为你当时不在场。"

options.en: Have you heard back from Daud about the Hyder offer?
options.zh: 关于给 Hyder 的提议，Daud 回话了吗？

texts.en:
"No, not yet."

He lets out a deep breath.
texts.zh:
"没有，还没有。"

他长长吐出一口气。

texts.en:
"No, not yet."

He lets out a deep breath.
texts.zh:
"没有，还没有。"

他长长吐出一口气。

texts.en: "No," he says flatly. "And it doesn't matter anymore. Hyder was arrested by Macario's goons."
texts.zh: "没有，\"他平板地说，\"而且也不重要了。Hyder 被 Macario 的打手抓了。"

options.en: Well. Hyder switched sides. To Achilles.
options.zh: 嗯。Hyder 换了阵营。投到 Achilles 那边去了。

texts.en:
Rao looks at you for a long moment.

"Yes. I've had reports. Guess that means her answer was 'no'." He relaxes, not pleased, but not willing to take this as a defeat.

"So was Daud's, for what it's worth. He put it in official words, but what he didn't say was that he can't look soft on traitors. Not in the current political environment."

Orcus snorts. "Best not to get into all that."
texts.zh:
Rao 盯着你看了好一会儿。

"是。我收到报告了。看来这就是她的答复：'不'。"他松了松身子，不算满意，却也不肯把这事当成一次挫败。

"Daud 的答复也一样，算是吧。他用官话写的，但没说出来的是：他不能对叛徒显得心软。在眼下这种政治气候里不能。"

Orcus 哼了一声。"这些还是别深究了。"

texts.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired.

"$TitleHeg." He takes a moment, a deep breath.

"It's over, then."
texts.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。

"$TitleHeg。"他顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"那么，结束了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat is stronger than ever. A young leader, some damned clone of Andrada. Renewed sense of purpose. You understand what that means?"

"We lost," he says, staring into space. "Completely."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权比以往任何时候都强。一个年轻的领袖，Andrada 的什么该死的克隆体。目标感重燃。你明白那意味着什么吗？"

"我们输了，\"他盯着虚空说道。\"彻底输了。"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat remains," he says. "Whatever damage was done, that is the important fact. And now they've got a young energetic leader, some damn clone of Andrada. Renewed sense of purpose. You understand what that means?"

"We lost."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权还在，\"他说。\"不管这次受了多大损伤，那才是要紧的事实。而现在他们有了一个年轻有为的领袖，Andrada 的什么该死的克隆体。目标感重燃。你明白那意味着什么吗？"

"我们输了。"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat has taken some hits, but they've held on," he says, almost a growl. "And now they've got a young, energetic leader. Some damn clone of Andrada. Renewed sense of purpose. You understand what that means?"

"If we didn't lose, we sure didn't win."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权挨了几下，可他们撑住了，\"他说，声音几乎像是低吼。\"而现在他们有了一个年轻、有干劲的领袖。Andrada 的什么该死的克隆体。目标感重燃。你明白那意味着什么吗？"

"我们要是没输，那也绝对没赢。"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Mutiny is a shell of itself."

"I wouldn't call it a total win, but I'll take it. The Strategic Council has questions, but they'll be handing out medals soon enough."

"You'll get one too, I'm sure." He smirks. "Once the bureaucrats figure out which end to stick it on."
texts.zh:
"辛达叛乱如今只剩个空壳。"

"我不会说这是全胜，但这个结果我认了。战略委员会有些疑问，但勋章很快就要发下来了。"

"你也会拿到一枚，我肯定。\"他撇了撇嘴。\"等那帮官僚弄明白该把别针别在哪一头之后。"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Mutiny is destroyed."

He grins, a bitter thing held back for many cycles.

"The Hegemony got a win here, $titleHeg. And so did Daud. Won't shut up my back-stabbing cousins at the Eventide ball, but they'll keep it to whispers."

"And you're a hero. Enjoy it. I bet Daud'll even give you a medal." He smirks. "Once the bureaucrats figure out which end to stick it on, that is. Could take a while!"

He laughs.
texts.zh:
"辛达叛乱被摧毁了。"

他咧嘴一笑，那笑意里带着苦，压了不知多少个星历年。

"霸主在这里赢了一局，$titleHeg。Daud 也赢了。这堵不住我在 Eventide 舞会上那些背后捅刀的表亲的嘴，但他们至少会压成耳语。"

"而你是个英雄。好好享受吧。我打赌 Daud 甚至会给你发一枚勋章。\"他撇了撇嘴。\"等那帮官僚弄明白该把别针别在哪一头——那可得等上一阵子！"

他笑了起来。

texts.en:
Rao sighs. He looks deflated.

"It's all a huge mess, this planet-killer business. Good riddance to the mutineers, yes, blown up into forms of radiation that only excite academicians. But everyone knows the rot that birthed the Diktat started in the Hegemony and this makes the Hegemony look bad. Very bad. It makes Daud look bad. It makes me look bad."

He rubs his face, then pauses.

"You too. For your involvement."
texts.zh:
Rao 叹了口气。他看上去像被抽空了。

"这整摊子行星杀手的破事，全是一团乱麻。那些叛变分子算是清干净了，没错，被炸成只有院士们才会感兴趣的辐射形态。可谁都知道，生出辛达强权的那份腐坏，源头就在霸主；这事让霸主很难看。非常难看。让 Daud 难看。让我难看。"

他抹了把脸，然后停住。

"还有你。因为你也掺和在里面。"

texts.en:
"There's no reward for this, $titleHeg. My funding is frozen. Under investigation. They'll be thorough."

He seems older, and listless. Like a ship that's lost too many maneuvering thrusters.

"I'll be facing a court-martial, of course. Quiet retirement and keeping my mouth shut is the best I can hope for."

Rao takes a deep breath, then his eyes turn to meet yours through the link. "I'm done. You... you keep your head down. They're going to be looking for people to blame. It's the Hegemony way."
texts.zh:
"这件事没有奖赏，$titleHeg。我的经费被冻结了。正在被调查。他们会查得很彻底。"

他看上去老了些，也提不起劲，像一艘丢掉了太多姿态推进器的船。

"我当然要上军事法庭。安静退休、把嘴闭上，已经是我能指望的最好结局。"

Rao 深吸一口气，然后目光穿过通讯链路，与你的目光相接。"我完了。你...你也把头低下去吧。他们会找人来背这个责任。这就是霸主的做派。"

texts.en: "That's it," he says. "There'll still be work now and then, if you want it. When I get back."
texts.zh: "就这样了，\"他说。\"零星还有些活，你要是想接就接。等我回来。"

texts.en:
"Burn bright."

He reaches for the comms cut-off and the link goes dark.
texts.zh:
"愿你光芒不灭。"

他伸手去关通讯，链路暗了下去。

texts.en: He slowly reaches for the comms cut-off and the link goes dark.
texts.zh: 他缓缓伸手去关通讯，链路暗了下去。

options.en: What about Dolos Macario?
What about Dolos Macario?
Continue
