texts.en:
He closes his eyes. You can see his jaw tighten a little.

"The Hegemony has determined that it's not my concern anymore." Orcus opens his eyes. They are cold, and clear. "We'll see."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛。你能看到他的下颌稍稍绷紧。

"霸主已经认定，这不再是我的事了。\"Orcus 睁开眼。那双眼睛又冷又清。\"我们走着瞧。"

texts.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"Not my problem anymore. It's over."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"不再是我的问题了。都结束了。"

texts.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"Not my problem anymore. It's over."
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"不再是我的问题了。都结束了。"

texts.en:
He gives you a weary look.

"Sindria is toast. Macario with it." A long pause. "That's the line, anyway. The Hegemony has determined that it's not my concern anymore."

"So it's not."
texts.zh:
他疲惫地看了你一眼。

"Sindria 完了。Macario 也跟着完了。\"长久的沉默。\"至少官方是这么说的。霸主已经认定，这不再是我的事了。"

"那就不是吧。"

texts.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"He won."

A hand reflexively balls into a fist, loosely. Rao notices himself, and relaxes. Another sigh.
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"他赢了。"

一只手不自觉地松松握成拳。Rao 自己察觉到了，松开手。又是一声叹息。

texts.en:
"There's no reward for this, $titleHeg. My funding has been frozen pending an investigation."

"I'll be facing a court-martial. Not my first," he adds with a joyless smile. "But I imagine my assignment at Ragnar is going to be renewed until they convince me to retire. It's... what this place is for."

"You keep your head down for a bit, $titleHeg. I take full responsibility for the operation, but they're still going to be looking for people to blame. It's the Hegemony way."
texts.zh:
"这件事没有奖赏，$titleHeg。我的经费已被冻结，等候调查。"

"我要上军事法庭了。这倒不是第一次，\"他补了一句，笑意里没有半分快活。\"不过我猜，我在 Ragnar 的任职会被无限续下去，直到他们说服我退休为止。这地方...就是干这个用的。"

"你也把头低一阵子，$titleHeg。这次行动由我负全责，可他们照样会找人来背锅。这就是霸主的做派。"

texts.en: "My budget is being put under review, but I'm going to make sure you get something for your trouble." He taps something on his datapad.
texts.zh: "我的预算正在被重新审查，不过我会确保你为自己这些麻烦拿到点东西。"他在数据板上点了点什么。

texts.en:
"They're going to call me to stand before the Strategic Council," he says wearily. "An inquiry. Effectively a court-martial but they're not quite calling it that for," he snorts, "public morale."

"I can handle them. Have before, will again. Don't think I'll be leaving Ragnar any time soon though."
texts.zh:
"他们会叫我到战略委员会面前站着，\"他疲惫地说。\"一次调查。实质上就是军事法庭，只是他们不肯这么叫，为了，\"他哼了一声，\"为了士气。"

"我应付得了他们。以前应付过，以后也还得应付。不过我想，我短期内是离不开 Ragnar 了。"

texts.en:
"There's a bit of leftover budget. I'm sure the auditors won't be too put out if I ensure you're rewarded for your service."

"And who knows," he says, "Maybe when everything settles down I'll get promoted out of this back-orbit dumpster and given a seat on some committee. Plenty of those to go around."

He looks off and far away. "Hoping for somewhere warm... not Jangala though, ugh."
texts.zh:
"还剩一点预算。我确保你因这份效劳得到奖赏，审计官们想必不会太介意。"

"谁知道呢，\"他说，\"等一切平息下来，说不定我能从这个后轨道的垃圾堆里升出去，在某个委员会里弄个位子。那种位子多得是。"

他望向远处。"想找个暖和点的地方...不过别是 Jangala，唉。"

texts.en:
"There's a bit of leftover budget. I'm sure the auditors won't be too put out if I ensure you're rewarded for delivering what even they will be forced to admit is a victory."

"And you know what?," his grin only grows, "I have a pretty good feeling that I'm going to get promoted out of this back-orbit dumpster and given a seat on a decent committee. If I'm lucky, I'll even get a choice in the matter!"

"I'm hoping for..." He looks off and far away, basking in an imagined sun. "Somewhere warm. Not Jangala though, ugh."
texts.zh:
"还剩一点预算。我确保你因交付了一场连他们都不得不承认的胜利而得到奖赏，审计官们想必不会太介意。"

"你猜怎么着？\"他的笑越咧越开，\"我有种很好的预感：我能从这个后轨道的垃圾堆里升出去，在一个像样的委员会里弄个位子。运气好的话，我甚至还能自己挑一个！"

"我想去...\"他望向远处，像在享受一轮想象出来的太阳。\"暖和一点的地方。不过别是 Jangala，唉。"

texts.en:
"The auditors are going to be merciless, $titleHeg. My funding is frozen. Under investigation."

He seems older, somehow, and listless, like a ship that's lost most of its maneuvering thrusters.

"I'll be facing a court-martial, of course. Quiet retirement and keeping my mouth shut is about the best I can hope for. They'll be out for blood - someone to blame."

Rao takes a deep breath, then his eyes turn to meet yours through the link.

"I'm done. You... you keep your head down. Even if they find the idiot who provided the Diktat with a PK, the knives will be out."
texts.zh:
"审计官们不会手下留情，$titleHeg。我的经费被冻结了。正在被调查。"

他不知怎么的，看上去更老了，也提不起劲，像一艘丢掉了大半姿态推进器的船。

"我当然要上军事法庭。安静退休、把嘴闭上，差不多就是我能指望的最好结局。他们要来喝血的——总得有人背这个。"

Rao 深吸一口气，然后目光穿过通讯链路，与你的目光相接。

"我完了。你...你也把头低下去吧。就算他们找到那个给辛达强权送上行星杀手的白痴，刀也已经出鞘了。"

texts.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired. But by his eyes you can see he's smiling inside.

"It's good to see you, $titleHeg." He takes a moment, a deep breath.

"We did it."
texts.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。但从他的眼神里能看出，他心里在笑。

"见到你真好，$titleHeg。"他顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"我们做到了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired. He doesn't even look at you.

"I still can't believe the crazy drunk did it," he says.

Now his eyes go to the feed, to you. "There's going to be an inquiry."
texts.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。他甚至没有看你。

"我还是没法相信，那个疯酒鬼居然办成了，"他说。

这时他的目光才转到通讯画面，落到你身上。"接下来会有调查。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"The Hegemony is the living remnant of the Domain. The only authorized possessor of planet-killers." He snorts. "That's the official line."

"Some stupid spacer hard-up for credits must have found a PK somewhere out in the Fringe and thought selling it to the Diktat would be..." he trails off, shaking his head. "Who knows."

He looks away for a long moment.
texts.zh:
"霸主是人之领活着的残片。是唯一被授权持有行星杀手的势力。\"他哼了一声。\"官方说法就是这样。"

"准是哪个缺钱缺疯了的蠢船员，在边缘星域某处翻出一件行星杀手，还以为把它卖给辛达强权能换来...\"他话没说完，摇了摇头。\"谁知道呢。"

他把目光移开，很久没有作声。

options.en: Continue
Did you ever get anything from Daud on the Hyder offer?
options.zh: 关于 Hyder 那个提议，你从 Daud 那儿问到什么了吗？

texts.en:
"I did," he says. "Finally."

He takes a deep breath.

"The answer was no."
texts.zh:
"问到了，\"他说。\"总算问到了。"

他深吸一口气。

"答复是不。"

options.en: Did he say why?

texts.en:
"He didn't, no," Rao answers, then looks away.

"But he made it pretty clear in how he said no. What he didn't say was that he can't look soft on traitors. Not in the current political environment."
texts.zh:
"没说，"Rao 答道，然后把目光移开。

"但他那句'不'是怎么说出口的，已经很清楚了。他没说出口的是：在眼下这种政治气候里，他不能对叛徒显得心软。"

options.en: And Hyder?

texts.en:
"She's got her work cut out for her rebuilding Achilles' navy."

He doesn't sound too pleased about this, but not too upset either.
texts.zh:
"她要重建 Achilles 的舰队，够她忙的了。"

他说这话时听不出多高兴，但也不算太难过。

texts.en:
"I'm surprised she didn't die in battle, what with the defeat of her fleet," he says. "Figured that's how she'd have wanted to go."

"Well, she's got her work cut out for her rebuilding Achilles' navy for the shiny new Sindrian Diktat."

He doesn't sound too pleased about this, but not too upset either.
texts.zh:
"她的舰队都败成那样，她居然没战死，我挺意外，\"他说。\"我以为那会是她想要的死法。"

"不过话说回来，她要为那个崭新的辛达强权重建 Achilles 的舰队，够她忙的了。"

他说这话时听不出多高兴，但也不算太难过。

texts.en:
"Besides, we have it on reasonably good authority she died in battle," he says.

"Probably how she wanted to go."
texts.zh:
"再说，我们有相当可靠的消息来源，说她战死了，"他说。

"大概正是她想要的死法。"

texts.en:
"Besides, we have it on reasonably good authority she died in battle," he says.

"Probably how she wanted to go."
texts.zh:
"再说，我们有相当可靠的消息来源，说她战死了，"他说。

"大概正是她想要的死法。"

texts.en:
He looks back at you, joyless.

"We did pick her up. On Nortia. She surrendered herself from a command shuttle holed through a half dozen times, by the report."
texts.zh:
他回望你，眼里没有笑意。

"我们确实把她接回来了。在 Nortia。报告说，她从一艘被打穿了六七个洞的指挥穿梭机里自己出来投降了。"

texts.en:
He looks back at you, joyless.

"We did pick her up. On the Askonia fringe. She surrendered herself from a command shuttle holed through a half dozen times, by the report."
texts.zh:
他回望你，眼里没有笑意。

"我们确实把她接回来了。在 Askonia 星系的边缘。报告说，她从一艘被打穿了六七个洞的指挥穿梭机里自己出来投降了。"

options.en: Is the Hegemony going to do anything?
Is the Hegemony going to do anything?
Probably. Duty until death.
Probably. Duty until death.
And?
And?

texts.en:
"Do anything?" He snorts. "That's up to the bureaucracy and the committees. Maybe they'll ask Achilles nicely to transfer her to a liaison post so we can nab her."

He shrugs, then looks away. Quiet for a moment.

Nothing more to say.
texts.zh:
"有什么动作？\"他哼了一声。\"那得看官僚和委员会的意思。说不定他们会客客气气地请 Achilles 把她调去做联络官，好让我们把她抓到手里。"

他耸了耸肩，把目光移开。安静了片刻。

没什么可再说的了。

texts.en:
Orcus shrugs.

He is quiet, and his look distant for a moment. Perhaps wondering if that's how he'd want to go.
texts.zh:
Orcus 耸了耸肩。

他沉默着，有一瞬目光很远。也许是在想，那会不会也是他想要的死法。

texts.en:
"In custody. Still sentenced for execution but apparently the Strategic Council isn't in a hurry to have it carried out."

"What does that mean?" Orcus gives you an ironic look. "Ludd's hell if I know. It's up to the bureaucracy now."
texts.zh:
"在押。判决仍是死刑，但显然战略委员会并不急着执行。"

"这是什么意思？\"Orcus 带着讽刺看了你一眼。\"卢德在上，我哪知道。现在这归官僚管了。"

texts.en:
Fortuna appears.

"$TitlePL $PlayerName. I expect to see you soon at Yesod."

"Perhaps we will speak further after your conversation with Achilles," she says.
texts.zh:
Fortuna 出现在画面里。

"$TitlePL $PlayerName，盼着早日在 Yesod 见到你。"

"等你和 Achilles 谈完，或许我们再细聊，" 她说道。

options.en: Speaking of Andrada... I've got some good news for you.
options.zh: 说到 Andrada...我有个好消息要告诉你。

texts.en: "What about him?" She watches you carefully.
texts.zh: "他怎么了？" 她仔细端详着你。

options.en: I'm pretty sure he's braindead. Dolos Macario as much as admitted it to me.
options.zh: 我敢肯定他已经脑死亡了。Dolos Macario 几乎对我承认了这一点。

texts.en:
She frowns, considering your claim.

"Could be. We don't think there's been a legitimate holo-cast from him for at least a cycle."

She shifts the tilt of her head. "But this raises two questions. One, why should we believe anything that comes from that ghoul Macario's mouth? Two, and this is the more pressing question to me, why in the name of Old Earth are you having personal conversations with Dolos Macario, Andrada's chief torturer and spymaster?"
texts.zh:
她皱起眉头，一边思忖你的说法。

"有可能。我们认为他的合法全息影像不会暂停一个星历年那么久。"

她偏了偏头："但这引出两个问题。第一，我们凭什么相信从 Macario 那只食尸鬼嘴里说出的任何话？第二，这也是我更迫切的问题 —— 看在旧地球的份上，你究竟为何会与 Dolos Macario，那个 Andrada 的首席刑讯官兼间谍头子，进行私人对话？"

options.en: I think, given the circumstances, he was being relatively honest.
options.zh: 我认为在这种情况下，他已经算相对诚实了。

options.en: I'm just a merc. He was extremely assertive about giving me a job.
options.zh: 我只是个佣兵。他极其强硬地给了我一份差事

options.en: I'm on a personal mission to undermine the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我在执行一项瓦解 辛达强权 的个人任务。

options.en: I'm on a personal mission to undermine the Sindrian Diktat. (lie)
options.zh: 我在执行一项瓦解 辛达强权 的个人任务。 (说谎)

options.en: I'm a secret Hegemony agent working to undermine the Diktat. (lie)
options.zh: 我是暗中瓦解辛达强权的 霸主 特工。 (说谎)

options.en: I'm in a deep-cover ARC cell you've never heard of working as a double agent. (lie)
options.zh: 我在一个你从未听闻的 Askonia 革命者委员会深度潜伏小组里担任双面特工。 (说谎)

options.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I'm taking them down from the inside. (lie)
options.zh: 我信仰卢德之道，并且正从内部瓦解他们。 (说谎)

options.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I'm taking them down from the inside.
options.zh: 我信仰卢德之道，并且正从内部瓦解他们。

options.en: I'm Persean League fleet intelligence. My real name is 'Siyavong'. (lie)
options.zh: 我是 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部探员，真名叫 'Siyavong'。 (说谎)

texts.en:
You barely get half the words out before Imoinu speaks forcefully over you.

"I don't care about Macario's lies! Answer my question. How are you talking to him?"
texts.zh:
你还没说出半个字就又 Imoinu 厉声打断了。

"我不在乎 Macario 的谎言！回答我的问题，你怎么会和他搭上话的？"

texts.en:
"A merc." Imoinu crosses her arms. "So you only believe in credits. Good for you."

"Did Macario hire you to spread his lies for him? Don't bother answering."
texts.zh:
"佣兵。" Imoinu 抱起双臂，"所以你只相信星币吧。祝你顺利。"

"是 Macario 雇你来替他散布谎言的吧？不用回答了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"And even if you weren't lying about Andrada, practically speaking it doesn't change the situation. Holos can be faked. It's the entire basis of the Diktat propaganda machine."

She shrugs. "The Sindrian Diktat lives on, run by Andrada's underlings in his name. The worlds of Askonia are still held under the boot of the oppressor. The fight must go on."
texts.zh:
"即便你没在 Andrada 的事上撒谎，实际情况也毫无改变。全息影像也可以伪造，这正是独裁政权宣传机器的立身之本。"

她耸了耸肩，"辛达强权 的独裁政权仍在延续，由 Andrada 的爪牙们以他的名义所掌控着。Askonia 的星球仍在被压迫者的铁蹄所践踏，斗争必须继续。"

texts.en:
"And I suppose you're acting as a double agent to take them down from the inside, somehow."

She considers you, though from her face it is clear that her opinion of your methods and their chance of success is not high.

"Okay." She crosses her arms. "I don't think that changes anything."
texts.zh:
"所以你是以双面特工的身份从内部瓦解他们，是吧。"

她审视着你，但表情明显透露出对你的方法及其成功几率评价不高。

"好吧。" 她抱起双臂，"我认为这改变不了什么。"

texts.en:
"And I suppose you're acting as a double agent to take them down from the inside, somehow."

She considers you, though from her face it is clear that her opinion of your methods and their chance of success is not high.

"Okay." She crosses her arms. "I appreciate... the ARC and the United Front appreciate your contribution to the cause."
texts.zh:
"所以你是以双面特工的身份从内部瓦解他们，是吧。"

她审视着你，但表情明显透露出对你的方法及其成功几率评价不高。

"好吧。" 她抱起双臂，"我很感谢...Askonia 革命者委员会与联合阵线很感谢你为事业作出的贡献。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"If what you say is true about Andrada, then it's probably good news. Probably. But practically speaking it doesn't change the situation. Holos can be faked. It's the entire basis of the Diktat propaganda machine."

She shrugs. "Besides, the Sindrian Diktat lives on, run by Andrada's underlings. The worlds of Askonia are still held under the boot of the oppressor. The fight must go on."
texts.zh:
"如果你关于 Andrada 的消息属实，那大概是好消息，大概吧。但实际上这并未改变局势，全息影像也可以伪造，这是独裁者宣传机器的根本运作方式。"

她耸了耸肩，"况且，辛达强权 的独裁政权仍在延续，由 Andrada 的爪牙们掌控。Askonia 的星球仍在被压迫者的铁蹄所践踏，斗争必须继续。"

texts.en: "Sure. Okay." She crosses her arms and gives you an incredulous look.
texts.zh: "行吧。好吧。" 她抱起双臂，向你投来难以置信的目光。

texts.en: "No you're not." Imoinu crosses her arms. "You're as much a liar as Macario."
texts.zh: "不，你可不是。" Imoinu 抱起双臂，"你和 Macario 一样都是骗子罢了。"

texts.en:
"No you're not." Imoinu crosses her arms. "You already used that line on us and it was a lie the first time."

"Did Macario hire you to spread his lies for him? Don't bother answering."
texts.zh:
"不，你可不是。" Imoinu 抱起双臂，"你之前已经对我们用过这套说辞了，而自第一次起就是谎言。"

"是 Macario 雇你来替他散布谎言的吧？不用回答了。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"A Luddic, huh." She has an odd expression, a crease in her brow. Like there's some deep-seated disgust that she's trying to hide.

"Well. Blessings to you, I guess," she says awkwardly. "I don't know whether to believe you or not. You should probably connect with Standfast and the VSDC. Anyway..."
texts.zh:
"卢德信徒，呵。" 她神情古怪，眉头紧蹙，仿佛在压抑某种深藏的嫌恶。

"好吧。愿主赐福于你，大概吧，" 她不自然地应道，"我不知道该不该信你，或许你该联系 Standfast 和 Volturn 自卫盟约。总之..."

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Finlay Siyavong? Ha!"

You can hear the aristocrat in her laugh. It is bitter, and a potential for sharp cruelty hides there.

"I've met him, you fool. You're not Finlay Siyavong. You're a liar."
texts.zh:
"Finlay Siyavong？哈！"

她的笑声里透着贵族式的刻薄。那是一种苦涩的、可能隐含着尖锐与残忍的笑声。

"我见过他，你这蠢货。你不是 Finlay Siyavong，你就是个骗子。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: The question now is, do you continue and contact Achilles Andrada, perhaps to pledge support for him?
texts.zh: 现在的问题是：你是否继续，去联系 Achilles Andrada，或许向他宣誓效忠？

texts.en: This means your arrangement with Reynard Hannan is unambiguously concluded. If you want help with the Askonia situation, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh: 这意味着你与 Reynard Hannan 的约定已彻底了结。若想在 Askonia 的局势上得到助力，你只能另寻门路。

texts.en: Your arrangement with Reynard Hannan is unambiguously concluded. If you want help with the Askonia situation, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh: 你与 Reynard Hannan 的约定已彻底了结。若想在 Askonia 的局势上得到助力，你只能另寻门路。

options.en: Yes, I will speak to Achilles
options.zh: 是的，我会去找 Achilles 谈谈

options.en: No, I'm not doing that

texts.en: You will speak to Achilles. Perhaps there is someone worthwhile to support in this conflict...
texts.zh: 你会去找 Achilles 谈。这场冲突里，也许真有什么人值得你扶持...

options.en: Close the comms interface

texts.en: You pledge to yourself to find your own way through this mess.
texts.zh: 你暗下决心，要在这摊浑水里闯出自己的一条路。

options.en: Close the comms interface
I have come to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。

texts.en:
Achilles almost smiles, then acknowledges your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 几乎露出笑意，随后以一个点头而非鞠躬，算是领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

options.en: The way I see it, if I can be rich, you can be Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 在我看来，只要我能发财，你就能当上最高元首。

options.en: Remember, I'm doing this for the Persean League.
options.zh: 记住，我做这些是为了英仙座联盟。

options.en: I do think you'll be the best for Askonia.
options.zh: 我确实认为，对 Askonia 来说，你才是最好的选择。

options.en: You must not become a client, a puppet, of Fortuna Kato.
options.zh: 你绝不能变成 Fortuna Kato 的门客、她的傀儡。

options.en: I want to ensure Macario is removed. I assume you're agreed?
options.zh: 我要确保 Macario 被除掉。我想你对此没有异议？

options.en: I'm only doing this so I can see Macario dead.
options.zh: 我这么做，只是为了亲眼看到 Macario 死。

options.en: It wasn't cheap.

texts.en:
"$TitlePL." Achilles begins to speak, then falters.

It's the first time you've seen him like this. He seems uncomfortable owing anyone such gratitude as would be appropriate.

"I'll assign a liaison officer, and," he pauses again. "I should say... thank you, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"$TitlePL。"Achilles 开口，又顿住了。

你还是头一次见他这样。看来欠下别人这样一份感激，让他浑身不自在。

"我会派一名联络官，还有——\"他又顿住。\"我该说... 谢谢你，$titlePL。"

texts.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
texts.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

texts.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
texts.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

texts.en: "Now," he says. "There is much to see done."
texts.zh: "现在，\"他说。\"还有许多事等着办。"

texts.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer. "My staff will contact you. An invitation. Will you do this? I ask no oath or pledge, simply your presence at... an important announcement."
texts.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气已换成指挥官那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。你愿意来吗？我不要誓言，也不要承诺，只要你到场——出席... 一场重要的宣告。"

texts.en:
As he draws breath to speak further some kind of alert sounds. With an annoyed look he presses his cuff and holds it to his ear.

"Understood." Achilles' expression hardens.

His eyes turn to you. "Setting this link to standby."
texts.zh:
他吸了口气，正要继续往下说，某种警报响了。他面露恼色，按下袖口，把它凑到耳边。

"明白。"Achilles 的神情沉了下去。

他的目光转向你。"这条链路转入待机。"

options.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
options.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

options.en: What's going on?

texts.en:
"You'll know shortly." His words are clipped. "Talk after."

The comms cut to a holding pattern.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." You hear the voice of your comms officer.

They do not, as a rule, use priority override to interrupt your comms.
texts.zh:
"你很快就知道了。\"他的话音短促。\"之后再谈。"

通讯转入保持状态。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"你听见通讯官的声音。

按规矩，他们不会用优先权限打断你的通讯。

options.en: Report. What is it?

texts.en: "Holofeed rebroadcast from Sindria- priority signal. Content sweep flagged critical high interest."
texts.zh: "由 Sindria 转发的全息推送——优先信号。内容筛查标记为最高关注级别。"

options.en: Put it on.

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've already heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我已经听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

texts.en:
"I cannot disagree."

He smiles, though it is a cold smile. "Leadership in Askonia has been rather scarce of late, has it not?"
texts.zh:
"我无法反驳。"

他笑了笑，只是那笑冷得很。"最近 Askonia 的领导人可是相当稀缺，不是吗？"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"Strange, though, this behaviour... from a client of Fortuna Kato. Or do you call it a partnership?"
texts.zh:
"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过真奇怪，这种做派... 竟出自 Fortuna Kato 的一个门客。还是说，你们管这叫合伙？"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I am entirely untroubled by your motivation, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he was behind the assassination attempt that Fleet Intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫不介意，舰长。毕竟那场暗杀——舰队情报部乐意称之为'一场酒吧斗殴'——多半是他主使的，虽然还不能确定。"

texts.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I have no qualms with your motive, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he tried to have me assassinated in what League intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'. The other possibilities..."
texts.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫无意见，舰长。毕竟他多半——虽然还不能确定——就是想让人暗杀我，而联盟情报部门乐意把这事称作'一场酒吧斗殴'。其余的可能性..."

texts.en:
"You made a wager, captain, and I presume you accept the risk that entails."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"I'll see that you win, however. Though not for the sake of your accounts."
texts.zh:
"你下了注，舰长，我猜你也接受随之而来的风险。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过，我会让你赢的。虽然不是为了你的账本。"

options.en: You sold Jason's info to a Diktat agent.
options.zh: 你把 Jason 的情报卖给了辛达强权的一个特工。

texts.en:
"So you caught up with the tiger cub?" He looks as pleased with himself as ever. "Well done, captain."

"If I may?" Jove holds up a finger. "I anticipate a certain indignation based on your phrasing and tone."

"It's true, more detailed data was discovered upon further inquiry made by myself and my organization following our own conversation. Jason Korin is, after all, a much more interesting person than I could ever have imagined."

He blinks innocently.

"I meant 'was', of course."
texts.zh:
"这么说，你追上那只小老虎了？\"他看上去一如既往地自得。\"干得好，船长。"

"容我插一句？\" Jove 竖起一根手指。\"从你的措辞和语气里，我预感到一阵怒气。"

"确实如此。我们那番谈话之后，我与我的人又做了一番追查，发现了更详细的数据。毕竟，Jason Korin 这个人比我所能想象的要有趣得多。"

他无辜地眨了眨眼。

"当然，我的意思是——【曾经是】。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You, in fact, held back certain essential facts from me. Well, one particularly crucial fact about Jason... Andrada's heritage."

He leans back, looking satisfied.
texts.zh:
"事实上，你对我瞒下了一些关键事实。嗯，一个格外要紧的事实：Jason...Andrada 的血脉。"

他向后一靠，一脸满意。

texts.en:
"Pardon me. Jason Andrada, I mean."

"There's profit to be found in the wake of important people, you see. Besides, we had no exclusive arrangement," he gives a little wave. "You have no basis for complaint."
texts.zh:
"恕我失言。我是说，Jason Andrada。"

"要紧人物走过之后，留下的尾流里是有钱可赚的，你瞧。再说，我们之间并没有排他约定。\"他轻轻一摆手。\"你没有理由抱怨。"

options.en: So you figured it out.
Pedantry won't make you any friends.
I'm not confirming your speculation.
I would appreciate a little discretion.
options.zh: 希望你能稍稍谨慎一些。

options.en: You assisted the Sindrian Diktat. That's my complaint.
options.zh: 你帮了辛达强权。这就是我的不满。

options.en: You betrayed secrets of the Sindrian Diktat. That's my complaint.
options.zh: 你泄露了辛达强权的机密。这就是我的不满。

options.en: I've heard enough.

texts.en: "No. I inferred it." His tone is crisp.
texts.zh: "不。我是推断出来的。"他的语气干脆。

texts.en:
"I don't want or need 'friends'," he almost hisses the word.

"I want competent associates. Collaborators, clients, partners; whatever. I want them clear-eyed, because I tire of simpleminded brutes and self-deluded fanatics. They're sloppy. They're fools."

He takes a deep breath. "Still making up my mind about you, captain."
texts.zh:
"我不想要，也不需要【朋友】。"这个词几乎是从他齿间嘶出来的。

"我要的是能办事的同伙。合作者、客户、伙伴，随便叫什么。我要他们眼睛清楚，因为我受够了头脑简单的莽夫和自欺欺人的狂信徒。他们做事毛糙。他们都是蠢货。"

他深吸一口气。"至于你，船长，我还在下判断。"

texts.en: "You don't need to," he waves airily. "That gormless Diktat agent was confirmation enough."
texts.zh: "不必了。\"他漫不经心地一挥手。\"强权那个蠢头蠢脑的探子已经足够作证。"

texts.en:
"Then I graciously accept your appreciation, captain," he smiles broadly and insincerely. "I revealed nothing of you or of any agreement made between us to anyone else."

"What you, yes, must understand is that this information - the ripples made by the life and death of Jason Andrada - was already loose in the world when you stepped into that bar on Qaras. You can't stop it, and couldn't."

He rests his chin on both his hands.

"The question is, and this I eagerly await to witness, is what you do next."
texts.zh:
"那我就恭敬地领受你的谢意了，船长。\"他笑得开朗，却毫无诚意。\"关于你，关于我们之间的任何约定，我一个字都没向旁人透露。"

"你必须明白的是——没错，你必须明白——这些消息，Jason Andrada 的生死所激起的涟漪，在你踏进 Qaras 那间酒吧时就已经在这世上散开了。你阻止不了，也从来阻止不了。"

他把下巴搁在双手上。

"问题在于——这一点我正热切地等着看——你接下来会做什么。"

texts.en:
"I would not be so confident that what I did was assistance," Jove says, stroking his chin.

"It was, however, profitable to me."
texts.zh:
"我做过的事算不算帮忙，你最好别那么有把握。"Jove 摩挲着下巴说。

"不过，那对我很有赚头。"

texts.en:
"To whom?" He looks less amused now. "To an agent of the one-and-same Sindrian Diktat? A patrol commander of the Sindrian Diktat with a fake uniform?"

"If that is the house to which you pledge your loyalty, captain, then I am afraid the betrayal is not on my part."
texts.zh:
"背叛了谁？\"他此刻不那么觉得好笑了。\"背叛了同一个辛达强权的探子？还是辛达强权某个穿着假制服、冒充巡逻指挥官的家伙？"

"如果你效忠的是那样一个门庭，船长，那我恐怕要说，背叛的人不是我。"

texts.en: Jove nods, eyes closed, looking quite calm.
texts.zh: Jove 闭着眼点了点头，神情相当平静。

options.en: You sold Jason's info to a Sindrian Diktat double-agent.
options.zh: 你把 Jason 的情报卖给了辛达强权的一个双面间谍。

options.en: I need to run a little operation on Qaras. I'd like to keep it quiet.
options.zh: 我要在 Qaras 上做个小行动。希望动静别太大。

texts.en:
"This is about the goon who shoved a gun in your face outside the bar." He places his hands together. "Yes, I heard about it. No, he wasn't mine."

"Now tell me a story about why I ought to help you navigate our tangled little web of protection agreements."
texts.zh:
"是为了那个在酒吧外把枪顶到你脸上的打手。\"他把双手并在一起。\"是的，我听说了。不，他不是我的人。"

"现在，讲个故事给我听，说说我为什么该帮你在这张乱成一团的小小保护协议网里找条路。"

texts.en:
"Oh, fine. Yes, I'll back you. No charge." Jove gives you an indulgent look. "We can't just allow goons to shove guns in the face of a 'fellow corsair', especially not after a meeting with myself."

"Yes, of course I heard about it. No, the goon wasn't mine. And yes, I assume you got everything you needed from a bit of interrogation."

"Anyway, the worst part of all of this," he examines a fingernail, "it sullies the integrity of my hospitality."
texts.zh:
"哦，好吧。行，我支持你。不收钱。\"Jove 宽容地看了你一眼。\"总不能让打手把枪顶到一位'同道私掠船长'脸上，尤其还是刚跟我见过面之后。"

"是的，我当然听说了。不，那打手不是我的人。还有，我猜你从那点审讯里该问的都问到了。"

"总之，这一切里最糟的一点，\"他端详着一片指甲，\"是它脏了我待客之道的名声。"

texts.en:
"Oh... fine. Yes, I'll back you - no charge." Jove gives you an indulgent look. "We can't just allow goons to shove guns in people's faces, especially not after a meeting with myself."

"Yes, of course I heard about it. No, the goon wasn't mine. And yes, I assume you got everything you needed from a bit of interrogation."

"Anyway, the worst part of all of this," he examines a fingernail, "it sullies the integrity of my hospitality."
texts.zh:
"哦...好吧。行，我支持你——不收钱。\"Jove 宽容地看了你一眼。\"总不能让打手把枪顶到别人脸上，尤其还是刚跟我见过面之后。"

"是的，我当然听说了。不，那打手不是我的人。还有，我猜你从那点审讯里该问的都问到了。"

"总之，这一切里最糟的一点，\"他端详着一片指甲，\"是它脏了我待客之道的名声。"

options.en: Threatening me with a gun was the worst part, I'd say.
options.zh: 要我说，最糟的是有人拿枪指着我。

options.en: Threatening me with a gun was the worst part, I'd say.
options.zh: 要我说，最糟的是有人拿枪指着我。

texts.en:
"Sure, sure. Matter of perspective," he says. "Anyway, I'll make sure no one interferes with your revenge plot."

$HeOrShe gives an ironic little salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
"当然，当然。看从谁的角度说，\"他说。\"总之，我会保证没人来搅你的复仇。"

$HeOrShe 行了个带讥意的小礼。"玩得开心。"

options.en: Would 10,000 credits buy your support?
Would 10,000 credits buy your support?
How about 15,000 credits.
How about 15,000 credits.
You already have an answer. You just want me to say it.
options.zh: 你心里早有答案。你只是想让我说出口。

options.en: Maybe later... (back)

texts.en: "You already know it'll be 15,000," he says, seemingly disinterested.
texts.zh: "你早知道是 15,000，"他说得像是毫无兴致。

texts.en: "Boring," he says. "It'll be 15,000. And no, I won't budget on the price, so don't bother with the 'meeting you halfway' with 12,500. I'm not interested."
texts.zh: "没意思。\"他说。\"就是 15,000。也别想我在这价上让步，省了那套 12,500'各让一步'的说辞。我没兴趣。"

texts.en:
He holds his wrist to his ear, theatrical, and nods when it gives a soft chime.

"No one will interfere with your little revenge plot." $HeOrShe gives an ironic salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
他装模作样地把手腕举到耳边，听见一声轻响，便点了点头。

"没人会来搅你那点复仇的小算盘。"$HeOrShe 行了个带讥意的礼。"玩得开心。"

texts.en:
"Is that so?" He looks genuinely intrigued.

"Prove yourself. What is it?"
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他看上去真被勾起了兴趣。

"那就拿出点东西来。是什么？"

options.en: In truth, it's several points which reinforce one another.
options.zh: 实话说，是几点理由，彼此互相支撑。

texts.en: He makes a rolling hand motion - get on with it.
texts.zh: 他抬起手做了个催促的手势——往下说。

options.en: You're an information broker. You must have integrity.
options.zh: 你是情报贩子。信誉总得有。

texts.en:
To sell information at a top price, you explain, his clients must believe that he is trustworthy. And not only that - they must believe that his judgement is solid. Jove himself must know who to trust in order to separate good information from bad. Or he must know precisely how little to trust the untrustworthy to turn bad information into good.

He nods, evidently enjoying your explanation.

You continue: a client attacked in public immediately after meeting with him does not project the image of a trustworthy enterprise. It raises uncomfortable, unprofitable questions. And if the attack was not carried out on his order, it's only worse, because that means a third party sees him as weak. An opportunity to exploit. This would mean that K-O Jove does not have the judgement necessary to handle his own affairs.
texts.zh:
你解释说，要把情报卖出最高价，他的客户就必须相信他可靠。而不止于此——他们还得相信他的判断是稳的。Jove 自己就得知道谁可信，才能从坏情报里挑出好的。又或者，他得非常清楚该少信那些不可信的人几分，才好把坏情报变成好情报。

他点头，显然颇享受你这一番解释。

你接着说：一个刚跟他见过面、就在公开场合被袭击的客户，传达不出任何可靠生意的形象。它会引出些令人不适、也赚不到钱的问题。而如果这场袭击不是他下的令，那就更糟——因为那意味着有第三方视他为软弱。是个可以下手的机会。而这也就意味着，K-O Jove 不具备处理自己事务所需的判断力。

options.en: You see, my problem is your problem.
options.zh: 你看，我的麻烦就是你的麻烦。

texts.en:
"I suppose." Jove watches you carefully.

"What you ask is not trivial. Favors must be called, bribes paid. Qaras is built on relationships and not all are so... trusting... as that between you and I."
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"Jove 仔细看着你。

"你求的不是小事。人情要动用，贿赂要打点。Qaras 是立在一层层关系上的，而这些关系并不都像你我之间这么...信得过..."

options.en: Exactly. When you are indebted to another, your problems become theirs...
options.zh: 正是如此。你欠了别人的时候，你的麻烦也就成了他们的...

texts.en:
You elaborate: if K-O Jove owes some other gang, syndicate, cell, boss, or clade, it ties their interests into alignment. None profits from annihilation of the other. Indeed, when Jove owes a debt of credits or favor, it will profit his creditor when he thrives.

Jove closes his eyes, not shaking his head, no; his subtle smile remains.

"Enough, captain. Enough. If I listen to more of this I'll be a poor man indeed, despite my many interested friends."
texts.zh:
你进一步说：若 K-O Jove 欠着别的帮派、辛迪加、小队、头目或宗族的债，那便把双方的利益捆到了一处。哪一方被彻底铲掉，另一方都无利可图。事实上，当 Jove 欠着一笔星币或人情的债时，他越兴旺，债主就越得利。

Jove 闭上眼睛，没有摇头，没有；那抹浅笑还挂着。

"够了，舰长。够了。再听下去，我就要变成一个穷光蛋了——尽管我有那么多愿意关照我的朋友。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I'll make sure no one interferes with your revenge plot. One supposes all of Qaras will be better for it, somehow - I'll hold you to that."

$HeOrShe gives an ironic little salute. "Have fun."
texts.zh:
"我会保证没人来搅你的复仇。想来这么一折腾，Qaras 上下多少会更好些——这话我可记在你账上。"

$HeOrShe 行了个带讥意的小礼。"玩得开心。"

texts.en: He gives you a look of patience which is anything but.
texts.zh: 他给了你一个耐心的眼神——只是完全不是那个意思。

options.en: I have a problem named Dolos Macario - perhaps you can help.
options.zh: 我有个麻烦，名叫 Dolos Macario——也许你能帮上忙。

texts.en:
His amusement, if anything, grows.

"Help." Jove puts a finger to his lips. "Perhaps."

"A direct assassination would be unlikely, if that was your meaning. Perhaps something more subtle?"
texts.zh:
他的笑意反倒更浓了。

"帮忙。\"Jove 把一根手指按在唇上。\"也许吧。"

"如果你指的是直接暗杀，那恐怕不太可能。要不要来点更隐蔽的手段？"

options.en: Even if I defeat the Sindrian Diktat myself, he's sure to run and hide.
options.zh: 就算我亲手打败辛达强权，他也一定会跑、会藏。

texts.en:
"Yes, I expect he would."

Jove allows a more serious expression to grow.

"You suggest that if Macario's present arrangement - the Sindrian Diktat - is broken by superior force, you would like me to then ascertain his subsequent whereabouts? Hm."

He's rubbing his hands together thoughtfully. You suspect that's a good sign.
texts.zh:
"没错，我想他会。"

Jove 的神情渐渐严肃起来。

"你的意思是，如果 Macario 眼下赖以存身的依仗——辛达强权——被更强的武力打碎，你希望我再去查明他之后的去向？嗯。"

他若有所思地搓着双手。你觉得这是个好兆头。

texts.en: He rubs his hands together, though thoughtfully. You suspect that's a good sign.
texts.zh: 他搓着双手，不过带着思量的意味。你觉得这是个好兆头。

options.en: I wish to deal with Dolos... personally.
options.zh: Dolos 的事...我想亲自了结。

options.en: He must answer to the people of the Sector for his crimes.
options.zh: 他必须为自己的罪行向星域的人民作答。

options.en: He must answer to the true heir of Andrada for his treason!
options.zh: 他必须为自己的叛国罪向 Andrada 真正的继承人作答！

options.en: He must answer to the new Supreme Executor for his crimes.
options.zh: 他必须为自己的罪行向新任最高元首作答。

options.en: It doesn't matter why. He must be stopped.
options.zh: 理由不重要。必须拦住他。

texts.en:
"Personally." His eyebrows raise. "I understand, captain."

"Personally," his smile grows, "I am interested in your credits. And I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting challenge."
texts.zh:
"亲自。\"他挑起眉毛。\"我明白，舰长。"

"就我个人而言，\"他的笑容加深，\"我感兴趣的是你的星币。而且我得承认，一项...有趣的挑战，确实有点吸引力。"

texts.en:
"Personally." His eyebrows raise. "I understand, captain."

"Personally," his smile grows, "I am interested in Reynard's credits. And I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting problem."
texts.zh:
"为了私怨。\"他挑起眉毛，\"我明白，舰长。"

"为了私怨，\"他的笑意深了，\"那我就对 Reynard 的星币感兴趣了。而且我得承认，一个...有意思的难题，确实挺吸引我。"

options.en: How interesting? In credits, I mean.
options.zh: 有多有趣？我是说，值多少星币。

texts.en:
"I'll require a fee, a retainer, of 80,000 credits immediately then 80,000 credits upon 'delivery' of the target."

"It'll take time. But I'll know how to contact you." He smiles carnivorously. "It's what I do."

"Deal?" His eyes are bright. Keen, even.
texts.zh:
"我要收一笔费用，也就是定金：80,000 星币，立刻支付；目标'交付'之后，再付 80,000 星币。"

"这需要时间。不过我知道该怎么联系你。\"他露出掠食者般的笑容，\"这是我的本行。"

"成交？"他两眼发亮，甚至称得上锐利。

texts.en:
"I'll require a fee, a retainer, of 80,000 credits immediately then 80,000 credits upon 'delivery' of the target. And you, or your proxies, must unseat Dolos Macario from the office of Chief High Inspector-General. Once that is done, I will do my part to find what hole he scurries off to hide in."

"It'll take time. But I'll know how to contact you." He smiles carnivorously. "It's what I do."

"Deal?" His eyes are bright. Keen, even.
texts.zh:
"我要收一笔费用，也就是定金：80,000 星币，立刻支付；目标'交付'之后，再付 80,000 星币。另外，你或者你的代理人，必须把 Dolos Macario 从首席总监察长的位子上赶下来。等这件事办完，我再来尽我的本分，找出他钻进了哪个洞里躲着。"

"这需要时间。不过我知道该怎么联系你。\"他露出掠食者般的笑容，\"这是我的本行。"

"成交？"他两眼发亮，甚至称得上锐利。

texts.en:
"Beautiful," he says. "I'll find your spider, captain."

He picks up a TriPad, presses a finger to it and begins flicking the interface around, then halts. Looks up.

"I shall contact you as the situation... develops. In the meantime, may I presume that is all?"
texts.zh:
"漂亮，\"他说，\"我会替你找到那只蜘蛛，舰长。"

他拿起一台 TriPad，把手指按上去，开始划弄界面，随后停住，抬起头。

"等局势...有了进展，我会联系你。在那之前，我想就这些了？"

texts.en:
"Beautiful," he says. "I'll find your spider, captain. You just need to send him running."

He picks up a TriPad, presses a finger to it and begins flicking the interface around, then halts. Looks up.

"In the meantime, may I presume that is all?"
texts.zh:
"漂亮，\"他说，\"我会替你找到那只蜘蛛，舰长。你只需要把他惊动起来。"

他拿起一台 TriPad，把手指按上去，开始划弄界面，随后停住，抬起头。

"在那之前，我想就这些了？"

texts.en:
"Happily, I have been paid my retainer as well as a generous bonus," he says. "With double that on delivery. I'll find your spider, captain, if that's what pleases the Prime Demarchon."

He picks up a TriPad, presses a finger to it and begins flicking the interface around, then halts. Looks up.

"May I presume that is all? These things take time."
texts.zh:
"很乐意，定金已经到手，还外加一笔慷慨的奖金，\"他说，\"交付时还有双倍。我会替你找到那只蜘蛛，舰长——只要这能让大统领满意。"

他拿起一台 TriPad，把手指按上去，开始划弄界面，随后停住，抬起头。

"我想就这些了？这种事急不得。"

texts.en: "That would be profoundly uninteresting to me," he says, his smile growing thinner.
texts.zh: "那对我来说就极其无趣了，"他说着，笑意淡了几分。

texts.en:
"His crimes?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Truly, I'm not concerned with whatever justice you imagine this will serve. But your credits, those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting challenge."
texts.zh:

"说实话，我不在乎你想让这事成全什么样的正义。但你的星币，那个我有兴趣。而且，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一项...有趣的挑战，确实有点吸引力。"

texts.en:
"True heir?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Hector?"

Jove appears about to speak further, but instead catches himself and touches his lips with both hands to demonstrate that he is withholding comment.

"I leave your motivation to your own concern. But your credits? Those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an interesting challenge."
texts.zh:
"真正的继承人？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛。\"Hector？"

Jove 似乎还想说下去，却及时收住，用双手碰了碰嘴唇，表示自己忍住不评论。

"你的动机，你自己操心就好。但你的星币？那个我有兴趣。而且，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一项有趣的挑战，确实有点吸引力。"

"It doesn't matter?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Insatiable curiosity aside, I'm not concerned with your reason or purported lack thereof. But your credits, those are very much of interest."

"Besides," he sighs, "I admit there is the intrinsic draw to an... interesting challenge."

texts.en:
"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He gives you a meaningful look, then folds his hands together.
texts.zh:
"恕我直言，凡不属英仙座联盟成员、也未以联盟之名领受委任的人，我连谈一谈势力安全事务的门都无从谈起。"

他意味深长地看了你一眼，双手交叠。

texts.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

texts.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

texts.en: "Before we continue," he says, "there's a small matter..."
texts.zh: "在继续之前，\"他说，\"还有一件小事..."

options.en: Yes?
I need to talk to you about Fortuna Kato's plans with Achilles.
options.zh: 我得跟你谈谈 Fortuna Kato 围绕 Achilles 的打算。

texts.en:
"With respect for my position and duty, $titlePL, I would prefer not to discuss the situation from a perspective which could be misconstrued as favoring one or another of the Gens."

Siyavong doesn't change his expression.

"Perhaps we might speak again when the situation becomes... more clearly applicable to the security of the Persean League." He pauses. "And, perhaps, to one of its citizens, commission-bearers, or even a demarchon."
texts.zh:
"出于对我职位与职责的尊重，$titlePL，我不愿从某个可能被误解为偏袒某一氏族的立场来谈这件事。"

Siyavong 面色不改。

"也许等局势...更明确地涉及英仙座联盟的安全时，我们可以再谈。\"他顿了顿。\"或者，涉及它的某位公民、某位持委任状者，甚至某位统领时。"

options.en: I'd like to speak with Doctor Cydonia.
options.zh: 我想跟 Cydonia 医生谈谈。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe gives you a look of at least mild shock and perhaps moderate disgust.

"Bloody stars, why? You're... you're not making a 'delivery' are ya?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 看了你一眼，那眼神至少有几分错愕，或许还有几分不加掩饰的厌恶。

"群星在上，为什么？你... 你不是来'送货'的吧？"

texts.en: $HeOrShe sounds skeptical, but may answer some questions.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe 的语气里带着怀疑，不过也许愿意回答几个问题。

texts.en: $HeOrShe sounds like $heOrShe is on the edge of cutting the comms on you. You're unlikely to get much more from $himOrHer.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe 听上去随时都会切断你的通讯，$heOrShe 大概已经忍到极限了。你恐怕很难再从 $himOrHer 那里问出什么。

options.en: No, I want to find out what he did at the Cryosanctum on Nomios.
options.zh: 不是。我想弄清楚他在 Nomios 的冷冻圣所里做了什么。

options.en: 'Meat trade', huh. I heard he was doing more sophisticated work.
options.zh: '卖肉'，是吗。我听说他做的是更精细的活儿。

options.en: Do I look like a servitor? I've my own business which is none of yours.
options.zh: 我看起来像个仆役吗？我有我自己的事，跟你无关。

options.en: Maybe I'll just deliver 1000 credits to your accounts... (bribe)
options.zh: 也许我干脆往你的账户里送 1000 星币... (贿赂)

options.en: A delivery. Yes. For the doctor. Live specimens. Very... delicate. (lie)
options.zh: 送货。对。给医生的。活体样本。非常... 娇贵。 (说谎)

options.en: Actually, never mind. (back)

texts.en:
The pirate look is no less confounded.

"Meat trade, s'what he did isn't it? Chopping them frosty corpsies up for bits? Common knowledge, I'd think."
texts.zh:
那海盗脸上的困惑一点没减。

"'卖肉'，他干的不就是这个吗？把那些冻得硬邦邦的尸首剁成块？我还以为这是人人都知道的。"

texts.en:
$PersonName looks aside, a queasy look crossing their face.

"Whatever that is, I've ain't got nothing to do with it, truth, and it's none of my business besides."
OR
"What, augments and suchlike?" $heOrShe says.

"Cydonia does them, I suppose. Nowabouts he oils the queen's clanky parts, rigs wires and neurointerfacing or whatnot, I hear."

A shrug. Not $hisOrHer business.
texts.zh:
$PersonName 把脸转向一边，脸上掠过一阵反胃的神色。

"不管那是什么，都跟我没关系，说真的，好吧，反正不归我操心。"
OR
"什么，植入体之类的东西？"$heOrShe说。

"Cydonia 大概就干这个。眼下他给女王那些叮当响的部件上油，接线、搞神经接口什么的，我听说。"

耸了耸肩。不关$hisOrHer的事。

texts.en:
"Oh, well good on you $playerSirOrMadam! I'm honored to be spoke down at by your fanciness."

$HeOrShe spits, though the effect is somewhat diminished by the spittle landing on $hisOrHer own console.

"I'll not be be wasting your time no more, by yer leave."
texts.zh:
"哦，那可真了不起啊，$playerSirOrMadam！能被您这样的大人物居高临下地说上两句，我真是荣幸。"

$HeOrShe 吐了口唾沫，不过那点气势打了折扣——唾沫落在了$hisOrHer自己的控制台上。

"那我就不再耽误您的时间了，告退。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The comms are cut rather abruptly.
OR
The link is immediately terminated.
OR
The image snaps to static, the link rudely broken before both parties' comms could acknowledge the command.
texts.zh:
通讯被颇为突兀地切断了。
OR
链接即刻中断。
OR
画面骤然化作雪花，双方通讯还来不及应答这道指令，链接便被粗鲁地掐断。

texts.en:
"Now we're talkin' my language." $PersonName's face looks suddenly much brighter as $heOrShe pulls up a datapad and taps at it. Your comms ping as an ID is received.

"That's done with, so I don't want to hear anything more about it. I don't want to know what that freak is doing - and don't mention my name to him."
texts.zh:
"这话才说到点子上了。"$PersonName 的脸一下子亮了起来，$heOrShe 抽出一块数据板点了几下。你的通讯器叮的一声，收到一个身份识别码。

"账已经清了，所以这事我不想再听一个字。我也不想知道那个怪胎在干什么——还有，别在他面前提我的名字。"

texts.en:
"Ugh." $HeOrShe eyes you suspiciously.

$HeOrShe pulls up a datapad and taps at it. Your comms ping as an ID is received.

"I don't want to hear anything about it. I don't want to know what that freak is doing. And don't mention my name to him."
texts.zh:
"呃。"$HeOrShe 狐疑地打量着你。

$HeOrShe 抽出一块数据板，在上面点了几下。你的通讯器叮的一声，收到一个身份识别码。

"这事我一个字都不想听。我也不想知道那个怪胎在干什么。还有，别在他面前提我的名字。"

options.en: I told Horus Yaribay I'm backing you and Achilles. And so should he.
options.zh: 我告诉过 Horus Yaribay，我站在你和 Achilles 这一边。他也该如此。

texts.en:
She looks mildly amused.

"Rather direct of you, but nonetheless appreciated. I am in the midst of negotiations with Gens Yaribay and hope that he will see the wisdom of my plan."

"Perhaps your good word will tip his opinion," Fortuna says charitably. "But these things take time. Especially with Horus."
texts.zh:
她看上去被逗乐了一点。

"你倒是直截了当，不过我还是领情。我正在与 Yaribay 氏族谈判，希望他能看出我这套计划的明智之处。"

"也许你的一句好话能让他的看法偏过来。\"Fortuna 说得宽厚，\"不过这种事急不得。尤其是对 Horus。"

options.en: Is there anything I can do to help with Achilles?
options.zh: 关于 Achilles 的事，我能帮上什么忙吗？

texts.en:
"Patience, my dear, patience," she says indulgently. "You'll have an opportunity soon enough."

"In the meantime, ready yourself for the coming war."
texts.zh:
"耐心，亲爱的，耐心。\"她纵容地说，\"机会很快就会来的。"

"在那之前，为即将到来的战争做好准备。"

texts.en:
"Patience, my dear, patience," she says indulgently. "You'll have an opportunity to earn more credits soon enough."

"In the meantime, ready yourself for the coming war."
texts.zh:
"耐心，亲爱的，耐心。\"她纵容地说，\"机会很快就会来，让你挣到更多星币。"

"在那之前，为即将到来的战争做好准备。"

options.en: Is there anything I can do to help with Achilles?
options.zh: 关于 Achilles 的事，我能帮上什么忙吗？

texts.en: "A matter comes to mind," she says suddenly.
texts.zh: "我想起一件事，"她忽然说。

texts.en:
"Horus Yaribay," she says, watching you. "It is known that you've worked closely with him on matters essential to his interests. There is trust."

A pause.

"I would like you to ask him to back Gens Kato in the All-League Council."

"The obstruction of Prime Demarchon can be overridden with a majority vote, and if Horus delivered me, us, that majority... we would not have to resort to bureaucratic trickery and outright smuggling to support Achilles' fleets."
texts.zh:
"Horus Yaribay，\"她说着，目光落在你身上，\"众所周知，你曾与他密切合作，办过几件关系到他切身利益的大事。你们之间有信任。"

她停了停。

"我希望你去请他在全联盟议会上支持 Kato 氏族。"

"大统领的阻挠可以用多数票压下去，而如果 Horus 能为我、为我们带来那个多数...我们就不必再靠官僚把戏和明摆着的走私去支援 Achilles 的舰队了。"

options.en: I will ask Horus to back you, on your behalf.
options.zh: 我会替你去找 Horus，请他支持你。

options.en: I could ask Horus. The trust I've earned from him is not cheap, however...
options.zh: 我可以去找 Horus。不过，我在他那里挣来的信任可不便宜...

options.en: I apologize, but I cannot instrumentalize the trust Horus has placed in me.
options.zh: 抱歉，但我不能把 Horus 对我的信任当作工具。

options.en: I apologize, but I cannot instrumentalize the trust Horus has placed in me. (lie)
options.zh: 抱歉，但我不能把 Horus 对我的信任当作工具。 (说谎)

texts.en: "You have my thanks, $titlePL," she says graciously.
texts.zh: "多谢你，$titlePL，"她仪态从容地说道。

texts.en:
A cynical smile appears for a moment.

"Of course. That is our arrangement."

Fortuna taps her TriPad.

"Speak to Horus."
texts.zh:
一丝讥讽的笑在她脸上一闪而过。

"当然。我们就是这么约定的。"

Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了点。

"去跟 Horus 谈吧。"

texts.en:
She sniffs, suppressing an expression.

"A rather directly mercenary request, but I ought to have anticipated it."

Fortuna taps her TriPad.

"Speak to Horus."
texts.zh:
她轻哼一声，把某种神色压了下去。

"这要求直白得像雇佣兵，不过我早该料到的。"

Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了点。

"去跟 Horus 谈吧。"

texts.en:
She sniffs, suppressing an expression.

"Of course, $titlePL. I could not demand you infringe upon personal trust. It is sacred, and I accept your answer with the utmost respect."
texts.zh:
她轻哼一声，把某种神色压了下去。

"当然，$titlePL。我无权要求你背弃私人的信任。那是神圣的，我以最大的敬意接受你的答复。"

texts.en:
She sniffs, suppressing an expression.

"Of course, $titlePL. I could not demand you infringe upon personal trust. It is sacred, and I accept your answer with the utmost respect."
texts.zh:
她轻哼一声，把某种神色压了下去。

"当然，$titlePL。我无权要求你背弃私人的信任。那是神圣的，我以最大的敬意接受你的答复。"

options.en: Horus Yaribay has agreed to back you against Reynard.
options.zh: Horus Yaribay 已经答应支持你对抗 Reynard。

texts.en:
Fortuna cannot quite contain her delight.

"Thank you, $titlePL," she says breathlessly.
texts.zh:
Fortuna 几乎掩不住欣喜。

"谢谢你，$titlePL，"她气息难平地说道。

texts.en: She taps something on her TriPad, then nods graciously.
texts.zh: 她在 TriPad 上点了几下，随后矜持地点了点头。

options.en: We need to discuss the situation in Askonia...
options.zh: 我们得谈谈 Askonia 的局势...

texts.en: "Yes, much is afoot." She nods slowly.
texts.zh: "是啊，眼下暗流不少。"她缓缓点头。

texts.en:
"Yes, much is afoot," she says with a nod.

"The Prime Demarchon is using his position to sabotage my efforts through official sanctions. It is most vexing. Would that Horus Yaribay had the spine to stand against Reynard Hannan."
texts.zh:
"是啊，暗流不少，"她点头说道。

"大统领正利用他的职位，以官方制裁来破坏我的努力。这实在恼人。要是 Horus Yaribay 有那份脊梁，敢站出来对抗 Reynard Hannan 就好了。"

texts.en:
"Yes, much is afoot," she says with a nod.

"Gens Yaribay's backing is proving essential to thwarting the Prime Demarchon's sabotage of our support for Achilles. You have my thanks for securing his cooperation."
texts.zh:
"是啊，暗流不少，"她点头说道。

"要挫败大统领对我们支援 Achilles 一事的破坏，Yaribay 氏族的支持已证明不可或缺。你促成了他的合作，我多谢你。"

texts.en: Her eyes go distant. "Someone has supplied Imoinu and her rebels. When I discover who... Rao probably. He always was a scoundrel."
texts.zh: 她的目光飘远。"有人在给 Imoinu 和她的叛军供补给。等我查出是谁...多半是 Rao。他一向就是个无赖。"

texts.en: "Achilles' fleets could use diversified logistical support. It could prove efficacious to bribe a certain Tri-Tachyon executive," she says coyly.
texts.zh: "Achilles 的舰队需要更多元的后勤支持。买通某位速子科技的高管，或许会颇有成效，"她意味深长地说。

texts.en:
"Achilles' fleets are moving on Volturn. We expect to take the planet rapidly, and from there, gather strength for a final confrontation with Hector's forces."

"He shall require your own fleet when that moment arrives."
texts.zh:
"Achilles 的舰队正在向 Volturn 推进。我们预计能迅速拿下那颗行星，然后在那里积蓄力量，与 Hector 的部队做最后决战。"

"到那一刻，他会需要你的舰队。"

texts.en:
"Achilles' fleets are in orbit of Volturn. That shall be his base to prepare for the final confrontation with Hector's forces."

"He shall require your own fleet when that moment arrives."
texts.zh:
"Achilles 的舰队已在 Volturn 轨道上。那里将成为他的基地，用来准备与 Hector 部队的最后决战。"

"到那一刻，他会需要你的舰队。"

options.en: Continue
Continue
Continue
Continue

texts.en: "What is your concern?"
texts.zh: "你在顾虑什么？"

texts.en:
"I would suggest engaging Hector's forces directly, if given an opportunity with good odds," she says. "Otherwise you might attack patrols, raid merchant convoys... this will sap the strength of his dying 'Diktat'."

"But then, of course," Fortuna smiles coldly, "you know full well how to conduct space warfare, captain. That's why I met with you on Yesod."
texts.zh:
"若有胜算在握的机会，我建议直接与 Hector 的部队交战，\"她说，\"否则，你可以袭击巡逻队、劫掠商船队...这会一点点抽干他那具行将就木的'强权'。"

"不过话说回来，\"Fortuna 冷冷一笑，\"太空战该怎么打，你比谁都清楚，舰长。我在 Yesod 见你，正是为此。"

options.en: I've secured support from a Tri-Tachyon agent, Faro Inesis. (explain)
options.zh: 我已争取到速子科技一名特工的支持：Faro Inesis。 (解释)

options.en: I've secured a Tri-Tachyon agent, Faro Inesis, to help counter Macario. (explain)
options.zh: 我已争取到速子科技特工 Faro Inesis，由他协助对付 Macario。 (解释)

options.en: I've secured support from a Tri-Tachyon executive, Rayan Arroyo. (explain)
options.zh: 我已争取到速子科技一位高管 Rayan Arroyo 的支持。 (解释)

options.en: I've heard Imoinu Kato is part of a rebel group on Umbra...
options.zh: 我听说 Imoinu Kato 参与了 Umbra 上的一支叛军...

options.en: Making concessions to the Luddics on Volturn might help Achilles' cause.
options.zh: 在 Volturn 对卢德派做些让步，或许对 Achilles 的事业有利。

options.en: I could use more fuel and supplies.
options.zh: 我需要更多燃料和补给。

options.en: Let's talk about something else. (back)

texts.en:
"Well done, $titlePL," she says. "Diversified logistics are particularly useful in light of Reynard's attempts to meddle in Gens Kato affairs."

"Your service must be compensated, of course." Fortuna taps at her TriPad.
texts.zh:
"干得好，$titlePL，\"她说，\"Reynard 一心想插手 Kato 氏族的事务，这种时候，多元的后勤渠道尤其有用。"

"你的付出当然该有酬劳。"Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了几下。

texts.en:
She can't hide her pleasure as you explain how Faro Inesis will counter Dolos Macario using the technological superiority he can draw upon from Tri-Tachyon's corpus of information warfare applications and experience.

(You do, of course, withhold the inconvenient detail that Inesis intends to help Achilles free himself from the influence of Gens Kato by doing so.)

"Well done, $titlePL," she says. "Macario is infamous for his cruelty and cleverness. It provides comfort to hear you've gained cooperation from such an elite operative to foil his schemes."

"I judge you are due compensation." She taps her TriPad.
texts.zh:
你解释 Faro Inesis 将如何凭他可以从速子科技那一整套信息战应用与实战经验中调取的技术优势，来反制 Dolos Macario；她听着，掩不住喜色。

(当然，你略去了一个不便提及的细节：Inesis 这么做，是要帮 Achilles 摆脱 Kato 氏族的掌控。)

"干得好，$titlePL，\"她说，\"Macario 的残忍与狡诈是出了名的。听说你争取到这样一位精锐特工来挫败他的算计，这让人安心。"

"我看你该得一份酬劳。"她在 TriPad 上点了点。

texts.en:
"Excellent work, $titlePL," she says. "Additional supply lines shall make it less difficult for the Prime Demarchon to interfere in my- our project."

"Please accept this payment for your trouble." She taps at her TriPad.
texts.zh:
"干得漂亮，$titlePL，\"她说，\"多几条补给线，大统领要插手我的——我们的计划，就没那么容易了。"

"这份报酬，请收下，算你辛苦一场。"她在 TriPad 上点了几下。

texts.en:
Her expression closes somewhat.

"I see. Of course." She sighs.

"Headstrong, is she not? I fear I was too liberal with Eunomia concerning her upbringing. Hadwin, my consort, always said so. Perhaps he was right."
texts.zh:
她的神情微微收紧。

"我明白了。当然。"她叹了口气。

"性子太拗，是不是？我怕是对 Eunomia 的管教太松了。Hadwin，我的伴侣，一直这么说。也许他是对的。"

options.en: It's understandable. She's young.
She's going to get herself killed.
options.zh: 她这是要把自己送进死路。

options.en: She is fighting for what she believes.
options.zh: 她在为自己相信的东西而战。

options.en: She is fighting for a righteous cause.
options.zh: 她在为一项正义的事业而战。

texts.en: "Indeed. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh: "确实。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
texts.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

texts.en:
She shakes her head.

"The sooner the question of the Sindrian Diktat is resolved, the sooner she'll come home, where she belongs."
texts.zh:
她摇了摇头。

"辛达强权的问题了结得越早，她就能越早回家，回到她该在的地方。"

options.en: I am no 'creature' of Reynard!
options.zh: 我可不是 Reynard 的'走狗'！

options.en: Does Horus Yaribay know about what you're doing here?
options.zh: Horus Yaribay 知道你在这儿做的事吗？

options.en: So is this a play against Gens Hannan?
options.zh: 所以这是一场针对 Hannan 氏族的棋局？

options.en: I told Reynard I would vote him out at the first opportunity. Will you help me?
options.zh: 我跟 Reynard 说过，一有机会就把他投下台。你愿意帮我吗？

options.en: Reynard Hannan blackmailed me. I'm not his 'creature'.
options.zh: Reynard Hannan 勒索过我。我不是他的'走狗'。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon's commission allows me to take initiative. As you have with Achilles.
options.zh: 速子科技的委任状允许我自行决断。就像你对 Achilles 做的那样。

options.en: Andrada's genius is transcendent. As is his blood!
options.zh: Andrada 的天才是超凡的。他的血脉也是！

options.en: I am no 'automaton'. My commission is held with my own self-interest in mind.
options.zh: 我不是什么'人偶'。我接这份委任，考虑的是我自己的利益。

options.en: I am no automaton. I seek only to bring order to the growing chaos.
options.zh: 我不是人偶。我只想给这愈演愈烈的混乱带来秩序。

options.en: If I'm meddling, then what is this? You've taken Achilles for your tool.
options.zh: 如果我这叫插手，那你又算什么？你把 Achilles 当成了自己的工具。

options.en: Are you working with Finlay Siyavong, from Fleet Intelligence?
options.zh: 你在跟舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong 合作吗？

options.en: I serve the Persean League. Who is served by making Achilles your tool?
options.zh: 我为英仙座联盟效力。把 Achilles 变成你的工具，又是为谁效力？

options.en: What is your scheme with Achilles?
options.zh: 你跟 Achilles 打的什么算盘？

options.en: Why Achilles? Why not another?
options.zh: 为什么是 Achilles？为什么不是别人？

options.en: So how will you ensure Achilles becomes Supreme Executor?
options.zh: 那你要怎么保证 Achilles 当上最高元首？

options.en: Andrada must be destroyed. His hateful polity, his clones. All of it.
options.zh: Andrada 必须被摧毁。他那个可憎的政权，他的克隆体。全部。

options.en: It appears that we disagree about what is to be done.
options.zh: 看来我们对于该做什么，意见不合。

options.en: I spoke to Imoinu. Your granddaughter, I believe?
options.zh: 我跟 Imoinu 谈过。我想她是你孙女？

options.en: I met Dardan. Your grandson, if I am not mistaken?
options.zh: 我见过 Dardan。没弄错的话，他是你孙子？

texts.en:
"As you wish," she says, conceding absolutely nothing.

"I shall speak as if he shall hear every word, of course."
texts.zh:
"如你所愿，"她说，却一步也没让。

"当然，我说话时会当作他每个字都听得见。"

texts.en:
She shrugs. Then she looks up at you.

"You mean to align yourself with Horus Yaribay," she says, looking you over.

"$TitlePL. You know he is too hesitant, too cautious. You and I know why the Hegemony can't simply be invited to 'clean up' their errors and crimes in Askonia. The situation has evolved - this is an opportunity to unseat Reynard Hannan from what he believes is his personal throne in the office of Prime Demarchon by shifting the center of power of the Persean League and, indeed, the Sector."

"Horus will understand that it was necessary to do it my way, in the end."
texts.zh:
她耸了耸肩，然后抬头看向你。

"你想跟 Horus Yaribay 站到一边，"她打量着你，说。

"$TitlePL。你知道他太犹豫，太谨慎。你我都清楚，为什么不能干脆请霸主来'清理'他们在 Askonia 犯下的错误和罪行。局势已经变了——这是个机会：把英仙座联盟、乃至整个星域的权力中心挪一挪，让 Reynard Hannan 从他自以为属于他的那张大统领宝座上滚下来。"

"到头来，Horus 会明白，按我的方式做是必要的。"

options.en: How will supporting some renewed Diktat lead to the peace Horus desires?
options.zh: 扶持一个重生的强权，怎么可能带来 Horus 想要的那种和平？

options.en: Won't this set off the Hegemony? Don't you risk a greater conflict?
options.zh: 这不会激怒霸主吗？你就不怕引出一场更大的冲突？

options.en: If you support Achilles, it means there will be civil war in Askonia.
options.zh: 你要是支持 Achilles，就意味着 Askonia 会打内战。

options.en: Let us set aside Horus for the moment...

texts.en:
"Would you propose allowing Dolos Macario to dictate the constitution of a renewed Sindrian Diktat?"

She pauses, then answers herself, "There's little that'd be worse."
texts.zh:
"你难道主张让 Dolos Macario 来定一个重生的辛达强权的宪法？"

她顿了顿，随即自答："没什么比那更糟了。"

texts.en:
"Every act entails risk," she says steadily. "The question is if you seize the opportunity to direct events or cede it to another."

"Anyway, the High Hegemon is no fool." Fortuna speaks confidently, "He will do everything to minimize the spread of conflict. To minimize further fallout which embarasses the project of the Hegemony."
texts.zh:
"任何行动都有风险，"她语气平稳。"问题在于，你是抓住机会去主导局势，还是把它让给别人。"

"再说，至高霸主不是蠢人。\"Fortuna 说得很笃定，\"他会尽一切努力把冲突压到最小，把进一步让霸主的事业蒙羞的余波压到最小。"

texts.en:
"Yes!" Her hand makes a small fist.

"And if I don't, who stands to stop a new consolidation of power within the Sindrian Diktat? For cycles now the polity has been as paralyzed as the drooling corpse of Philip Andrada."

"Imagine Dolos Macario behind Caden, or some clone he's managed to indoctrinate, with the full, unified power of the Sindrian Diktat! It would be disaster."
texts.zh:
"对！"她的手轻轻握成拳。

"如果我不做，还有谁能拦住辛达强权内部新一轮的权力整合？这么多星历年，这个政权就跟 Philip Andrada 那具流着口水的尸体一样瘫痪。"

"想想看，Dolos Macario 躲在 Caden 背后，或者躲在他成功洗脑的某个克隆体背后，握着辛达强权完整而统一的权力！那会是场灾难。"

texts.en: "Let's," she agrees.
texts.zh: "那就先放一放。"她表示同意。

texts.en:
"With Reynard," she begins, "The world is of two camps: those for and those against Gens Hannan."

"A Sindrian Diktat simmering at near-war against the Hegemony? This serves Gens Hannan."

"Askonia at peace, however, and a member of the League?" Her expression is open.
texts.zh:
"在 Reynard 看来，\"她开口道，\"这世上只分两派：支持 Hannan 氏族的，和反对 Hannan 氏族的。"

"一个跟霸主僵持在战争边缘的辛达强权？这正合 Hannan 氏族的意。"

"可要是 Askonia 太平无事，还成了联盟的一员呢？"她的神情坦荡。

options.en: It would dilute his influence. And yours.
options.zh: 那会稀释他的影响力。还有你的。

options.en: It would dilute his influence.

texts.en: "Yes," she admits. "But this gens of secondary influence has already adapted to such conditions."
texts.zh: "没错，\"她承认，\"可这个影响力居次的氏族，早就适应这种局面了。"

texts.en:
"Imagine what the population and industry of Askonia - not so great as once they were, admittedly - and a majority stake in Sector fuel production would mean. The barycenter of League power would no longer fall solely within the orbit of Kazeron."

"The Kazeron dominated by Reynard Hannan."
texts.zh:
"想象一下：Askonia 的人口与工业——得承认，已不复当年——再加上星域燃料生产的多数份额，那意味着什么。联盟权力的重心，将不再只落在 Kazeron 的轨道里。"

"那个由 Reynard Hannan 把持的 Kazeron。"

texts.en: "Temper your enthusiasm, captain," she says calmly. "I have a plan for Reynard."
texts.zh: "收一收你的热情，舰长，\"她平静地说，\"我对 Reynard 有安排。"

texts.en:
"I know of what happened," she says. "And you are his until you're freed."

She holds up a hand, delicately. "We may yet speak of that. Patience."
texts.zh:
"我知道发生了什么，\"她说，\"在你脱身之前，你就是他的人。"

她优雅地抬起一只手。"这事我们以后或许会谈。耐心点。"

texts.en:
"I see you understand me," she says with a smirk.

"It may be that I am simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"看来你懂我的意思，"她带着一丝冷笑说。

"也许我不过是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

options.en: I'm sure your goodwill comes with reasonable conditions.
options.zh: 我相信你的善意，附带着合理的条件。

options.en: A sound proposal; I applaud your initiative.
options.zh: 很好的提议，我欣赏你的主动性。

options.en: So he's to be a tool of your ambitions for Gens Kato?
options.zh: 所以他要成为你为 Kato 氏族铺路的工具？

options.en: There is nothing 'natural' about Achilles, or his position you would exploit.
options.zh: Achilles 身上没有一点'天然'可言，你想利用的那个位置也一样。

texts.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my own interests," she says. "But I recognize the value in forming a coalition with a capable, dutiful, and... ambitious young man."

"There's much to gain: lasting peace as a united bloc stays Hegemony aggression. Trade agreements, knowledge-sharing, a shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan and toward the League itself."
texts.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益做事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟一个能干、尽责、而且...有野心的年轻人结成同盟，是有价值的。"

"能得到的很多：一个统一的集团就能挡住霸主的进犯，换来长久和平。贸易协定、知识共享，权力重心从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron，转向联盟本身。"

texts.en:
She leans back slightly.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association."

"Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and an implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。"

"有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en:
She leans back slightly, her look skeptical.

"As you wilI have it. I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去，神情带着怀疑。

"随你怎么说。我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in forming a coalition with... a capable, dutiful, and ambitious young man."

"Trust me," she says, showing perfect teeth. "If he thought he was to be a mere tool, he would not have agreed to my terms. He's an Andrada."
texts.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟一个...能干、尽责、而且有野心的年轻人结成同盟，自有其价值。"

"相信我，\"她说着，露出一口完美的牙齿，\"如果他以为自己只是个工具，就不会答应我的条件。他可是 Andrada 家的人。"

texts.en:
She leans back slightly.

"He is what he is believed to be. And I won't deny that I serve my self-interest, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去。

"他就是人们所认定的那个人。我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en:
"So you're a believer," she says, gently.

A distance, a coolness enters her voice.

"Know that Achilles is a willing partner in my endeavour. I am extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"原来你是个信徒，"她温和地说。

她的声音里多了一层疏远和冷意。

"要知道，Achilles 是自愿与我同行的。我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

options.en: If this course is his choice... then I cannot oppose it.
options.zh: 如果这条路是他自己的选择...那我不能反对。

options.en: I'm sure your 'goodwill' does not come without conditions.
options.zh: 我确信你的'善意'不会没有条件。

options.en: I won't see the heir of Andrada be made a tool of your ambitions for Gens Kato!
options.zh: 我不会看着 Andrada 的继承人变成你为 Kato 氏族谋算的工具！

texts.en:
She leans back slightly, her look skeptical of your tone.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
texts.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去，神情分明是不认同你的语气。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

texts.en: "As you would have it," she says. "I shall not whisper even a hint of your faithlessness to the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh: "随你，\"她说，\"你对辛达强权的二心，我一个字都不会往外递。"

options.en: Then we understand one another.
Is that a threat?

texts.en: She nods.
texts.zh: 她点了点头。

texts.en: "I speak in jest, captain," she says evenly. "If I threaten you, you will know it."
texts.zh: "我在说笑，舰长，\"她语气平缓，\"我要是威胁你，你会知道的。"

texts.en:
"Then perhaps, in that, we can find common orbit," she says. A coolness enters her voice, like armor.

"Achilles is a willing partner in my endeavour. I am extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"那么在这一点上，我们或许能进入同一条轨道，"她说。一层冷意像装甲一样覆上她的声音。

"Achilles 是自愿与我同行的。我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

texts.en: "My 'tool'?" She smirks. "I'm simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh: "我的'工具'？\"她嘴角一挑。\"我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

texts.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interests, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners. Some junior, some senior; it as natural as fortunes rise and wane by the vagaries of time."
texts.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手的伙伴结成同盟是有价值的。有晚辈，也有长辈；就像时运随光阴的无常而起落一样自然。"

texts.en:
"You've met Reynard Hannan. Would you rather Achilles fell into his orbit?"

She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners. Be they junior or senior; it as natural as fortunes wax and wane."
texts.zh:
"你见过 Reynard Hannan。你宁可让 Achilles 落进他的轨道？"

她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手的伙伴结成同盟是有价值的。不论辈分高低；就像时运有盛有衰一样自然。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"Now I ask you - not accuse - what is your interest in Achilles? What is the Hegemony's interest in Achilles?"

She smiles, coyly. "Did Daud... no, it would have been Orcus Rao, wouldn't it. Did Orcus put you up to this?"
texts.zh:
"现在我问你——不是指控你——你对 Achilles 有什么图谋？霸主对 Achilles 又有什么图谋？"

她勾了勾嘴角，笑得有几分做作。"是 Daud 让你...不，应该是 Orcus Rao，对吧。是 Orcus 教你这么干的？"

options.en: He is involved.
I'll not confirm or deny Hegemony involvement.
options.zh: 霸主是否介入，我不承认，也不否认。

options.en: He knows nothing of this. (lie)
He knows nothing of this. As far as I know.
options.zh: 此事他一无所知。据我所知是如此。

options.en: I'm acting under my own initiative, ma'am.

texts.en: "Of course he is," she says, satisfied.
texts.zh: "他当然参与其中，"她心满意足地说。

texts.en: "Please give Orcus my compliments when next you meet with him on that dismal station of his," she concludes.
texts.zh: "下次去他那座阴惨惨的空间站上见他，代我向他致意，"她最后说。

texts.en: "How loyal," she says. "Maybe he'll give you a medal... when the dust settles."
texts.zh: "真忠诚，\"她说，\"也许他会给你发一枚勋章...等尘埃落定之后。"

texts.en:
"No," she says. "Either you're lying or you've been woefully uninformed."

"Which is worrying," she adds, with a look of concern.
texts.zh:
"不对，\"她说，\"要么你在撒谎，要么你被瞒得彻底。"

"这可叫人担心，"她补了一句，脸上现出忧色。

texts.en:
She examines you for a moment.

"Trust me, then," she says, "when I tell you that he knows quite a lot of this."
texts.zh:
她打量了你片刻。

"那么，就相信我吧，\"她说，\"我说他对这事知道得相当多。"

texts.en: "Perhaps you even believe that," she says.
texts.zh: "也许你自己都信了这话，"她说。

texts.en:
Her eyes shift at his name.

"Fleet Intelligence serves the Persean League. And so do I, in my way. That is all that need be said."
texts.zh:
听到这个名字，她的眼神一动。

"舰队情报部效忠英仙座联盟。我也是，以我的方式。该说的就这些。"

texts.en:
Her eyes shift at his name.

"Fleet Intelligence serves the Persean League. And so do I, in my way. That is all that need be said."
texts.zh:
听到这个名字，她的眼神一动。

"舰队情报部效忠英仙座联盟。我也是，以我的方式。该说的就这些。"

options.en: He put me in contact with Achilles. I trust you knew?
options.zh: 他让我跟 Achilles 接上了线。我猜你早就知道？

options.en: I'm working with him on... the situation. I trust you knew?
options.zh: 我在跟他一起处理...这件事。我猜你早就知道？

options.en: Then I'll say no more.
He put me in contact with Achilles. I trust you knew?
options.zh: 他让我跟 Achilles 接上了线。我猜你早就知道？

options.en: Then I'll say no more.

texts.en: She gives you a level look. Not a topic for discussion, it says.
texts.zh: 她定定地看你一眼。那意思很清楚：这不是可以谈的话题。

texts.en: "Good," she says, then gives you a level look. Not a topic for discussion, it says.
texts.zh: "很好，"她说，然后定定地看你一眼。那意思很清楚：这不是可以谈的话题。

texts.en: She nods.
texts.zh: 她点了点头。

texts.en:
She smirks.

"I am extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
她嘴角一挑。

"我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

options.en: I'm sure your goodwill does not come without conditions.
options.zh: 我确信你的善意不会没有条件。

options.en: A sound proposal; I applaud your vision.
options.zh: 提议不错；我欣赏你的眼光。

options.en: So he's to be a tool of your ambitions for Gens Kato.
options.zh: 所以他要成为你为 Kato 氏族铺路的工具？

options.en: There is nothing 'natural' about Achilles, or his position you seek to use.
options.zh: Achilles 身上没有一点'天然'可言，你想利用的那个位置也一样。

texts.en:
"My 'scheme'?" She smirks.

"I'm simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"我的'算盘'？"她嘴角一挑。

"我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

texts.en:
"He is trained, competent, dutiful. And humbler by far than his clone-father. As well I know."

She does not elaborate.

"So." She stares into you. "Tell me what you know of another."
texts.zh:
"他受过训练，有能力，也尽责。而且远比他那位克隆父亲谦逊。这一点我很清楚。"

她没有再往下说。

"那么，\"她直视着你，\"告诉我，关于另一个人的事，你知道多少。"

options.en: It stands to reason there are others. I speak hypothetically, of course. (lie)
options.zh: 按理说还有别人。当然，我只是假设。(说谎)

options.en: Seven others. I have a report intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 还有七个。我手上有份报告，本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: Leonidas. Although he... cannot function.
Hercules. An academician. A man of peace, I think.
options.zh: Hercules。一位院士。我想他是个爱和平的人。

options.en: Hercules. An academician. He'd be easier to control.
options.zh: Hercules。一位院士。他更容易控制。

options.en: Could Hercules be your second choice?
options.zh: Hercules 能不能当你的第二人选？

options.en: Hector... who appears to be backed by Macario.
options.zh: Hector...他似乎有 Macario 撑腰。

options.en: Hector, though misguided, is truly passionate for his birthright.
options.zh: Hector 虽然走错了路，可他对自己那份与生俱来的权利是真有热忱。

options.en: You've made your decision.

texts.en:
"Hypothetically," she repeats, watching you closely.

"If there is one clone of Philip Andrada, it stands to reason there are others."

"And none other is so conveniently present." She spreads her hands, showing the lack of clones, or perhaps inviting them to appear.
texts.zh:
"只是假设，"她重复道，紧盯着你。

"既然 Philip Andrada 有一个克隆体，按理说就该有别的。"

"而且没有哪个像他这样方便在场。"她摊开双手，像是在展示这里并没有别的克隆体，又像是在邀他们现身。

texts.en:
"A pity Dolos allowed it to fall into your hands," she says. "Sloppy work for the 'Spider of Sindria', I think."

"If I wanted to instigate a crisis, force another contender to make their move prematurely, what could do it?"

She looks expectantly at you, having answered her own question.
texts.zh:
"Dolos 竟让这东西落到你手里，真是可惜，\"她说，\"对'辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛'来说，这活干得太糙了。"

"如果我想挑起一场危机，逼另一个竞争者提前出手，什么办法能办到？"

她带着期待看着你，显然自己已经答了这个问题。

options.en: You think Macario leaked this intentionally?
options.zh: 你觉得是 Macario 故意放出来的？

options.en: I don't think it was intentional. But I think he'll work with it.
options.zh: 我觉得不是故意的。但我认为他会顺势利用。

options.en: He screwed up. And he'll never admit it.
options.zh: 他搞砸了。而且他绝不会承认。

texts.en:
"I'd be a fool not to treat it as though he did," she says.

"So would he."
texts.zh:
"要是不把它当成他有意为之，我就是个傻子，"她说。

"换了他，也会这么处理。"

texts.en: "Then little is changed. My course is set."
texts.zh: "那么，变化不大。我的航向已定。"

texts.en: "Then it changes little. My course is set."
texts.zh: "那么，也差不了多少。我的航向已定。"

texts.en: "Meaning?"
texts.zh: "什么意思？"

options.en: He's lived a dream for his entire life. He can't really move, or speak.
options.zh: 他一辈子都活在一场梦里。他动不了，也说不出话。

texts.en: "That would make seizing the office of Supreme Executor difficult," she says.
texts.zh: "那要夺取最高元首之位，可就难了。"她说。

texts.en:
"The one who was shot at the Galatia Academy?" she asks, though it is more of a statement.

"I don't think we need to concern ourselves with him."
texts.zh:
"就是在 Galatia 学院挨枪的那个？"她问，不过更像是在陈述。

"我看不必为他费心。"

texts.en:
"A man of study and quiet, you mean," she says.

"How would he fare in battle? Could he alight fire in the heart of a crowd through his speech alone?"

She seems satisfied with her answers.
texts.zh:
"你是说，一个埋头学问、安安静静的人。"她说。

"他在战场上能行吗？只凭一张嘴，就能点燃人群心里的火？"

她似乎对自己的答案很满意。

texts.en:
"I need remind you that I am searching for a legitimate partner, albeit a junior one? Not a puppet whose every move I must choose and master."

"How would he fare in battle? Could he alight fire in the heart of a crowd through his speech alone?"

She looks at you as if she's already satisfied with her own answers.
texts.zh:
"需要我提醒你吗，我要找的是一个名正言顺的伙伴——哪怕资历浅些？不是一个每一步都得由我挑选、由我摆布的傀儡。"

"他在战场上能行吗？只凭一张嘴，就能点燃人群心里的火？"

她看着你，仿佛早已对自己的答案满意了。

texts.en:
"If it came to it." She smirks.

"Regardless," she says airily, "I've made my decision and it is Achilles."
texts.zh:
"真到了那一步，也无妨。"她嘴角一挑。

"无论如何，\"她轻描淡写地说，\"我已经定了，就是 Achilles。"

texts.en:
"Backed by Macario," she repeats, watching you closely. "Inconvenient, but not unexpected."

"Whatever this Hector is, and if he's Macario's creature then he must be something quite unloveable. Achilles is the better option - for me, for the League, for the Persean Sector. Of each of those I am certain."
texts.zh:
"有 Macario 撑腰，\"她重复道，目光紧盯不放。\"麻烦，但不意外。"

"不管这个 Hector 是什么来路——若他是 Macario 的人，那必定是个相当讨人嫌的东西。Achilles 是更好的选择：对我，对联盟，对英仙座星域。这三点我都确信。"

texts.en:
"That would not be quite the sort of passion I seek to foster in an heir to the Sindrian Diktat."

Her head tilts slightly. "You do understand why that is, don't you?"
texts.zh:
"这可不是我想在辛达强权继承人身上养出来的那种热忱。"

她微微偏头。"你明白这是为什么，对吧？"

texts.en:
"Correct."

She politely places her hands together, settled.
texts.zh:
"没错。"

她礼貌地把双手交叠，安然而坐。

texts.en:
"Broadly speaking," she says, "He will claim legitimacy. He will have backing. Allies, credits, warships."

A pause. "Insiders."

"And he will take Sindria. And with Sindria, Askonia. And Askonia will join the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"大略说来，"她说，"他会宣称自己名正言顺。他会有靠山。盟友、星币、战舰。"

一顿。"还有内应。"

"然后他会拿下 Sindria。拿下 Sindria，也就拿下了 Askonia。而 Askonia 会加入英仙座联盟。"

options.en: The Hegemony would never allow it.
But Andrada's ideology is incompatible with the Persean League's... diversity.
options.zh: 可 Andrada 的意识形态，与英仙座联盟的...多元，水火不容。

options.en: But Andrada's transcendent ideology is incompatible with the League's 'diversity'.
options.zh: 可 Andrada 那套超凡的意识形态，与联盟的'多元'水火不容。

options.en: Bold of you to tell me the plan. What stops me from revealing it?
options.zh: 把计划讲给我听，胆子不小。我凭什么不把它捅出去？

options.en: I will make no agreement without speaking to Horus Yaribay.
options.zh: 不先跟 Horus Yaribay 谈，我不会达成任何协议。

options.en: A bold plan, and I've heard no better. Can I help?
options.zh: 计划够大胆，我也没听过更好的。我能帮上忙吗？

options.en: If you've got the credits, then I'll back you. And Achilles, if you want.
options.zh: 只要星币到位，我就支持你。还有 Achilles，如果你要。

options.en: You're going to have one big problem - me.
options.zh: 你会有个大麻烦——就是我。

options.en: Andrada still must be destroyed. Everything he built, torn down.
options.zh: Andrada 还是得被毁掉。他建起来的一切，都得推倒。

options.en: I am not comfortable with the power you may have over Achilles.
options.zh: 你可能对 Achilles 拥有的那种支配力，让我很不舒服。

options.en: I won't help or hinder you. I've got my own business to see to.
options.zh: 我不帮你，也不拦你。我自己还有事要办。

texts.en: "That's why I didn't ask the Hegemony for permission."
texts.zh: "所以我才没去求霸主批准。"

texts.en:
"Philip's ideology was the half-baked musing of an amateur historian," she whisks a hand, dismissive. "The appeal is all aesthetics."

"Achilles looks good in uniform. He'll co-opt the legacy of his clone-father with ease."
texts.zh:
"Philip 的意识形态，不过是个业余历史学者的半吊子玄想。\"她随手一挥，满不在乎。\"它的吸引力全在审美上。"

"Achilles 穿军装好看。他要接手他那克隆父亲的遗产，轻而易举。"

texts.en:
"Philip's ideology was the half-baked musing of an amateur historian," she whisks a hand, dismissive. "The popular appeal is all aesthetics."

Fortuna holds a moment, then gives you a look.

"No offense intended, of course," she says. "Achilles looks good in a uniform. It's all he needs."
texts.zh:
"Philip 的意识形态，不过是个业余历史学者的半吊子玄想。\"她随手一挥，满不在乎。\"它能收拢人心，靠的也全是审美。"

Fortuna 顿了顿，然后看了你一眼。

"当然，无意冒犯。\"她说，\"Achilles 穿军装好看。这就够了。"

texts.en:
"Nothing. And soon it won't matter, because it is already in motion."

"Understand that my telling you," she says, "Is a sign of respect. For your accomplishments, for your judgement."

"Accept my good regard," she says, positively dripping noblesse oblige.
texts.zh:
"什么也拦不住。而且很快就无所谓了，因为它已经在运转。"

"你要明白，我把这些告诉你，\"她说，\"是一种尊重。对你的功绩，对你的判断。"

"收下我的敬意。"她说，那口吻里满是居高临下的施恩意味。

texts.en:
She nods, keeping her eyes on you.

"I understand. My plans are already in motion and shall provide the best of any alternative. Horus will see that when you speak to him, as I assume you shall."

"Understand that my openness in speaking with you," she says, "Is a sign of respect. For your accomplishments, for your judgement. And for that of Gens Yaribay, even if we do not agree on... every detail."
texts.zh:
她点头，目光始终没有离开你。

"我明白。我的计划已在运转，它会胜过任何替代方案。你去跟 Horus 谈，他会看明白的——我想你总会去谈。"

"你要明白，我这样坦率地同你说话，\"她说，\"是一种尊重。对你的功绩，对你的判断。对 Yaribay 氏族 那一族也是如此，哪怕我们并非在...每个细节上都一致。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Accept my good regard," she says, her tone making it clear that her statement is equal to natural law to her mind.

She stands.

"Now I have much to see done. Give Horus my regards."
texts.zh:
"收下我的敬意。"她说，那语气分明表明，在她看来这话等同于自然律。

她站起身。

"眼下我还有太多事要办。替我向 Horus 问好。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
She leaves, gilded silhouette followed by ranks of attendants.

The bartender lets out a sigh. Business this shift is ruined... but the next will be filled with gawkers and rumor-mongers.

You take your leave, followed by your bodyguards.
texts.zh:
她离开了，镀金般的身影后跟着一列随从。

酒保叹了口气。这一班的生意算是毁了...不过下一班会挤满看热闹的和传闲话的。

你带着保镖离开。

texts.en:
You've discovered the fate of each of the seven sons of Philip Andrada.

Scattered to the small worlds of the Persean Sector, some died by the hand of assassins, others never truly lived.

But enough survived. The blood of Andrada lives on.
texts.zh:
你已经查清了 Philip Andrada 七个儿子各自的结局。

他们被散落到英仙座星域的小世界，有的死于刺客之手，有的从未真正活过。

但活下来的已经够多。Andrada 的血脉仍在延续。

texts.en:
You've discovered the seven Andradas and found Macario's contingency plan for control of the Sindrian Diktat in the form of Hector Andrada. It is clear, too, that he does not fully control the situation and perhaps never did. He would have never allowed Achilles to live.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
texts.zh:
你查清了七位 Andrada 其人，也发现了 Macario 为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

历史悬在一线之间，每位自认的继承者都在积蓄力量。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。
