texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's sons have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength, as each prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两个儿子已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。七人中的二人。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

那就是动手的时候。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs - his true blood - have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two viable heirs of the original seven. But are they made weak by corrupting influence - one by Macario's scheming, the other by the League's? Can Andrada's blood, can his transcendent philosophy, overcome such setback?

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

One thing is clear: you must choose.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两位继承人——他真正的血脉——已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。最初七人中仅存的两个可继之人。可他们是否已被腐蚀性的影响弄弱了——一个毁于 Macario 的算计，另一个毁于联盟的？Andrada 的血脉，他那套超凡的哲学，能跨过这样的挫折吗？

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

有一件事很清楚：你必须选边。

She smiles.

"Yes. When the time is right. We'll speak again before long, I am sure."

"好。等时机成熟。用不了多久我们还会再谈，我确信。"

texts.en:
She smiles. "Yes. When the time is right. We'll speak again before long."

"Perhaps we can get you out from under Reynard's thumb. Contingent on Achilles' success, of course."
texts.zh:
她微微一笑。"好。等时机成熟。用不了多久我们还会再谈。"

"也许我们能把你从 Reynard 的掌心里弄出来。当然，得看 Achilles 成不成事。"

texts.en:
She stands.

"Thank you, $TitlePL $PlayerLastName. Together we will build a better Persean Sector. One with a future."
texts.zh:
她站起身。

"谢谢你，$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。我们会一起建起一个更好的英仙座星域。一个还有未来的星域。"

texts.en:
She smiles coldly. "Your mercenary reputation prevails."

Fortuna takes a moment to whisper into her cuff. You, in turn, receive the ping of a credits transfer.

"For your consideration," she says. "You shall receive additional payments as you follow my instructions to ensure the ascension of Achilles to his birthright."
texts.zh:
她冷冷一笑。"你这雇佣兵的名声，果然名不虚传。"

Fortuna 低头对着袖口低语了几句。随即，你的通讯器响起一声星币转账的提示音。

"一点心意。\"她说，\"只要你按我的吩咐行事，确保 Achilles 登上他生来就该有的位置，后续还会另有酬劳。"

texts.en:
She smiles coldly.

"No. You can't be trusted to uphold a deal. Everyone knows that."
texts.zh:
她冷冷一笑。

"不必。你守不住协议，这谁都知道。"

options.en: You had me at '100,000 credits'.
options.zh: 你说出'十万星币'的时候，我就已经答应了。

texts.en:
"When the time is right we must speak again," she says.

Fortuna stands.

"I thank you, $TitlePL $PlayerLastName. We will build a better Persean Sector. One with a future."
texts.zh:
"时机成熟时，我们得再谈一次。"她说。

Fortuna 站起身。

"我谢谢你，$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。我们会建起一个更好的英仙座星域。一个还有未来的星域。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You?"

Her face twitches and settles into cool disappointment rather than bursting into laughter, but you suspect she might have.
texts.zh:
"你？"

她脸上抽动了一下，随后没有爆出笑声，而是沉成一片冷淡的失望——但你怀疑她差点就笑出来了。

texts.en:
"I don't expect you or your masters in the Hegemony Strategic Council to understand why my way is best."

"I will ask simply that you do not place yourself in the way of progress, captain," she says, her tone distinctly stonier than before.
texts.zh:
"我不指望你，也不指望你那些在霸主战略委员会里的主子，能明白我的路为何最好。"

"我只请你别挡在进步的路上，舰长。"她说，语气比先前明显更硬。

texts.en: "Remember that you are part of the Persean League, captain," she says. "Our strength is together. Do not place yourself in the way of progress."
texts.zh: "记住你是英仙座联盟的一分子，舰长。\"她说，\"我们的力量在于同心。别挡在进步的路上。"

texts.en: "I will ask simply that you do not place yourself in the way of progress, captain," she says, her tone distinctly stonier than before.
texts.zh: "我只请你别挡在进步的路上，舰长。"她说，语气比先前明显更硬。

options.en: Continue
Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"You deal in absolutes. Ideals with no regard for the world."

She sighs. "You speak like Imoinu."
texts.zh:
"你只讲绝对。只讲理想，不管这世界如何。"

她叹了口气。"你说话像 Imoinu。"

options.en: And you compromise away a legacy of treason, mass killings, and planet-murder.
options.zh: 而你，把叛国、屠杀和屠星换来的那份遗产，拿去做妥协交易。

texts.en: "It is clear we do not see eye to eye." She stands.
texts.zh: "显然我们谈不到一处。"她站起身。

texts.en:
"Uncomfortable," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Achilles is a man grown and can see to his own comfort and compromise, captain. See to it that you mind your own."
texts.zh:
"不舒服，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"Achilles 已经成年，他的安逸和他的妥协，他自己会照看，舰长。你管好你自己的事。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I too shall mind to my own. See to it that you do not interfere."
texts.zh:
"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我也只管我自己的。你务必别来插手。"

texts.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I shall mind my own. See to it that you, and your bosses at Tri-Tachyon, mind yours."

"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我就只管我自己的。你，还有你在速子科技的那些上头，管好你们的。"

She stands.

"Then I shall mind my own. See to it that you, and your spymaster Orcus, mind yours."

她站起身。

"那我就只管我自己的。你，还有你那间谍头子 Orcus，管好你们的。"

texts.en:
"Temper your rage, captain," she says.

"Whatever you think of Andrada, my way is easier. Achilles can soften the excesses of the Sindrian Diktat, promote openness and transparency, and foster the new trade relationships which peace is built upon."
texts.zh:
"收一收你的怒火，舰长，"她说。

"不管你怎么看 Andrada，我的路更省事。Achilles 能收敛辛达强权的过度之处，推动开放与透明，培育和平所依托的新贸易关系。"

options.en: I shall hold my tongue. For now.
The Andrada mutiny must be brought to justice - by the Hegemony.
options.zh: Andrada 的叛变必须受到审判——由霸主来审。

options.en: You would call Andrada's conquest legitimate? What of Opis and its dead?
options.zh: 你会说 Andrada 的征服是合法的？那 Opis 和它死掉的人呢？

options.en: You would accept Diktat legitimacy! You'd deny what your own granddaughter fights for?
options.zh: 你要承认强权的合法性！你要否掉你亲孙女为之奋斗的东西？

options.en: You would find it less 'easy' if you valued the lives of the Faithful sent to Cruor.
options.zh: 要是你在乎那些被送去 Cruor 的卢德信徒的性命，就不会觉得这事有多'省事'。

options.en: You misunderstand. I intend to take the Sindrian Diktat for myself.
options.zh: 你误会了。我打算自己拿下辛达强权。

texts.en: "I appreciate your respect for civil discussion," she says, "despite our differing perspectives."
texts.zh: "我欣赏你对文明讨论的尊重，\"她说，\"尽管我们看法不同。"

texts.en: "The Hegemony had its chance, captain. Auxiliary captain," she says the words quite deliberately. "For more than 20 cycles, you had your chance."
texts.zh: "霸主有过机会，舰长。辅助军的舰长，\"她把这几个字说得格外刻意，\"二十多个星历年，你们都有过机会。"

texts.en:
She moves as if to wipe some imagined dirt from her extravagant costume, but catches herself, and folds her hands neatly.

"Perhaps there is a more salient point we might build upon."
texts.zh:
她像是要抹掉那身华服上并不存在的灰尘，手抬到一半又收住，端端正正地把双手交握在身前。

"或许我们可以从一个更切题的要点谈起。"

texts.en:
"I remember the horror of Opis, captain," she says. "I remember watching as that world was torn apart and millions died. You need never remind me."

She lets that be for a moment.

"But I cannot change the past. And with respect to your idealism, my ability to bend the present is limited, however great."
texts.zh:
"我记得 Opis 的惨状，舰长，\"她说，\"我记得看着那个世界被撕碎，几百万人死去。你用不着提醒我。"

她让这句话悬在那儿，过了一会儿。

"可我改不了过去。至于你的理想主义——不管它多宏大，我能扭转当下的力量都是有限的。"

texts.en:
"That fight was lost before it began!" Her voice raises.

"I will use what power I have to bend the present toward the best future I can see. I shall not hold my hand to await your judgment on that matter, or any other!"
texts.zh:
"那场仗在开打之前就已经输了！"她的声音扬了起来。

"我会用我手上的权力，把当下推向我看得见的最好的未来。我不会停手等着你来评判这件事，或者别的什么事！"

texts.en:
"I will make no time for your dim sermonizing," she spits. Then, suppressing her anger, takes a deep breath.

"I have Achilles' assurance that he will stop the persecution. Is that not enough?"
texts.zh:
"我没空听你那些昏话布道。"她咬着牙说，随后压住怒气，深吸一口气。

"Achilles 向我保证过，他会停止迫害。这还不够吗？"

options.en: I suppose it'll have to be.
And you trust him?
It'll have to be. For now.
And let the crimes against humanity go unpunished? It is not enough.
options.zh: 就让反人类的罪行不受惩罚？这不够。

texts.en: She nods, slowly.
texts.zh: 她缓缓点头。

texts.en: "I must," she says.
texts.zh: "我必须这么做，"她说。

texts.en: She nods, slowly.
texts.zh: 她缓缓点头。

texts.en: She lets out a breath, slowly. Eyes hard.
texts.zh: 她缓缓吐出一口气，眼神变硬。

texts.en:
This response baffles her.

"You?" She makes a strange expression; it'd be unseemly to laugh in your face.

"I am at a loss, $playerSirOrMadam. What you propose is... unreasonable."
texts.zh:
这个回答让她一时不知所措。

"你？"她露出一个古怪的表情；当着你的面笑出声来，终究有失体面。

"我不知道该说什么了，$playerSirOrMadam。你的提议...不合情理。"

options.en: We'll see.
Keep up. I've made a habit of accomplishing the impossible.
options.zh: 跟上。把不可能的事办成，我已经习惯了。

texts.en: "I suppose we shall," she says doubtfully.
texts.zh: "那就走着瞧吧，"她将信将疑地说。

texts.en: "So you say," she says.
texts.zh: "随你怎么说，"她说。

texts.en: "So it does." She stands.
texts.zh: "确实如此。"她站起身。

texts.en:
Her expression closes slightly.

"I see. Of course." She sighs.

"Headstrong, is she not? I fear I was too liberal with Eunomia concerning her upbringing. Hadwin, my consort, always said so. Perhaps he was right."
texts.zh:
她的神情微微收紧。

"我明白了。当然。"她叹了口气。

"性子太拗，是不是？我怕是对 Eunomia 的管教太松了。Hadwin，我的伴侣，一直这么说。也许他是对的。"

options.en: It's understandable. She's young.
She's going to get herself killed.
options.zh: 她这是要把自己送进死路。

options.en: She is fighting for what she believes.
options.zh: 她在为自己相信的东西而战。

options.en: She is fighting for a righteous cause.
options.zh: 她在为一项正义的事业而战。

texts.en: "Indeed. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh: "确实。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
texts.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

texts.en:
She shakes her head.

"The sooner the question of the Sindrian Diktat is resolved, the sooner she'll come home, where she belongs."
texts.zh:
她摇了摇头。

"辛达强权的问题了结得越早，她就能越早回家，回到她该在的地方。"

texts.en: "I sincerely hope not. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh: "我真心希望不至于。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en:
"'A righteous cause'," Fortuna says scornfully. "As if that ever changed anything."

"Imoinu complicates matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
texts.zh:
"'一项正义的事业'，\"Fortuna 轻蔑地说，\"好像那玩意儿什么时候改变过什么。"

"Imoinu 是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

texts.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
texts.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

texts.en:
"Oh, Dardan." She looks off and away. "Stubborn boy."

"Perhaps we were too strict in directing his upbringing - I left that to Hadwin, you know. It is as though he fears to have any imagination. It makes his... situation difficult."
texts.zh:
"唉，Dardan。"她的目光移向别处。"倔孩子。"

"也许我们在管教他时太严了——你知道，那摊事我交给了 Hadwin。他像是连一点想象力都怕有。这让他的...处境很难办。"

options.en: Maybe planetary administration isn't Dardan's calling.
options.zh: 也许行星行政本来就不是 Dardan 该走的路。

options.en: It appears he's learned a hatred for the Luddic Faithful.
options.zh: 看样子他学会了憎恨卢德信徒。

options.en: He lacks the conviction to take the steps necessary to quell the Pather uprisings.
options.zh: 他缺那份决心，下不了镇压左径暴动该下的手。

texts.en:
She gives you a look.

"He will learn. It is his duty to the gens. And I gave him it not because I thought it would be easy, but because the challenge would teach him what he needs to lead the gens."
texts.zh:
她看了你一眼。

"他会学会的。这是他对氏族的责任。我把这差事交给他，不是以为它轻松，而是因为这挑战能教会他领导氏族所需要的东西。"

texts.en:
"It is not 'hatred' if it is a rational fear. Look upon Mairaath, captain! See there the destruction wrought by blind faith, the millions dead. For what?"

"It is an irrational cult. No greater force holds us back from rebuilding human civilization - one of freedom and plenty rather than the tyranny and war of the Domain."

She takes a deep breath, centering regal calm upon herself once again.

"Freedom and plenty. To return to the point, Achilles offers us a chance for this and more, captain."
texts.zh:
"如果那是理性的恐惧，就不叫'憎恨'。看看 Mairaath，舰长！看看盲信造出的毁灭，看看那几百万条人命。图什么？"

"那是个不理性的教派。没有哪股力量比它更妨碍我们重建人类文明——一个自由而富足、而非人之领那种暴政与战争的文明。"

她深吸一口气，重新把那份君临般的镇定收拢回来。

"自由与富足。回到正题：Achilles 给了我们一个机会，能换来这些，甚至更多，舰长。"

texts.en:
She gives you a look of some consternation.

"I have no love for the Luddics and their irrational mythology. They hold the entire Sector back, in an age of darkness. But consider well such bold and bloodthirsty proclamations - see how such 'conviction' has served Philip Andrada on Volturn."

"Andrada was as blind the Luddics he slaughtered," she hisses. Then takes a deep breath, re-centering herself in a sense of regal calm.

"And for all purposes he is as good as dead. Which brings us back to Achilles."
texts.zh:
她看着你，神情有些不安。

"我对卢德派和他们那套不理性的神话毫无好感。在这黑暗的时代，是他们拖住了整个星域。可你好好掂量掂量这种大胆又嗜血的说辞——看看这种'决心'让 Philip Andrada 在 Volturn 落了个什么下场。"

"Andrada 跟他屠杀的那些卢德派一样瞎，"她嘶声道。随后深吸一口气，重新沉回那份君临般的镇定里。

"而说到底，他早跟死了没两样。这就又说回 Achilles 了。"

texts.en: She interrupts, holding a hand aloft, a finger raised to summon the bartender, who appears almost instantly.
texts.zh: 她打断你，一只手抬起，竖起一根手指唤来酒保；那酒保几乎立刻就到了。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I find myself in the mood for a glass of the Aguila-Samek '45."

She projects her voice to the room.

"I apologize, ma'am," the bartender says, scurrying up to the table, "but we don't h-"

"Of course you don't," she says over him. "I brought some that you may pour for me."
texts.zh:
"我忽然想喝一杯 Aguila-Samek '45。"

她把声音送向整个房间。

"抱歉，女士，\"酒保快步凑到桌边，\"可我们没——"

"你们当然没有，\"她打断他，\"我自己带了，你只管给我斟上。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
She snaps her fingers, and an attendant approaches.

A case appears and from it an amber bottle webbed in silver tracery, a stream of cool mist flowing down the sides. It opens with a crisp pop.

The bartender fills Fortuna's glass, then hesitates, the spout frozen above the glass set in front of you.

She gives a tiny nod, and the bartender pours for you.
texts.zh:
她打了个响指，一名随从走上前来。

一只箱子送上桌，从里面取出一只琥珀色酒瓶，瓶身覆着银丝般的纹路，冷雾顺着瓶壁流下。瓶盖弹开，发出清脆的一声。

酒保为 Fortuna 斟满一杯，随后迟疑起来，壶嘴悬在你面前那只杯子的上方不动了。

她轻轻一点头，酒保便为你斟上。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
She raises her glass.

"I desire stability. It is a necessary precursor to general prosperity and good living. I offer Achilles all of this, and more - the opportunity to fulfill his duty and ambition as a 'great man' of history." She pauses. "Or, at least, the echo of one."

"I do not demand his humiliation for my own self-regard, nor his life or pain for the crimes of his clone-father."

"And to you I offer an honest accounting of my goals and motives." She looks to you with haughty expectation.
texts.zh:
她举起酒杯。

"我要的是稳定。那是普遍繁荣与优裕生活必要的前提。这些我全都给 Achilles，还有更多——一个成为历史上'伟人'、尽到责任并实现抱负的机会。\"她顿了顿。\"至少，做一个伟人的回声。"

"我并不为了自己的体面要求他受辱，也不为他克隆父亲的罪行索取他的性命或痛苦。"

"而对你，我愿意如实交代我的目标与动机。"她带着傲然的期待看向你。

options.en: You forget that Achilles is the blood of Andrada, from which all authority flows.
options.zh: 你忘了，Achilles 身上流着 Andrada 的血，而一切权威皆由此而来。

options.en: I'll drink to that.
I'll drink to that, provisionally.
options.zh: 为这话，我先干一杯——有条件地。

options.en: You forget MY ambitions. Which have been earned, not inherited.
options.zh: 你忘了我的野心。那是我挣来的，不是继承来的。

options.en: You forget that Achilles is a symbol. So long as he lives, so does Andrada.
options.zh: 你忘了 Achilles 是个象征。只要他活着，Andrada 就还活着。

texts.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then, with a sigh, she sips her drink, looking for a moment pleased to ignore your words.
texts.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

随后叹了口气，抿了一口酒，一时之间像是很乐意无视你说的话。

texts.en:
"I welcome the prospect of your partnership."

She clinks your glass and sips, looking pleased.
texts.zh:
"我很期待与你携手。"

她与你碰杯，抿了一口，看上去颇为满意。

texts.en:
"I welcome the prospect of your partnership."

She clinks your glass and sips, looking pleased.

"Provisionally."
texts.zh:
"我很期待与你携手。"

她与你碰杯，抿了一口，看上去颇为满意。

"有条件地。"

texts.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then sips her drink, timing her action to allow herself to ignore your gaffe.
texts.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

然后抿了一口酒，借着这个动作，正好不去理会你的失言。

texts.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then sips her drink, looking for a moment pleased to ignore your impasse.
texts.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

然后抿了一口酒，一时之间像是很乐意无视你们之间的僵局。

texts.en: "I sincerely hope not. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."

texts.en:
Her eyes narrow.

"The so-called Volturnian Self Defense Covenant cannot be negotiated with, $titlePL. They possess an irrational fanaticism they hold higher than any 'worldly' agreement they might temporarily make, particularly with someone they view as an arch-'Mammonite'." Her tone is venomous. "These are not people fundamentally driven by rationality, merely whatever fearful emotions might be invoked by whichever demogogue the mob decides to call 'prophet' or 'curate'."

She composes herself. A deep breath. Control and calm.

"They are a problem to be dealt with after the civil war is concluded. Giving them even a slip of legitimation now would only make the problem worse long-term."
texts.zh:
她眯起眼睛。

"没法跟所谓的 VSDC 谈判，$titlePL。他们抱着一种不理性的狂热，把它看得比任何'世俗'的临时协定都高——尤其当对方在他们眼里是头号'玛门信徒'。"她语调里带着毒意。"这种人根本不由理性驱动，只是被恐惧情绪牵着走——而那些恐惧，是随便哪个被暴民奉为'先知'或'教区长'的煽动家都能挑起来的。"

她定了定神。深吸一口气。重拾掌控，恢复平静。

"他们是内战结束之后才需要处理的问题。现在哪怕给他们一丝名分，长期看也只会让问题更糟。"

texts.en:
Fortuna looks toward someone off-link and gives a nod. Then back to you.

Your TriPad pings softly.

"See that they are not misused," she says.
texts.zh:
Fortuna 朝通讯之外某人看了一眼，点了点头，然后转回你这边。

你的 TriPad 轻轻响了一声。

"记着，别把它们用错了地方。"

texts.en: "But you must be here because of Askonia," she says. "Much has changed in a short time."
texts.zh: "不过你到这儿来，肯定是为了 Askonia，\"她说。\"短短时间里，变了很多。"

options.en: Yes, let's speak of Askonia.

texts.en: "You'll want your credits, of course, mercenary," she adds with a smirk.
texts.zh: "当然，你想要你的星币，雇佣兵，"她嘴角一挑，补了一句。

texts.en:
"Achilles has won our victory on terms quite acceptable to Gens Kato."

Fortuna looks as pleased as a felid.

"The shape of the Persean League, and indeed the Sector, is shifting much as I intended. Gens Hannan's investments into the Sindrian Diktat old guard were greater than we imagined - Reynard has lost a great deal of capital, to say nothing of his political credibility."

"Gens Hannan is a fortress, still, but," she smiles slowly. "But there is a crack, a growing defect, a progressive failure state..."
texts.zh:
"Achilles 为我们赢下了胜利，条件对 Kato 氏族而言相当可以接受。"

Fortuna 一脸猫似的得意。

"英仙座联盟的格局——其实还有整个星域——正按我的意图挪动。Hannan 氏族投进辛达强权旧卫队里的本钱比我们想的多得多——Reynard 损失了大笔资本，更别提他的政治信誉。"

"Hannan 氏族眼下仍是座堡垒，可是，\"她缓缓一笑，\"可是那里已有了一道裂缝、一处不断扩大的缺陷、一种逐步失效的状态..."

texts.en:
"Achilles has won our victory on terms quite acceptable to Gens Kato."

Fortuna flashes a look as pleased as a felid, but quickly tempers herself.

"Despite the tragedy of Sindria, the shape of the remaining Persean League, and indeed the Sector, is shifting much as I intended. Gens Hannan's investments into the Sindrian Diktat old guard were greater than we imagined - Reynard has lost a great deal of capital, to say nothing of his political credibility."

"Gens Hannan is a fortress, still, but," she allows herself a slow smile. "But there is a crack, a growing defect, a progressive failure state..."
texts.zh:
"Achilles 为我们赢下了胜利，条件对 Kato 氏族而言相当可以接受。"

Fortuna 脸上掠过猫一般的得意，但很快收敛住了。

"尽管 Sindria 出了那样的惨剧，余下的英仙座联盟——其实还有整个星域——的格局仍按我的意图挪动。Hannan 氏族投进辛达强权旧卫队里的本钱比我们想的多得多——Reynard 损失了大笔资本，更别提他的政治信誉。"

"Hannan 氏族眼下仍是座堡垒，可是，\"她容许自己缓缓一笑，\"可是那里已有了一道裂缝、一处不断扩大的缺陷、一种逐步失效的状态..."

texts.en:
"Achilles, Achilles." Fortuna frowns.

"His support, and success, has exceeded all expectations. I fear the boy has grown somewhat... independent."
texts.zh:
"Achilles，Achilles。"Fortuna 皱起眉。

"他的支持度，还有他的成功，都超出了所有预期。我怕这孩子已经长出了几分...独立。"

texts.en:
"I cannot but find myself displeased with Achilles' performance," she says, looking aside - and looking very displeased.

"I gave him everything, everything he needed. Then as he was called upon to deliver victory... he faltered."
texts.zh:
"我没法不觉得 Achilles 的表现令人不满，"她说着把目光移开——那神情确实很不满。

"我给了他一切，他需要的一切。可等该他交出胜利的时候...他退缩了。"

texts.en:
"The civil war was too much for the Sindrian Diktat."

She looks distant.

"I cannot say I am surprised. I could see even in his youth that Philip Andrada was fundamentally a selfish brute despite his charm and obvious talent. Then he sought to create his own 'Gens Andrada' through perverse technologies without understanding that family is something more, and greater, than one man."

She sniffs dismissively.

"Even Reynard understands that much."
texts.zh:
"内战对辛达强权来说太重了。"

她的目光飘远。

"我不能说我觉得意外。早在年轻时我就看得出，Philip Andrada 骨子里是个自私的暴徒，尽管他有魅力、有显而易见的才干。后来他竟想借那些悖逆的技术造一个自己的'Andrada 氏族'，却不懂家族是比一个人更多、也更重的东西。"

她轻蔑地哼了一声。

"这一点，连 Reynard 都明白。"

texts.en:
"Sindria. Stars above, no one expected it could happen again," she says softly.

"What fool gave a planet-killer to an even greater fool?"
texts.zh:
"Sindria。群星在上，谁也没想到这事还能再发生一次，"她轻声说。

"是哪个蠢货把行星杀手交给了一个更蠢的蠢货？"

texts.en:
"To see Gens Kato and Gens Yaribay finally uniting against Gens Hannan, why, Reynard's arrogance has long earned its due!"

Fortuna holds back her pleased expression.

"Perhaps upon the turn of the next All-League Council election we might finally make another bid for the seat of the Prime Demarchon..."
texts.zh:
"看着 Kato 氏族和 Yaribay 氏族终于联手对付 Hannan 氏族，哼，Reynard 的傲慢早就该有这一天了！"

Fortuna 忍住那副得意的神情。

"也许等下一轮全联盟议会选举来临，我们终于能再争一次大统领的位子..."

texts.en:
"In the meantime," she picks up and glances at her TriPad, "We have not been lax in our activities. A special All-League committee has begun an investigation into certain practices of the Prime Demarchon." She lowers the TriPad to look at you.

"This means you will no longer have to pay some 'bribe' to Gens Hannan to retain your organization's position, in good standing, within the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"与此同时，"她接回话头，瞥了一眼 TriPad，"我们的动作也没松懈。一个全联盟特别委员会已经开始调查大统领的某些做法。"她放下 TriPad，看向你。

"这意味着，你不必再向 Hannan 氏族交那笔所谓的'贿赂'，来保住你组织在英仙座联盟内的席位与声誉了。"

texts.en:
"Despite the... situation, I am pleased to see Gens Kato and Gens Yaribay finally uniting against Gens Hannan. Reynard's arrogance has earned its due."

Fortuna cannot quite summon a pleased expression.

"Perhaps upon the turn of the next All-League Council election we might finally make another bid for the seat of the Prime Demarchon..."
texts.zh:
"尽管有那个...状况，我还是很高兴看到 Kato 氏族和 Yaribay 氏族终于联手对付 Hannan 氏族。Reynard 的傲慢得到了应有的报应。"

Fortuna 没能完全摆出高兴的神情。

"也许等下一轮全联盟议会选举来临，我们终于能再争一次大统领的位子..."

options.en: That was the deal.
I'd like to think I helped make the Sector a better place, too.
options.zh: 我倒愿意相信，我也帮着让星域变好了一点。

texts.en: "Indeed," she says airily.
texts.zh: "确实，"她轻飘飘地说。

texts.en: "All is as I planned," she says, tapping her TriPad. "You have earned this."
texts.zh: "一切都在我计划之中，\"她轻敲 TriPad，\"这是你应得的。"

texts.en: "You fulfilled your end of the deal," she says, tapping her TriPad.
texts.zh: "你履行了你那一半约定，"她轻敲 TriPad。

texts.en:
"Indeed, your payment was not contingent upon Achilles winning," she says, not hiding her disappointment. "But we had a deal."

She taps her TriPad.
texts.zh:
"确实，你的报酬并不以 Achilles 取胜为条件，\"她说，并不掩饰失望。\"但我们有约在先。"

她轻敲 TriPad。

texts.en:
"Indeed, your payment was not contingent upon a productive victory," she says, not hiding her disappointment. "But we had a deal."

She taps her TriPad.
texts.zh:
"确实，你的报酬并不以一场有成果的胜利为条件，\"她说，并不掩饰失望。\"但我们有约在先。"

她轻敲 TriPad。

texts.en:
"Your payment was not contingent upon a productive victory, I admit," she says, not hiding her disappointment. "But we had a deal."

She taps her TriPad.
texts.zh:
"我承认，你的报酬并不以一场有成果的胜利为条件，\"她说，并不掩饰失望。\"但我们有约在先。"

她轻敲 TriPad。

texts.en: She raises an eyebrow but does not otherwise comment on your sudden burst of idealism.
texts.zh: 她挑起一边眉毛，除此之外没对你这份突如其来的理想主义作任何评论。

texts.en: "In any event, I have found that we work well together. I would elect to continue our partnership. There is ever more challenge and opportunity; the Gens never rest."
texts.zh: "无论如何，我觉得我们合作得很好。我愿意继续这段伙伴关系。挑战与机会只会越来越多；氏族从不停歇。"

texts.en:
Then she goes quiet, eyes downcast. Thinking. Somehow not quite satisfied, never satisfied.

Looking more her age than timelessly regal.
texts.zh:
随后她静了下来，垂下眼帘。她在想事。不知怎的，总有些不够满足，永远不满足。

这一刻，她看上去更像她这个年纪的人，而不是那位超脱岁月的君主。

options.en: Say nothing.
Fortuna?

texts.en:
She lets out a deep breath, then looks up.

"Until we speak again, $titlePL," she says, her attention already on the next project.

The link cuts.
texts.zh:
她长长吐出一口气，然后抬起头。

"下次再谈，$titlePL，"她说着，心思已经转到下一个项目上。

通讯切断。

texts.en:
She looks up, quickly, as if she was caught daydreaming. She recomposes herself nearly instantly, and releases a breath.

"Until we speak again, $titlePL," she says.

The link cuts.
texts.zh:
她猛地抬起头，像是被人撞见在走神。几乎瞬间她就恢复了常态，吐出一口气。

"下次再谈，$titlePL，"她说。

通讯切断。

options.en: Cut the comms
Have you heard from Imoinu?

texts.en:
There's a long pause. Fortuna's expression is very still.

"We shall not be speaking of that," she says, finally.
texts.zh:
长久的沉默。Fortuna 的神情一动不动。

"这件事我们不必谈，"她终于开口。

texts.en:
There's a long pause. Fortuna's expression is very still. Then something softens, ever so slightly.

"I have not, no."
texts.zh:
长久的沉默。Fortuna 的神情一动不动。随后，有什么东西极轻微地软了下来。

"没有，没有消息。"

texts.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart, and Umbra controlled directly by several loosely associated pirate gangs. I fear the worst, for if she were captured I would soon expect a ransom demand."

She looks down, then up.

"If you..."
texts.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了，Umbra 现在直接由几伙关系松散的海盗帮派把持。我怕的是最坏的结果——若她只是被俘，我早该收到索要赎金的消息了。"

她低下头，又抬起来。

"如果你..."

texts.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart, and Umbra controlled directly by several loosely associated pirate gangs. I fear the worst, for if she were captured I would soon expect a ransom demand."

She looks down, then up.

"If you..."
texts.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了，Umbra 现在直接由几伙关系松散的海盗帮派把持。我怕的是最坏的结果——若她只是被俘，我早该收到索要赎金的消息了。"

她低下头，又抬起来。

"如果你..."

texts.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart, and with Umbra retaken by the Sindrian Diktat, I would expect official word of legal prosecution. It would be negotiated away, of course. And arrangements made. It is always so with members of the inner Gens."

She looks down, then up.

"If you..."
texts.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了。Umbra 既被辛达强权重新拿下，我该收到正式起诉的消息。当然，那最终会被谈掉，再作些安排。核心氏族的人向来如此。"

她低下头，又抬起来。

"如果你..."

texts.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart. With the new administration on Umbra, I would expect... either legal prosecution or a ransom demand. Either is acceptable to me. But to hear nothing at all?"

She looks down. Then back up.

"If you..."
texts.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了。Umbra 换了新政府，我本该等到...要么正式起诉，要么一封赎金要求。哪一样我都能接受。可什么消息都没有？"

她低下头。然后又抬起来。

"如果你..."

options.en: I will let you know if I hear anything.
I will let you know if I hear anything.
I will let you know if I hear anything.
I will let you know if I hear anything.

texts.en: She nods, composing herself.
texts.zh: 她点了点头，重新定了定神。

options.en: About the ANDRADA files...

texts.en: "They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."
texts.zh: "它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I can only assume you've coordinated some response with Fortuna Kato."

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact Gens Kato myself."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和 Fortuna Kato 协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Kato 氏族。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."

"We must," he gives you a look of emphasis, "speak again when it is clear that events are beginning to culminate. Contact me then."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

"我们得——\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"等事态明显开始走向高潮时再谈一次。到时候联系我。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."

"We must," he gives you a look of emphasis, "speak again when it is clear that events are beginning to culminate. Contact me then."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

"我们得——\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"等事态明显开始走向高潮时再谈一次。到时候联系我。"

texts.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I can only assume you've coordinated some response with the Prime Demarchon."

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact the office of the Reynard Hannan myself."
texts.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和大统领协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Reynard Hannan 的办公室。"

texts.en: "They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I shan't act prematurely. It is, you understand, a delicate situation and it would be a mistake to expose my Gens to some scandal or crisis."
texts.zh: "它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我不会过早行动。你要明白，这是个微妙的局面，把我的氏族卷进什么丑闻或危机里，是犯不上的错。"

texts.en:
The comms connect.

"You." Arroyo doesn't look happy.

"Your first impulse after that disastrous propaganda cast - yes, I saw it - was to come here?"

He makes an exasperated sound. "Unbelievable."
texts.zh:
通讯接通了。

"你。" Arroyo 脸色不好看。

"那场灾难性的宣传直播之后——对，我看了——你的第一反应是跑到这儿来？"

他恼火地出了口气。"真是难以置信。"

options.en: Help me Arroyo. You're my only hope.
options.zh: 帮帮我，Arroyo。你是我唯一的希望了。

options.en: I need your help. You could profit from this.
options.zh: 我需要你的帮助。这事你能赚一笔。

options.en: I suppose I can just figure this out on my own.
options.zh: 那我还是自己想办法吧。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Unbelievable," he says again, disgusted.

He sighs, deeply, then puts his elbows on his desk and his head in his hands.

"But fine. Fine. Tell me why you think I should have anything to do with... you."
texts.zh:
"真是难以置信，"他又说了一遍，一脸嫌恶。

他长叹一声，然后把双肘撑在桌上，两手抱住了头。

"不过算了。算了。你倒是说说，我凭什么要跟...你——扯上关系。"

options.en: I must destroy Macario so Hector Andrada can reign as Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 我必须除掉 Macario，好让 Hector Andrada 以最高元首的身份执政。

options.en: I want to take down Dolos Macario.
I want to take down Dolos Macario - and the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我要扳倒 Dolos Macario——还有辛达强权。

options.en: I just want to make this whole situation go away.
options.zh: 我只想让这一团乱麻赶紧过去。

options.en: I need to prove myself to Dolos Macario. Show that he made a mistake.
options.zh: 我得向 Dolos Macario 证明我自己。让他知道他错了。

texts.en:
Arroyo sighs. Then, slowly, he raises his head.

He adjusts his suit, though it is tailored to effortless perfection, then looks at you directly, expression well past skeptical and nearly within the realm of dismissive.

"Is that what will make you happy? Fine. Hypothetically, then, let's talk about how you - yourself - get out of this."

"First, forget about 'destroying' Macario."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 叹了口气。然后缓缓抬起头。

他理了理西装——那身衣服本就剪裁得无可挑剔——然后直视着你，神情早已越过怀疑，几乎到了不屑一顾的地步。

"那样你就满意了？行。那我们就假设一下，谈谈你——你自己——怎么从这局里脱身。"

"第一，别想什么'除掉'Macario。"

texts.en: "What you have, captain," he slaps one hand in the other. "Is a PR problem. A big one. But we've got tools for that. Does anyone still talk about Daedaleon? Nope!"
texts.zh: "你现在的处境，舰长，\"他一掌拍在另一只手上，\"是个公关问题。而且是个大问题。不过我们有工具对付这个。现在还有谁提 Daedaleon 吗？没有！"

options.en: I fail to see what this has to do with Transcendent Andradan Ideology.
options.zh: 我看不出这跟 Andrada 超凡意识形态有什么关系。

options.en: Daedaleon?
What does this have to do with showing Macario his error?
options.zh: 这跟让 Macario 认清自己的错误有什么关系？

options.en: You mean that moon Tri-Tachyon turned into an exotic radiation-spewing death-trap?
options.zh: 你是说那颗卫星——速子科技把它改造成了一座喷射奇异辐射的死亡陷阱？

texts.en:
Arroyo gapes for a moment, then says - perhaps not quite shouts - "No! Stop that, stop trying to tell me - anyone - about his transparent ideology!"

"Stars above," he says, palm to his face. "You sound like a malfunctioning sub-gamma assistant."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 张着嘴愣了片刻，然后说——也许算不上吼——"不！住口，别再跟我——跟任何人——讲他那套一眼就能看穿的意识形态了！"

"群星在上，\"他一手捂住脸。\"你听起来像台出了故障的次伽马级辅助程序。"

options.en: If you can't respect the transcendent ideology of Philip Andrada, then we have nothing to talk about.
options.zh: 如果你不尊重 Philip Andrada 那套超凡的意识形态，那我们就没什么好谈的。

options.en: I apologize. You were saying?
options.zh: 我道歉。你刚才说到哪了？

texts.en:
"I guess not," he says. "You're unbelievable."

He turns away, one hand reaching for what you assume is the comms cut-off.

"By the way, a 'fellow' Company executive got it in their head that you were interfering with their profits. Watch your back, because I'm not going to do it anymore."

He turns to look over his shoulder. "This? It's over. Have a nice life."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"看来不会，\"他说。\"你真是不可理喻。"

他转过身去，一只手伸向你猜是通讯切断键的地方。

"顺便说一句，公司里有位'同事'认定你在妨碍他们的利润。自己盯着背后吧，这事我不会再替你看着了。"

他回头看了一眼。"这事？到此为止。祝你过得愉快。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms

texts.en:
Arroyo has made his position clear.

You'll just have to watch your back and react as other parties make their moves - or contact stronger, more willing allies.

Whether by some murderous Tri-Tachyon executive or some pretender Supreme Executor, you will be stopped by no one.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 已经把立场说得很清楚了。

你只能自己盯着背后，等别人先出手再作应对——或者去联系更强、更愿意出手的盟友。

不管是某个杀心已起的速子科技高管，还是某个僭称最高元首的人，谁都拦不住你。

texts.en:
"Let's keep focused on the problem we're trying to solve here, captain." He points, "Your reputation."

He's starting to look a bit more cheerful.
texts.zh:
"我们还是集中在这个要解决的问题上，舰长。\"他指了指。\"你的名声。"

他的脸色开始好看起来。

options.en: I can handle my own reputation, thanks.
options.zh: 我自己的名声我自己能处理，多谢。

options.en: Is this going to be expensive?
What do you propose?

options.zh: 我自己的名声我自己能处理，多谢。

What do you propose?
I don't care about that. I want to take down Macario.
options.zh: 我不在乎那些。我要扳倒 Macario。

options.en: I don't care about that. I want to destroy the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我不在乎那些。我要摧毁辛达强权。

texts.en: "No, you can't," he says. "That's why you're here."
texts.zh: "不，你处理不了，\"他说。\"这正是你来找我的原因。"

texts.en:
"With half the Sector's meat-head bounty hunters trying to kill the number one terrorist on Macario's list and the other half merely suspecting you're a baby-killer?"

"You need to get your act together. Fix your reputation, gather allies, then you can even begin to consider hitting back. I've got a contact in a PR firm that can clean things up for 50,000 credits."
texts.zh:
"半个星域的莽夫赏金猎人都在追杀 Macario 名单上的头号恐怖分子，另一半不过是在怀疑你是个杀婴犯？"

"你得先把自己收拾整齐。修好名声，拉拢盟友，然后才谈得上考虑反击。我认识一家公关公司，花 50,000 星币就能把事摆平。"

options.en: Accept
No, I can handle it.
I'd like to, but I can't afford it.

texts.en:
"Good," he says, though clearly isn't allowing himself to sound pleased. "The first rational decision you've made since..."

He considers.

Then waves a hand. "Whenever. Anyway, they'll get it done. You'll see."
texts.zh:
"很好，\"他说，语气却明显不肯露出半分满意。\"这是你自...以来做出的第一个理性决定。"

他想了想。

然后摆了摆手。"随便什么时候吧。总之他们会办妥的。你等着看就是。"

texts.en: "Now all you need to do," he leans back, hands behind his head. "Is lay low. Stay out of trouble. Let things calm down, let your investments mature. Collect the interest, re-invest."
texts.zh: "现在你只需要做一件事，\"他往后一靠，双手枕在脑后。\"低调。别惹麻烦。让事情冷下来，等你的投资慢慢成熟。收利息，再投出去。"

options.en: The situation in the Sindrian Diktat must be addressed.
options.zh: 辛达强权的局面必须处理。

options.en: I'm not sure that's a realistic outcome, Rayan.
options.zh: 我不认为那能成为现实，Rayan。

options.en: Sit it out? Not my style, Rayan.
options.zh: 袖手旁观？那不是我的作风，Rayan。

options.en: Good plan. I'll do it.

texts.en: Arroyo sighs, and closes his eyes. "Somehow I thought you'd say that."
texts.zh: Arroyo 叹了口气，闭上眼睛。"不知怎么，我就猜到你会这么说。"

texts.en:
His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.

"Help? I told you to lay low and you agreed."
texts.zh:
他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

"帮忙？我跟你说过要低调蛰伏，你也答应了。"

texts.en:
"Well, I already agreed to help." Arroyo looks you over. "Just don't push your luck."

"What's the plan?"
texts.zh:
"行吧，我已经答应帮忙了。\"Arroyo 把你上下打量一遍，\"只是别得寸进尺。"

"计划是什么？"

texts.en:
His look is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Back on this, huh," he says.

But he does appear to be listening.
texts.zh:
他的目光带着怀疑，几乎算得上不屑。

"又绕回这事了，"他说。

不过他看起来确实在听。

texts.en:
"I told you I didn't want to get involved," he says. "Remember when you came to me waving around some top-level secret files you stole from the... who was it - oh, right, the leader of the Sindrian Diktat's secret police with a reputation for torture and assassination? Remember that?"

He looks away, shaking his head. "I make it a policy never to get involved with someone named after an animal. Never ends well."
texts.zh:
"我跟你说过，我不想掺和。\"他说，\"还记得你跑来找我，手里挥着几份顶级机密文件，从那个...谁来着的——哦对，辛达强权秘密警察的头子，一个以酷刑和暗杀出名的家伙——从他那儿偷来的？还记得吗？"

他别过脸去，摇了摇头。"我有个原则：绝不跟名字是动物的人打交道。从来没好下场。"

texts.en:
His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.

"Now why exactly would I want to get involved in that 'situation'?"
texts.zh:
他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

"那么，我到底为什么会想掺进那个'局面'里去？"

texts.en: His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.
texts.zh: 他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

options.en: I want you to back Achilles' faction. He's a reformer.
options.zh: 我要你支持 Achilles 那一派。他是个改革者。

options.en: I want you to assist Hector, the true heir to Andrada.
options.zh: 我要你协助 Hector——Andrada 真正的继承人。

options.en: I want you to help supply the uprisings against the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我要你帮那些反抗辛达强权的起义者供应物资。

options.en: Uh, no plan just yet. I'll get back to you.
options.zh: 呃，暂时还没计划。我回头再来找你。

texts.en:
"The clone who looks like he didn't finish thawing out from the cryo-pod they keep self-important little officers in? The uniformed puppet dancing for Fortuna Kato?"

Arroyo holds his look for just a moment.
texts.zh:
"就是那个看着像没从冷冻舱里化透的克隆人？那种舱专用来装自命不凡的小军官。还有那个穿着制服、围着 Fortuna Kato 打转的傀儡？"

Arroyo 迎着你的目光，停了片刻。

texts.en:
"Sure," he says agreeably, tapping at a TriPad. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies. I wager we'll be moving cargo within two or three shifts."

It sounds almost as if Arroyo may enjoy running a smuggling operation into a star system burning in civil war.
texts.zh:
"行啊，\" 他爽快地应道，一边戳着 TriPad，\"我让我的人去把空壳公司搭起来。我打赌，两三个班次之内咱们就能开始运货了。"

听着倒像是 Arroyo 挺享受这桩买卖：往一个正烧着内战的星系里走私。

texts.en:
"Sure," he says agreeably, tapping at a TriPad. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies. I wager we'll be moving cargo within two or three shifts."

"Meeting concluded. And I'm busy, so." He waves you off, looking back to his TriPad.
texts.zh:
"行啊，\" 他爽快地应道，一边戳着 TriPad，\"我让我的人去把空壳公司搭起来。我打赌，两三个班次之内咱们就能开始运货了。"

"会开完了。我这儿还忙着呢，就这样。" 他摆了摆手把你打发走，目光又落回 TriPad 上。

options.en: Cut the comms

texts.en:
You cut the comms, leaving him to his business.

It sounds almost as if Arroyo may enjoy running a smuggling operation into a star system burning in civil war.
texts.zh:
你切断了通讯，留他忙自己的事去。

听着倒像是 Arroyo 挺享受这桩买卖：往一个正烧着内战的星系里走私。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: The next step: go to Yesod to tell Achilles about the logistics operation you've arranged via Arroyo.
texts.zh: 下一步：前往 Yesod，把你在 Arroyo 那里安排好的后勤行动告知 Achilles。

texts.en:
Now you need to get yourself to Yesod and inform Achilles about Arroyo's supply operation.

This should help him secure an independent power base from Gens Kato. Perhaps it is not sufficient alone, but every little bit helps.
texts.zh:
现在你得亲自去一趟 Yesod，把 Arroyo 的补给行动告知 Achilles。

这应当能帮他从 Kato 氏族手里挣出一块独立的权力根基。也许单凭这一点还不够，但积少成多。

texts.en:
Now you need to get word to Hector that you've secured an additional line of support to tip the scales in his favor.

Surely he'll recognize that you've proven your loyalty in spite of Macario's lies.
texts.zh:
现在你得把消息送到 Hector 那里：你又为他拉到了一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。

他总该认账：哪怕 Macario 满口谎话，你的忠诚已经得到了证明。

texts.en:
Now you need to get word to the Sindrian Diktat that you've secured an additional line of support for the rightful heir, Hector Andrada, which should help tip the scales in his favor. Every little bit helps, after all.

Surely they'll recognize that you've proven your loyalty in spite of Macario's gross misstep.
texts.zh:
现在你得把消息递给辛达强权：你为合法继承人 Hector Andrada 又拉到一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。毕竟积少成多。

他们总该认账：哪怕 Macario 犯下大错，你的忠诚已经得到了证明。

texts.en:
There's some time now, while the inevitable conflict lays quiet. Time to move additional supplies to the rebels, make more contacts, and refit your own fleet...

You take a moment to have your comms officer set up wide-band content monitors so you will be alerted when events of interest occur in the Askonia system.
texts.zh:
眼下还有一段时间，那场迟早要来的冲突暂且沉寂。正好把更多补给送给叛军，多结几路人脉，再把自己的舰队整备一番...

你抽空让通讯军官架起全频段内容监听，Askonia 星系里一有值得注意的动静，你就能收到警报。

texts.en:
Next step: get word to Dolos Macario that you've secured an additional line of support for the 'rightful' heir, Hector Andrada, which should help tip the scales in his favor. Every little bit helps.

He'll be forced to recognize your value in spite of his gross misstep.
texts.zh:
下一步：把消息递给 Dolos Macario——你为那位'合法'继承人 Hector Andrada 又拉到一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。积少成多嘛。

哪怕他犯下大错，也由不得他不认你的价值。

options.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

options.en: I must contact Hector directly
I must contact Dolos Macario
But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

texts.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network.

It's a long shot, but even with a common snoop hack you might be able to find a link for Hector's alias - or for someone who knows where he might be found.

Decisive action is exactly how Andrada won Askonia - you need but follow his example.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。

希望不大，但哪怕只用寻常的窥探手段，也许就能找到通往 Hector 化名的链路——或是找到一个知道他下落的人。

Andrada 当年正是靠果断的行动赢下了 Askonia——你只需照他的样子做。

texts.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system.

A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and give him one last chance to correct himself before you show him the true meaning of power.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。

一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说清他犯下的错误，给他最后一次改正的机会——在那之后，就让他见识见识权力的真正含义。

options.en: It must be done. Macario must be shown the error of his ways
options.zh: 必须这么做。必须让 Macario 看清他错在哪里

texts.en:
You take a deep breath.

And open your eyes.
texts.zh:
你深吸一口气。

然后睁开了眼睛。

texts.en: Hector Andrada is key. His will alone will determine the future of the Sindrian Diktat, whatever Macario thinks.
texts.zh: 关键在于 Hector Andrada。不管 Macario 怎么想，辛达强权的未来只系于他一个人的意志。

options.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

texts.en: Dolos Macario is key. His manipulations will determine the future of the Sindrian Diktat, whatever Hector thinks.
texts.zh: 关键在于 Dolos Macario。不管 Hector 怎么想，辛达强权的未来都系于他的手腕。

options.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

texts.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system.

A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and set everything right.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。

一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说清他犯下的错误，把一切拨回正轨。

texts.en:
"That bloodthirsty, raving blowhard?"

Arroyo holds his look for just a moment.
texts.zh:
"那个嗜血成性、满嘴疯话的牛皮大王？"

Arroyo 迎着你的目光，停了片刻。

texts.en:
"That circus dumping-ground of pirates, zealots, and terrorists?"

Arroyo holds his look for just a moment.
texts.zh:
"那个海盗、狂信徒和恐怖分子凑成一堆的马戏团垃圾场？"

Arroyo 迎着你的目光，停了片刻。

texts.en: "Then why the big pitch?" He shakes his head, annoyed. "You're just going to lay low and wait after all?"
texts.zh: "那你刚才那一大通说辞算什么？\"他不耐烦地摇头，\"绕了一圈，你还是打算缩起来等？"

texts.en: "Then why the big pitch?" He shakes his head, annoyed.
texts.zh: "那你刚才那一大通兜售算什么？" 他烦躁地摇了摇头。

options.en: I'm serious. I'm going to try to lay low and see what happens.
options.zh: 我是认真的。我会尽量缩着不出头，看看会怎样。

options.en: No, I still need to deal with the situation in Askonia.
options.zh: 不，Askonia 的局面我还是得处理。

texts.en:
"Good." He nods. "Smart."

"I also should tell you. I've heard... grumbling. About you meddling in Askonia." His hand comes up. "I don't care if you meant to or not, it's immaterial. Point is, a couple fellow Company executives got the idea that their profits would be better off if your operations were closed."

"Permanently."
texts.zh:
"很好。\"他点了点头。\"聪明。"

"还有件事我该告诉你。我听到了一些...怨言。说你在 Askonia 多管闲事。\"他抬起一只手。\"我不在乎你是不是有意的，那不重要。重点是，公司里有几位高管认定，你的产业要是被关掉，他们的利润会更好看。"

"永久关掉。"

options.en: Someone's trying to kill me?

texts.en:
"Yeah."

He leans back. "So be careful."
texts.zh:
"是啊。"

他往后一靠。"所以小心点。"

options.en: Who is it? How? I'd like some information.
options.zh: 是谁？怎么动手？我想知道些细节。

texts.en:
Arroyo's expression doesn't change.

"That's all I've got. Like I said, rumors. And I'm not about to go digging around in the dirt of these trigger-happy ladder-climbers. It's called 'self preservation' and you should consider learning about it. Don't get killed. I'd be..."

He trails off, considering his words. None seem to come to him.

"Got work to do," he says quickly. "Arroyo out."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 的表情没有变化。

"我知道的就这些。我说了，都是传言。我才不会去翻那些一点就炸、只顾往上爬的家伙的脏事。这叫'自保'，你该学着点。别被人弄死了。不然我会..."

他话说到一半停住了，斟酌着用词。似乎一个词也没斟酌出来。

"我还有活要干，\"他飞快地说。\"Arroyo 完毕。"

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms

texts.en:
You'll just have to watch your back and react as other parties make their moves.

Whether a murderous Tri-Tachyon executive or would-be Supreme Executor.
texts.zh:
你只能自己盯着背后，等别人先出手再作应对。

不管出手的是个杀心已起的速子科技高管，还是个想做最高元首的人。

texts.en: "I guess you do have a Tri-Tachyon commission," he admits rather begrudgingly.
texts.zh: "看来你手里确实有张速子科技的委任状，"他不情不愿地承认。

options.en: Askonia needs stability, a strong leader, for profits to be ensured. It needs Hector Andrada.
options.zh: Askonia 需要稳定，需要一位强势的领袖，利润才有保障。它需要 Hector Andrada。

options.en: Askonia needs stability, a strong leader, for profits to be ensured. It needs Achilles Andrada.
options.zh: Askonia 需要稳定，需要一位强势的领袖，利润才有保障。它需要 Achilles Andrada。

options.en: Ending Macario's corrupt reign of terror is simply the right thing to do.
options.zh: 终结 Macario 那套贪腐的恐怖统治，本来就是该做的事。

options.en: I want to show Macario why trying to make me his patsy will be his downfall.
options.zh: Macario 想拿我当替罪羊，我要让他明白，这就是他的覆灭之因。

options.en: I want to stop Macario's reign of terror and corruption.
options.zh: 我要终结 Macario 的恐怖统治和贪腐。

options.en: It's an opportunity. One side's downfall provides another's ascension, right?
options.zh: 这是个机会。一边倒下，另一边就能上位，对吧？

options.en: This is an opportunity to make credits from the chaos! (pander)
options.zh: 这场乱局正是赚星币的机会！ (谄媚)

options.en: I'm a profitable business contact, aren't I? That must count for something.
options.zh: 我是个能赚钱的商业伙伴，不是吗？这总该算点什么。

options.en: I'm a profitable business contact, aren't I. That must count for something.
options.zh: 我是个能赚钱的商业伙伴，对吧。这总该算点什么。

options.en: Macario is distracted - he's trying to run a coup. Now is the time to push.
options.zh: Macario 正分身乏术——他在操办一场政变。现在正是加码的时候。

options.en: Once I prove to Macario he made a mistake he'll reward me - and you.
options.zh: 只要我让 Macario 明白他看错了人，他就会奖赏我——还有你。

options.en: With upheaval comes opportunity. Credits moved. Old deals broken, new deals made.
options.zh: 动荡带来机会。星币在流动。旧约作废，新约签成。

options.en: Askonia's is underutilized. Suppression and uprisings are holding back an economic boom.
options.zh: Askonia 的经济远没有被充分盘活。镇压和暴动压着一场经济繁荣。

options.en: So we're agreed?
Maybe we can figure this out later... (back)
options.zh: 这事也许以后再想吧... (返回)

options.en: Maybe I'll just wait and see what happens...
options.zh: 也许我就先等等，看看会怎么样...

texts.en:
"A strong leader."

He gives you a withering look. "Okay. I suppose."

"Askonia has seen more corruption and unrest every cycle. The bribes are eating into profits. And where's that Supreme Executor that's supposed to keep the system in line? Personally I don't find the holos convincing- I've faked better."
texts.zh:
"一位强势的领袖。"

他投来一个能把人看矮半截的眼神。"行吧。我想是吧。"

"Askonia 每个星历年的贪腐和动荡都在加剧。贿赂正在吃掉利润。那位本该管住这个星系的最高元首呢？就我个人而言，那些全息影像一点也说服不了我——我伪造的都比他像样。"

texts.en:
"A strong leader."

He gives you a withering look. "Okay. I suppose."

"Askonia has seen more corruption and unrest every cycle. The bribes are eating into profits. And where's that Supreme Executor who's supposed to keep the system in line?? Personally I don't find the holos convincing- I've faked better."
texts.zh:
"一位强势的领袖。"

他投来一个能把人看矮半截的眼神。"行吧。我想是吧。"

"Askonia 每个星历年的贪腐和动荡都在加剧。贿赂正在吃掉利润。那位本该管住这个星系的最高元首呢？就我个人而言，那些全息影像一点也说服不了我——我伪造的都比他像样。"

texts.en:
"The right thing." He gives you a withering look. "To do."

"What does that even mean? No - don't explain. I don't care. That's not a business plan. Why am I supposed to work with you on... whatever this is?"
texts.zh:
"该做的事。\"他投来一个能把人看矮半截的眼神，\"我是说，去做。"

"这话到底什么意思？不——别解释。我不在乎。那不算商业计划。我凭什么要跟你一起干...不管你这是在干什么？"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms.

"Why do I suddenly care about your infantile need for revenge? Why am I supposed to work with you on... whatever this is?"
texts.zh:
"好，"他双臂抱在胸前。

"我为什么会突然在乎你那点幼稚的复仇心？我凭什么要跟你一起干...不管你这是在干什么？"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms.

"Why do I suddenly care about Askonia? Why am I supposed to help you with... what are you even proposing?"
texts.zh:
"好，"他双臂抱在胸前。

"我为什么会突然在乎 Askonia？我凭什么要帮你...你到底在提什么？"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms. "That's a bit vague, but now we're beginning to talk sense."

"And it's risky, even in the hypothetical. And you need to convince me why whatever you're proposing is worth it."
texts.zh:
"好，\"他双臂抱在胸前，\"说得有点含糊，不过总算开始讲点像样的话了。"

"而且就算只是假设，这也够冒险的。你得说服我，你提的这套为什么值得。"

texts.en:
"Okay," he says, crossing his arms. "I know you don't believe that - but I do. So I like how you're talking."

"But it's risky. And you need to convince me why whatever this is is worth it."
texts.zh:
"好，\"他双臂抱在胸前，\"我知道你自己都不信这话——可我信。所以你这套说法，我喜欢。"

"但这很冒险。你得说服我，这整件事为什么值得。"

texts.en:
After a short silence, and a sigh.

"I suppose. But that's not enough."
texts.zh:
沉默了片刻，然后是一声叹息。

"我想是吧。可这还不够。"

texts.en:
"Hmm." Arroyo rubs his beard, thinking.

"Sure. If he's been planning this for ten, maybe twenty cycles... He's launching a new enterprise, he's committed his liquid assets. Customers aren't sure about the new value proposition and branding. The investors must be jumpy."

He looks at you, conceding. "It's an interesting point."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"Arroyo 捻着胡须，思索起来。

"有道理。如果他为此筹划了十年，也许二十年...他是在开张一门新买卖，把流动资金全押了进去。客户对新的价值主张和品牌还没底。投资人一定坐不住。"

他看着你，算是让步。"这个点很有意思。"

texts.en:
"Reward, huh." Arroyo rubs his beard. "You... think Dolos Macario is going to come around on all of this and give you a reward?"

"Wait," he makes a show of searching around, as if there was someone nearby that he overlooked. "Is there some other Macario you're talking about? Who isn't a vindictive monster?"

He stops to give you a look through the comms.

"Don't be stupid. At this point you're lucky if he gives you a quick execution."
texts.zh:
"奖赏，是吗。\"Arroyo 捻着胡须，\"你...觉得 Dolos Macario 会在这件事上转变心意，还给你发奖赏？"

"等等，\"他煞有介事地四下张望，像是在找什么被自己漏掉的近旁之人，\"你说的该不会是另一个 Macario 吧？总不会是那个记仇成性的怪物？"

他停下来，隔着通讯盯着你看。

"别犯傻。到这一步，他肯给你一个痛快的处决，你就该谢天谢地了。"

texts.en:
"True," he admits. "It's a high-risk market, but the potential to open new segments is equally high. There'll be some big investments made in bold initiatives."

"Weapons, ships, mercenaries, fuel, supplies - up, up, up."

He also stands up, now, getting excited.

"Supply chain stability will take a short-term hit, but heavy industry futures in stable zones... you can't lose."

Arroyo stops himself and gives you a look. Is that something like respect? He turns away before you're sure.
texts.zh:
"没错，\"他承认，\"这是个高风险的市场，可开出新板块的潜力一样高。会有一批大钱投到大胆的举措上去。"

"武器、舰船、雇佣兵、燃料、补给——涨，涨，涨。"

他也站了起来，兴致上来了。

"供应链的稳定短期内会受些冲击，可稳定地带的重工业期货...稳赚不赔。"

Arroyo 收住话头，看了你一眼。那里面是不是有点类似敬意的东西？你还没看清，他就转开了脸。

texts.en:
"Mm. The old Lion hasn't been running a tight ship, it's true."

Arroyo considers this for a moment.

"Instability lowers demand. Low investment in secondary and tertiary sectors... any surplusses invested go to low-return weapons technology - profitable for sections of Tri-Tachyon, sure." He looks over at you. "Not my department and not my portfolio, however. Low return for me. They can crash and burn, for all I care."

"If there's a new chief executive in Askonia, maybe I can get in on the ground floor of new budget allocations."

He rubs his hands together.

"They just need leadership that isn't some drooling idiot..."
texts.zh:
"嗯。那头老狮子掌舵确实不够严。"

Arroyo 琢磨了一下。

"动荡会压低需求。二、三产业投资不足...投出去的盈余都流向了低回报的武器技术——对速子科技的部分部门来说当然赚钱。\"他看过来，\"可那不是我的部门，也不在我的投资组合里。对我来说回报太低。他们烧光、垮掉，我都不在乎。"

"要是 Askonia 换个新的首席执行官，也许我能在新预算分配的起步阶段就插进去。"

他搓了搓手。

"他们只需要一个不是流着口水犯傻的领导人..."

texts.en: "No," he says. "We're not."
texts.zh: "不，\"他说，\"我们没说定。"

texts.en:
He stares at you for a moment.

"Yes, we're agreed. There are credits to be made."

"What's the plan?"
texts.zh:
他盯着你看了片刻。

"对，我们说定了。这生意有星币可赚。"

"计划是什么？"

texts.en:
"Hrm." Arroyo narrows his eyes. "After all of that?"

He shrugs.

"Good," he says. "I guess."
texts.zh:
"嗯。\"Arroyo 眯起眼，\"说完这么一大套，你就这么算了？"

他耸了耸肩。

"好，\"他说，\"大概吧。"

options.en: Yes, I'm going to lay low and see how it pans out.
options.zh: 对，我会先蛰伏，看看事情怎么发展。

options.en: No, let's discuss options.
options.zh: 不，我们还是谈谈有哪些选择。

texts.en:
"Play it safe, that's what I'd do."

Arroyo still doesn't seem pleased with you, somehow.
texts.zh:
"稳着来，这是我的做法。"

不知怎么的，Arroyo 看上去还是不太满意你。

texts.en:
Arroyo slowly spins his chair so he's facing you once more. His look is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

But he does appear to be listening.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 慢慢转动椅子，重新面向你。他的目光带着怀疑，几乎算得上不屑。

不过他看起来确实在听。

texts.en: "I'm not as annoyed with you as all logic suggests I should," he says. "For some reason."
texts.zh: "按道理我该对你很不耐烦，可我并没有那么不耐烦，\"他说，\"不知道是什么缘故。"

texts.en:
Arroyo slowly spins his chair around, turning his back to you, then returning so he's facing you once more. His look is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

But he does appear to be listening.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 慢慢把椅子转过去，背对着你，又转回来，重新面向你。他的目光带着怀疑，几乎算得上不屑。

不过他看起来确实在听。

texts.en:
He eyes you. "You're terrorist number one to the Sindrian Diktat. You should be in hiding, like I said. Best PR move in a crisis like this is to shut up and make yourself scarce. Let the professionals run damage control." He frowns. "Figuratively, I mean."

He fiddles with a crystal glass from his decanter set, but doesn't fill it. Yet.
texts.zh:
他打量着你。"在辛达强权那里，你是头号恐怖分子。你该躲起来，我说过了。这种危机里最好的公关手段就是闭嘴、让自己从视线里消失。让专业人士去做危机管控。"他皱了皱眉，"我这是打比方。"

他摆弄起酒具里的一只水晶杯，却没有倒酒。暂时没有。

texts.en:
He eyes you. "Yes, I saw the 'cast. Terrorist number one."

"I don't believe half of it, for what it's worth." A pause. "But I believe half of it, because this is you we're talking about."
texts.zh:
他打量着你。"是啊，那则广播我看了。头号恐怖分子。"

"顺带说一句，那里面我一半都不信。\"他顿了顿，\"可另一半我信，因为说的是你。"

texts.en:
He eyes you. "You're terrorist number one to the Sindrian Diktat."

"I don't believe half of it, for what it's worth." A pause. "But I believe half of it, because this is you we're talking about. What you should do is lay low, like I said."

He fiddles with a crystal glass from his decanter set, but doesn't fill it. Yet.

"And what I should do is have nothing to do with any of this."
texts.zh:
他打量着你。"在辛达强权那里，你是头号恐怖分子。"

"顺带说一句，那里面我一半都不信。\"他顿了顿，\"可另一半我信，因为说的是你。你该做的是低调蛰伏，我说过了。"

他摆弄起酒具里的一只水晶杯，却没有倒酒。暂时没有。

"而我该做的，是跟这一切都不沾边。"

options.en: You're right. I'll keep my head down.
options.zh: 你说得对。我会低调藏好。

options.en: I understand your reticence, but I need to act.
options.zh: 我理解你的顾虑，但我必须行动。

options.en: I understand your reticence, but acting now is the right move.
options.zh: 我理解你的顾虑，但现在动手才是对的。

options.en: Well never mind, then.
I understand your reticence, but I need to take the initiative.
options.zh: 我理解你的顾虑，但我必须抢先动手。

options.en: Well never mind, then. I'll lay low.
options.zh: 那就当我没说。我会低调蛰伏。

texts.en: He sits up, giving you a suspicious look.
texts.zh: 他坐直身子，狐疑地看着你。

options.en: I was kidding. I still need to deal with the situation in Askonia.
options.zh: 我开玩笑的。Askonia 的局面我还是得处理。

options.en: I'm serious. I'm going to try to lay low.
options.zh: 我是认真的。我会尽量低调。

texts.zh: "别叫我 Rayan，"他厉声道。

texts.en: "You sure? That'd be letting Dolos Macario tell the story."
texts.zh: "你确定？那等于让 Dolos Macario 来讲这个故事。"

options.en: I'm sure.
I'd like to, but I can't afford it.
Fine, I accept.

texts.en: He shrugs.
texts.zh: 他耸了耸肩。

texts.en: "You can't afford..." Arroyo rubs his eyes. "Okay. Too bad, I guess."
texts.zh: "你付不起...\"Arroyo 揉了揉眼睛。\"行吧。那挺可惜。"

texts.en: "Not in the long run," he says.
texts.zh: "从长远看，你承受不起，"他说。

texts.en:
"Exactly!"

He's starting to look a bit more cheerful.

"We're going to fix your reputation. Some of it, anyway."
texts.zh:
"正是！"

他的脸色开始好看起来。

"我们要把你的名声修好。至少修好一部分。"

texts.en:
"Focus on the problem we're trying to solve here." He points. "Your reputation!"

He's starting to look a bit more cheerful.
texts.zh:
"先集中在我们眼下要解决的问题上。\"他指了指。\"你的名声！"

他的脸色开始好看起来。

texts.en:
Arroyo raises his head and straightens his suit, looking at you directly once more. His expression is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Is that it? Fine. Hypothetically, then, let's talk about how you get out of this. First, forget about 'taking down' Macario."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，理了理西装，再次直视你。他的神情带着怀疑，近乎不屑。

"就这些？行。那我们就假设一下，谈谈你怎么从这局里脱身。第一，别想什么'扳倒'Macario。"

texts.en:
Arroyo raises his head and straightens his suit, looking at you directly once more. His expression is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Is that it? Fine. Hypothetically, let's talk about how you get out of this. First, forget about all of that."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，理了理西装，再次直视你。他的神情带着怀疑，近乎不屑。

"就这些？行。那我们就假设一下，谈谈你怎么从这局里脱身。第一，这些念头全都放下。"

texts.en:
Arroyo raises his head and straightens his suit, looking at you directly once more. His expression is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Is that it? Fine. That's not... not quite so unrealistic as I expected."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，理了理西装，再次直视你。他的神情带着怀疑，近乎不屑。

"就这些？行。这倒...没有我想的那么不切实际。"

texts.en:
Arroyo raises his head, looking at you directly. His expression is grotesque.

"Prove yourself."

He takes a deep breath, bordering on a sigh.

"To Dolos Macario."

He raises both hands - is that a tremor - to his temples and rubs them, as if to ritualistically fend off an expected headache.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，直视着你。他的神情古怪得有些扭曲。

"证明你自己。"

他深吸一口气，几乎要变成一声叹息。

"向 Dolos Macario 证明。"

他抬起双手——那是在发抖吗——按上太阳穴揉了起来，像是在做某种仪式，好挡开一场预料之中的头痛。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You understand that he just flushed your reputation into the recycling tank? And, besides, HE has a reputation for torture, kidnapping, assassination, and so on and on and on?"

He puts his hands together carefully, as if restraining himself.

"You don't think he's made his intentions for you clear? You want to... prove yourself."
texts.zh:
"你明白他刚把你的名声冲进回收槽里了吧？而且，他自己可是以酷刑、绑架、暗杀等等等等出名的？"

他小心地把双手合在一起，像是在克制自己。

"你难道不觉得他对你的意图已经够清楚了？你还想...向他证明自己。"

options.en: Yes. That's what I just said.
options.zh: 对。我刚才就是这么说的。

options.en: Perhaps you don't understand the full context here.
options.zh: 也许你根本没弄明白这里面的来龙去脉。

options.en: I don't feel like you have an appreciation for Transcendent Andradan Ideology.
options.zh: 我看你并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态的分量。

options.en: He has power. I have power, and I want more. Isn't this obvious?
options.zh: 他手里有权。我手里也有权，而且我想要更多。这还不够明显吗？

texts.en: He just stares at you.
texts.zh: 他只是盯着你。

texts.en:
He lets the air out of his lungs, a sound of existential pain. After a moment, he seems to recover.

"No! Forget all of that. Clear your head. You want to live to enjoy riches and power? Smarten up!"
texts.zh:
他把肺里的气全吐了出来，那声音像是一种存在层面的痛苦。过了片刻，他像是缓过来了。

"不！那些全忘了。脑子放清楚。你想活着享受财富和权力？那就给我聪明点！"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Yes!" He slams his hands down. "I do!"
texts.zh: "没错！"他双手往下一拍。"我懂！"

texts.en: "The," he speaks haltingly, bewildered, "transcendent... what? No! No one cares about any of that. Least of all me!"
texts.zh: "那、那个，\"他结结巴巴，一脸茫然，\"超凡...什么？不！没人关心那些东西。至少我不关心！"

texts.en: "I... guess," he says, his expression at trying to wrap his mind around your statements somehow grotesque.
texts.zh: "我...大概吧，"他说，那副拼命想弄懂你那番话的表情，不知怎的有些狰狞。

texts.en:
He sighs deeply.

"Unlikely," he says, putting his elbows on his desk and his head in his hands. "But tell me why you think I should have anything to do with... you."
texts.zh:
他长叹一声。

"不太可能，\"他说着，双肘撑在桌上，两手抱住了头，\"不过你倒是说说，我凭什么要跟...你——扯上关系。"

texts.en:
"No," he says, and sighs. "You can't."

"Look at what a mess you've already made of yourself! I mean- just-"

With a consternated expression, he moves his hands, but seems unable to express how to describe the depth of your blundering.

Then he sighs, deeply, then puts his elbows on his desk and his head in his hands. "Fine. Tell me why you think I should have anything to do with... you."
texts.zh:
"不行，\"他说，叹了口气，\"你办不到。"

"看看你把自己搞成了什么烂摊子！我是说——你就——"

他一脸苦恼地比划着双手，却似乎找不到话来形容你闯的祸有多深。

然后他长叹一声，把双肘撑在桌上，两手抱住了头。"算了。你倒是说说，我凭什么要跟...你——扯上关系。"

texts.en:
"I told you I didn't want to get involved," he says. "Remember when you came to me waving around some top-level secret files you stole from the... who was it - oh, right, the leader of the Sindrian Diktat's secret police with a reputation for torture and assassination? Remember that?"

He looks away, shaking his head.

"I make it a policy never to get involved with someone named after an animal. Never ends well."
texts.zh:
"我跟你说过，我不想掺和进来，\"他说，\"还记得你拿着几份绝密文件跑到我这儿来晃吗？你从那个...叫什么来着——哦对，辛达强权秘密警察的头子、那个以酷刑和暗杀出名的家伙——那儿偷来的。还记得吗？"

他别过脸去，摇了摇头。

"我的原则是，绝不跟名字取自动物的人打交道。从来没好下场。"

options.en: I need your help. You could profit from this.
options.zh: 我需要你的帮助。这事你能赚一笔。

options.en: Help me Arroyo. You're my only hope.
options.zh: 帮帮我，Arroyo。你是我唯一的希望了。

options.en: I suppose I can just figure this out on my own.
options.zh: 那我还是自己想办法吧。

texts.en:
The comms snap into focus.

"Captain $PlayerLastName." He makes a thin smile. "I've seen a holo-cast that's been very unkind to your public image."

"Don't worry," he says, looking magnanimous. "I don't believe a word of it."
texts.zh:
通讯画面一下子清晰起来。

"$PlayerLastName 舰长。\"他挤出一个薄薄的笑。\"我看了一档全息节目，对你的公众形象相当不客气。"

"别担心，\"他说，一副宽宏大量的样子。\"我一个字都不信。"

options.en: I intend to ensure Hector becomes Supreme Executor. All other considerations are secondary.
options.zh: 我要确保 Hector 成为最高元首。其他一切都在其次。

options.en: I want to remove Macario's corrupting influence from the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我要把 Macario 的腐蚀性影响从辛达强权里清出去。

options.en: I'm more worried about taking out Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 我更在意的是除掉 Dolos Macario。

options.en: I'm more worried about what Macario is doing to the Sector.
options.zh: 我更在意的是 Macario 正在对星域做的事。

options.en: Honestly, I'm trying to avoid getting entangled in any of this. Can you help?
options.zh: 说实话，我只是想避开这摊事，不被卷进去。你能帮忙吗？

options.en: Consider me reassured.

texts.en:
"Do not be so quick to discard your self-interest, captain," he says, smile fixed. "I know the 'transcendent philosophy' makes much of self-sacrifice, but in my reading Philip Andrada always considered it a quality best found in... others."

"I cannot help but recognize the genius of Philip Andrada."
texts.zh:
"别急着把自己的利益丢到一边，舰长，\"他说，笑容不变。\"我知道那套'超凡哲学'很看重自我牺牲，但据我解读，Philip Andrada 一向认为这种品质最好出现在...别人身上。"

"我不得不承认 Philip Andrada 的天才。"

options.en: We were speaking of Hector Andrada.
options.zh: 我们刚才在说 Hector Andrada。

texts.en:
Inesis raises an eyebrow. "It has been said that Hector is a bit young. Sheltered. Inexperienced. Reckless. Unstable. Sociopathic."

"Reports are reports. It is possible they underestimate his potential." He shrugs, smiling pleasantly. "I can only imagine what would be said of you."

"In any event, tacit support of the legitimate successor aligns with Tri-Tachyon policy, so it appears we are in alignment."
texts.zh:
Inesis 挑起一边眉毛。"据说 Hector 有点年轻。养在温室里。缺乏经验。鲁莽。不稳定。反社会。"

"报告终归是报告。也许他们低估了他的潜力。\"他耸耸肩，笑得和善。\"我倒很想知道，别人会怎么议论你。"

"无论如何，默许支持合法继承人都符合速子科技的方针，看来我们是一致的。"

options.en: Good. I'm glad to hear we are agreed.
options.zh: 很好。很高兴我们达成了一致。

options.en: Let's discuss some other possibilities first...
options.zh: 我们先谈谈别的可能性...

texts.en:
"With your cooperation, I can make certain extraordinary arrangements. Sharing intel, weapons technology... I hope your good opinion of Hector proves correct."

"For your sake," he continues brightly, "I hope his reputation - yes, already - is much exaggerated. At the risk of being presumptuous, I would suggest bringing news of our arrangement to Hector yourself."

"Making a good impression is paramount, in business and... other fields of human endeavor."
texts.zh:
"有你的配合，我可以做出一些非同寻常的安排。共享情报、武器技术...我希望你对 Hector 的好评最终被证实。"

"为了你自己好，\"他语气轻快地继续说，\"我希望他的名声——对，现在就已经有了——被大大夸大了。恕我冒昧，我建议由你亲自把这个安排的消息带给 Hector。"

"留下好印象至关重要，在生意场上如此...在人类努力的其他领域也是如此。"

texts.en:
"I'll be making certain arrangements. Sharing intel, weapons technology... I hope your opinion of Hector proves correct."

"For your sake," he continues brightly, "I hope his reputation - yes, already - is much exaggerated. At the risk of being presumptuous, I would suggest bringing news of our arrangement to Hector yourself."

"Making a good impression is paramount, in business and... other fields of human endeavor."
texts.zh:
"我会做一番安排。共享情报、武器技术...我希望你对 Hector 的看法是对的。"

"为你着想，\"他语气明亮地接着说，\"我希望他的名声——是的，已经有的名声——是被大大夸大了。恕我冒昧，我建议由你亲自把我们的安排告诉 Hector。"

"留下好印象是最要紧的，做生意如此...人类其他的行当也一样。"

texts.en:
"There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble fleet with a clever commander," he nods generously toward you, "could sneak in, hack the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network. It all runs on our software, there's nothing to worry about."

He winks. Your TriPad pings.
texts.zh:
"Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支机动灵活的舰队，配上一位聪明的指挥官，\"他大方地朝你点了点头，\"可以悄悄潜入，黑进中继站，与辛达强权军方的网络直接建立通讯链路。那套系统全跑在我们的软件上，不必担心。"

他眨了眨眼。你的 TriPad 响了一声。

options.en: But how do I contact Hector if I am shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat navy?
options.zh: 可我是辛达强权海军格杀勿论的对象，怎么联系 Hector？

options.en: I shall contact Hector directly.
I shall contact Hector directly.
Thanks. I think.

texts.en: Inesis nods.
texts.zh: Inesis 点了点头。

texts.en: "I have two items to review, it'll take but a moment."
texts.zh: "有两件事要过一遍，用不了多久。"

texts.en: "I have an item to review, it'll take but a moment."
texts.zh: "有件事要过一遍，用不了多久。"

options.en: Yes?

texts.en:
"A word of warning," he says cheerfully. "In Tri-Tachyon we have... how would you put it - 'zones of interest'?"

"Official job descriptions are, of course, a statement of minimum expectation. Tri-Tachyon expects all of its employees - and contractors - to exceed expectations by showing ambition and initiative above and beyond the strict definitions of their role whenever possible. This naturally results in a certain amount of conflict, a 'jostling for position', if you like."
texts.zh:
"提醒一句，\"他语气轻快，\"在速子科技，我们有...怎么说呢——'利益区'？"

"正式的职位说明，当然只写明最低的期望。速子科技要求所有雇员——以及承包商——只要有可能，就要拿出超越职责严格界定的野心与主动性，去超过期望。这自然会造成一定程度的摩擦，或者说'抢位置'，随你怎么说。"

options.en: What are you getting at?

texts.en:
"Your participation in the Sindrian Diktat situation has drawn attention from certain fellow executives who have profited greatly from the status quo - that is, the development, sale, and production of advanced technologies in the field of weapons, starship hulls, surveillance, and public relations."

"Willing or not, you've threatened their profits, which has led to a certain resentment." He pauses a moment, "Which I do not share, of course."

The smile re-appears.

He picks up his TriPad, as if concluding the conversation - though you know full well his implants can access any information he requires.
texts.zh:
"你在辛达强权那摊事里的作为，已经引来了几位同僚执行官的注意——那些人从现状里获利极丰，所谓现状，即武器、舰体、监控与公关领域先进技术的研发、销售与生产。"

"不管你有意无意，你威胁到了他们的利润，这就招来了一些怨气。\"他顿了顿，\"当然，我没有这种怨气。"

笑容又浮了上来。

他拿起 TriPad，像是要给这场谈话收尾——尽管你很清楚，他的植入体随时能调取他需要的任何信息。

options.zh: 荒谬。我支持的是 Hector，合法继承人！

He glances at you one last time.

"You will be attacked by a very well-outfitted war fleet. Could be mercenary, could be private. You didn't hear this from me, of course."

"Profit in all your ventures, captain," he says cheerfully.
texts.zh:

"你会遭到一支装备极精良的舰队袭击。可能是雇佣兵，也可能是私人武装。当然，这话你没从我这儿听过。"

texts.en: "Alas," Inesis says with an apologetic shrug. "They view Hector's cause as a secondary objective - one contingent upon their continued profits."
texts.zh: "唉，\"Inesis 歉意地耸了耸肩，\"他们只把 Hector 的事业当作次要目标——一个得看他们利润能否延续的目标。"

texts.en:
"The first: you have a public-relations problem. Mr. Macario did some nasty work... and I'd be pleased to contract, on your behalf, a firm which specializes in reputation recovery of just this sort."

"60,000 credits and they'll undo the damage. Well, most of it, and we can only promise that outside of the Sindrian Diktat. I'll handle the details - my fee is built into the price. What do you say?"
texts.zh:
"第一件：你的公关出了问题。Macario 先生干的那些事可不干净...而我很乐意代你签下一家公司，专做这一类声誉修复。"

"60,000 星币，他们就能把损害抹平。嗯，大部分吧，而且我们只能保证在辛达强权境外有效。细节由我打理——我的抽成算在价里了。你说呢？"

options.en: I accept. (transfer credits)
I can handle my own reputation.
options.zh: 我自己的名声，我自己处理。

texts.en:
"A wise choice," he makes a small nod, as if you've taught him a subtle lesson. "I'll put in a request immediately."

"Just remember that these things take time. I think you'll be impressed by what my contact's firm can accomplish."
texts.zh:
"明智的选择，\"他微微颔首，仿佛你给他上了一堂不动声色的课，\"我这就去提申请。"

"只要记住，这种事需要时间。我想，我那位联系人手下公司的本事会让你满意的。"

options.en: Thanks, I think.

texts.en: "Of course," he makes a small nod, as if you've taught him something.
texts.zh: "当然，"他微微颔首，仿佛你刚教会了他什么。

Thanks, I think.
But how do I contact Hector if I am shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat navy?
options.zh: 可我是辛达强权海军格杀勿论的对象，怎么联系 Hector？

options.en: This will help me prove my loyalty to Hector.
options.zh: 这能帮我向 Hector 证明我的忠诚。

options.en: Advice noted.
Advice noted.

texts.en:
"There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble fleet with a clever commander," he nods generously toward you, "could sneak in, hack the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network. It all runs on our software, there's nothing to worry about."

He winks. Your TriPad pings.
texts.zh:
"Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支机动灵活的舰队，配上一位聪明的指挥官，\"他大方地朝你点了点头，\"可以悄悄潜入，黑进中继站，与辛达强权军方的网络直接建立通讯链路。那套系统全跑在我们的软件上，不必担心。"

他眨了眨眼。你的 TriPad 响了一声。

options.en: Thanks. I think.

texts.en: Inesis smiles helpfully.
texts.zh: Inesis 热心地笑了笑。

texts.en: Inesis smiles helpfully, suspiciously bereft of judgment.
texts.zh: Inesis 热心地笑了笑，那笑容干净得可疑，全无评判之意。

texts.en: He raises his eyebrows, ever optimistic.
texts.zh: 他挑起眉毛，一如既往地乐观。

texts.en: Inesis looks at you attentively, his expression inviting you to speak.
texts.zh: Inesis 专注地看着你，神情像是邀你开口。

options.en: I just want to see that Macario is destroyed.
options.zh: 我只想看到 Macario 被彻底除掉。

options.en: Simple - support Achilles' bid to become Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 很简单——支持 Achilles 角逐最高元首之位。

options.en: Help me put Hector in charge - without Macario. Then he can truly reign.
options.zh: 帮我扶 Hector 上位——把 Macario 排除在外。这样他才能真正掌权。

options.en: Support Hector's claim. He's an Andrada - he will handle Macario.
options.zh: 支持 Hector 的继承权。他是 Andrada 家的人——Macario 由他来对付。

options.en: Help me destroy the Sindrian Diktat by supporting the rebel United Front.
options.zh: 帮我摧毁辛达强权——支持叛军的联合阵线。

options.en: I've changed my mind. I'm just going to wait and see what happens.
options.zh: 我改主意了。我打算先等着，看事情怎么发展。

options.en: It looks like we can't come to an agreement.

texts.en:
"Interesting," he says, half-smile undisturbed.

"I admit that I share something of your sentiment. While his ministry is an excellent customer of Tri-Tachyon data products, our strategic predictors estimate that his leadership produces a negative effect on consumer confidence - even outside of the Askonian market volume!"

Inesis shakes his head with mild disappointment.
texts.zh:
"有意思，"他说，半笑不减。

"我承认，我与你有几分同感。他的部门是速子科技数据产品的优质客户，但我们的战略预测器估计，他的领导对消费者信心有负面影响——甚至在 Askonia 市场容量之外也是如此！"

Inesis 带着几分失望摇了摇头。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Certain divisions of Tri-Tachyon are enthusiastic about marketizing the iterative improvements derived from Macario's... applications. But I think you and I share alignment on this matter."

He smiles for you.

"If we proceed, it would be prudent to form a parallel initiative, a low-visibility shell operation so I could arrange certain matters personally. I'd require a pool of working capital separated from the usual accounts, of course..."
texts.zh:
"速子科技的某些部门热衷于把 Macario 那些...应用所带来的迭代改进推向市场。但我想，在这件事上你我立场一致。"

他朝你笑了一下。

"若要推进，稳妥的做法是另立一项并行计划，以低可见度的空壳形式运作，这样我就能亲自安排某些事务。当然，我需要一笔与常规账户分开的周转资金..."

options.en: You're asking for a bribe to covertly remove Macario?
options.zh: 你是在索贿，好暗中除掉 Macario？

options.en: Sounds complex. Maybe there's another approach...
options.zh: 听着太复杂了。也许还有别的路子...

texts.en:
"That word has certain moralistic implications inapplicable to an arrangement between two free agents," he says cheerfully.

"But whatever word you use, 100,000 credits would let me launch an 'independent initiative' nearly immediately."

He smiles.
texts.zh:
"那个词带有某种道德说教意味，并不适用于两个独立行为方之间的安排，"他愉快地说。

"不过随你怎么称呼，100,000 星币就能让我几乎立刻启动一项'独立计划'。"

他笑了。

options.en: Transfer the credits
That's a bit much. Maybe there's another approach...
options.zh: 这价码有点高。也许还有别的路子...

texts.en:
Inesis blinks in perfect sync with the confirmation of your credits transfer.

"I'll start making arrangements... partner."

He smiles, again.
texts.zh:
星币划转确认的那一刻，Inesis 正好眨了一下眼。

"我这就开始安排...合伙人。"

他又笑了。

options.en: Good. What's the plan?

texts.en:
"When the conflict begins openly - projections say it will, soon - the situation will become far more dynamic. Macario will commit his resources to removing internal and external opposition."

His half-smile is unchanged.

"We can begin with is making that job more difficult for him - and more expensive, more frustrating."

He closes his eyes for a moment, then opens them. Is that an entrepreneurial gleam? It could be. Or it could be a retina-cast vision overlay aug.
texts.zh:
"等冲突公开爆发——预测说很快了——局面会变得流动得多。Macario 会把资源投去清除内外的反对者。"

他的半笑没有变化。

"我们可以先让他这活儿更难办——更费钱、更叫他窝火。"

他闭眼片刻，又睁开。那是企业家式的精光吗？也许是。也可能只是视网膜投射式的视觉叠加植入体。

texts.en:
"Macario has committed his resources to removing internal and external opposition."

His half-smile is unchanged.

"We can begin with making that job more difficult - more expensive, more frustrating. He'll be... made incompetent."

Inesis closes his eyes for a moment, then opens them. Is that an entrepreneurial gleam? It could be. Or it could be a retina-cast vision overlay aug.
texts.zh:
"Macario 已经把资源都押在了清除内外的反对者上。"

他那种半笑的神情没有变。

"我们可以先让这桩活儿变得更难——更费钱、更让人窝火。他会...被弄得无能。"

Inesis 闭了一下眼睛，又睁开。那是一丝企业家的锐光吗？也许吧。也可能只是视网膜投影的叠加植入体。

options.en: Continue
How do you propose to do that?

texts.en:
"A software attack. Through the hypercomms system."

Without lifting a finger, Inesis conjures an image in your shared comms-volume: a diagram of the Askonia system. It zooms into a highlighted entity - the comms relay.
Askonia's primary hub of interstellar communication and data transfer.

This would be a classic Tri-Tachyon tactic - it was employed to great effect in the AI Wars.

"You'll receive a software package," he says. "Don't worry, it'll be quite harmless... until you upload it into the relay."
texts.zh:
"一次软件攻击。通过超波通讯系统。"

Inesis 连手指都没抬，就在你们共享的通讯空间里变出一幅图像：Askonia 星系的示意图。画面推近，锁定一个高亮的实体——通讯中继站。
Askonia 星际通讯与数据传输的主要枢纽。

这会是典型的速子科技战术——在 AI 战争中曾大获成功。

"你会收到一个软件包，\"他说。\"别担心，它相当无害...直到你把它上传进中继站。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"While you're at it, is it possible you have any important contacts within the Sindrian Diktat who might be persuaded to oppose Macario?"

His tone is innocent on its surface. But of course Inesis knows about what Macario had you doing in Askonia, running around like a servant between various victims and enemies. But how much does he know?

"This would be the time to contact them," he says.
texts.zh:
"趁这工夫——你在辛达强权内部，有没有什么重要的人脉，也许能被说服去反对 Macario？"

他的语气表面上天真无邪。可 Inesis 当然知道 Macario 在 Askonia 让你干了些什么，像个听差一样在形形色色的受害者和敌人之间奔波。但他究竟知道多少？

"现在正是联系他们的时候，"他说。

options.en: Hyder. She hates Macario. She hates 'dishonorable' acts, but maybe she can help.
options.zh: Hyder。她恨 Macario。她痛恨'不光彩'的勾当，不过也许她能帮上忙。

options.en: Hyder is known to be... in conflict with Macario.
options.zh: 据说 Hyder 与 Macario...有冲突。

options.en: Caden. I told him Macario wanted to control him, which angered him.
options.zh: Caden。我告诉他 Macario 想控制他，这让他很恼火。

options.en: I wasn't exactly focused on 'networking' with the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我可没心思跟辛达强权'搞人脉'。

options.en: Caden. He is a fervent Andradaist.
options.zh: Caden。他是狂热的 Andrada 主义者。

options.en: Caden. He is a loyal Andradaist.
options.zh: Caden。他是忠诚的 Andrada 主义者。

options.en: I shall worry about such matters as I see fit.

texts.en:
"Good. I am familiar with Deputy Star Marshal Hyder's inflexibility."

He sounds amused.

"Nonetheless, opening a line of contact with an insider will be useful... so long as she believes her sense of honor will survive untarnished."
texts.zh:
"很好。副星际元帅 Hyder 的不知变通，我是知道的。"

他听起来颇为玩味。

"不过，与内部人士建立联系总会有用...只要她相信自己那份荣誉感不会受损。"

texts.en:
He smiles, and this time it seems like he might truly be enjoying himself. Just a little.

"I have just two more items to review with you."
texts.zh:
他笑了，这一次他似乎真的有点乐在其中。只有一点点。

"我还有两件事要与你过一遍。"

options.en: Yes?

texts.en:
"Good. "I am familiar with Guard High Deputy Executor Caden's ambition, which is sure to be... frustrated by Hector's claim - and Macario's backing."

"Opening a line of contact with an insider will be useful, provided he believes he is giving the orders."
texts.zh:
"很好。卫队高级副执政官 Caden 的野心，我是知道的，那野心注定会被...Hector 的继承主张——以及 Macario 的支持——所挫。"

"与内部人士建立联系总会有用，只要他相信自己才是下命令的人。"

texts.en: "Oh, well," he says, not in the least disappointed. "The software attack will have to be our opening move, then. We'll track his moves, find his safehouses..."
texts.zh: "哦，好吧，\"他说，一点也不失望。\"那就只能拿软件攻击当开场棋了。我们会追踪他的动作，找出他的安全屋..."

Askonia's primary hub of interstellar communication and data transfer.

This would be a classic Tri-Tachyon tactic - it was employed to great effect in the AI Wars.

"You'll receive a software package," he says. "Don't worry, it'll be quite harmless... until you upload it into the relay."
