You begin to explain that the blood of Andrada will prevail over Macario's trickery and deception. Hector is a young man and he needs the experience of an old warrior, an example to lead him; indeed, a hero of the-

Caden sulks, then, frustrated, interrupts with a shout.

"Enough! I won't be pandered to by a degenerate spacer. Loyal you may claim to be, but I shall not tolerate presumption! Not from spacer trash."

He takes a few seconds to catch his breath, glaring.
texts.zh:
你开口解释，Andrada 的血脉终将胜过 Macario 的诡计与欺瞒。Hector 还年轻，他需要一位老将的经验，需要一个可供他效法的榜样；确切地说，需要一位辛达强权的英雄——

Caden 沉着脸，随即烦躁地一声喝断，不让你说下去。

"够了！我不需要你这种堕落的太空佬来哄。你可以自称忠诚，但别太僭越！你僭越得太过了，太空渣滓。"

他花了几秒钟才喘匀气，瞪着你。

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
You explain that you see Hyder and Caden both as fighters - though she more tentative, obsessed with rules and order of logistics without truly understanding the glory of battle as described by Andrada's transcendent philosophy.

But that's why Hyder needs Horacio Caden: to serve as heroic example. This entire ploy by Macario to divide the fleets only weakens the Sindrian Diktat while enemies around a pretender.

Caden should make an ally of Hyder - subservient, of course - to use his skill, experience, and knowledge of Andrada's transcendent philosophy to overcome Hyder's innate failings.

The Diktat must come first and all must serve its cause.
texts.zh:
你解释说，在你眼里 Hyder 与 Caden 都是战士——只是她更为犹疑，执迷于规则与后勤秩序，却并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态所描述的战斗之荣光。

也正因如此，Hyder 才需要 Horacio Caden：作为英雄的榜样。Macario 分化舰队的整套把戏，只会削弱辛达强权，同时让敌人聚拢到一名僭位者周围。

Caden 应当把 Hyder 收为盟友——当然，是从属的盟友——以他的本领、经验和对 Andrada 超凡意识形态的通晓，去弥补 Hyder 天生的缺陷。

强权必须高于一切，人人都该为它的事业效力。

texts.en:
You begin to explain that you see Hyder and Caden both as fighters - though she more tentative, obsessed with rules and order of logistics without truly understanding the glory of battle as described by Andrada's transcendent philosophy.

But that's why Hyder needs Horacio Caden: to serve as heroic example. This entire ploy by Macario to divide the fleets only-

"Cease your talk!" Caden interrupts with a shout.

"You speak defeatism! A capital offense if so I deem it. And you dare compare Hyder with myself? She's fit only to run a commissary. By Andrada's immortal glory, you're testing my patience, spacer."
texts.zh:
你解释说，在你眼里 Hyder 与 Caden 都是战士——只是她更为犹疑，执迷于规则与后勤秩序，却并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态所描述的战斗之荣光。

也正因如此，Hyder 才需要 Horacio Caden：作为英雄的榜样。Macario 分化舰队的整套把戏，无非——

"住口！"Caden 一声喝断。

"你这是失败主义言论！我若认定如此，就是死罪。你还敢拿 Hyder 跟我相比？她只配去管军需库。以 Andrada 不朽的荣光起誓，太空佬，你是在试探我的耐性。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"Even spacers like yourself," he says, claiming the line of reasoning for himself.

"It must be obvious if even you can see it," he concludes proudly.
texts.zh:
"就连你这样的太空佬，"他说，把这套推论据为己有。

"连你都看得出来，那这道理必定显而易见，"他得意地下了结论。

texts.en:
You ask, does Dolos Macario embody the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada?

He is deceptive, physically cowardly, and avoids the glory of battle and contest of will, favoring trickery instead.

Worse, he appears to believe he is better than the great work laid out by Philip Andrada! By seeking to manipulate, mold, and corrupt both the polity and heir of Andradaism reified, he mocks and sullies their perfection.

Macario is the rot in the heart of the Sindrian Diktat that must be purged. And everyone, everyone, from Gilead to Kazeron to Chicomoztoc, can see that it is Horacio Caden who holds the knife.
texts.zh:
你问：Dolos Macario 身上可体现了 Philip Andrada 的超凡意识形态？

他惯于欺瞒，身体上怯懦，回避战斗的荣光与意志的较量，只会取巧。

更糟的是，他似乎自认为比 Philip Andrada 所奠定的伟业更高明！他妄图操纵、塑造并腐蚀 Andrada 主义所实体化的政体与继承人，这是在嘲弄并玷污它们的完美。

Macario 是辛达强权心脏里的腐坏，必须清除。而从 Gilead 到 Kazeron 再到 Chicomoztoc，所有人，所有人都看得出，握刀的人是 Horacio Caden。

texts.en:
You ask, does Macario embody the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada? He is deceptive, physically cowardly, and avoids the glory of battle and contest of will, instead favoring trickery and lies.

Worse, he appears to believe he is better than-

Caden interrupts you with a snort.

"Why would you attempt to lecture, of all people, ME about the Transcendent Philosophy? You are vermin before the master."

He gestures dismissively. "Cease before I order the oxygen torn from your lungs."
texts.zh:
你问：Macario 可体现了 Philip Andrada 的超凡意识形态？他惯于欺瞒，身体上怯懦，回避战斗的荣光与意志的较量，只爱取巧与说谎。

更糟的是，他似乎自认为比——

Caden 哼了一声，打断你。

"你算什么东西，偏要来给我讲超凡意识形态？在宗师面前，你不过是虫豸。"

他轻蔑地一挥手。"趁我还没下令把你肺里的氧气抽干，闭嘴。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
Caden looks off and away at a particular angle, a practiced pose to emphasize what's left of his jawline.

"And I suppose it must fall to me, as usual, the last one who has the will and the power to save the Sindrian Diktat."

He takes a deep breath, then releases it.

"So must it be."
texts.zh:
Caden 侧过脸，朝某个特定角度望去——那是练熟了的姿势，为的是显出他仅剩的那点下颌轮廓。

"那么，照例又该落到我头上——最后一个还有意志、还有力量拯救辛达强权的人。"

他深吸一口气，再缓缓吐出。

"那就只能如此了。"

texts.en:
"Yes." He looks up, eyes bloodshot.

"Yes, there is much to be done. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh:
"是。"他抬起头，双眼布满血丝。

"是，还有很多事要做。荣耀归于辛达强权。"

options.en: Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!

texts.en:
"To the death," he mutters, hair lank.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"至死方休，"他低声说，头发黏成一绺绺。

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
He scoffs, expression more cruel than pitying.

"A spacer's oath. What's that worth? More than the blood of a clone?"
texts.zh:
他嗤了一声，那神情与其说是怜悯，不如说是残忍。

"一个太空佬的誓言。值几个钱？比一个克隆体的血还值钱？"

texts.en:
"You speak far too familiarly of the Supreme Executor's mind, spacer," Caden says, expression is pitiless.

"None knew him as did I. Certainly some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos knows nothing, nothing at all."
texts.zh:
"你对最高元首的心思说得也太随便了，太空佬，"Caden 说，神情毫无怜悯。

"没有人像我那样了解他。某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子，当然什么都不知道，什么都不知道。"

texts.en:
He gives you a cold look at that. But it is not dismissive.

"I was to be Supreme Executor," he growls. "Not some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos."
texts.zh:
听到这话，他冷冷瞥了你一眼。但那目光并非不屑。

"本该由我来当最高元首，\"他低吼道，\"而不是某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子。"

texts.en: "Yes, yes," he waves a hand impatiently. "Of course you did and do. An admirable declaration... for a spacer."
texts.zh: "是，是，\"他不耐烦地摆摆手。\"你当然效忠过，现在也还效忠着。一番值得钦佩的宣言...对一个太空佬来说。"

texts.en: "Of course. This loyalty is unexpected, but admirable... from a spacer." Caden looks pleased with himself, puffing up his chest, setting medals jangling.
texts.zh: "当然。这份忠诚出人意料，不过...对一个太空佬来说，值得钦佩。"Caden 看上去颇为自得，挺起胸膛，勋章叮当作响。

texts.en:
"Tri-Tachyon?" He scoffs. "Fools! Decadent fools, cowards who invent robots to play war. What do robots know of glory?"

He looks far and away, becoming somehow unsatisfied with this line of thought.

Caden turns back to you.

"This is an unexpected loyalty, but admirable... for a spacer. War is not won on an empty stomach eh?" He pats his stomach, setting medals jangling.
texts.zh:
"速子科技？\"他不屑地哼了一声。\"蠢货！堕落的蠢货，一群造机器人来打仗的懦夫。机器人懂什么荣耀？"

他望向远方，不知怎的，越想越不痛快。

Caden 转回来看你。

"这份忠诚出人意料，不过...对一个太空佬来说，值得钦佩。空着肚子可打不赢仗，对吧？"他拍拍自己的肚子，勋章叮当作响。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a 'loyal' follower of the Supreme Executor's vision."

He smirks at his own cleverness.

"Terrible what Macario's saying you've done. I do suggest you avoid meeting any of our other fleets; there's a kill-on-sight order, you know. It was Macario's idea and he has no authority over me, so I've chosen to treat you with... patience."
texts.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"啊，舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"看到有人'忠心'追随最高元首的愿景，真叫人热血沸腾。"

他为自己这份机灵得意地笑了。

"Macario 到处说你干了些什么，那些话真难听。我确实建议你避开我们其余的舰队；有一道见即格杀的命令，你知道的。那是 Macario 的主意，而他无权管我，所以我选择对你...保持耐心。"

options.en: Wait! I must speak to you about Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 等等！我必须和你谈谈 Dolos Macario。

options.en: Wait! I must speak to you about Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 等等！我必须和你谈谈 Dolos Macario。

texts.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "Dolos tells me such things, such terrible things about what he claims you've done."
texts.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"Dolos 跟我说了些事，说了些很可怕的事，都是他声称你干下的。"

texts.en: Macario's informants could be listening. It may be best to begin this conversation through a private channel via the Sindria Relay.
texts.zh: Macario 的线人也许正在监听。这次谈话，最好经由 Sindria Relay 走私人频道开始。

texts.en:
The comms stall on the crest of the Persean League navy.

After several minutes, you pass the link to your comms officer to watch.
texts.zh:
通讯画面停在英仙座联盟海军的徽记上。

几分钟后，你把这条线路交给通讯官盯着。

options.en: Wait

texts.en:
You review a few reports from your senior officers, supply and fuel levels. A bizarre suggestion from a junior officer to switch to a four shift rotation...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," you hear your comms officer. "I have Achilles... Achilles Andrada for you."
texts.zh:
你翻了几份高级军官的报告：补给与燃料存量。一名下级军官提出了改用四班轮换制的古怪建议...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"你听见通讯官的声音，\"Achilles... Achilles Andrada 要找你。"

options.en: Put him through.

texts.en: He appears before you, posture rigid, uniform perfectly ordered.
texts.zh: 他出现在你面前，身姿僵直，制服一丝不苟。

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我的时间很紧。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "I do not welcome your conversation, so make it quick."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我不欢迎这场谈话，所以有话快说。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "You are sworn to my lost brother and we shall soon do battle. What have you to say?"
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"你已向我那迷失的兄弟宣誓效忠，我们很快就要交战。你还有什么话说？"

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says stoically. "Your presence at the announcement of my Supreme Executorship was not unnoticed."

He lowers his head slightly, a slow nod. An acknowledgement that you acted as honorably as the situation allowed, even if you are no friend, much less an ally.
texts.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 淡淡地说，\"你出席我获任最高元首的宣告仪式，我不是没看见。"

他微微低头，缓缓一点。那是承认：在局势允许的范围内，你已尽可能做得体面，尽管你不是朋友，更不是盟友。

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我的时间很紧。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "I do not welcome your conversation, so make it quick."
texts.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我不欢迎这场谈话，所以有话快说。"

options.en: The Persean League has made you weak. Hector is going to crush you.
options.zh: 英仙座联盟把你养软了。Hector 会碾碎你。

options.en: The blood of Andrada runs thin in you. Perhaps your cloning was botched?
options.zh: 你身上 Andrada 的血太稀了。也许当初克隆你的时候出了岔子？

options.en: I've come to pledge my support for your cause. Because Finlay Siyavong told me to.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。因为 Finlay Siyavong 让我来。

options.en: I've come to pledge my support. Because it's what the Persean League wants.
options.zh: 我来表示支持。因为这是英仙座联盟想要的。

options.en: Fortuna Kato is paying me to pledge you my support. So here I am.
options.zh: Fortuna Kato 出钱让我向你效忠。所以我来了。

options.en: I've come to pledge my support for your cause. Because Fortuna Kato asked.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。因为 Fortuna Kato 开口了。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have decided to pledge my support to your cause.
options.zh: 我已决定对你的事业表示支持。

options.en: I have come to pledge my support to your cause. (lie)
options.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。 (说谎)

options.en: I agreed to pledge to you, but I cannot truly support your cause.
options.zh: 我答应过向你效忠，但我无法真正支持你的事业。

options.en: I agreed to pledge to you, but I cannot truly support your cause.
options.zh: 我答应过向你效忠，但我无法真正支持你的事业。

options.en: The Prime Demarchon, Reynard Hannan, is conspiring against you.
options.zh: 大统领 Reynard Hannan 正在密谋对付你。

options.en: I've secured support for your cause from a Tri-Tach agent on Achaman Station.
options.zh: 我在 Achaman 站上为你的事业争取到了一名速子科技特工的支持。

options.en: I've secured a line of support for you from a wealthy Tri-Tachyon executive.
options.zh: 我为你在速子科技一位富有的高管那里打通了一条支持渠道。

options.en: Took you long enough to answer your comms.
I've come to ask you to make a compromise with the Volturnian Self Defense Covenant.
options.zh: 我来是想请你与 Volturnian 自卫盟约达成妥协。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

options.en: Cut the comms

texts.en:
"I think not," Achilles says, a distinct chill entering his voice. "On both counts."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"This conversation serves no purpose. Consider it terminated."
texts.zh:
"我看未必，\"Achilles 说，声音里明显添了几分寒意，\"两条都不成立。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"这场谈话毫无意义。就当它已经结束了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: The link terminates rather abruptly.
texts.zh: 通讯链接断得相当突兀。

texts.en:
"That's not how it works, captain," he says.

"Perhaps you've been reading too much into the more esoteric sections of my father's 'transcendent philosophy'. He trained as an admiral, not a cloning technician; to be great at one field does not give mastery of all others."

"He forgot that, in time."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"I shall not."
texts.zh:
"事情不是这么运作的，舰长，"他说。

"也许你把我父亲那套【超凡意识形态】里过于玄虚的章节读得太多了。他受的是海军上将的训练，不是克隆技师；精通一行，并不等于通晓其余各行。"

"到后来，他把这一点忘了。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"我不会忘。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Agent Siyavong." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Siyavong 特工。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

texts.en:
"The work of Agent Siyavong, no doubt." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. But your support is welcome, whatever the means by which it was obtained; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"这无疑是 Siyavong 特工的手笔。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不过，不论你用什么手段换来的，你的支持我都欢迎；我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna. Of course." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, whatever its motive, and I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不论你出于什么动机，你的支持我都欢迎，我也并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna. Of course."

Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, and I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"

Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，我不是不知感恩的人。"

texts.en:
Achilles almost smiles, then acknowledges your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 几乎露出笑意，随后以一个点头而非鞠躬，算是领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
Achilles watches you carefully, acknowledging your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
Achilles 仔细打量着你，以一个点头而非鞠躬，领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

options.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

options.en: No, actually I am working with Horus Yaribay.
options.zh: 不，其实我是在和 Horus Yaribay 合作。

texts.en: "I respect your candor, if not your choice of master," he says.
texts.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，虽然不敬重你选的主子，"他说。

texts.en: "A public demonstration of support, even if it is given no true substance, is nonetheless useful."
texts.zh: "公开表态支持，哪怕没有半点实质内容，也依然有用。"

texts.en: "Then I may say with confidence that we share that much," he says, though his voice is not warm.
texts.zh: "那么我可以有把握地说，至少在这一点上我们是一致的，"他说，只是语气并不热络。

texts.en:
Achilles is taken aback.

"Unexpected. I always considered Horus Yaribay to be a tr-" He catches himself.

"An uncertain leader. With unconventional beliefs, given his position."
texts.zh:
Achilles 一怔。

"出乎意料。我一直以为 Horus Yaribay 是个叛——"他及时收住了。

"一个靠不住的领袖。以他的位置而言，信念未免太不合常规。"

options.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

options.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

texts.en:
"This was anticipated," he says, then gives you an inquisitive look.

"But why are you here, now, telling me this?"
texts.zh:
"这在我预料之中，"他说，随后探询地看了你一眼。

"可你为什么现在跑来，把这件事告诉我？"

options.en: To warn you. I want you to win despite Reynard.
options.zh: 来提醒你。我希望你赢，哪怕 Reynard 插手也一样。

options.en: Because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
Because it amuses me.
Because I don't like being manipulated.
options.zh: 因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

texts.en: "Good," he says like your position is both obvious and unquestionably correct.
texts.zh: "很好，"他说，那口气仿佛你的立场既显而易见，又无可置疑地正确。

texts.en:
He nods, as if this was expected.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition." Achilles almost smiles. "Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。\"Achilles 几乎笑了。\"你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

texts.en: "I respect your candor," he says. "And I must ask the question: do I have your support?"
texts.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，\"他说。\"而且我必须问一句：我是否得到了你的支持？"

options.en: Yes.
No.

texts.en:
"Too bad," he says. "As we have nothing more to discuss, I will consider the conversation concluded."

Without another word he reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"太遗憾了，\"他说。\"既然我们再没有什么可谈的，我就此认为谈话结束。"

他一言不发，伸手按下了通讯切断键。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"It is strange, $playerName, to taunt me to my face after so much effort. It is a waste. And for what?"

He, for one, sounds unamused. His expression clears and is replaced by something stoic, hardened over many cycles.

"You are no use to me. Do not interfere."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"$playerName，费了这么多功夫之后当面嘲弄我，真是奇怪。这是浪费。究竟图什么？"

至少他听起来毫无笑意。他脸上的神情一扫而空，换成了某种坚忍的东西——历经许多星历年磨出来的硬。

"你对我没有用处。别来碍事。"

通讯中断。

"An understandable position," he says calmly. "Your choice must be your own."

"I must ask the question, $titlePL: do I have your support?"

"可以理解，\"他平静地说。\"你的选择必须由你自己作。"

"我必须问一句，$titlePL：我是否得到了你的支持？"

options.en: Yes.
No.

texts.en: "Yes, we've had unusually sophisticated materiel coming in. Good Tri-Tachyon tech. Unlocked, it seems, by an insider. The kind of kit that usually comes from lucky convoy-raiding."
texts.zh: "是的，最近进来的物资精密得反常。上好的速子科技货。看来是有内鬼解锁的。这种装备，通常只有运气极好地劫下一支运输队才弄得到。"

texts.en:
"It is useful to diversify sources of material support. I expect you appreciate the implications, captain."

He nods toward you. "I do."
texts.zh:
"物资来源多样化，总是有用的。我想你明白这意味着什么，舰长。"

他朝你点了点头。"我明白。"

texts.en:
He nods, satisfied and even amused.

"It is welcome," he says. "I admit, my staff - yes, I have a staff now - was a little surprised when your partner first made contact."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，颇为满意，甚至有些觉得好笑。

"这很受欢迎，\"他说。\"我承认，我的幕僚——没错，我现在也有幕僚了——在你那位伙伴初次接触时，还有点吃惊。"

texts.en:
"Of course." He doesn't quite smile.

"My logistics team noted that the black market prices were unusually generous. My new shadowy 'benefactor' might make enemies of the usual con-artists if they aren't careful."
texts.zh:
"当然。"他算不上笑了。

"我的后勤组注意到，黑市上的价格优惠得反常。我那位新来的、神出鬼没的'恩主'，要是不小心，恐怕会把那些惯常坑蒙拐骗的家伙都得罪光。"

texts.en:
He blinks, expressionless.

Saying nothing for several moments more. As if to drive the point home that he does not owe you an explanation or even a reaction.

"Captain," he says finally. "You did not come here to whine, I hope."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，面无表情。

又是好一会儿一言不发。仿佛要把这一点钉实：他不欠你任何解释，甚至连一个反应都不欠。

"舰长，\"他终于开口。\"我希望你不是来这儿诉苦的。"

texts.en:
"Unthinkable," he snaps.

"Those Pather terrorists have been carrying out a campaign of sabotage and assassination to directly undermine my cause. And for what? One would hope that they recognize that I am not my father - or my brother - and am not to fault for the excesses of either."

Achilles takes a deep breath. "I've already shown considerable restraint, captain. Considerable."

His tone makes his feelings about further discussion of the topic quite clear.
texts.zh:
"想都别想，"他厉声道。

"那些左径恐怖分子一直在搞破坏、搞暗杀，就是要直接毁掉我的事业。可这又是图什么？我倒希望他们能明白：我不是我父亲——也不是我兄长——他们两人做过的那些过头事，怪不到我头上。"

Achilles 深吸了一口气。"我已经克制得够多了，舰长。相当多。"

他的语气已经把他的态度说得很清楚：这个话题不必再谈。

texts.en: The comms stall for several minutes on the crest of the Persean League.
texts.zh: 通讯画面在英仙座联盟的徽记上停滞了好几分钟。

"Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says stoically. "Your presence at the announcement of my Supreme Executorship was not unnoticed."

He lowers his head slightly, a slow nod. An acknowledgement that you acted as honorably as the situation allowed, even if you are no friend, much less an ally.

texts.en:
"Fine words cost little," he says with an uncommon hint of humor in his voice. "And do little to repay the sacrifice and expenses of my supporters."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
texts.zh:
"漂亮话不值几个钱，\"他说，语气里带着少见的几分幽默，\"也还不清我支持者们的牺牲与花销。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

texts.en:
"Fine words cost little," he says. "And they do little to repay the sacrifice - and expenses - of my supporters. We have great debts to pay due to the devastation, but it is a poor leader who does not see to his followers."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
texts.zh:
"漂亮话不值几个钱，\"他说，\"也还不清我支持者们的牺牲——还有花销。这场浩劫让我们欠下巨额债务，可一个不照应追随者的领袖，算不上好领袖。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

texts.en:
"It was hard fought," he says. "Askonia... will have debts to pay for a long, long time. But it is a poor leader who does not pay the expenses incurred by his followers while supporting his cause."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
texts.zh:
"这一仗打得很苦，\"他说，\"Askonia...要还很久很久的债。可追随者为了支持我的事业而欠下的开销，一个不替他们付账的领袖，算不上好领袖。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

texts.en:
"And I will not use fine words to hide the fact that I cannot reward you with credits."

Achilles takes a breath. He clearly does not enjoy this.

"My Sindrian Diktat is reduced, and deeply in debt. Recovery from the devastation of war is..."

He trails off, looking distant. And very tired.
texts.zh:
"我也不会用漂亮话来掩饰：我没法用星币酬谢你。"

Achilles 吸了口气。他显然并不享受这番话。

"我的辛达强权被削弱了，还背上了一身深债。从战争浩劫中恢复，是..."

他的话音低了下去，目光望向远处。他看上去疲惫至极。

texts.en:
"Were that it was so simple. If I was a Persean League Fleet lieutenant, winning would have been enough- job done, now get some R&R."

Achilles looks wistful for just a moment.

"But Askonia calls. I must transform a win into a victory; no small task, even for the 'blood of Andrada'."

By his smirk, you are led to understand that he is making a joke.

"Now I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
texts.zh:
"要是事情真有那么简单就好了。我要是英仙座联盟舰队的一名上尉，打赢就够了——事情完了，回去休整。"

Achilles 有一瞬间神情怅然。

"可 Askonia 在召唤。我得把一场胜仗变成一场胜利；就算对'Andrada 的血脉'来说，这也不是小事。"

看他那副得意的笑，你明白他是在开玩笑。

"现在我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

texts.en:
He frowns, looking down for a moment. Then back to you.

"I was never given favor for my secret name. Reynard Hannan saw to that. And I will not slacken now like a Gens-heir because of my name."

Achilles wears a hard expression, then continues.

"It is no small thing to be the son of Philip Andrada, but my potential is what I made of it. As for me, as for Askonia."

He takes a deep breath.

"I have much to do, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉，低头看了片刻，然后重新看向你。

"我这个隐秘的姓氏，从来没给我带来过什么优待。Reynard Hannan 把这条路堵死了。我也绝不会因为一个姓氏，就像个氏族继承人那样松懈下来。"

Achilles 面色严峻，接着说道。

"做 Philip Andrada 的儿子不是小事，可我这份潜力，是我自己挣出来的。于我如此，于 Askonia 亦如此。"

他深吸了一口气。

"我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"

options.en: Cut the comms
Glory to the Sindrian Diktat.
I understand. I supported you for the cause, not the credits.
options.zh: 我明白。我支持你，是为了这番事业，不是为了星币。

options.en: You managed to escape from under Fortuna Kato's thumb, didn't you?
options.zh: 你总算从 Fortuna Kato 的掌心里挣脱出来了，不是吗？

options.en: That's more than a little disappointing.
I understand. I supported you for the cause, not the credits.
options.zh: 我明白。我支持你，是为了这番事业，不是为了星币。

options.en: It sounds like Fortuna Kato's patronage comes at a steep price.
options.zh: 听起来，Fortuna Kato 的庇护代价不低。

options.en: That's more than a little disappointing.

texts.en:
He lowers his head again, in acknowledgement.

"I... haven't the words."

He takes another deep breath.

"There is much to do, $titlePL. I must go."
texts.zh:
他又低下头，以示认可。

"我...不知道该怎么开口。"

他又深吸了一口气。

"有许多事要做，$titlePL。我得走了。"

options.en: Cut the comms
Glory to the Sindrian Diktat.

texts.en:
"We shall not be speaking of that."

You'd swear his eyes glint coldly as he takes a deep, calming breath.

"I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
texts.zh:
"这件事我们不会谈。"

他深吸了一口气，让自己平静下来；你几乎敢发誓，那一瞬他的眼里闪过一丝冷光。

"我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

options.en: Cut the comms
Glory to the Sindrian Diktat.

texts.en:
His expression, however restrained, makes it clear that this is an unwelcome reply.

"I have much to do," he says conclusively.

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
他的神情再怎么克制，也分明告诉你：这不是他想听到的回答。

"我还有许多事要做。"他以这句话作结。

通讯中断。

options.en: Cut the comms

texts.en:
The comms stall on the crest of the Persean League navy.

After several minutes, you pass the link to your comms officer to watch.
texts.zh:
通讯画面停在英仙座联盟海军的徽记上。

几分钟后，你把这条线路交给通讯官盯着。

options.en: Wait

texts.en: Despite his bright tone, his look is weary.
texts.zh: 尽管语气亮堂，他的神情却很疲惫。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Sindria," he says, staring outward for a moment. "Opis and now Sindria, by the stars, how history repeats itself- darkly."
texts.zh: "Sindria，\"他说着，目光向外望了片刻，\"先是 Opis，如今是 Sindria。群星在上，历史是多么执拗地重演——一次比一次更黑暗。"

texts.en: "But it is a joyful time, captain! The so-called Sindrian Diktat is dead and gone - and the last of the Andradas with it!
texts.zh: "但这是个值得欢庆的时刻，舰长！所谓的辛达强权已经死了、没了——Andrada 家最后的血脉也随它而去！"

texts.en:
"We still have Hector to deal with, don't we. Another Phillip. A dim shadow of his father, at least."

He smirks at his wordplay.
texts.zh:
"我们还得应付 Hector，不是吗。又是一个 Phillip。至少，只是他父亲投下的一道暗影。"

他为自己这句俏皮话得意地笑了笑。

texts.en:
"We still have Achilles to deal with, don't we." He taps a finger on his cheek.

"A pale shadow of his clone-father, but an Andrada nonetheless. The work is unfinished."
texts.zh:
"我们还得应付 Achilles，不是吗。"他用一根手指轻敲着脸颊。

"比起他的克隆父亲，那只是个苍白的影子，可终究是 Andrada 家的人。这活儿还没干完。"

texts.en:
"We still have Achilles to deal with, don't we." He taps a finger on his cheek.

"I can't help but hold two contradictory hopes: that the League will hold him close so that he may not repeat the crimes of his clone-father... and that the League will stay well aloof, so that the Sindrian Diktat can be finished off once and for all through uprising and intervention!"
texts.zh:
"我们还得应付 Achilles，不是吗。"他用一根手指轻敲着脸颊。

"我忍不住同时抱着两个互相矛盾的指望：指望联盟把他牢牢攥住，好让他没法重犯他克隆父亲的罪行...也指望联盟远远撒手不管，好让辛达强权在起义与干预之下被彻底了结！"

options.en: Continue
Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"But Nortia, sweet Nortia remains free. There is still much to be done, no?"

"One day, ALL of Askonia will again be strong and free," he says, then grins with a new weariness.
texts.zh:
"可 Nortia，可爱的 Nortia 仍然自由。还有许多事要做，不是吗？"

"总有一天，Askonia 的每一寸土地都会重新变得强大而自由，"他说，随后带着一种新的倦意咧嘴笑了。

texts.en:
"But Nortia, oh Nortia, the fight goes on. At least under the Hegemony it shall be fought with words and, and... process. A slow process, compromise, but at least not warships and bombs."

"One day, all Askonia will again be strong and free," he says, then grins with renewed weariness.

The Hegemony does not easily give up polities it has 'returned' to the fold.
texts.zh:
"可 Nortia，唉，Nortia，斗争还在继续。至少归入霸主之后，这场斗争要用言辞、用...程序来打。缓慢的程序，妥协，但至少不是战舰和炸弹。"

"总有一天，整个 Askonia 会重新变得强大而自由，"他说，随后带着新的倦意咧嘴笑了。

霸主不会轻易放手它已经'收归'治下的政权。

texts.en:
"But Nortia, oh Nortia, the fight goes on. One day, all Askonia will again be strong and free."

He grins, though with a new weariness.
texts.zh:
"可 Nortia，唉，Nortia，斗争还在继续。总有一天，整个 Askonia 会重新变得强大而自由。"

他咧嘴笑了，只是那笑里添了一层新的倦意。

options.en: I'd like to help out the Charterists.

texts.en: "I'd like nothing more," he says.
texts.zh: "这正是我求之不得的，"他说。

texts.en: "The fuel you provided is already supporting increased covert fleet operations. Smuggling and... well, it wouldn't be covert if I told you, would it?" He laughs at himself.
texts.zh: "你提供的燃料已经在支撑更多秘密舰队行动。走私，还有...嗯，要是我告诉你了，那还叫秘密吗？"他自嘲地笑了。

texts.en: "The credits you've given have already been put to work - I've seen to it personally."
texts.zh: "你给的星币已经派上了用场——是我亲自盯的。"

texts.en: "Your contribution of supplies has already been distributed to our gathering of marines and warships among several independent polities. Thanks to you, they'll be well-equipped for the uprising."
texts.zh: "你捐赠的补给已经分发给我们散布在几个独立政权中的陆战队与战舰。多亏了你，起义时他们会装备齐整。"

texts.en:
"It's quite a list," he picks up his TriPad, but does not consult it. Perhaps just holding it helps him remember.

"We need fuel for covert fleet operations. And credits would do much to support our recruitment, fundraising, and expenses. Supplies, of course. We could train our fighters and operatives while building stockpiles of equipment for the uprising."

"The Charterists can operate openly in most of the Persean Sector so there will be no problems storing and shipping any contributions you choose to make."
texts.zh:
"这张单子可不短。"他拿起 TriPad，却没有去看。也许只是握着它就能帮他记住。

"我们需要燃料来维持秘密舰队行动。星币则大有用处，可以支撑招募、筹款和各项开支。当然还有补给。我们可以一边训练战士与特工，一边为起义囤积装备。"

"宪章派在英仙座星域大部分地方都能公开活动，所以你无论捐什么，储存和运输都不会有问题。"

options.en: Give 100,000 credits
Give 250 units of supplies
Give 300 units of fuel
Maybe another time.
Maybe not just now.

texts.en:
"Fantastic," he says, eyes wide at his TriPad. "You have my thanks, now and forever, captain."

"I'll turn each credit you give me into three - that's the multiplicative power of recruitment and fundraising! And then to say nothing of bribing the right officials..."

He smiles, then winks.

"But I should actually say nothing about that. Let me simply thank you once more."
texts.zh:
"太好了，\"他盯着 TriPad，眼睛睁得老大，\"舰长，我的谢意从此刻直到永远。"

"你每给我一枚星币，我就能把它变成三枚——这就是招募与筹款的乘数效应！更不用说打点该打点的官员了..."

他笑了笑，眨了眨眼。

"不过这事我其实一个字都不该说。还是让我再谢你一次吧。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I cannot thank you enough," he says graciously.

"On the day that we liberate Sindria, Volturn, and the rest of the Askonia system the Charterists will not forget-"

He pauses, unable to speak for a moment. He rubs his eyes, then clears his throat.

"I apologize. We will never forget what you've done for us, captain."
texts.zh:
"我实在感激不尽，"他恳切地说。

"等到我们解放 Sindria、Volturn 以及 Askonia 星系其余各地的那一天，宪章派不会忘记——"

他顿住了，一时说不出话。他揉了揉眼睛，清了清嗓子。

"抱歉。我们永远不会忘记你为我们做的一切，舰长。"

texts.en:

"On the day that we liberate Sindria, Volturn, and the rest of the Askonia system the Charterists will not forget-" He pauses, unable to speak for a moment, then clears his throat.

"I apologize. We will never forget what you've done for us, captain."

"Now I... I have a lot of work to do. Look me up on Nortia if you pass through. I'm around... sometimes." An apologetic look. "Duty keeps me afar too often."
texts.zh:
"我实在感激不尽，"他恳切地说。

"等到我们解放 Sindria、Volturn 以及 Askonia 星系其余各地的那一天，宪章派不会忘记——"他顿住了，一时说不出话，随后清了清嗓子。

"抱歉。我们永远不会忘记你为我们做的一切，舰长。"

"现在我...我还有很多事要做。你要是路过 Nortia，就来找我。我...有时候在。\"一个歉然的眼神。\"职责太常把我拉到远处去了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: He gives you a friendly pat on the shoulder, then leaves with uncharacteristic determination - a few officers scattered around the bar wave to him, but he walks by, TriPad clutched tightly.
texts.zh: 他友善地拍了拍你的肩膀，随后以一种少见的决然转身离开——散在酒吧各处的几个军官朝他挥手，他却径直走过，TriPad 攥得死紧。

options.en: Tell me about the Charterist Alliance.
So you approve of Rao's plan for Askonia?
options.zh: 那么，你认可 Rao 对 Askonia 的打算？

options.en: Do you approve of Yaribay's vision? Reconciliation of the League and Hegemony?
options.zh: 你认可 Yaribay 的构想吗？让联盟与霸主和解？

options.en: Your cause sounds just. How can I help?
options.zh: 你的事业听起来是正义的。我能帮上什么？

options.en: Look, I'm just trying to get by. I'm not interested in a lost cause.
options.zh: 听着，我只想混口饭吃。对注定失败的事业没兴趣。

options.en: I'd like to give additional support to the Charterists.
options.zh: 我想给宪章派追加一些支援。

options.en: If you need a merc, I need to know what you're paying.
options.zh: 你要是缺雇佣兵，那得先让我知道你能出多少。

options.en: Are you trying to recruit me to a terrorist organization?
options.zh: 你是在招募我加入一个恐怖组织吗？

options.en: What about the ARC, on Umbra?
options.zh: 那 Umbra 上的 ARC 呢？

options.en: What about the Luddics on Volturn?
options.zh: 那 Volturn 上的卢德信徒呢？

options.en: Does Provost Baird know about... this?
options.zh: 院长 Baird 知道...这件事吗？

options.en: Maybe another time...
I'll see you around, maybe.

texts.en:
"We are going to restore Askonia to what it was before Andrada enslaved Sindria, and conquered Volturn and the rest. We're going to make Askonia independent, free, and prosperous!"

"Of course, Opis can never be restored," he says bitterly. "Nor the lives of millions dead. But it's for them, for the memory of Opis, that we must fight!"

He remembers in the moment to maintain appearances, putting on a smile and giving a wave to some contact across the bar before returning his attention to you.

There is a darkness - a killing darkness - in his eyes quite at odds with the breezy attitude he's put on display.
texts.zh:
"我们要把 Askonia 恢复到 Andrada 奴役 Sindria、征服 Volturn 与其余各地之前的样子。我们要让 Askonia 独立、自由、繁荣！"

"当然，Opis 再也回不来了，\"他苦涩地说，\"几百万条人命也回不来了。但正是为了他们，为了 Opis 的记忆，我们必须战斗！"

他忽然想起要维持体面，挂上笑容，朝酒吧另一头某个熟人挥了挥手，才把注意力转回你身上。

他的眼里有一片暗影——杀意森然的暗影——与他摆出的那副轻松做派全然不符。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"If you contribute to our cause, your dedication would not be forgotten. I won't insult you by promising you'll be repaid in full - after all, we may all die tomorrow, who knows?" A bitter laugh. "But if - no, when we make it through, when we topple the Andrada regime and freedom reigns once more in Askonia... the ACA won't forget your help."

He produces a grim, tentative smile.

"What do you say?"
texts.zh:
"如果你为我们的事业出力，你的付出不会被忘记。我不会用'全额奉还'这种话来侮辱你——毕竟，谁知道呢，也许我们明天就都死了？\"一声苦笑。\"但如果我们——不，当我们挺过去，当我们推翻 Andrada 政权、自由重临 Askonia...ACA 不会忘记你的帮助。"

他挤出一个阴郁而试探的笑。

"你说呢？"

texts.en: "Oh captain," he says cheerfully. "You know what they say about the best-laid plans?"
texts.zh: "哦，舰长，\"他快活地说。\"你知道人们怎么评价那些最周密的计划吗？"

options.en: No. What do they say?
They usually don't work?

texts.en: "I don't quite recall," he says, rubbing his chin. "Something terribly poetic, no doubt."
texts.zh: "我记不太清了，\"他搓着下巴说。\"反正多半是句特别诗意的话。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Anyhow," he says, looking up and away. "In a lonely Sector one must see how far one can go with the help of a powerful friend, you understand? Not all who share my, ah, passion for freedom see this on quite the same level, of course, but," he smile turns colder. "They've not once turned down a shipment of arms."

He seems satisfied with that, and takes a substantial drink from his glass.

"Let us deal with the problem of victory after it's been achieved, that's what I say."
texts.zh:
"总之，\"他说着，抬眼望向远处。\"在这孤零零的星域里，人总得看看，靠着一位有权势的朋友能走多远，你明白吧？并非所有跟我一样，呃，热爱自由的人都能站在同一个高度看这事，当然，不过——\"他笑意转冷。\"他们可一次都没拒绝过我们送去的军火。"

他似乎对此很满意，端起杯子灌了一大口。

"胜利之后的问题，等胜利到手再说，我就是这个主张。"

texts.en:
"Really?" He seems taken aback.

"I wasn't actually sure how it went, so I'll have to take your word for it. Perhaps I should have chosen a less ominous turn of phrase... nonetheless, it's fitting enough."
texts.zh:
"真的？"他像是被将了一军。

"我其实也不确定原话是怎么说的，那就只好信你了。也许我该换个不那么不祥的说法...不过，倒也挺贴切。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Oh captain," he says cheerfully. "It is quite a vision, quite a dream. But do you know what they say about the best-laid plans?"
texts.zh: "哦，舰长，\"他快活地说。\"那确实是一幅了不起的图景，一个了不起的梦。可你知道人们怎么评价那些最周密的计划吗？"

They usually don't work?

texts.en:
"That's what I want to hear," he says with a laugh.

"As for help - well, you know how these sorts of things work, don't you?" He taps his TriPad. "We need supplies, fuel, and above all credits."

"这才是我爱听的话，"他笑着说了句。

"至于帮忙——你也知道这种事是怎么运转的，对吧？"他点了一下 TriPad。"我们需要补给、燃料，最要紧的是星币。"

"I'm sorry you feel that way, captain," he says. "Truly I am."

"But if you change your mind... us Charterists aren't going anywhere."

He taps his TriPad then he gives your shoulder a friendly pat and returns to the cluster of spacer captains he was speaking to previously.
texts.zh:
"很遗憾你这样想，舰长，"他说，"我是真心的。"

"但要是你改了主意...我们宪章派哪儿也不会去。"

他点了一下 TriPad，然后友善地拍了拍你的肩膀，回到刚才那几位船长聚着的圈子里。

"这张单子可不短。"他拿起 TriPad，却没有去看。也许只是握着它就能帮他记住。

"我们需要燃料来维持秘密舰队行动。星币则大有用处，可以支撑招募、筹款和各项开支。当然还有补给。我们可以一边训练战士与特工，一边为起义囤积装备。"

"宪章派在英仙座星域大部分地方都能公开活动，所以你无论捐什么，储存和运输都不会有问题。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps there's been a misunderstanding," he says smoothly. "My present interest is more in the area of fundraising - credits, fuel, supplies. For when the time comes."

"Now with that said," he says with a smile as he taps at his TriPad, "we may have a role for mercenaries when the time comes."
texts.zh:
"也许这里有点误会，"他圆滑地说，"我眼下更关心的是筹款——星币、燃料、补给。为了那一天到来的时候。"

"不过话虽如此，"他笑着说，"等到那一天，我们或许真有用得着雇佣兵的地方。"

texts.en: Your TriPad produces a soft ping.
texts.zh: 你的 TriPad 发出了一声轻柔的提示音。

texts.en:
He blinks, then laughs.

"You've been watching too much regime propaganda, my friend! We're the continuation of the legitimate government that was ousted by Andrada's genocidal invasion - he's the terrorist, not us! The ACA is, in effect, fighting for the re-establishment of the Chartery of Askonia."

He jabs two fingers at the bar with each word, "Freedom, prosperity, and independence."
texts.zh:
他愣了一下，随即笑了。

"你是政权宣传看多了，朋友！我们是被 Andrada 那场种族灭绝式入侵推翻的合法政府的延续——他才是恐怖分子，不是我们！实际上，ACA 战斗的目的，就是重建 Askonia 宪章政体。"

他每说一个词就用两根手指戳一下吧台："自由、繁荣、独立。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Now does that make us terrorists? To a ruthless dictator like Philip Andrada, I suppose it does. And if we strike terror into his black heart, all the better!"

He gives the bar a pound for emphasis, settling glasses rattling. Then gives an apologetic smile and a small salute to the bartender before turning his attention back to you.
texts.zh:
"这就算恐怖分子了？在 Philip Andrada 那样的冷酷独裁者眼里，大概算。可要是能让他那颗黑心生出恐惧，那更好！"

他重重捶了一下吧台以示强调，酒杯跟着一阵乱响。随后他歉然一笑，朝酒保草草行了个礼，再把注意力转回你身上。

texts.en:
"Ah, them." He drums his fingers on the bar.

"We've agreed to form a united front against the Andrada regime, so I can't speak too poorly of our present allies."

"But," he looks away, "They're unrealistic. Opportunistic, even, considering their role in destabilizing our polity during the Askonia Crisis - that's what created the opening for the Hegemony's invasion in the first place! And then Andrada's mutiny and conquest."

"They should have followed the Chartery's processes. Yes, the system was slow and imperfect - but look at us now!"
texts.zh:
"啊，他们啊。"他手指在吧台上敲着。

"我们已经同意结成统一战线，对抗 Andrada 政权，所以我不好把眼下的盟友说得太糟。"

"可是，\"他移开目光，\"他们不切实际。甚至可以说是在投机——想想他们在 Askonia 危机期间把我们的政体搅乱成什么样，正是那场乱子给霸主的入侵开了口子！接着就是 Andrada 的叛乱与征服。"

"他们本该遵循宪章派的程序。是的，那套制度缓慢、不完美——可看看我们现在落到了什么地步！"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"They insist they're building some starry-eyed utopia and don't care who or what they tear down to get there. Just look at how they live - as destitute pirates. That's their utopia!"

"Nonetheless," he takes a breath, "I respect their dedication. Imoinu Kato - she's got the spirit, everyone can see that. Brings much-needed attention to the cause shared by the United Front."

"But if you ask me?" He speaks quietly, "I think she's just going to get herself killed."
texts.zh:
"他们一口咬定自己在建什么痴心妄想的乌托邦，却不管为了走到那儿要拆掉谁、拆掉什么。就看看他们过的是什么日子——一群穷光蛋海盗。这就是他们的乌托邦！"

"尽管如此，\"他吸了口气，\"我敬重他们的执着。Imoinu Kato——她有那股劲头，谁都看得出来。她让联合阵线共同的事业得到了亟需的关注。"

"可要我说？"他压低声音，"她不过是把自己往死路上送。"

texts.en:
"So you've met Curate Standfast?" He smiles warmly. "She's a tough biddy, isn't she?"

"The Volturnian Self-Defense Covenant is an invaluable ally in the United Front. Their fighters are dedicated... zealous even," he puts on a distant, impressed look.

"That's my answer. Fanatical, though under-equipped. I salute their contribution to the cause."
texts.zh:
"这么说你见过助理牧师 Standfast 了？\"他笑得很暖，\"那老太太可不好对付，对吧？"

"Volturn 自卫盟约是联合阵线里不可或缺的盟友。他们的战士忠诚...甚至称得上狂热，"他露出一种遥想而钦佩的神情。

"这就是我的回答。狂热，但装备不足。我向他们为事业所做的贡献致敬。"

options.en: But?

texts.en:
He grins. "Yes, alright. You've got me."

His expression turns more serious. "I worry about what they might become. If we win - when we win - will they lay down arms? Will they allow Volturn to restore the Charter we lived under before this nightmare began?"

Iscare gives you an open look.

"Or will they establish a theocracy? Will they enforce their religion with militant zeal, like the Knights of Ludd? Or worse, like the Path? I don't think Moyra Standfast wants any of that, but it's bigger than her, isn't it."

"I don't have the answers. And that worries me."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。"好吧，算你说中了。"

他的神情严肃起来。"我担心他们会变成什么样子。如果我们赢了——不，当我们赢了——他们会放下武器吗？他们会允许 Volturn 恢复那场噩梦开始前我们生活其下的宪章吗？"

Iscare 坦然地看了你一眼。

"还是说，他们会建起一个神权政体？会像卢德骑士团那样，以好战的狂热推行他们的信仰？或者更糟，像卢德左径那样？我不认为 Moyra Standfast 想要这些，但这事的分量早已超过她一个人，不是吗。"

"我没有答案。而这让我不安。"

texts.en:
He settles his face into a neutral expression.

"The Galatia Academy is founded on a policy of strict neutrality, and I follow Baird's leadership in upholding that policy."

He winks.
texts.zh:
他把表情收成一副中立的模样。

"Galatia 学院建立在严格中立的原则之上，我追随 Baird 的领导，恪守这一原则。"

他眨了眨眼。

texts.en:
"You've got a lot to think about," he says, "I can tell. The Charterists aren't going anywhere, and we can use all the help we can get."

He gives your shoulder a friendly pat as he leaves, heading toward one of the spacer captains he was speaking with before.
texts.zh:
"你要想的事不少，"他说，"我看得出来。宪章派哪儿也不会去，而我们需要一切能得到的助力。"

他友善地拍了拍你的肩膀离开，走向刚才与他交谈的其中一位船长。

texts.zh: 你的 TriPad 发出了一声轻柔的提示音。

"Count on it."

He gives your shoulder a friendly pat as he leaves, heading toward one of the spacer captains he was speaking with before.
texts.zh:
"一定。"

他友善地拍了拍你的肩膀离开，走向刚才与他交谈的其中一位船长。

texts.en:
"These supplies are a welcome gift," he says.

"We're training fighters on Nortia and in several friendly independent polities in nearby systems - both ground combatants and the core of what will become the Navy of the Reformed Chartery of Askonia."

"Soon, my friend, they will fight for our freedom."
texts.zh:
"这批补给是份及时礼，"他说。

"我们正在 Nortia 以及邻近星系的几个友好独立政权那里训练战士——既有地面战斗人员，也有将成为改革后的 Askonia 宪章政体海军之核心的舰员。"

"很快，朋友，他们就会为我们的自由而战。"

texts.en:
"Excellent! With fuel reserves we can run additional covert fleet ops - and I can add a few additional stops to my rounds of the Core worlds drumming up support and recruits!"

"And once the uprising begins, we'll bring troops and combat ships in from where we've gathered them among a few friendly independent polities." He grins. "We seem to have friends everywhere."
texts.zh:
"太好了！有了燃料储备，我们就能多跑几趟秘密舰队行动——我也能在核心世界的巡回中多加几个站点，去鼓动支持、招募人手！"

"等起义一开始，我们就把部队和战斗舰艇从几个友好独立政权那里调来——人手舰船都攒在那儿。\"他咧嘴一笑，\"我们好像到处都有朋友。"

texts.en:
"Excellent! With these fuel reserves we can run additional covert fleet ops - and I can add a few additional stops to my rounds of the Core worlds drumming up support and recruits."

"We're bringing troops and combat ships in from a few friendly independent polities." He grins. "We seem to have friends everywhere."
texts.zh:
"太好了！有了这些燃料储备，我们就能多跑几趟秘密舰队行动——我也能在核心世界的巡回中多加几个站点，去鼓动支持、招募人手。"

"我们正从几个友好的独立政权那里调集部队和战斗舰艇。\"他咧嘴一笑，\"我们好像到处都有朋友。"

texts.en: "Of course," he says. "Caution is the word."
texts.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"谨慎为上。"

options.en: I'd like to help out the Charterists.
I'd like to contribute more to your cause.
options.zh: 我想再为你们的事业出一份力。

options.en: I spoke with Horus Yaribay. He will support you against Kato.
options.zh: 我和 Horus Yaribay 谈过了。他会支持你对付 Kato。

texts.en:
He smiles, smug and powerful.

"You did well to push him over the edge. Horus was always easily manipulated. He is more like his cousin Menes than he'd ever admit, but..."

Reynard smirks, then waves the thought away.
texts.zh:
他笑了，自得而强势。

"你把他推过了那道坎，干得不错。Horus 一向容易被人摆布。他比他自己肯承认的更像他表亲 Menes，不过..."

Reynard 扯了扯嘴角，把那点念头挥手拂开。

options.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

texts.en:
"Dolos Macario's secret files, yes."

He smiles broadly, teeth flashing perfectly.

"You can only imagine my surprise when they turned out to be of substance. Quite the conspiracy you've revealed. Or is it Macario I should thank?"

He raises his eyebrows. "You may yet be doing him service."
texts.zh:
"Dolos Macario 的秘密档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，牙齿白得发亮。

"你可以想象我有多意外——那些东西居然真有分量。你揭出来的阴谋可不小。或者，我该谢的是 Macario？"

他挑起眉毛。"说不定你这是在帮他。"

texts.en:
"The files you brought to me, yes."

He smiles broadly, teeth flashing perfectly.

"You can only imagine my surprise when they turned out to be of substance. Quite the conspiracy you've revealed. Or is it Dolos Macario I should thank?"

He raises his eyebrows. "You may yet be doing him service."
texts.zh:
"你带给我的那些档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，牙齿白得发亮。

"你可以想象我有多意外——那些东西居然真有分量。你揭出来的阴谋可不小。或者，我该谢的是 Dolos Macario？"

他挑起眉毛。"说不定你这是在帮他。"

texts.en:
"The files you brought to me, yes."

He smiles broadly, leaning back.

"Well?"
texts.zh:
"你带给我的那些档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，向后靠去。

"然后呢？"

texts.en:
"Macario's secret files, yes."

He smiles broadly, leaning back.

"Well?"
texts.zh:
"Macario 的秘密档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，向后靠去。

"然后呢？"

texts.en: "No. The topic has been discussed to my satisfaction," he says authoritatively. "Don't mention it again."
texts.zh: "不必了。这个话题已经谈得让我满意了，\"他以不容置疑的口吻说，\"别再提了。"

texts.en:
"The files you brought to Horus Yaribay before me, yes."

He leans back, smiling broadly without making any effort to look like he means it.

"Well?"
texts.zh:
"那些你先交给了 Horus Yaribay、才轮到我看到的档案，对。"

他向后一靠，咧嘴笑着，却半点没打算装出真诚。

"然后呢？"

options.en: Horus is too weak to respond. It's clear why you are Prime Demarchon.
options.zh: Horus 太软弱，根本无力回应。你为什么会是大统领，一目了然。

options.en: Uh, never mind.

texts.en:
"You're telling me things that I know, $titlePL," he says impatiently - but is his interest piqued?

"Speak plainly. Why are you here?"
texts.zh:
"你在跟我说我早就知道的事，$titlePL，"他不耐烦地说——可他的兴趣是不是被勾起来了？

"直说吧。你来做什么？"

options.en: I want to take down Macario. You're strong enough to do it.
options.zh: 我要扳倒 Macario。你有这个实力。

options.en: I seek power. If I work for you, I may achieve it.
options.zh: 我求的是权力。若为你效力，我或许能得到它。

options.en: I want to back the winning side. It's safer - and profitable.
options.zh: 我想站在赢的那一边。更安全，也有利可图。

options.en: Uh, never mind.

texts.en: "Hmm. We will speak of your... troubles," he says.
texts.zh: "嗯。你的...麻烦，我们以后再谈，"他说。

texts.en:
"But first, I ask a question of you, $titlePL," he says regally.

"It is the question of whether you are with me, with Gens Hannan, or if you are not. I would see that you given great rewards, power, and access as a client of my patronage."

"It is a choice," he says softly. "I want you to confirm it to me."

"Now."
texts.zh:
"但首先，我要问你一个问题，$titlePL，"他说，气度俨然。

"问题就是：你到底站在我这边、站在 Hannan 氏族这边，还是不。若你站过来，我会让你作为我的门客，得到丰厚的赏赐、权力与门路。"

"这是个选择，\"他轻声说，\"我要你亲口向我确认。"

"就现在。"

options.en: I am with you.
I cannot submit myself to you and your Gens.
options.zh: 我不能向你和你的氏族屈膝。

texts.en: "Good," he whispers.
texts.zh: "很好，"他低声道。

texts.en: The comms cut quite abruptly.
texts.zh: 通讯骤然中断。

texts.en: Reynard's meaning is as clear as your answer to his arrogant demand. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh: 你对他那傲慢要求的回答，已经让 Reynard 的意思再明白不过。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

texts.en:
"Now - we were speaking of the ANDRADA files."

Reynard sits up, attentive. Expectant.
texts.zh:
"好了——刚才我们说到 ANDRADA 档案。"

Reynard 坐直身子，专注，带着期待。

texts.en:
He drops whatever expression he was performing for you and turns away.

The link cuts to black.
texts.zh:
他收起了那副专门演给你看的神情，转过身去。

通讯切断，屏幕一片漆黑。

texts.en: "I'll see to Dolos," he says. "But first is a matter more important to me: Fortuna Kato."
texts.zh: "Dolos 的事我会处置，\"他说，\"但眼下有件对我更重要的事：Fortuna Kato。"

texts.en:
"Fortuna Kato's puppet, Achilles, will soon launch his claim as Philip Andrada's heir."

He looks off-link as he speaks, at some view not shared with you. It's probably grand.

"She seeks to undermine the cohesion of the Persean League and primacy of Gens Hannan. A foolish plan, and doomed, but it nonetheless requires my personal response."

He smiles to himself, a feral gleam in his eyes. "She'll see that I am not lax in my attentions. And you can help me with a part of it."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna Kato 的傀儡，Achilles，很快就要公开宣称自己是 Philip Andrada 的继承人。"

他说话时目光飘向链路之外，看着一处不与你共享的景象。那景象想必很气派。

"她想瓦解英仙座联盟的团结，动摇 Hannan 氏族的首要地位。这计划很蠢，也注定失败，可终究需要我亲自应对。"

他自顾自地笑了笑，眼里闪着野性的光。"她会看到，我盯事情从不松懈。而其中一部分，你可以帮我。"

options.en: What are you proposing?

texts.en:
"A quiet and civilized war, as is proper. I have had a quantity of materiel assembled. It shall be transferred to your name before the end of our conversation."

"I want you to take this materiel to Umbra and give Imoinu Kato everything she possibly wants for her little play-revolution."

He seems very, very pleased with himself.

"Do this, and you will be rewarded."
texts.zh:
"一场安静而文明的战争，这才合规矩。我已经备好了一批军需物资，等我们谈完，就会转到你名下。"

"我要你把这批物资送到 Umbra，交给 Imoinu Kato；她那个过家家似的革命要什么，就给她什么。"

他看上去对自己满意极了。

"办成这件事，你会得到赏赐。"
effects: #AddTextSmall "You have been given fuel and supplies in a storage bay on $entity.name" highlight

texts.en:
"I was going to ask you to take weapons and supplies to Umbra to fuel one Imoinu Kato's little revolution - imagine my surprise at the report that you had already done so!"

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

"If I was a more suspicious man, I might have concerns that you shared the anarchic delusions of Antis like the Gens Kato child. But I know you better than that, $titlePL. You appreciate what power provides."

"Keep up the good work. I want the Gens Kato child to have everything she wants."
texts.zh:
"我本打算让你带武器和补给去 Umbra，给 Imoinu Kato 那场小革命添把火——结果报告说，你已经这么干过了！你可以想见我有多意外。"

他打量着你，目光锐利得有些反常，全无平日那副漫不经心。

"我要是疑心再重些，或许会担心你跟 Kato 氏族那小丫头一样，抱着 Antis 那套无政府的妄想。可我了解你，$titlePL，不至于此。你懂得权力能给你什么。"

"继续这么干。Kato 氏族那小丫头要什么，我就要她得到什么。"

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

他朝链路外的某个人打了个响指。

options.en: You want me to... help Imoinu and the ARC?
options.zh: 你要我...去帮 Imoinu 和 ARC？

texts.en:
"Yes!"

He laughs.

"Nothing will vex Fortuna more. I want to see the flames from Kazeron!"

He closes his eyes to take in a slow, pleased breath.

"If there's anything left over, keep it. Use it or sell it, I don't care."
texts.zh:
"对！"

他大笑起来。

"没什么比这更让 Fortuna 恼火了。我要从 Kazeron 都能看见那火光！"

他闭上眼，缓缓吸了一口气，满心惬意。

"要是有剩下的，就留着。自己用还是卖掉，我不管。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"As for Macario's propaganda... yes, in fact, I have just the thing. Speak to Finlay Siyavong; he's an agent with Fleet Intelligence. A bit unimaginative," Reynard flashes a look of minor embarassment on Siyavong's behalf, "but competent nonetheless."

"He has much potential if he can get over... well, you'll see. My secretary will arrange his comms-id for you, I'm sure."

Reynard looks away, something off-link catching his eye.
texts.zh:
"至于 Macario 的那套宣传...没错，我这儿正好有个办法。去找 Finlay Siyavong，他是舰队情报部的特工。人有点缺乏想象力，\"Reynard 脸上掠过一丝替 Siyavong 感到的尴尬，\"但办事还是靠得住的。"

"只要他能克服...算了，你见了就知道。他很有潜力。我的秘书会把他的通讯编号给你，我想没问题。"

Reynard 移开目光，链路外有什么东西吸引了他。

options.en: I've spoken with Agent Siyavong before.
options.zh: 我之前和 Siyavong 特工谈过。

texts.en:
"Wonderful," he says in a way that ensures you are not mistaken about the fact that he does not care.

"Fleet Intelligence will probably ask you to pledge yourself to support Achilles Andrada," he waves a hand, growing bored.

"Do it, or don't, I care not."
texts.zh:
"太好了，"他说道，那语气确保你不会误会——他其实一点也不在乎。

"舰队情报部大概会让你表态支持 Achilles Andrada，"他摆了摆手，已经开始觉得无聊。

"做不做，随你，我不在乎。"

options.en: Don't you want to undermine Achilles, and therefore Kato?
options.zh: 你不想搞垮 Achilles，从而搞垮 Kato 吗？

texts.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself.

"Let us speak of it again after the war is announced. Now I have much to do. Probably. Good day then, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord, to a holding pattern, the crest of Gens Hannan.
texts.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声。

"等战争宣布之后，我们再谈这件事。眼下我有很多事要办。大概吧。那就这样，$titlePL，日安。"

通讯仿佛自己断了，转入了等待画面：Hannan 氏族的纹章。

texts.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself, then pauses.

"Although... yes, I think I would have you speak to Horus Yaribay."
texts.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声，随即顿住。

"不过...对，我想让你去和 Horus Yaribay 谈谈。"

What do you want me to say to Horus?

texts.en:
Reynard's secretary appears, for only a moment. "Hold please, I shall forward the link per the Prime Demarchon's request," they say, before disappearing.

The crest of Gens Hannan appears again for a moment. An upthrust, open hand. Golden rays.

You're pondering Reynard's petty revenge against Fortuna via her granddaughter Imoinu when your quartermaster pings you about an inquiry from a warehouse manager on $entity.name.

Before you can respond, the comms flash an incoming link.
texts.zh:
Reynard 的秘书只露了一瞬。"请稍候，我这就按大统领的吩咐把链路转过去，"说完便消失了。

Hannan 氏族的纹章又出现了一瞬：一只向上张开的手，金色的光芒。

你正琢磨着 Reynard 如何借 Fortuna 的孙女 Imoinu 来实施他那点小报复，军需官忽然发来提示：$entity.name 上有一位仓库管理员提出查询。

你还没来得及回应，通讯界面上闪起一条接入请求。

options.en: Accept the link

texts.en:
"Advise him, as a contact, as a friend, to work against Fortuna Kato," he says, a slow smile growing at the thought.

"He is soft and will respond to sentiment. Then let us speak of all of this again, once the war is announced, as soon it must be. I have much to do now, probably."

"Good day, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord.
texts.zh:
"以联系人的身份、以朋友的身份劝他，去跟 Fortuna Kato 作对，"他说，想到这儿，笑容缓缓绽开。

"他心软，吃感情这一套。等战争宣布之后——那不会太久了——我们再把这一切谈一遍。眼下我有很多事要办，大概吧。"

"日安，$titlePL。"

通讯仿佛自己断了。

"I have nothing more to say to you."

texts.en:
"It is presumptive to question me, $titlePL." He narrows his eyes. "But I am in a forgiving mood."

He flicks with his hand, discarding his own indignation.

"Of course I knew of Kalian. He's the product of a minor and long-standing arrangement with our 'friends' from Askonia. A little insurance for Philip, a little hostage for us."
texts.zh:
"质疑我，是越界，$titlePL。\"他眯起眼睛。\"不过我眼下心情宽厚。"

他随手一挥，连自己的不悦也一并挥开了。

"Kalian 的事我当然知道。那是我们与 Askonia 那些'朋友'之间一项不起眼却由来已久的安排。对 Philip 是一份小小的保险，对我们则是一个小小的人质。"

options.en: Wait, you're working with Macario?
options.zh: 等等，你在和 Macario 合作？

texts.en:
"Mind your tone, $titlePL," Reynard says, though casually.

"Our Diktat representative has not been entirely forthright about Macario's personal attention to the matter, nor about the scope of Philip's... ambitions. Your files," he extends a charitable hand. "Prove their misdirection."

"Not that I blame them, of course. I wouldn't trust me either."

"I suppose I have you to thank." Reynard almost rolls his eyes. "A rare concession, do enjoy it."
texts.zh:
"注意你的口气，$titlePL，"Reynard 说，语气倒还随意。

"我们那位辛达强权代表，并没有完全坦白 Macario 对这件事的亲自关注，也没有说清 Philip 那些...野心的范围。而你的档案，\"他伸出手，姿态宽宏，\"证明了他们的误导。"

"当然，我不怪他们。换了我，我也不会信我自己。"

"看来我该谢你。\"Reynard 几乎翻了个白眼。\"难得的让步，好好享用吧。"

texts.en:
"Mm. Clearly."

Reynard doesn't seem terribly concerned.
texts.zh:
"唔。看来确实如此。"

Reynard 看上去并不怎么在意。

options.en: You don't seem terribly concerned.
You have a plan, don't you.
I wish to offer my assistance with your... response.
options.zh: 我想为你的...回应出一份力。

texts.en: "Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." He grins toothily. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
texts.zh: "不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

texts.en:
He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."
texts.zh:
他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

texts.en:
He produces a concessionary smile, as if from an approving teacher to a clever student.

"Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." His grin becomes toothier. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
texts.zh:
他挤出一个带点让步意味的笑，像是老师在夸奖一个机灵的学生。

"不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他的笑容咧得更开，牙齿都露了出来。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

texts.en:
"It pleases me to hear you say this. I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."

He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening. Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner."

He produces a toothy grin.
texts.zh:
"听你这么说，我很高兴。等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。"

他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。

texts.en:
"Good," he says.

"And before you succumb to the impulse by making a gauche inquiry, this has not been done at my order. Why dirty my own hands with such frivolity when there are so many others who are more than willing?"

He leans back comfortably, quite content with the situation.
texts.zh:
"很好，"他说。

"还有——趁你还没忍不住提出那种失礼的问题：这事不是我下令做的。既然有那么多人心甘情愿代劳，我何必用自己的手去沾这种无聊的事？"

他舒坦地向后一靠，对这局面相当满意。

texts.en:
Reynard looks at you for a moment, a gleam in his eye. His smirk is not entirely unfriendly.

"Your offer is appreciated, but no. It amuses me to watch the drama unfold," he says, looking off-link somewhere. Perhaps at a gorgeous landscape.

"I've a notion that this may be worked to my advantage," he lifts a finger at you, looking smug. "But it shan't do to tell too early. Watch closely. You may learn something, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
Reynard 看了你片刻，眼里有光。他的笑不算全然不友善。

"你的提议我很领情，但不必。看着这出戏演下去，我挺开心，"他说，目光飘向通讯之外某处。也许是某片华美的风景。

"我有个想法，这件事或许能为我所用，\"他朝你竖起一根手指，一脸得色，\"不过说太早可不行。看仔细了。你或许能学到点什么，$titlePL。"

texts.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He drums his fingers on his luxurious desk.

"This 'Hector' will announce that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he's been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

"We'll deal with it in due time."
texts.zh:
你刚开口解释，Reynard 便挥手打断。

"知道，知道，报告我读过——连字缝里的也读了。Macario 篡夺了克隆计划的一环或几环，为的是弄到一个能推进他私心的手段。招数太明显了。"

他用手指在奢华的书桌上敲了敲。

"这个'Hector'会宣布：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

"到时候再收拾。"

texts.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He taps manicured fingers on his luxurious desk. They stop. His eyes turns to you.

"And how sure are you that he was in that asteroid when you blew it up?" He doesn't wait for an answer. "Not sure enough, I think."
texts.zh:
你刚开口解释，Reynard 便挥手打断。

"知道，知道，报告我读过——连字缝里的也读了。Macario 篡夺了克隆计划的一环或几环，为的是弄到一个能推进他私心的手段。招数太明显了。"

他用修整齐整的手指在奢华的书桌上轻叩几下。停住。目光转向你。

"你炸掉那颗小行星的时候，有多确定他就在里面？\"他不等你回答。\"我看，还不够确定。"

options.en: Human remains were detected...

texts.en:
He snaps his fingers, interrupting your explanation.

"The intention is that we are surprised when this 'Hector' announces that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he has been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

Pausing to giving you a patient look, he says, "I do not plan to be surprised. We'll deal with it in due time."
texts.zh:
他打了个响指，打断你的解释。

"他们的用意，就是让我们在这个'Hector'宣布时措手不及：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

他顿了顿，用一种近乎耐心的目光看着你，说："我没打算措手不及。到时候再收拾。"

texts.en:
"Mm," he says. "Yes, I'm familiar with the situation. Philip Andrada transformed into a weak-necked academician. It's the punchline of a sophomoric joke."

Reynard doesn't manage a smile, but he sits up, and anger enters his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"是，这局面我清楚。Philip Andrada 变成了一个缩着脖子的院士。这像个幼稚笑话的包袱。"

Reynard 没能挤出笑容，但他坐直了，声音里多了怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

texts.en:
"Mm," he says. "And he was killed, I know. Boo-hoo."

Reynard sits up, anger entering his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"而且他死了，我知道。真惨。"

Reynard 坐直身子，声音里透出怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"I've sent a representative to express my displeasure; many of my Gens' offspring, and of my clients besides, attend the Galatia Academy and I won't hold with assassination."

He scoffs, annoyed, then brushes the issue away. His anger, at least, is directed elsewhere.

"We'll speak no more of it."
texts.zh:
"我已派了一名代表去表达不满；我氏族里许多子弟，还有不少附庸的子弟，都在 Galatia 学院就读。我容不下暗杀这种事。"

他恼火地哼了一声，随即把这事拂开。至少，他的怒气是冲着别处去的。

"此事不必再提。"

texts.en:
Shockingly, the comms open not with some under-secretary, but upon Reynard Hannan himself.

"$TitlePL $playerLastName! You've made quite an impression in the holos, haven't you - a terrorist and child-murderer, I hear."

He chuckles luxuriously, then quite deliberately catches himself, and pauses.

"I know, I know. It's just Dolos playing his game."
texts.zh:
出乎意料，通讯接通的不是哪个副秘书，而是 Reynard Hannan 本人。

"$TitlePL $playerLastName！你在全息新闻里可真是出尽风头——恐怖分子，还杀过孩子，我听说是这样。"

他惬意地低笑几声，随即刻意收住，顿了顿。

"我知道，我知道。不过是 Dolos 在玩他那套把戏。"

texts.en:
A slow smile grows.

"It seems you understand my position. It is refreshing, from time to time, to be relieved of the need to explain myself yet again to some underling."
texts.zh:
一个笑容缓缓绽开。

"看来你明白我的处境。偶尔不必再向哪个下属解释一遍自己，倒也让人神清气爽。"

texts.en: "I'll see to Dolos," he says. "But first there is a matter more important to me. Fortuna Kato."
texts.zh: "Dolos 的事我会处置，\"他说，\"但眼下有件对我更重要的事。Fortuna Kato。"

texts.en:
"Oh?" He raises his eyebrows, carnivorous smile in place.

"Perhaps I shouldn't place my hand upon the scale... just to see how you attempt it."

"But as amusing as that might be, I cannot let this insult to my patronage go unanswered."
texts.zh:
"哦？"他挑起眉毛，脸上挂着那副食肉动物般的笑。

"也许我不该伸手去动那架天平...就看看你打算怎么动手。"

"可尽管那会很有趣，对我这份庇护的侮辱，我不能不作回应。"

texts.en:
A slow smile grows. Then he can't hold it in any longer, and he bursts out laughing, canines flashing.

It takes him some time to settle down.

"You came to me- for help?"

He suppresses another burst of laughter. "Due to your own short-sighted decisions, you are no longer a member of the Persean League, captain! You expect... help? From ME?"
texts.zh:
一个笑容缓缓绽开。接着他再也憋不住，放声大笑起来，犬齿闪着光。

他好一会儿才收住笑。

"你来找我——就为了求助？"

他压下又一阵笑。"因为你自己那些短视的决定，你已经不再是英仙座联盟的一员了，舰长！你还指望...帮忙？从我这儿？"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You've resigned yourself to irrelevance," Reynard says with icy contempt. "I have nothing more to say to you."

The comms cut.

Reynard has made his position clear. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh:
"你已经认了命，甘做一个无足轻重的人，\"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑，\"我跟你没什么好说的了。"

通讯中断。

Reynard 的立场已经很清楚了。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

texts.en:
"No doubt," he says, not quite rolling his eyes. "You need to learn to enjoy yourself from time to time, $titlePL," he says. "I do."

He lets out a breath and looks aside.

"Regardless. I cannot let this insult to my patronage go unanswered."
texts.zh:
"那是自然，\"他说，差点就要翻起白眼。\"$titlePL，你得学会偶尔让自己快活一点，\"他说，\"我就很会。"

他吐出一口气，目光移向别处。

"总之。对我这份庇护的侮辱，我不能不作回应。"

options.en: I wish to discuss the situation in Askonia.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 Askonia 的局势。

texts.en: "Askonia." He looks distant. "What of it?"
texts.zh: "Askonia。\"他目光飘远。\"你想说什么？"

texts.en:
"Oh, of course. I received report that you provided for the Gens Kato child's rebellion on Umbra. Good work."

He snaps his fingers at someone off-link.
texts.zh:
"哦，当然。我收到报告，说你在 Umbra 为 Kato 氏族那个孩子起事提供了支援。干得不错。"

他冲通讯链路外的什么人打了个响指。

texts.en:
"Mm? Oh, you must want your reward for helping out our Luddie friends on Volturn."

He snaps his fingers at someone off-link.

"Well done."
texts.zh:
"嗯？哦，你一定是来领赏的——为你在 Volturn 帮了我们那些卢德朋友一把。"

他冲通讯链路外的什么人打了个响指。

"干得好。"

options.en: What about Dolos Macario.
Aren't you concerned about the Luddic uprising taking power in Volturn?
options.zh: 你就不担心卢德派起事在 Volturn 夺了权吗？

options.en: You've effectively funded a piratical insurrection on Umbra...
options.zh: 你实质上资助了 Umbra 上一场海盗式的暴动...

texts.en:
"Oh yes, your sworn nemesis," he says, amused. "He has disrespected my office, my Gens, and my self."

"It is..."

Reynard drums his fingers on his desk. The muted thrum of rocket batteries unleashing their payload. "Unacceptable."

He turns his eyes to you. There's an odd gleam.

"I have an idea."
texts.zh:
"哦，是啊，你那位不共戴天的仇敌，\"他饶有兴味地说，\"他冒犯了我的职位、我的氏族，还有我本人。"

"这实在..."

Reynard 的手指在桌面上敲击，那声音闷闷的，像火箭炮组齐射时的低鸣。"不可接受。"

他把目光转向你。那眼神里有种古怪的光。

"我有个主意。"

options.en: Yes?
Uh oh.

texts.en:
"I'll ensure that you are given Macario," he says. "When this is all over. He'll be a gift."

"All you must do is complete what I have asked, so that I am in an appropriately generous mood."
texts.zh:
"我会确保 Macario 落到你手里，\"他说，\"等这一切结束之后。他会是一份礼物。"

"你要做的，只是把我交代的事办完，好让我届时心情足够慷慨。"

options.zh: 我已经和某个 K-O Jove 有了...一项安排。

texts.en:
"Achilles, yes." He closes his eyes. "I intend to enjoy watching him spend Fortuna's reserves on a failing cause. Perhaps he'll even have a happy little accident. But not too soon..."

Reynard's eyes open with a fierce gleam. "Hector requires a humbling too, you see. The boy would do well to learn to appreciate the value of a 'friendly neighbor'."
texts.zh:
"Achilles，对。\"他闭上眼睛。\"我打算好好看着他把 Fortuna 的家底耗在一桩注定失败的事业上。说不定他还会碰上点愉快的'小意外'。不过，用不着太早..."

Reynard 睁开眼，目光锐利如刃。"你看，Hector 也欠一次挫败。这小子最好学会体会'友善的邻居'有多值钱。"

texts.en: "No," he corrects you with a warning look. "It will be a gift. Do not presume otherwise."
texts.zh: "不，\"他带着警告的目光纠正你，\"那是一份礼物。别自作多情。"

texts.en: "No," he corrects you with a warning look. "It will be a gift. Do not presume otherwise."
texts.zh: "不，\"他带着警告的目光纠正你，\"那是一份礼物。别自作多情。"

texts.en:
"I need not explain myself."

He almost looks annoyed, but more than anything bored with your question.

"Particularly when giving you a gift. We will not speak of it until it is time, and then you may thank me appropriately."
texts.zh:
"我不需要向你解释自己。"

他看上去有点恼，但更多的是对你这个问题感到腻烦。

"尤其是当我要送你一份礼物的时候。时候未到，我们不必谈它；到时候，你自可以好好地谢我。"

texts.en:
"I need not explain myself." He almost looks annoyed. But more than anything, bored with your question.

"-Particularly when giving you a gift. We will not speak of it until it is time, and then you may thank me appropriately."
texts.zh:

"——尤其是在我要送你一份礼物的时候。时候未到，我们不必谈它；到时候，你自可以好好地谢我。"

texts.en:
There's a strange flash of an expression - surprise? And a hint of respect. Reynard quickly suppresses it.

"You demonstrate proper foresight, $titlePL, but you put perhaps too much trust into the resources of one ambitious young criminal. He has a part to play, but who will ensure that the final settlement of the Second Askonia Crisis will preclude any amnesty or employment for one Dolos Macario?"

He leans in. "Only my Persean League can provide such diplomatic leverage."
texts.zh:
他脸上飞快掠过一丝古怪的神情——是惊讶？还带着一点敬意。Reynard 立刻把它压了下去。

"你颇有远见，$titlePL，可你对一个野心勃勃的年轻罪犯手里的资源，信得或许太过了。他自有他的角色，但谁来保证第二次 Askonia 危机的最终解决方案会彻底堵死 Dolos Macario 获得特赦或受雇的门路？"

他凑近了些。"只有我的英仙座联盟能提供这样的外交筹码。"

options.en: I can work with that.
It's a deal.
Why not something more direct?
options.zh: 为什么不干脆直接一点？

texts.en:
"Not particularly," he says.

"They hate Gens Kato more than they hate me, and that is useful. Fortuna doesn't have the wisdom to tolerate their little 'irrationalities', nor reign in the excesses of her somewhat dull grandson... What's his name, Dandan? On Mazalot, you'll recall."

He motions a dismissal. "Those fanatics will make themselves useful, one way or another."
texts.zh:
"不怎么担心，"他说。

"他们恨 Kato 氏族胜过恨我，这就很有用。Fortuna 没那份肚量去容忍他们那点'不讲道理'，也管不住她那个有点迟钝的孙子的过火做派...他叫什么来着，Dardan？在 Mazalot，你该记得。"

他摆了摆手，像是把人打发走。"那些狂信徒总会派上用场的，以某种方式。"

texts.en:
"And I won't have been the first."

Reynard looks away, quite collected.

"Take the so-called Thulian raiders, in this very system. I could easily erase them. Quite easily." His hand motions a demonstration.

"But I do not. Why? They provide something useful to interested parties. The people of the League are reminded to be thankful for Kazeron's contributions to Fleet. Fleet is kept focused on patrols and skirmishes, away from politics. Interfactional traders are reminded of the safety their tariffs pay to provide."

"It's a beautiful tension," he says, speaking more for himself than for you. "As in Askonia, as across the Sector entire."
texts.zh:
"而且我也不会是第一个这么干的人。"

Reynard 移开目光，神色从容。

"就说这个星系里那伙所谓的 Thulian 劫掠者。我要抹掉他们，不费吹灰之力。真的，不费吹灰之力。"他的手比划了一下，权作演示。

"可我没有动手。为什么？因为他们对有心人有用。联盟的民众由此记得感激 Kazeron 对舰队的贡献。舰队则被牢牢拴在巡逻和小规模冲突上，离政治远远的。跨势力贸易商也由此记得，他们交的那些关税买来的是安全。"

"这是一种美妙的张力，\"他说，这话更像是说给他自己听的，\"Askonia 如此，整个星域也如此。"

texts.en:
"Cut a deal? For what?" Reynard raises an eyebrow. "I have credits, I have power, I have my Gens, and I have Kazeron."

He leans forward.

"My intent, you see, is to provide Fortuna with education."
texts.zh:
"做笔交易？为了什么？\"Reynard 挑起一边眉毛。\"我有星币，我有权力，我有我的氏族，我还有 Kazeron。"

他向前倾身。

"你看，我的打算，是给 Fortuna 一点教育。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"She must learn to quell her ambitions, to accept her place in the order of things."

"But she chose... this." He shakes his head in mock-sadness. "She chose this, and now I must teach her why things are as they are."
texts.zh:
"她得学会压住自己的野心，接受自己在秩序中的位置。"

"可她偏偏选了...这个。\"他故作惋惜地摇了摇头。\"她选了这个，那现在就得由我来教她，事情为什么是这个样子。"

options.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

texts.en: Reynard's meaning is as clear as your answer to his arrogant demand. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh: 你对他那傲慢要求的回答，已经让 Reynard 的意思再明白不过。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

texts.en:
"Sure," he says agreeably, tapping at a TriPad. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies. I wager we'll be moving cargo within two or three shifts."

"Meeting concluded. And I'm busy, so." He waves you off, looking back to his TriPad.
texts.zh:
"行啊，\" 他爽快地应道，一边戳着 TriPad，\"我让我的人去把空壳公司搭起来。我打赌，两三个班次之内咱们就能开始运货了。"

"会开完了。我这儿还忙着呢，就这样。" 他摆了摆手把你打发走，目光又落回 TriPad 上。

texts.en:
"Nope," he says. "We're done with that. End of conversation."

He raises a hand as if to pre-empt any objections.

"I'm not going to get involved in another political boondoggle only to have you back out. That's the last we're going to speak of this."
texts.zh:
"不行，\"他说，\"这事到此为止。谈话结束。"

他抬起一只手，像是要先堵住你的反驳。

"我不会再掺和进一桩政治烂摊子，结果你半路抽身。这话我们说到这儿为止。"

options.en: Okay, good. Just checking in.

options.zh: 我要你换掉你支持的对象。

texts.en:
"Really?"

He gives you a questioning look, then examines his TriPad again.

"The numbers are good. I'm making a nice profit. What's the problem?"
texts.zh:
"真的？"

他狐疑地看了你一眼，又低头去看他的 TriPad。

"账面上的数很好看。我赚得不少。有什么问题？"

options.en: It's not about credits, it's about results.
Okay, good. Just checking in.

texts.en:
"My answer is no."

He looks thoughtful. "It's not even about the credits. It's about the principle of making a decision about my business and owning it. If this," he flaps a hand, "is how you run your business, more power to you. Let me know how it turns out."

Arroyo crosses his arms. He's not going to budge.
texts.zh:
"我的回答是不。"

他若有所思。"这甚至跟星币无关。这是原则问题：我自己的生意，我自己拿主意，自己担着。要是你，"他摆了摆手，"就是这么打理生意的，那祝你顺风。结果如何，回头告诉我一声。"

Arroyo 抱起双臂。他不会松口。

texts.en:
"It's not about credits? What else is could it be about? Actually, don't answer. I don't care."

He crosses his arms.

"But okay. Fine. The only way I'm going to agree is if you cover my expenses to pivot the operation. Let's call it 80,000 credits."
texts.zh:
"跟星币无关？那还能跟什么有关？算了，别回答。我不在乎。"

他抱起双臂。

"不过好吧。行。要我答应，唯一的办法是你出钱补我转手这摊生意的开销。就算 80,000 星币吧。"

options.en: I want you to assist Hector, the true heir to Andrada. (transfer credits)
options.zh: 我要你去扶助 Hector，Andrada 真正的继承人。 (移交星币)

options.zh: 我要你支持 Achilles 那一派。他是个改革者。 (移交星币)
