options.en: Never mind.

texts.en:
"That raving blowhard?"

Arroyo holds his look of contempt for just a moment. His TriPad pings as the credit transfer is confirmed.

"Sure," he says agreeably. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies."
texts.zh:
"那个满嘴胡话的吹牛货？"

那份轻蔑在 Arroyo 脸上停了一瞬。他的 TriPad 叮了一声，星币转账已确认。

"当然，\"他爽快地答应，\"我让人去把那些空壳公司搭起来。"

texts.en:
"That ice-cold puppet of Gens Kato?"

Arroyo holds his look of contempt for just a moment. His TriPad pings as the credit transfer is confirmed.

"Sure," he says agreeably. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies."
texts.zh:
"Kato 氏族那个冷冰冰的傀儡？"

那份轻蔑在 Arroyo 脸上停了一瞬。他的 TriPad 叮了一声，星币转账已确认。

"当然，\"他爽快地答应，\"我让人去把那些空壳公司搭起来。"

texts.en:
"That dumping-ground circus of pirates, zealots, and terrorists?"

Arroyo holds his look of contempt for just a moment. His TriPad pings as the credit transfer is confirmed.

"Sure," he says agreeably. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies."
texts.zh:
"那帮由海盗、狂信徒和恐怖分子凑成的垃圾场马戏团？"

那份轻蔑在 Arroyo 脸上停了一瞬。他的 TriPad 叮了一声，星币转账已确认。

"当然，\"他爽快地答应，\"我让人去把那些空壳公司搭起来。"

texts.en:
"Really?" He looks at the TriPad again. "Smuggling weapons is more profitable than I thought. And easier, in the current chaos, which contributes to point A."

"Seems like a bad move to quit while we're ahead."

He pauses, looking you over. Looking displeased. Arroyo's frown grows.

"Fine. If you insist, I'll pull the plug - but you have to cover my expenses to pivot the operation. Call it 80,000 credits. Maybe I can sell the extra stock to pirates. Or the Pathers."

"Bet you'd like that," he says under his breath.
texts.zh:
"真的？\"他又看了一眼 TriPad。\"走私军火比我原来想的更赚。而且眼下这乱局让这事更容易——这又正好印证了第一点。"

"正赚着的时候收手，看着可不是好主意。"

他顿了顿，上下打量你。一脸不快。Arroyo 的眉头越皱越紧。

"行。既然你坚持，我就把这摊收了——但你得补我转手生意的开销。就算 80,000 星币。那批多出来的货，说不定能卖给海盗。或者卖给那些左径分子。"

"你肯定乐意看到这个，"他低声嘟囔。

options.en: Never mind.
Transfer the credits

texts.en:
Arroyo's TriPad chimes confirmation of the credits transfer.

"Huh. You really paid." He looks away, brow furrowed.

"Fine. A deal is a deal. Now get out of here before you sell me some other stupid idea."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 的 TriPad 叮咚一响，确认星币转账已完成。

"哼。你还真付了。"他移开目光，眉头拧着。

"行。说好的就是说好的。现在赶紧走，别又给我灌什么蠢主意。"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
Your comms connect.

"Arroyo here."

Rayan Arroyo looks you over, not quite disapproving.

"Askonia. Exciting place."
texts.zh:
通讯接通了。

"Arroyo 在此。"

Rayan Arroyo 把你打量了一遍，说不上是不赞同。

"Askonia。是个热闹地方。"

options.en: Yes, that's one way to put it.
A lot of good people died, Rayan.

texts.en:
He shrugs, then leans back, fingertips together.

"For me, it was a bit of an exploratory venture. You pushed me," he admits, "But don't get any ideas."
texts.zh:
他耸了耸肩，向后靠去，指尖抵在一起。

"对我来说，这趟多少算是一次探路之行。是你推了我一把，\"他承认道，\"不过你别多想。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Anyway I've got a good 'in' to land some plush reconstruction contracts. They've got a navy to rebuild - I hear the new guy, Hector? He likes warships. But you know what they say about clones..."

Arroyo goes quiet for a second, seeing no need to finish the aphorism.

"There's a lot of planetary infrastructure to rebuild as well, but those won't have quite the same margins." He rubs his hands together. "But also - less oversight. There are opportunities. It'll be busy times!"
texts.zh:
"总之我已经打通了一条不错的路子，能拿下几份肥厚的重建合同。他们要重建舰队——听说那位新人，Hector？他喜欢战舰。不过克隆体那些事，你也知道人们怎么说..."

Arroyo 静了一秒，觉得不必把这句谚语说完。

"要重建的行星基础设施也不少，只是那些的利润差得远。\"他搓了搓手。\"不过——监管也松。机会是有的。接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
He sighs, giving you a look just short of accusing.

"Here's the thing - it's politics. You back to wrong guy, make a gamble and the new Grand Lion isn't the one you put your credits on..."

He shakes his head, looking aside. Perhaps at the spectacular mountain-top view from his private chalet.

"Still. Lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. Plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."
texts.zh:
他叹了口气，看你的眼神里差一点就是责备。

"关键是——这是政治。你押错了人，赌了一把，可新任大狮不是你下了星币的那位..."

他摇了摇头，把目光移开。也许是在看他那座私人山庄外的壮丽山景。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

texts.en:
"Anyway I've got a good 'in' to land some plush reconstruction contracts. They've got a navy to rebuild - I hear the new guy, Achilles? He's a navy man. But you know what they say about clones..."

Arroyo goes quiet for a second, seeing no need to finish the aphorism.

"There's planetary infrastructure to rebuild too, and I'm hearing good things about some economic reforms that should loosen things up in Askonia. Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime - with the new guy?"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"It's an open orbit! That's the chatter among investors, anyway." He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead!"
texts.zh:
"总之我已经打通了一条不错的路子，能拿下几份肥厚的重建合同。他们要重建舰队——听说那位新人，Achilles？他是行伍出身。不过克隆体那些事，你也知道人们怎么说..."

Arroyo 静了一秒，觉得不必把这句谚语说完。

"行星基础设施也有得重建，而且我听说有些经济改革会让 Askonia 松快起来。不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近——可现在这位新人呢？"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"眼下是一片开阔轨道！至少投资圈里是这么传的。\"他搓了搓手。\"接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
He sighs, giving you a look just short of accusing.

"Here's the thing - it's politics. You back to wrong guy, make a gamble and the new Grand Lion isn't the one you put your credits on..."

He shakes his head, looking aside. Perhaps at the spectacular mountain-top view from his private chalet.

"Still. Lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."
texts.zh:
他叹了口气，看你的眼神里差一点就是责备。

"关键是——这是政治。你押错了人，赌了一把，可新任大狮不是你下了星币的那位..."

他摇了摇头，把目光移开。也许是在看他那座私人山庄外的壮丽山景。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

texts.en:
"A glorious mess, isn't it?" He grins.

"Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime, and not a few senior execs in the Company. And you know what happens when their cozy arrangement with the old guard collapses!"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"Got lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place! Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight." He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead!"
texts.zh:
"一场光辉灿烂的烂摊子，不是吗？"他咧嘴一笑。

"不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近，公司里也有好些高管。你也知道，他们跟旧势力那套舒坦的勾当一垮，会是什么下场！"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是！利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。\"他搓了搓手。\"接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
"It's a glorious mess, isn't it." He frowns.

"Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime, and not a few senior execs in the Company. And you know what happens when their cozy arrangement with the old guard collapses!"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"Got lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place. Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight."

He rubs his hands together. "I can still turn this whole operation into the black. Busy times ahead!"
texts.zh:
"这真是场光辉灿烂的烂摊子。"他皱起眉。

"不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近，公司里也有好些高管。你也知道，他们跟旧势力那套舒坦的勾当一垮，会是什么下场！"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是。利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。"

他搓了搓手。"我照样能把整桩买卖做成盈利。接下来有的忙了！"

texts.en:
"I'll tell you what I think - I think it's a big, Ludd-damned mess. First Opis, and now Sindria? What an unbelievable waste of capital."

He shakes his head, clearly upset. Though not quite, you suspect, at the loss of life for its own sake.

"What idiot gave that blowhard Diktat general, or admiral, or... whatever; some idiot gave him a planet-killer. Unbelievable."
texts.zh:
"我跟你说我怎么想——我觉得这就是一大摊卢德诅咒的烂事。先是 Opis，现在又是 Sindria？难以置信的资本浪费。"

他摇了摇头，看样子很恼火。不过你猜，这不全是为那些人命。

"是哪个白痴，把一件行星杀手塞给了辛达强权那个爱吹牛的将军、或者上将、或者...随便什么军衔来着；反正是个白痴把行星杀手给了他。简直难以置信。"

options.en: Continue

I gave him the planet-killer, Rayan.

texts.en:
He slaps his hands on his desk.

"What'd we learn?"

Arroyo draws his fingers back together and dips them toward you, indicating that you should provide an insightful response.
texts.zh:
他双手拍在桌上。

"我们学到了什么？"

Arroyo 把手指并拢收回，朝你微微一倾，示意你给个有见地的回答。

options.en: A loose coalition of mercenaries and opportunists cannot stop a polity based on military tradition.
options.zh: 雇佣兵与投机者凑成的松散同盟，挡不住一个以军事传统立国的政体。

options.en: Even a polity based on strong military tradition can be destroyed by betrayal and decadence?
options.zh: 即便以强大军事传统立国的政体，也会毁于背叛与腐化？

options.en: A cosmopolitan polity is more resilient than any absolutist dictatorship.
options.zh: 开放包容的政体，比任何专制独裁都更有韧性。

options.en: Even a resilient, cosmopolitan coalition can be defeated if reactionary forces are backed by a megacorporation?
options.zh: 即便是坚韧而开放的同盟，只要反动势力背后有巨型企业撑腰，也会落败？

options.en: Personalist dictatorships are particularly prone to failure?
options.zh: 个人独裁的政体尤其容易崩盘？

options.en: Never trust a clone?
Starship fuel is the most important substance in the Persean Sector.
options.zh: 星舰燃料才是英仙座星域最重要的东西。

options.en: Avoid a succession crisis by building strong institutions?
options.zh: 靠建立强有力的制度来避免继承危机？

texts.en:
"Wrong!" He slams a hand back on his desk.

"It's 'don't listen to hot tips from $playerName'. I can't believe I ever let you talk me into getting involved."

He turns away.

"Now stop bothering me, I have work to do."
texts.zh:
"错！"他一只手又拍回桌面。

"正确答案是'别听 $playerName 的内幕消息'。我真不敢相信，我居然让你说动我掺和进来。"

他转过身去。

"行了，别再来烦我，我还有活要干。"

options.en: Cut the comms

texts.en:
Arroyo looks aside, at the excellent view from his chalet.

"Still. There are lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place! Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight."

He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 把目光移开，望向他山庄外那片极好的景致。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是！利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。"

他搓了搓手。"接下来有的忙了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Arroyo," he corrects you. "And a word of advice, you're not going to impress anyone with your sense of humor so stick to fleet actions."
texts.zh: "是 Arroyo，\"他纠正你。\"给你一句忠告：靠幽默感是赢不了任何人好感的，还是专心打你的舰队战吧。"

texts.en: "Arroyo," he corrects you. "And a lot of bad people died too. Think it balances out? You keeping up your moral accounting?"
texts.zh: "是 Arroyo，\"他纠正你。\"而且死的坏人也很多。你觉得这能抵平吗？你还在记你那份道德账？"

texts.en: "Running with the transponder off in $faction space is against the law. You're hereby ordered to turn your transponder on, identify yourself immediately, and submit to a cargo scan for contraband."
texts.zh: "Running with the transponder off in $faction space is against the law. You're hereby ordered to turn your transponder on, identify yourself immediately, and submit to a cargo scan for contraband."

options.en: I'm working for Admiral Rao, $rank.
options.zh: 我在为 Rao 上将效力，$rank。

options.en: Turn the transponder on and comply
Talk your way out of it
Refuse and cut the comm link

texts.en:
An annoyed look crosses $post's face.

"Hold a moment for confirmation," $heOrShe says, tapping at an interface.

It appears to come through green because $heOrShe sighs, and says, "$PlayerSirOrMadam. You are clear to proceed, just... try to keep a low profile from now on, alright?"

Then, curtly, "$PersonRank $PersonLastName out."
texts.zh:
$post 脸上闪过一丝不快。

"稍等，我需要核实一下，"$heOrShe 说着，在界面上敲了几下。

看来核验通过了，因为$heOrShe 叹了口气，说道："$PlayerSirOrMadam。你可以通行了，只是...往后尽量低调些，行吗？"

随后简短地说："$PersonRank $PersonLastName 通话结束。"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en: You issue an order to activate the transponder and wait for the cargo scan to finish.
texts.zh: 你下令启动了应答器，并等待货物扫描完成。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: After a brief wait, the $faction $otherFleetName transmits the scan results.
texts.zh: After a brief wait, the $faction $otherFleetName transmits the scan results.

texts.en: However, instead of proceeding with the scan, the $faction $fleetName shuts down comms and powers up combat systems.
texts.zh: 然而，$faction $fleetName 没有继续进行扫描，而是关闭了通讯并启动了战斗系统。

texts.en: However, instead of proceeding with the scan, the $faction $fleetName shuts down comms and powers up combat systems.
texts.zh: 然而，$faction $fleetName 没有继续进行扫描，而是关闭了通讯并启动了战斗系统。

texts.en:
The $faction $personRank pauses and looks off-screen.

"But what about these cargo pods, which, let me check - why, they do contain illegal cargo. Not yours, are they? No? Excellent. We'll be confiscating the contents, then."
texts.zh:
$faction $personRank 停了下来，并把视线从屏幕上移开了。

"请你解释下这些货舱是怎么回事，为什么它们装的是违禁品？这不是你的，对吧？不是？很好，我们之后会没收这些玩意。"

texts.en:
$PersonRank $personName looks vaguely displeased.

"If I catch you running with the transponder off again, you won't get off so easily."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
texts.zh:
$personName $PersonRank 看上去很失望。

"如果再让我抓到你关着{应答器}晃悠，事情就不会这么简单了。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

texts.en:
The scan finds no overt contraband, but there is enough suspicion of your involvement in black market activities that the patrol commander is not appeased by this.

"Prepare to receive a boarding party. We'll be conducting a very thorough, hands-on inspection."

You consider it very likely the inspectors will do some small - but just borderline excusable - damage to the combat worthiness of your ships during the course of this "thorough" inspection.
texts.zh:
扫描没有发现公开的违禁品，但对由于你参与黑市活动的嫌疑充分，巡逻队指挥官对此并未善罢甘休。

"准备好迎接一个登船小组。我们要亲自动手进行一次非常彻底的检查。"

你认为在这次 "彻底" 的检查过程中，检查人员很可能会对你的舰船的战备造成一些还算勉强可以接受的少量损害。

texts.en:
"Well, well. Just as I suspected, we've got a smuggler here. Per standard $faction procedure, you're required to eject the contraband into space, for pickup or incineration at the discretion of the patrol commander."

$PersonRank $personLastName looks rather pleased, and you suspect that "pickup" rather than "incineration" might be the order of the day.
texts.zh:
"好啊。正如我所料，我们这还真逮到了个走私犯。遵照 $faction 的标准流程，你必须将违禁品抛弃到太空中，由巡逻队指挥官全权决定是拾取还是焚毁。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 看上去相当高兴，你猜今天的命令应该是 "拾取" 而不是 "焚毁"。

options.en: Continue
Continue
Comply and prepare for an inspection
Refuse and cut the comm link
Surrender the contraband and cut the comm link
options.zh: 上交违禁品并切断通讯链接

options.en: Refuse and cut the comm link

texts.en: As you'd half-expected, several of your ships report minor but painful losses of operational capability. Fortunately, the inspectors seemed to be more interested in causing "accidental" damage than looking for actual contraband, so no objectionable cargo was found.
texts.zh: 情况和你预计得差不多，你的几艘船报告说在作战能力上受到了轻微但令人不快的损失。幸运的是，检查人员似乎更热衷于制造 "意外" 损害，而不是去实际寻找违禁品，因此他们没有发现问题货物。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You manage to convince the patrol commander that $heOrShe would get in trouble with $hisOrHer superiors if $heOrShe pressed the issue.
OR
The patrol commander appears to have a venal streak a mile wide, and some vague promises of favors owed and eventual compensation convince $himOrHer to look the other way.
texts.zh:
你设法让巡逻队指挥官相信，如果$heOrShe坚持要惹事的话，$hisOrHer的上司就会让$heOrShe吃不了兜着走。
OR
看来巡逻队的指挥官早就贪腐成性，在一些诸如欠个人情以后必有重谢之类的含糊承诺之下，$himOrHer睁一只眼闭一只眼放了你一马。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

options.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
options.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

texts.en:
Hector's eyes gleam as you elaborate the logistics, facilities, and most especially the additional fleet capacity your colonial organization will bring to his cause.

"Yes, yes," he says, nodding. "THIS is how you demonstrate loyalty. Fleets and territory!"

He catches himself in his enthusiasm, and tempers it.
texts.zh:
当你细数后勤、设施，尤其是你的殖民组织将为他的事业带来的额外舰队产能时，Hector 的眼睛亮了起来。

"对，对，\"他连连点头，\"这才叫表忠心。舰队和地盘！"

他察觉自己失了态，随即收敛了几分。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"-However undeveloped these colonies might be and, doubtless, filled with spacer mongrels. Nonetheless, I must begin somewhere."

He flashes a grin again.
texts.zh:
"——尽管这些殖民地可能很落后，而且无疑塞满了太空杂种。不过，我总得有个起点。"

他又咧嘴一笑。

texts.en:
Then he crosses his arms, having come to a decision.

"I shall choose to believe in you, $playerName. If Dolos objects, let him bring me more fleets and weapons than you have provided."
texts.zh:
然后他双臂抱胸，显然已作出决定。

"我选择相信你，$playerName。要是 Dolos 有意见，就让他给我送来比你更多的舰队和武器。"

options.en: I've ensured the commitment of powerful allies... (explain)
options.zh: 我已确保了几位强援的承诺... (解释)

options.en: I have secured you logistical support from outside of Askonia... (explain)
options.zh: 我已从 Askonia 之外为你弄到了后勤支援... (解释)

options.en: I held a commission of the Sindrian Diktat... until Macario took it from me.
options.zh: 我曾持有辛达强权的委任...直到 Macario 把它夺走。

options.en: I follow Andrada's Transcendent Ideology and swear to serve his immortal blood!
options.zh: 我信奉 Andrada 的超凡意识形态，誓死效忠他不朽的血脉！

options.en: I bring a gift. (give him Leonidas Andrada)
options.zh: 我带来了件礼物。 (把 Leonidas Andrada 交给他)

options.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colony, to your cause.
options.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

options.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colony, to your cause.
options.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

options.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colonies, to your cause.
options.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的各块殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

options.en: How may I serve you, Supreme Executor?
options.zh: 我该如何为你效劳，最高元首？

options.en: I will... return when I can prove my loyalty, Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 我...会在能证明忠诚的时候回来，最高元首。

texts.en:
You explain that Macario's scheming had driven Hyder to smuggle supplies and even question her command, for the sake of duty to the Sindrian Diktat navy - but you confronted her with the reality of the situation and reminded her of her oath.

Not to Macario and his plotting, but to the blood of Andrada. To Hector.
texts.zh:
你解释说，Macario 的算计逼得 Hyder 私自偷运物资，甚至质疑自己接到的命令，只因她认为自己该对辛达强权海军尽责——但你当面把局势的实情摆给她看，并提醒她记起自己的誓言。

不是向 Macario 和他的阴谋效忠，而是向 Andrada 的血脉。向 Hector。

texts.en:
You explain how Macario's scheming had driven Caden into a state of wild resentment - he was led to believe he would be the next Supreme Executor while Macario hid Hector's existence. All of this was a ploy to use Caden's righteous fervor for the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada against the Sindrian Diktat, so that Dolos Macario could channel Caden's rage... and the resources of the Lion's Guard.

But you confronted Caden with the truth, and with his oath to serve the blood of Andrada. By submitting to Hector's authority, he will best serve the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
你解释说，Macario 的算计让 Caden 陷入了狂热的怨恨——他被引导相信，只要 Macario 继续藏着 Hector 的存在，下一任最高元首就该是他。这一切都是个圈套：把 Caden 对 Philip Andrada 超凡哲学的正义热忱用来对付辛达强权，好让 Dolos Macario 能利用 Caden 的怒火...以及狮心卫队的资源。

但你当面把真相告诉他，也提醒了他效忠 Andrada 血脉的誓言。臣服于 Hector 的权威，才是他报效辛达强权的最好方式。

texts.en:
You explain how Macario's scheming had driven a wedge between Hyder and Caden, splitting the combat effectiveness of the Sindrian Diktat Navy and the Lion's Guard so that each questioned their own loyalty to the legacy of Philip Andrada, Lion of Sindria. It was all a ploy to destabilize the Sindrian Diktat and make it vulnerable to Dolos Macario's sway.

But you've reminded each of their oath of service to the blood of Andrada - to Hector, the Supreme Executor and source of all true authority.
texts.zh:
你解释说，Macario 的算计在 Hyder 与 Caden 之间打进了一根楔子，让辛达强权海军与狮心卫队的战斗力一分为二，各自都开始怀疑自己对 Philip Andrada——辛达瑞亚之狮——所留遗产的忠诚。这一切都是为了让辛达强权失去稳定，好任由 Dolos Macario 摆布。

但你让他们各自想起了效忠 Andrada 血脉的誓言——效忠 Hector，最高元首，一切真正权威的源头。

texts.en: Hector nods, though there is a troubled look on his face.
texts.zh: Hector 点了点头，可脸上却带着几分不安。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I was assured by Dolos that he had everything under control."

There's a low, uneasy anger growing in Hector's voice. "He spoke of... grumbling in the leadership. Disloyalty."

He takes a deep breath.

"If what you say is true and not degenerate spacer lies, then you'll have done me a service." Hector nods, examining you through the link. A provisional acknowledgement.

"If. And I shall soon discover the truth."
texts.zh:
"Dolos 向我保证过，一切都在他掌控之中。"

Hector 的声音里，一股压抑而不安的火气正在积聚。"他提过...领导层里有人怨声载道。不忠。"

他深吸了一口气。

"如果你说的都是真的，而不是堕落的太空佬编的瞎话，那你就替我办成了一件事。"Hector 点了点头，透过链路打量着你。一次带保留的认可。

"如果。而且我很快就会查清真相。"

texts.en: You describe the spy networks and software intrusions of Faro Inesis. Seeing Hector grow bored, you move on to summarizing the dizzying arrangement of shell entities Faro Inesis can use to purchase materiel from any major polity to deliver directly to Sindrian Diktat arsenals.
texts.zh: 你讲述了 Faro Inesis 的间谍网络与软件入侵。见 Hector 听得有些乏味，你便转而概述他布下的那套令人眼花缭乱的空壳公司：凭这些公司，他可以从任何一个大势力手中购得军需物资，直接送进辛达强权的军械库。

texts.en: You describe the dizzying arrangement of shell entities Rayan Arroyo has organized which can facilitate the purchase materiel from any major polity to deliver directly to Sindrian Diktat arsenals.
texts.zh: 你讲述了 Rayan Arroyo 布下的那套令人眼花缭乱的空壳公司网络：靠它可以从任何一个大势力手中购得军需物资，直接送进辛达强权的军械库。

texts.en: You describe the spy networks and software intrusions of Faro Inesis. Seeing Hector grow bored, you move to summarizing the dizzying arrangement of shell entities both Faro Inesis and Rayan Arroyo control which they can use to purchase material - weapons - from any major polity to deliver directly to Sindrian Diktat arsenals.
texts.zh: 你讲述了 Faro Inesis 的间谍网络与软件入侵。见 Hector 听得有些乏味，你便转而概述两人共同掌控的那套令人眼花缭乱的空壳公司：凭这些公司，他们可以从任何一个大势力手中购得物资——武器——直接送进辛达强权的军械库。

texts.en:
"Yes, I'm sure-" Hector stifles a yawn. "You spacers are useful at this sort of thing, aren't you. I'd be interested if this involves any rare and powerful weapons..."

His expression grows more pleased as he imagines what might be gained from the armories of Culann, Kazeron, and Coatl.
texts.zh:
"是啊，我确信——\"Hector 把哈欠憋了回去。\"你们这些太空佬干这种事倒是挺在行，不是吗。要是这事牵扯到什么稀有又强力的武器，我倒会有兴趣..."

他一想到能从 Culann、Kazeron 和 Coatl 的军械库里弄到些什么，神色便越发满意起来。

texts.en:
"He took it from you? Do I recall ordering your commission stripped?" Hector raises an eyebrow. "Hmm."

"I sign a great number of executive orders," he says, peevish. "Endless bureaucracy. You'd think we were the Hegemony! Dolos has been very helpful, but I suspect at times he's pursuing his little side-projects..."

Hector rubs his chin, putting on a thoughtful look.
texts.zh:
"他从你手里夺走的？我记得我下过命令，撤销你的委任状？\"Hector 挑起一边眉毛。\"嗯。"

"我签的行政命令多得数不清，\"他烦躁地说，\"没完没了的官僚程序。简直像我们成了霸主似的！Dolos 帮了大忙，可有时候我怀疑他在搞自己那些小项目..."

Hector 摸了摸下巴，摆出一副沉思的模样。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I know- I'll just declare that you never lost your commission. I can do that, you know." He grins at the thought. Perhaps because it would annoy Macario.

"That is, if..." Hector turns his eyes on you. "If I am satisfied with your... loyalty."

He places his chin on his hands and looks through the link eagerly, as if anticipating a game.
texts.zh:
"我知道——我干脆宣布你从未失去委任状。你知道，这事我办得到。"想到这儿他咧嘴一笑。也许是因为这会让 Macario 恼火。

"也就是说，前提是...\"Hector 把目光转向你。\"前提是我对你的...忠诚感到满意。"

他双手托住下巴，兴味盎然地从链路那头望着你，像是在等一场游戏开场。

texts.en:
As you speak of Andradaism he stands taller, chin raised and regal, resplendent in his uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"Enough," he says at last, indulgent.

"I know all of this, of course, but it does please me to hear that even an outsider is capable of understanding my father's teachings."

"I am... his immortal blood, his legacy, the personification of his empire." Hector's gaze lifts; taking in his domain, the excitement obvious in his eyes.
texts.zh:
你谈起 Andrada 主义时，他的身姿愈发挺拔，下巴扬起，气度威严，一身最高元首的制服光彩照人。

"够了，"他最后说道，语气宽纵。

"这些我自然全都知道，可听到连一个外人都能理解我父亲的教诲，我还是很高兴。"

"我就是...他不朽的血脉，他的遗产，他那帝国的化身。"Hector 抬眼望去，将他的疆域尽收眼底，眼中的兴奋毫不掩饰。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
His eyes returns at last to you.

"See that you don't forget it, spacer."
texts.zh:
他的目光最终落回你身上。

"记住，别把这事忘了，太空佬。"

texts.en:
You order Leonidas' cryopod prepared. A drone-carrier is prepped for the transfer, its cargo cradled gently by an octet of clamp-arms.

Hector is intrigued, waving off what can only be objections on the receiving end from his attendants and bridge officers. Warnings not to accept indeterminate packages from dubious spacers.

"Tell me, captain, what is this gift?"
texts.zh:
你下令准备好 Leonidas 的冷冻舱。一架无人运输机为转运做好了准备，八条钳臂轻轻托住舱体。

Hector 来了兴致，挥手挡开了通讯那头侍从与舰桥军官的反对——无非是在警告他别收下来历不明的太空佬递上的不明包裹。

"告诉我，舰长，这是什么礼物？"

options.en: Your clone-brother, Leonidas Andrada. In cryosleep.
options.zh: 你的克隆兄弟，Leonidas Andrada。在冷冻睡眠中。

texts.en:
An alarmed look. "But Dolos said-"

Hector shuts himself up, and gives you a wary look.

"My clone-brother." He nods, slowly. Remembering to appear ruthless and in control at all times.

"A most unique and fitting gift, spacer. You shall have to tell me... your version of events. Someday. Perhaps my brother will... become useful one day."

By Hector's look, you don't think he has rehabilitation in mind; they are one flesh, after all.
texts.zh:
他神色一惊。"可 Dolos 说过——"

Hector 把话咽了回去，警惕地看着你。

"我的克隆兄弟。"他缓缓点头，没忘记要时刻显得冷酷、尽在掌握。

"一份绝无仅有、恰到好处的礼物，太空佬。你总得跟我讲讲...你那个版本的说法。改天吧。也许我这位兄弟有朝一日...会变得有用。"

看 Hector 的神情，你不觉得他打的是让人康复的主意；毕竟，他们本是一体。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Bring me Achilles' head on a spike!"

He barks a laugh at his own wit, eyes roaming.

You can't see the attendants and advisors in the room with him, but no doubt- with a brusque gesture he's on to a new thought.
texts.zh:
"把 Achilles 的脑袋插在矛尖上给我送来！"

他被自己的机灵逗得笑了一声，目光四处游移。

你看不见与他同处一室的侍从和顾问，但无疑——他一个粗率的动作，心思已经转到了别处。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Your commission is restored," Hector declares. "See that you bring honor to the Sindrian Diktat - preferably in battle with my cowardly enemies."

He raises a finger.

"I do want Achilles' head, captain. The thought that my own blood could be corrupted by the so-called Persean League... it is sacrilege."

His look of disgust is definitive.

"Now go away! Make it happen." He turns his back, cape fluttering.

"Glory to my Sindrian Diktat!"
texts.zh:
"你的委任状恢复了，\"Hector 宣布，\"记住为辛达强权带来荣耀——最好是在与我那些懦弱的敌人交战时。"

他竖起一根手指。

"Achilles 的脑袋我确实要，舰长。一想到我自己的血亲竟会被所谓的英仙座联盟腐蚀...这是大不敬。"

他脸上的厌恶毫不含糊。

"现在滚吧！去把它办成。"他转过身去，披风飘动。

"荣耀归于我的辛达强权！"

options.en: Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!

texts.en:
The comms fizzle and crack, then stabilize.

"Well well well, finally I meet Captain $PlayerName, the killer of Andrada's babies."

"Or, well." $HeOrShe looks you up and down, or at least makes a pretty good show of looking like that's what $heOrShe is doing. "That was what they were saying right up until they weren't and, hmm, the 'reformed' Sindrian Diktat cancelled the contract on me. Did get to call in the termination clause out of it, though knowing these Sindies it's going to take a cycle to get paid out. Even if they are 'reformed'."

"Still," $heOrShe grins, "Got some good kit out of it."
texts.zh:
通讯嘶嘶作响，噼啪一阵，随后稳定下来。

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

"或者说，嗯。\"$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。\"他们一直是这么说的，直到忽然不这么说了，然后，嗯，'改革后'的辛达强权撤了我的合同。不过好歹让我援引了终止条款，虽说以这帮辛达人的作风，想拿到赔款得等上一个星历年。哪怕他们'改革'了也一样。"

"不过嘛，\"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑，\"还是从这事儿里弄到了些好装备。"

texts.en:
The comms fizzle and crack, then stabilize.

"Well well well, finally I meet Captain $PlayerName, the killer of Andrada's babies."

"Or, well." $HeOrShe looks you up and down, or at least makes a pretty good show of looking like that's what $heOrShe is doing. "That was what they were saying right up until Sindria blew up. It's going to be a struggle to get the termination clause paid out in the bureaucratic aftermath of yet another planet blowing up." $HeOrShe sighs, looking down for a moment.

"Still," $heOrShe recovers with a grin, "Got some good kit out of it. I don't think anyone who authorized the armaments transfers is even alive, or not in prison somewhere ha-ha."
texts.zh:
通讯嘶嘶作响，噼啪一阵，随后稳定下来。

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

"或者说，嗯。"$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。"他们一直是这么说的，直到 Sindria 炸上了天。又一颗星球炸了，在这堆官僚烂摊子里想把终止条款的赔款要回来，可有得折腾了。"$HeOrShe叹了口气，低头片刻。

"不过嘛，\"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑，重新打起精神，\"还是从这事儿里弄到了些好装备。我觉得当初批准那批军械移交的人，没一个还活着，要不就是在哪儿蹲着大牢，哈哈。"

texts.en:
The comms fizzle and crack, then stabilize.

"Well well well, finally I meet Captain $PlayerName, the killer of Andrada's babies."

$HeOrShe looks you up and down, or at least makes a pretty good show of looking like that's what $heOrShe is doing. "Can't say I blame you much for doin' em in, but they'll be paying good - real good - to do you in."

"Figured I'd do the courtesy of telling you before I took my shot, is all. You ready, then?"
texts.zh:
通讯嘶嘶作响，噼啪一阵，随后稳定下来。

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。"说你把他们做了，我倒也不太怪你，可他们出的价很不错 —— 相当不错 —— 要你的命。"

"我想着，动手之前先跟你打个招呼，算是礼数。就这些。那么，你准备好了？"

options.en: Cut the comm link
Congrats, I suppose. Why are you telling me this?
options.zh: 那恭喜了。你为什么要告诉我这些？

options.en: Cut the comm link
Congrats, I suppose. Why are you telling me this?
options.zh: 那恭喜了。你为什么要告诉我这些？

options.en: Sure, let's get this over with. I do appreciate the courtesy, though.
options.zh: 行，那就了结吧。不过这份礼数，我领情。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
$HeOrShe shrugs.

"Was already on an intercept course. Figured it'd be good maneuvers practice for that lot," $heOrShe indicates with a thumb over $hisOrHer shoulder.

The link doesn't quite catch what sounds a lot like jeers in return.

"Yeah, yeah," the spacer says back over $hisOrHer shoulder. "Anyway. You burn bright, ya hear?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe耸了耸肩。

"本来就在拦截航线上。我想着，对那帮家伙来说，这正好练练机动，"$heOrShe用拇指朝$hisOrHer肩后指了指。

通讯链接没太收清那头传来的回应，听着很像是一片嘲骂。

"行了行了，\"那太空佬扭头朝$hisOrHer身后回了一句。\"总之。星火长明，听见没？"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"No trouble at all," $heOrShe says. "Could do with more politeness. Doesn't cost a credit, and life in the Sector's harsh enough as-is."

$HeOrShe trails off.

"Welp. Guess I'd usually say 'burn bright', but..."

The merc shrugs.
texts.zh:
"不麻烦，\"$heOrShe说。\"这世道多点礼貌总没坏处。又不花一个星币，何况星域里的日子本来就够难了。"

$HeOrShe话音渐弱。

"好吧。按说我一般会说'星火长明'，不过..."

那雇佣兵耸了耸肩。

options.en: Say, my scans show some... unusual hulls in your fleet.
options.zh: 我说，我的扫描仪显示你的舰队里有些...不寻常的船体。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"Oh, these old things?" $HeOrShe laughs.

"I'm joking of course - well spotted! Give my regards to your sensors officer!"

$HeOrShe looks around, as if admiring $hisOrHer own ship. "The Sindies gave us some of their goodies as a downpayment on the job. Some cutting-edge stuff. Not bad once you rip out some of their 'special modifications' and all the portraits of Andrada. Underneath? Not what you'd expect from a pack of AM-farmers who spend all day marching around and beating up Luddies."

$HeOrShe snaps $hisOrHer fingers. "And you know what?"
texts.zh:
"哦，这些老古董？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"当然，我开玩笑的——眼真尖！替我向你的传感器军官问好！"

$HeOrShe环顾四周，像是在欣赏$hisOrHer自己的船。"辛达人给了我们些好东西，算是这次活儿的定金。都是些尖端货色。把那些'特殊改装'和满墙的 Andrada 画像拆掉之后，还真不赖。剥开这层皮呢？可不是你指望从一帮整天列队游行、专揍卢德信徒的反物质农夫手里看到的东西。"

$HeOrShe抬起$hisOrHer手，啪地打了个响指。"你知道怎么样？"

options.en: What?

texts.en:
"It all came together when my techs were reviewing the software integration with our fire control. I've got some good techs - great even. The trick with 'em is you gotta listen when they get all fidgety. Not so good at talking, usually, but when they know their stuff..."

The merc sits back in $hisOrHer command seat, getting comfortable.

"Well, there's me getting off-track. Point is, the interfaces? All custom post-Collapse Tri-Tachyon!"
texts.zh:
"是我的技师们在检查火控软件集成的时候，一切才对上号的。我有几个好技师 —— 甚至可以说是一流的。跟他们的诀窍就是，他们开始坐立不安的时候你得听。他们通常不太会说话，可一旦他们真懂行..."

那雇佣兵靠回$hisOrHer的指挥座，摆了个舒服的姿势。

"唉，我又扯远了。重点是，那些接口？全是大崩塌后速子科技定制的！"

options.en: The AI-piloted, automated Remnants from the first AI war are a bit of a giveaway.
options.zh: 第一次 AI 战争里那些 AI 驾驶的自动化余辉，已经够说明问题了。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon? No!

texts.en:
"What!" $HeOrShe exclaims, clapping a hand to the side of $hisOrHer head.

"I suppose those are a little obvious," $heOrShe admits. "Should have thought of it first thing. Too much time in the fringe hunting strays, not enough having a fine drink with the likes of yourself."

"Anyway, thick as thieves, those Sindies and Tachies!"
texts.zh:
"什么！"$HeOrShe叫了一声，一只手拍上$hisOrHer的脑袋侧面。

"我想那些确实有点太显眼了，\"$heOrShe承认。\"我本该头一个就想到。在边缘星区追杀那些流窜的家伙待得太久，像你这样能好好喝一杯的人见得少了。"

"总之，好得穿一条裤子，那些辛达人和速子人！"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Anyway," $heOrShe says, some of the joy leaving $hisOrHer voice as it trails into silence.

"I suppose we ought to get on with it." $HeOrShe rests $hisOrHer chin on a hand.
texts.zh:
"总之，"$heOrShe说，声音渐渐低下，$hisOrHer那点欢快也随之褪去。

"我想我们该动手了。"$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer下巴搁在一只手上。

options.en: I suppose so.
I suppose. But...

texts.en:
"Yeah. Well."

$HeOrShe takes a long breath.

"Was a good chat. It'll be a shame when you're dead."
texts.zh:
"是啊。好吧。"

$HeOrShe长长地吸了口气。

"聊得挺痛快。等你死了，那就可惜了。"

options.en: Yeah. You too. I'll try to make it quick?
options.zh: 是啊。你也是。我会尽量下手快些？

texts.en:
"I appreciate it," $heOrShe says.

"Well. Better you cut the comms, then."
texts.zh:
"我领情，"$heOrShe说。

"好吧。那还是你来切断通讯吧。"

options.en: Cut the comm link
I suppose. But...

texts.en:
The merc perks up.

"Yes?"
texts.zh:
那雇佣兵来了精神。

"什么？"

options.en: What if we... didn't.

texts.en:
The merc laughs, scandalized.

"Stars! I'd be in such trouble. Not just with the Sindies, but with the guild and the association, and... well, lots of folks."
texts.zh:
那雇佣兵笑起来，像是被冒犯了。

"群星在上！那我麻烦可就大了。不光得罪辛达人，还有行会、协会，还有...呃，很多人。"

options.en: I don't see them here right now, do you?
options.zh: 我现在可没在这儿看见他们，你看见了吗？

texts.en:
"No... no I don't," $heOrShe says with a grin.

"Let's make a deal. I won't tell 'em if you won't. And," $heOrShe points a finger-pistol, "you make sure to treat your crew right so they don't tell either. Deal?"
texts.zh:
"没...我没看见，"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑。

"咱们做个交易。你不说，我也不说。还有，\"$heOrShe比了个手指枪，\"你得好好待你的船员，好让他们也不往外说。成交？"

options.en: Deal.

texts.en:
The merc laughs again, then puts $hisOrHer hands together.

"Well, see you around then. Burn bright, captain!"
texts.zh:
那雇佣兵又笑了起来，随后把$hisOrHer双手合在一起。

"好吧，那就后会有期。星火长明，舰长！"

options.en: Burn bright.

texts.en:
"Yes!" $HeOrShe exclaims, clapping $hisOrHer hands.

"Thick as thieves, it turns out! Sindies and Tachies!"
texts.zh:
"没错！"$HeOrShe拍着$hisOrHer手叫道。

"结果呢，好得穿一条裤子！辛达人和速子人！"

options.en: Continue

"Still," $heOrShe grins, "Got some good kit out of it."

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

"或者说，嗯。\"$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。\"他们一直是这么说的，直到忽然不这么说了，然后撤了我的合同。不过好歹让我援引了终止条款，虽说以这帮辛达人的作风，想拿到赔款得等上一个星历年。"

"不过嘛，\"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑，\"还是从这事儿里弄到了些好装备。"

options.en: I would thank you not to repeat that slander. I am loyal to the Supreme Executor!
options.zh: 我倒要请你别再重复这种诽谤。我忠于最高元首！

options.en: Congrats, I suppose. Why are you telling me this?
options.zh: 那恭喜了。你为什么要告诉我这些？

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"Ah." $HisOrHer expression is pointedly neutralized. "That's... good for you."

"Burn bright?"
texts.zh:
"啊。\"$HisOrHer的表情刻意归于平淡。\"那...对你是件好事。"

"星火长明？"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
Your shuttle drops to the primary landing pad of the Shrine of Volturn, a humble thing that cycled work crews and deliveries in cycles past.

The structure is not unscarred by the rough transition of this world between competing branches of the immortal Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在 Volturn 圣地的主停机坪上 —— 这处朴素的所在，往年轮转着接送工班与补给。

这颗星球在那不朽的辛达强权各派相互争斗间几经易手，建筑上难免留了些伤痕。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is empty, as lonely as a coffin that never embraced the corpse for which it was constructed.

The receiving hall is pocked and scorched by more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Rusty pools of dank water on the floor mingle with suspicious rusty stains.

It smells of salt and rot and smoke.

An enormous hole opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. Someone's left candles here, though they're cold and dark and have gathered small pools of water inside the divits burnt into the paraffin.
texts.zh: 圣地里空无一人，接待大厅里布满了弹孔与烧蚀的痕迹，很明显这是由武器开火造成的。这里的空气混杂着盐味，烟味，还有一股腐败的味道，地板上阴湿的水坑里混杂着可疑的铁锈色痕迹。

texts.en: A shard from a familiar teapot crunches beneath your boot.
texts.zh: 一个熟悉的茶壶碎片在你脚下嘎吱作响。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is warm and well-lit, and lined with patchwork repairs, the walls a hand-built mosaic of corroded metal, ceramic, and plastic.

After a moment you recognize that it is a mural executed in a palette of rust and ruin, a crudely rendered scene of nature - and there, Ludd, an ambigious figure suggested by a ragged silhouette.

It smells still of salt and smoke, but handweave carpeting softens the receiving hall.

Simon the subcurate greets you with a half-bow and an offering of the briny tea of Volturn.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅暖意融融，灯火通明，四壁打满补丁，是用锈蚀的金属、陶瓷与塑料手工拼成的一幅镶嵌画。

片刻之后你才认出，那是一幅以锈色与残败为调子绘成的壁画，拙朴地描着一处自然景致 —— 而那儿，是卢德，一个由参差剪影勾出的、模棱两可的身影。

空气里依旧是盐味与烟味，但手工织就的地毯让接待大厅柔和了些。

副助祭 Simon 欠身向你行礼，奉上一杯 Volturn 的咸茶。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is not quite empty, as a humbly-robed subcurate greets you with a half-bow, and a quiet word lost in the distorted susurration of waves and wind.

Your eyes roam over the interior of the receiving hall, noting the pocks and scorch of more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Artfully arranged hull-patch plates form a walkway through the rusty pools of water mingling with suspicious rusty stains.

Under the incense, it smells of salt and smoke. A hint of rot.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅并不算空，一位衣着朴素谦卑的副助祭欠身相迎，低声说了句什么，淹没在浪涛与风声扭曲的沙沙里。

你的目光扫过接待大厅内里，又留意到更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。几块船壳补板被巧妙地铺成一条小径，穿过混着可疑锈色污渍的锈水洼。

熏香底下，是盐味、烟味，还有一丝腐坏的气息。

texts.en:
Curate Sacraria Standfast greets you with tea inside the echoing receiving hall before escorting you down to the inner shrine.

You enter the creaking, humid inspection module at the end of a modified extraction stack where the shrine is housed, against all reason. Crates and racks of weapons and ammunition are piled high, crowding the pilgrims/insurgents. Their unwashed bodies smell of sweat and smoke. They speak and pray quietly.
texts.zh:
在回音袅袅的接待大厅之中，神龛祭司 Standfast 备好茶水接待了你，然后护送你前往内部的 圣地。

尽管这不合常理，你还是进入了圣地。它安置在一个潮湿的探测舱室，位于改良型钻井的末端，嘎吱作响。塞满武器弹药的板条箱和架子高高堆起，朝圣者和义军摩肩接踵。他们安静地交谈和祈祷着，未经清洗的身躯散发着汗水和烟熏的气息。

那圆形的金刚石观察窗，将海洋深处那粉碎性的重压阻隔在外，其下的空地上布置着圣地的核心。一些蜡烛在它们那一排排熄灭的同道之中挣扎着，闪烁出恰到好处的微光。一如既往，用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，也给你一支让你跟上。

texts.en:
Curate Sacraria Standfast coolly acknowledges your presence. She is armed with a small pistol, politely holstered but with the clasp impolitely loosed.

She is equal parts perplexed and annoyed when you request to see the shrine, but she draws back the dusty curtains for you and stands aside.

The shrine looks as abandoned as ever in this back room. Rows of unlit candles are arrayed around the wooden centerpiece carved with images of Ludd's travails. The place is illuminated only by dim shafts of light let in by grimy portholes.
texts.zh:
神龛祭司 Standfast 冷淡地于此地迎接了你。她随身携带的小型手枪规矩地塞在枪套里，但搭扣却肆意地没有扣上。

当你提出要参拜圣地的时候，困惑与些许厌烦两种情绪同等地浮现在了她的脸上，但她依旧为你拉下了尘封的幕帘，并站到了一旁。

在这间后屋中的圣地，看起来已被遗忘了许久。一排排蜡烛环绕着中心的木雕，其上镌刻着卢德的艰苦历程。烛火早已尽数熄灭，但透过那蒙尘的舷窗，一缕幽光依旧笼罩着这个地方。

options.en: Leave
Continue
Continue
Continue
Leave

texts.en:
You are met outside by a jittery-looking local laborer. Not one of the two, from before.

He puts his hands together and nods at you, watery eyes nervously darting to your bodyguards.
texts.zh:
出来时，一名神色惶惶的本地劳工迎上你。不是先前那两人中的一个。

他双手合十，朝你点了点头，水汪汪的眼睛紧张地在你几名护卫身上打转。

options.en: What happened here?

texts.en:
"Was a raid," he says. "The Sindies got some word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache."

He makes a nervous glance over his shoulder, though he seems gain confidence as he revisit what is clearly the source of simmering anger.

"Never saw anything like that, but the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is, Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这儿藏了批武器。"

他紧张地回头瞥了一眼，可一回到这桩显然还憋着火的事上，胆子倒像是壮了些。

"那种东西我从没见过，可辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说当时有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

texts.en:
"Was a raid," he says. "The Sindies got some word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache."

He seems to gain confidence as he revisits a simmering anger.

"Never saw anything like that, but the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is, Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这儿藏了批武器。"

一回到这桩憋着火的事上，他胆子倒像是壮了些。

"那种东西我从没见过，可辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说当时有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

options.en: What happened? Did they escape?
options.zh: 出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？

options.en: What happened? Did they escape?
options.zh: 出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？

texts.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I should go, boss. We never met," he turns away, then pauses. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
texts.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。咱们没见过面，\" 他转身，又顿住，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

options.en: Leave this place

texts.en:
The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.

You are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
texts.zh:
返程的穿梭机上一路无事。

你格外清楚地意识到，隔着真空与辐射的肆虐护住你的，不过是薄薄一层技术外壳。

texts.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I gotta go, boss." They turn away, and pause to look back. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
texts.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。\" 他们转身，又回头望了一眼，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

options.en: Leave this place

texts.en:
Simon leads you through the shrine, humbly rebuilt in much the same form - and there, the enormous, ragged hole still opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads.

Swarms and schools of small candles gather and flicker along the ragged portal. Prayers and memories of the lost.

Their flames outnumber the visitors who pray or whisper quietly; a few may even be off-worlders, judging by their suits and robes bereft of salt-stain.
texts.zh:
Simon 领你穿过圣地，依旧照着原来的样子谦朴地重建过 —— 而那儿，那个巨大的、边缘参差的窟窿依旧朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响。

成群成簇的小蜡烛沿着破口聚拢、摇曳。是给逝者的祷词与追忆。

烛火比前来祷告或低声絮语的访客还多；从那一尘不染、不见盐渍的衣袍来看，其中几位说不定还是外世界来的。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
You step forward over the plates, and see in the center of the platform's main deck an enormous hole which opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. There is a collection of candles set here, some lit, others are dark, with water collected in the divits burnt into the paraffin.

The subcurate notes your gaze.

"Blessed peace," he says in a rough voice, though softly. "Would you like to light a candle for someone?"

Despite the somewhat threadbare robes of a subcurate, you note that the man could be a laborer, maybe a low-status tech. Weathered face, scarred hands.
texts.zh:
你踩着补板走上前，看见平台主甲板中央有一个巨大的窟窿，朝底下幽暗的海敞开。浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响闷闷地传来。这儿摆着一堆蜡烛，有的亮着，有的熄了，烛泪凝出的小凹里积着水。

副助祭留意到了你的目光。

"愿平安与你同在，\" 他嗓音粗哑，却放得很轻，\"要为谁点一支蜡烛吗？"

副助祭的袍子虽有些寒酸，你却看出这人本可能是个劳工，或是身份低微的技术员。饱经风霜的脸，满是疤痕的手。

options.en: What happened here?

texts.en:
"It was a raid," he says. "The Sindies... the occupiers got word, somehow. It's said an informer told them there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬... 那些占领军，不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

texts.en:
"It was a raid," he says. "The Sindies... the occupiers got word, somehow. It's said an informer told them there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬... 那些占领军，不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

options.en: Who are you? Is this the shrine?
Who are you? What happened to the shrine?

texts.en:
"I'm called Simon," he says with a glance at you. "Came back after the committee said things were over. Took care of the place. They gave me a title, robes. Guess I found the calling late in life."

"And that," he kicks a foot forward, "was the shrine."

He's quiet for a moment. But he wants to tell the story.

"As I hear it, the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"我叫 Simon，\" 他看了你一眼，\"委员会宣布事情了结之后，我回来了，照看这地方。他们给了个头衔，一身袍子。大概我这辈子悟道得晚吧。"

"至于那个，\" 他抬脚往前点了点，\"就是圣地了。"

他沉默了片刻。可他想要讲出这段往事。

"我听说是这样，辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半是普通行者。"

options.en: Did anyone escape?
So this is it?

texts.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But the whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"Are you looking for someone in particular?"
texts.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

texts.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But the whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"Are you looking for someone in particular?"
texts.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

options.en: I'm not sure.
A curate sacraria. Who keeps the shrine.
options.zh: 是位司祭，掌管圣龛、看护这处圣地。

options.en: No. I came for the shrine.
options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

options.en: The curate sacraria, Moyra Standfast.
options.zh: 是那位司祭，Moyra Standfast，掌管圣龛。

options.en: I'm not sure.
No. I came for the shrine.
options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to contemplating the missing shrine.

"Well, this is it."
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回去凝望那已不复存在的圣地。

"嗯，就这样了。"

texts.en:
Simon takes a deep breath, then kneels by the candles. He selects one, flicking the water away, then replaces the stub to its original position.

An igniter clicks in his hand, and he sets a tiny, wavering flame on the wick. It grows, and he withdraws the igniter.

Two flames.

He snaps it shut with practiced hand, leaving just the candle. Then pauses a moment. And puts his hand out, offering you the igniter.
texts.zh:
Simon 深吸一口气，在蜡烛旁跪下。他挑出一支，弹去积水，又把那截烛头放回原处。

他手里咔哒一声打着了点火器，把一簇细小、摇曳的火苗送上烛芯。火苗长了起来，他便收回点火器。

两簇火光。

他手法熟练地把它啪地合上，只留下那支蜡烛。随后顿了片刻。又把手伸出来，把点火器递给你。

options.en: Light a candle
It's not my place.
Do not light a candle

texts.en:
You follow Simon's lead, clearing the seawater out of a likely-looking candle, then clicking the igniter to give it flame; a tenuous flicker of life renewed.

Simon takes the igniter back.

He watches the flames for a moment. and his eyes are brighter than before. He rubs at his face with one scarred hand. Fingers missing.
texts.zh:
你照着 Simon 的样子，把一支看着还合用的蜡烛里的海水清掉，再咔哒一声打着点火器给它续上火；一线微弱摇曳、重又燃起的生机。

Simon 把点火器收了回去。

他望着火光看了片刻，眼神比先前亮了些。他用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。缺了几根指头。

options.en: It is not just a candle.
It is just a candle.

texts.en:
"The Pneuma lives in these words," he says quietly.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.

You feel the muted thrum of the shifting platform through your feet, the barest roll as distant waves make their futile assault against the ruin.
texts.zh:
"圣灵寓于这些字句之中，" 他轻声说道。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

你隔着脚底感到平台移动时低沉的震颤，还有那一丝几不可察的摇晃 —— 远处的浪涛正徒劳地撞击着这片废墟。

options.en: Leave this place
Leave this place
Leave this place

texts.en:
He does not answer.

He stares sadly at the lonely, flickering flame.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.
texts.zh:
他没有作答。

他怔怔地望着那簇孤寂摇曳的火苗，神色黯然。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

texts.en: "It is, though," he says. "For those of us who lived."
texts.zh: "可对我们这些活下来的人来说，它就是，\" 他说道。"

options.en: Light a candle
Do not light a candle

texts.en: Simon makes the igniter disappear and watches the flame for a moment. His eyes are brighter than before, and he rubs at his face with one scarred hand.
texts.zh: Simon 把点火器收得没了影，又望着火苗看了片刻。他的眼神比先前亮了些，用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。

options.en: It is just a candle.
It is not just a candle.

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Standfast was her name. Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, hands still held together.
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她叫 Standfast。事发那会儿她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，双手仍合握在一起。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "This is it," he says.
texts.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, almost sheepish, hands still held together.

"I pray for her."
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，几乎有些局促，双手仍合握在一起。

"我为她祷告。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "This is it," he says.
texts.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

texts.en:
The small shrine's centerpiece is set in an open space under a round diamond-matrix window holding back the crushing depths of the sea. A few candles flicker among the ranks of their dead comrades.

As before, Moyra Standfast re-lights a candle from one that is burning, and offers one for you to do the same.
texts.zh:
小小圣地的中心陈设，安放在一扇圆形钻石矩阵窗下的空处，那窗挡住了深海压得人喘不过气的重压。几支蜡烛在它们已然熄灭的同伴行列间摇曳。

和从前一样，Moyra Standfast 就着一支燃着的蜡烛重新点亮一支，又递给你一支，请你照做。

texts.en: He is quiet for a moment, eyes on you. "A thought occurs..."
texts.zh: 他沉默片刻，目光注视着你。"突然想起一件事..."

texts.en: "If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.
texts.zh: "哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话音刚起，人已经出现在画面里。

texts.en:
Fortuna appears.

"$TitlePL $PlayerName. I expect to see you soon at Yesod."

"Perhaps we will speak further after your conversation with Achilles," she says.
texts.zh:
Fortuna 出现在画面里。

"$TitlePL $PlayerName，盼着早日在 Yesod 见到你。"

"等你和 Achilles 谈完，或许我们再细聊，" 她说道。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.

"I trust Horus Yaribay is well?"
texts.zh:
"哎呀，$PlayerName 舰长，稀客，" 你刚听见 Fortuna 的声音，她人已经现身。

"想来 Horus Yaribay 近来安好吧？"

texts.en: "If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice. "I trust you are attending to your own business, as I am to mine."
texts.zh: "哟，$PlayerName 舰长，\" Fortuna 说道，听见声音的同时人已出现在画面里，\"想必您忙着自己的事，我也忙我的。"

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.

"I trust Reynard Hannan is well?"

It does not sound like an earnest inquiry, somehow.
texts.zh:
"这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话音未落，人已经出现在画面里。

"想来 Reynard Hannan 近来安好吧？"

可不知怎么，听着不像真心在问。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, an edge already in her voice.

"I trust your newfound patron, Reynard Hannan, is well?"

She smirks, then adds "You will learn soon enough how well you deserve one another."
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，一开口就带了刺。

"你那位新攀上的靠山 Reynard Hannan，想来一切安好吧？"

她嘴角一挑，又补了句："过不了多久你就知道，你们俩有多般配了。"

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, an edge already in her voice.

"I trust your newfound patron, Reynard Hannan, is paying you well?"

She smirks, then adds "You will learn soon enough just how you deserve one another."
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，一开口就带了刺。

"你那位新攀上的靠山 Reynard Hannan，给的价码还满意吧？"

她嘴角一挑，又补了句："过不了多久你就明白，你们俩是怎么凑到一块的了。"

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, a distinct edge in her voice.

"I was disappointed to hear of your support for Horus Yaribay's nearly treasonous scheme - in direct contradiction to the agreement you and I came to on Yesod."

She raises an eyebrow. "Oh yes - I know about it. Horus should count himself lucky that I am so fond of him, and so patient. I shudder to think how it would look if the All-League Council were to hear of his... pursuits."

"Watch yourself, captain," she says.
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话里带着明晃晃的刺。

"听说你替 Horus Yaribay 那套近乎谋逆的把戏撑腰，我很失望——这和你在 Yesod 同我谈定的约定，可是正面相左。"

她挑了挑眉。"没错——我都知道。Horus 该庆幸我待他有几分情分，又耐得住性子。真要让全联盟议会听见他那些... 勾当，我都不敢想会闹成什么样。"

"自己当心，舰长，" 她说道。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, a distinct edge in her voice.

"I was disappointed to hear of your support for Horus Yaribay's nearly treasonous scheme - in direct contradiction to the agreement you and I came to on Yesod, however purely mercenary it was."

She raises an eyebrow. "Oh yes - I know about it. Horus should count himself lucky that I am so fond of him, and so patient. I shudder to think how it would look if the All-League Council were to hear of his... pursuits."

"Watch yourself, captain," she says.
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话里带着明晃晃的刺。

"听说你替 Horus Yaribay 那套近乎谋逆的把戏撑腰，我很失望——也和你在 Yesod 同我谈妥的那份约定正面相左，纵然那约定从头到尾不过是桩买卖。"

她挑了挑眉。"没错——我都知道。Horus 该庆幸我待他有几分情分，又耐得住性子。真要让全联盟议会听见他那些... 勾当，我都不敢想会闹成什么样。"

"自己当心，舰长，" 她说道。

texts.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice. Her tone contains more than a touch of acid.

"I trust Reynard Hannan is more than pleased with your conspiracy of self-serving fools."
texts.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" 话音刚起 Fortuna 便已现身，语气里的酸味可不止一点。

"想来 Reynard Hannan 对你们这伙只顾自己的蠢货攒的局，满意得不能再满意了吧。"

options.en: You should back the Prime Demarchon against Fortuna Kato's scheme for Achilles.
options.zh: 您该站在大统领这边，别由着 Fortuna Kato 替 Achilles 张罗那套。

options.en: I can see why he's the man who leads the Persean League.
options.zh: 我明白为什么他能领导 英仙座联盟 了。

options.en: He's an insufferable egotist.
options.zh: 他是个令人难以忍受的自大狂。

options.en: What do you think of Reynard Hannan?
How can you let that man run the League like it's his own fiefdom?
options.zh: 你怎么能让那个男人把联盟当成他自己的领地来管理呢？

options.en: You mentioned Reynard is backing the Sindrian Diktat. And you're opposed.
options.zh: 您说过 Reynard 在给辛达强权撑腰，而您不赞成。

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 我们还是谈谈别的事吧。

texts.en:
"You truly believe I should?"

He looks strained.

"I suppose my Gens has much to gain if Fortuna's plans fail. To be second is no shameful thing. And I must look first to the safety of Gens Yaribay... our future which is inexorably bound to Gens Hannan."

He pauses, then muses, "There will always future opportunities."
texts.zh:
"您当真觉得我该这么做？"

他神色有些发紧。

"Fortuna 那套要是黄了，我这一族确有不少好处可捞。屈居第二也不算丢人。我总得先顾着 Yaribay 氏族的周全... 我们往后的路，早和 Hannan 氏族绑死在一处了。"

他顿了顿，慢悠悠地念了句："往后总还有机会。"

options.en: Do it. Gens Yaribay will be rewarded for your loyalty.
options.zh: 放手去做。您这份忠心，Yaribay 氏族会得到回报。

options.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
options.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity," he says. "I shall consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白，\" 他说道，\"您的劝，我会放在心上，$titlePL。"

texts.en: He pauses. "I appreciated your... discretion. With the Menes situation. Now too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"我很感激你的...谨慎。在 Menes 那件事上。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with High Hegemon Daud was much appreciated. Now, too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主 Daud 的联络，我很领情。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with the High Hegemon was much appreciated," he says. "To say nothing of your... discretion with the Menes situation. Just so, now."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主的联络，我很领情，"他说，"更不必说你在 Menes 那件事上的...谨慎。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity," he says. "I shall consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白，\" 他说道，\"您的劝，我会放在心上，$titlePL。"

texts.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity. I shall seriously consider your counsel, $titlePL."
texts.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我会认真想想您的劝，$titlePL。"

texts.en:
"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.
texts.zh:
"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

他神色仍有些不安，可难下的决心既已拿定，眉宇间倒添了几分沉稳。

texts.en:
"His ability, and the success that follows from great ability, are not difficult to perceive," he says.

"Gens Hannan PR sees to that, of course," Horus adds with an ironic smile. "Every victory of the League is Reynard's; every setback, another's mistake... which he is gracious enough to forgive, of course, in public."
texts.zh:
"他的能力，以及由此带来的成功，都是显而易见的。" 他说道。

"当然，Hannan 氏族的公关会确保这一点。" Horus 带着讽刺的微笑补充道，"联盟的每一次胜利都属于 Reynard，而每一次挫折，都是别人的错误...当然，他会在公开场合慷慨地原谅这些错误。"

texts.en: "True though that may be, his accomplishments are notable and do much to justify much," he pauses on the word, "of his presumption."
texts.zh: "尽管这可能是真的，" Horus 平静地说道，"但他的成就斐然，足以撑起他大部分的..."他刻意停顿片刻，再吐出那个词，"...'自负'。"

texts.en:
"Gens Hannan is powerful," he says, "and Reynard a man who knows well how to wield power."

"I respect his station and ability, though he and I agree on few matters of politics."
texts.zh:
"Hannan 氏族势力庞大，" 他说，"而 Reynard 是一个深知如何运用权力的人。"

"虽然我们在政治上鲜有共识，但我尊重他的地位和能力。"

texts.en:
"It is not as if he must ask my permission," Horus says.

He smiles quickly, as if to disarm what might be perceived as the slip of a politic facade.
texts.zh:
"他好像没必要征求我的同意。" Horus 说。

他迅速一笑，仿佛要化解可能被视作礼貌外表下的小失误。

texts.en:
"The Persean League has a rather permissive official relationship with the Sindrian Diktat, yes," he says. "At Reynard's command as Prime Demarchon."

"It is purely cynical. And that I might at least respect if it truly did forward League interests! But to make such allowance for brutish Andradaism demonstrates a cruel hypocrisy on behalf of the ideals the Persean League and its Prime Demarchon are supposed to embody."

He shakes his head, irritated.
texts.zh:
"英仙座联盟对辛达强权，官方上确实宽容得过分，是，\" 他说道，\"Reynard 以大统领的身份一句话定的调。"

"纯粹是拿利害算计。若真能替联盟挣来好处，我倒还敬他几分！可这般迁就野蛮的 Andrada 主义，对着英仙座联盟与它那位大统治理该守住的那些理念，简直是狠狠一记虚伪的耳光。"

他恼火地摇了摇头。

options.en: But... with Reynard, the gens. Isn't this what the League is?
options.zh: 可... 有 Reynard，有这些氏族，联盟不就是这么回事吗？

options.en: And I don't imagine the Hegemony approves.
options.zh: 想来霸主那边也不会点头吧。

options.en: I understand your position. (back)
options.zh: 您的意思我明白了。 (返回)

texts.en:
"No- yes, but."

Horus catches himself and gives you a consternated look.

"Do we simply give in to base motives or do we aim to uphold an ideal? That is the question. The former bears profit and power for some, but it is a... a disease, a parasite, that will eventually kill the host. Without the League, without some common cause, what are we but pirates?"
texts.zh:
"不——是，可是..."

Horus 自知失言，窘迫地看了你一眼。

"是索性向那些上不得台面的私欲低头，还是撑起一桩理想？问题就在这儿。前者能给某些人带来好处和权势，可那是... 是场病，是条寄生虫，早晚要把宿主拖死。没了联盟，没了点共同的念想，我们跟海盗还有什么两样？"

texts.en:
"No, of course not."

Horus crosses his arms.

"And I well understand the point you are getting at. I am no hypocrite for believing that support for the Diktat is foolish for its own sake as well as a barrier to my desire to approach a reconciliation with the Hegemony."
texts.zh:
"不，当然不会。"

Horus 抱起双臂。

"您想说什么，我明白。我一面觉得支持强权本身就蠢，一面又嫌它挡了我同霸主修好的路——这两样摆在一块，我可不觉得自己是伪君子。"

texts.en: Horus nods, his hands held relaxed together in front of him.
texts.zh: Horus 点点头，双手放松地交握在身前。

texts.en: He pauses. "I appreciated your... discretion. With the Menes situation. Now too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"我很感激你的...谨慎。在 Menes 那件事上。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with High Hegemon Daud was much appreciated. Now, too."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主 Daud 的联络，我很领情。这一次也一样。"

texts.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with the High Hegemon was much appreciated," he says. "To say nothing of your... discretion with the Menes situation. Just so, now."

texts.en:
"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.

"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

他神色仍有些不安，可难下的决心既已拿定，眉宇间倒添了几分沉稳。

texts.en:
"You're proving useful to Provost Baird - an admirable figure generally - yet one who stubbornly ties herself to the Hegemony bureaucracy."

"If it weren't for Kallichore's blundering..." Her eyes grow distant - more distant - for a moment, then return to their usual unblinking detachment.

"Here at Tri-Tachyon, we put the highest value in unrestrained R&D. Especially its dividends." She smiles coyly. "So, I think, do you."
texts.zh:
"你对 Baird 院长 —— 一位总体而言值得敬佩的人物 —— 很有助益，可惜她固执地将自己捆绑在霸主的官僚体系上。"

"若非 Kallichore 的愚蠢行径..." 她的目光变得遥远 —— 更加遥远 —— 片刻后又恢复惯常的漠然。

"在 速子科技，我们最看重的就是不受束缚的研发。特别是其红利。" 她狡黠一笑，"我想，你也这么认为。"

texts.en:
"You've proven useful to Provost Baird. And your accomplishment with the Gates..."

She puts her hands together, not quite a single clap for all you've done. Her politely mechanical smile contains some bitterness, you sense.

"I admire Baird, truly I do. Her ability to overcome Hegemony stone-walling, and herding those academics with their notions... sadly, though, it appears as though her grip was too tight. Pity to lose top talent."

The bitterness, you see, has left Glamor-Rotanev's smile to be replaced with something more carnivorous.

"Our R&D is cutting-edge, eminently practical, and there's very little risk of runaways. Our results might match your ambitions, I think."
texts.zh:
"你已向 Baird 院长证明了自己。而你在星门方面的成就..."

她双手合十，却未能为你所做的一切拍响掌声。你察觉到她那礼貌机械的微笑中带着一丝苦涩。

"我敬佩 Baird，真心实意。她突破 霸主 阻挠的能力，以及她驾驭那些学者们的理念...可惜，似乎她抓得太紧了。损失顶尖人才总是遗憾。"

你看见那抹苦涩已从 Glamor-Rotanev 的微笑中褪去，取而代之的是某种更食肉性的神色。

"我们的研发是最前沿的，极为务实，且失控风险极低。我想，我们的成果或许能匹配你的抱负。"

texts.en:
"We see you've taken up an interest with the Luddi- pardon me, with the Church of Galactic Redemption. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so otherwise practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到你开始关注卢德 —— 抱歉，是 银河救赎教会 的事务。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more and better than that. I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Do you?"
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。"

她精准地扬起眉毛，"你觉得呢？"

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more than that. Better than that. And I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors. That silly little battleship he gave you? A child's toy compared to what I offer."

She brushes one hand off with the other.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。至于给你的那艘愚蠢的小战舰？与我提供的相比，那不过是孩童的玩具。"

她用一只手拂开另一只手。

texts.en:
"Old reports noted your service to Mr. Macario - sorry, 'The Chief High Inspector' - and took has taken you for one of his pawns. But you've managed both to unseat him and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Nonetheless, you and I both know you're more and better than service to that blinkered tin-pot dictatorship. I believe your potential could be worth more than those little bribes and medals they distribute."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Don't you agree?"
texts.zh:
"旧档案里记着你替 Macario 先生办过事——抱歉，是'最高检察长'先生——便把你当他的一枚棋子。可你不光把他掀下台，还一路送他上了绝路。干得漂亮。"

"话虽如此，你我心里都清楚，替那个目光短浅的小独裁政权当差，未免埋没了你。我看你的本事，值的可不止他们发的那点贿赂和勋章。"

她精确地挑了挑眉。"你说是不是？"

texts.en:
"Old reports described you as a pawn of Mr. Macario, the former 'Chief High Inspector' of the Sindrian Diktat. But it seems they got you wrong."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Achilles, I believe it's name is - you've managed to unseat him from his position."

"But Achilles? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and chant of 'reforms'. It soothes the ears of small men with small greeds. But I," she smiles oddly, "am no such man."
texts.zh:
"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Achilles——把他从位子上掀了下来。"

"可 Achilles？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章和'改革'口号。那套话哄得住贪小便宜的小人物，可我，\" 她笑得有些古怪，\"可不是那种人。"

texts.en:
"I must applaud your patriotism - the Hegemony, the restoration of the Domain!

She makes as if to clap, daintily, but stops her hands before they meet. Then turns her expression toward something far more cynical.

"You may earn the favor of that stubborn 'Old Man Daud'. But is that enough? Surely you tire of that paltry government stipend, the endless regulation? It must stifle your ambition. You must yearn for a truly dynamic enterprise. One in which someone like yourself can change the Sector..."
texts.zh:
"我必须为你的爱国情怀喝彩 —— 为了 霸主，为了 人之领 的复兴！"

她优雅地摆出鼓掌的架势，却在双手相触前停下。随即换上一副远为讥诮的表情。

"你或许能赢得那位固执的 'Daud 老爷子' 的青睐，但这足够吗？你定然已经厌倦那微薄的政府津贴和无尽的规章吧？那必定扼杀了你的雄心。你必然渴望真正充满活力的事业，一个能让你这样的人改变这片星域的事业..."

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you, but not so much that they've invited you to share power as a member," she says.

"Why play the mercenary for below-market rates? You're better than that, I think."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，但并未邀请你作为成员共享权力，" 她说道。

"为何要以低于市场的价格扮演雇佣兵？我想，你值得更好的待遇。"

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you," she looks down, and aside, placing a hand on the empty expanse of her enormous desk.

"But not enough to invite you to become a full member of the League, despite your colonial enterprise." She makes a small sound, halfways between pity and disappointment.

"Consider what you will gain from being a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，" 她垂目侧视，将手放在自己那空阔的巨大桌面上。

"但尽管你有殖民事业，但他们仍未邀请你成为联盟的正式成员。" 她发出轻微的声响，介于怜悯与失望之间。

"不妨想想成为合作伙伴而非从属者后，你将获得什么。"

texts.en:
"You're a member of the League. A junior member, however. Perhaps not in name, but... tell me, do the gens respect you as a peer?"

"Or are you just another vassal to their little empire? Consider your future, captain, and how you might truly achieve greatness."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你是联盟的一员，尽管只是下级成员。或许名义上不是，但...告诉我，氏族势力可曾将你视为平辈？"

"抑或你只是他们那小小帝国的又一个附庸？考量你的未来吧，舰长，思考你该如何真正地成就伟业。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me the truth, are you content to be a mere lackey of our mutual friend Reynard Hannan? He drains you like a leech from atop his so-called League. Let me give you a taste of real business, of real credits."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"说实话，你甘于当我们共同朋友 Reynard Hannan 的区区仆从吗？他高踞在所谓的联盟顶端，如蚂蟥般榨取你的价值。不妨让我带你体验真正的生意，真正的星币。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me, how is Rayan Arroyo? I've always admired his entrepreneurial spirit, but." She forms a little smile that might have been apologetic if it weren't so condescending.

"He doesn't have the killer instinct required for senior leadership. Isn't that funny? But we do need people like him."

"And we need people like you. Go-getters, achievers; builders and destroyers. And what we need, we at Tri-Tachyon pay for. Only the best."
texts.zh:
"告诉我，Rayan Arroyo 近况如何？我一直欣赏他的企业家精神，但是..." 她露出一个本该是歉意的微笑，却透着居高临下的意味。

"他缺乏高层领导所需的杀手本能。这很有趣，不是吗？但我们的确需要像他这样的人。"

"我们也需要你这样的人。行动派，实干家；建设者与毁灭者。而我们 速子科技 对于需要的事物，向来只聘用最顶尖的人才。"

texts.en:
"You cut a deal with the Company after some... assertive negotiations. To our mutual benefit. I applaud your audacity."

Her teeth glisten.

"Such fierce initiative is exactly what Tri-Tachyon needs."
texts.zh:
"经过一番...强势谈判后，你与公司达成了协议。这对我们双方都有利，我赞赏你的胆识。"

她的牙齿闪闪发光。

"如此凌厉的进取心正是 速子科技 所需要的。"

texts.en:
"You've had a taste of working for the Company. A mundane commission, mercenary fare. Boilerplate. Busywork. We'd have automated all that sort of thing long ago, of course, if not for-"

She pulls her gaze back down. "I digress. You're capable of much more. Think of this as the next step."
texts.zh:
"你已浅尝过为公司效力的滋味。无聊的差事，雇佣兵的薪酬。千篇一律。无谓的忙碌。若非某些原因，我们早该将这类工作全面自动化了 ——"

她将视线收回，"好吧，我有些离题了。我相信你有能力成就更多，远不止于此。请将此视为迈向更高层级的阶梯。"

texts.en:
"You're not only an explorer, you're a builder - founding a new colony!"

"It is bold of you to strike out despite the anti-innovation measures sure to fall upon you from the major factions," she says. "I suspect you'll benefit from an injection of capital. For the builder must also ensure that their prosperity cannot be simply seized by the small-minded takers."
texts.zh:
"你不仅是探索者，更是建设者 —— 你正在建立新的殖民地！"

"在各大势力必将施加反创新措施的背景下，你的开拓之举堪称勇毅，" 她说道，"我认为资本的注入将助你一臂之力。因为建设者必须确保自己的繁荣果实不会被眼界狭隘的掠夺者轻易夺取。"

texts.en: "I believe that's enough of that, captain," she says stonily.
texts.zh: "我想这个话题可以到此为止了，舰长，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en:
Her expression is blank for a moment.

"On second thought, I feel no need to justify myself," she says stonily.
texts.zh:
她的表情凝固了片刻。

"转念一想，我觉得我无需自证，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en: "Now allow me to explain the shape of our partnership."
texts.zh: "现在请允许我阐明我们合作关系的框架。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. You found something very old in the Abyss. Something known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。你在深渊中发现了非常古老的存在，历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. The ship is in your fleet - what is known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。那所正位于你舰队中的舰船 —— 历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "You know my title. I take a portion of surplus capital from the Company and invest it in what we like to call 'black sky initiatives'."
texts.zh: "你知道我的头衔。我从公司提取部分盈余的资本，投入我们称之为 '黑天计划' 的领域。"
