texts.en:
Dolos Macario displays sadness, deep concern, and a careful touch of righteous anger.

"My fellow, loyal, citizens of the Sindrian Diktat. I address not only you but all right-thinking people of the Persean Sector. All who uphold law and order in troubled times."

(Some off-duty Hegemony officers at the end of the bar boo and jeer. Several spacers join in.)
texts.zh:
Dolos Macario 脸上显出悲伤、深切的忧虑，以及一丝拿捏得当的义愤。

"辛达强权忠诚的同胞们。我不只是在向你们说话，也是在向英仙座星域所有明事理的人说话。向所有在乱世中维护法律与秩序的人说话。"

(酒吧尽头几名休班的霸主军官发出嘘声与嘲骂。几个太空人也跟着起哄。)

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I have provided evidence of a disturbing conspiracy which threatens everything we hold dear." He holds for a moment.

"Until now our dear leader, Supreme Executor Philip Andrada, has kept his progeny secret - entrusted to caretakers for protection and to provide a traditional upbringing far from the corrupting influence of celebrity and wealth. Given an honest start to life, as any father would wish for his sons, for these many past cycles."

"Until recently," his voice finally cracks, "they were safe."

He closes his eyes and takes a shuddering breath, appearing to suppress a sob.
texts.zh:
"我已提交证据，证明一场令人不安的阴谋正在威胁我们所珍视的一切。"他停顿了一瞬。

"直到今天，我们敬爱的领袖、最高元首 Philip Andrada 一直将自己的子嗣藏在暗处——托付给看护人抚养，既为保护他们，也为了让他们在远离名声与财富腐蚀的地方接受传统的教养。让他们有一个诚实的起点，正如任何一位父亲对自己儿子的期望，这么多星历年都是如此。"

"直到不久之前，\"他的声音终于裂了，\"他们都是安全的。"

他闭上眼，吸了一口气，肩膀发颤，像是在压住一声呜咽。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He appears to regain his composure.

"A mad spacer has made it $playerHisOrHer personal mission to... to murder the innocent children of Philip Andrada. The heirs to his project, his very bloodline!"

Macario looks up now, into the holosensor, eyes wide; reddened but not weeping - no, not now - now is the time to take hard action.

"Rest assured," his voice deepens, his hands, held together, raise up from his desk. "My organization has brought the sole remaining survivor of this murderous rampage into protection and we have taken all appropriate measures to ensure his security."
texts.zh:
他似乎重新稳住了情绪。

"一个疯狂的太空人，把杀害 Philip Andrada 那些无辜的孩子当成了 $playerHisOrHer 毕生的使命。那是他事业的继承人，是他真正的血脉！"

Macario 这时抬起头，望向全息传感器，双眼睁得很大；眼眶发红，却没有落泪——不，不是现在——现在是采取强硬行动的时候。

"请放心，\"他的声音沉了下去，交握的双手从桌面上抬起，\"我的机构已将这场屠杀中唯一的幸存者纳入保护，并已采取一切适当措施确保他的安全。"

texts.en:
He appears to regain his composure.

"A mad spacer somehow lied $playerHisOrHer way into a commission with the Sindrian Diktat. $PlayerHeOrShe made it a personal mission to... to murder the innocent children of Philip Andrada. The heirs to his project, his very bloodline!" His voice goes soft for a moment. "It is the foulest treachery one can imagine."

Macario looks up now, into the holosensor, eyes wide; reddened but not weeping - no, not now - now is the time to take hard action.

"Rest assured," his voice deepens, his hands, held together, raise up from his desk. "My organization has brought the sole remaining survivor into our protection and we have taken all appropriate measures to ensure his security."
texts.zh:
他似乎重新稳住了情绪。

"一个疯狂的太空人，靠着 $playerHisOrHer 的谎言，骗到了一份辛达强权的委任。$PlayerHeOrShe 把杀害 Philip Andrada 那些无辜的孩子当成了自己的使命。那是他事业的继承人，是他真正的血脉！\"他的声音软了一瞬，\"这是能想象到的最卑劣的背叛。"

Macario 这时抬起头，望向全息传感器，双眼睁得很大；眼眶发红，却没有落泪——不，不是现在——现在是采取强硬行动的时候。

"请放心，\"他的声音沉了下去，交握的双手从桌面上抬起，\"我的机构已将唯一的幸存者纳入我们的保护，并已采取一切适当措施确保他的安全。"

texts.en: "We shall not let one cowardly murderer, one senseless terrorist, shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
texts.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手、一个毫无理智的恐怖分子打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

options.en: Continue

options.en: Continue

options.en: Continue

texts.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手——一个受堕落的 Kazeron 贵族雇用的、毫无理智的恐怖分子——打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "We shall not let one loathsome traitor, one senseless terrorist - who swore a false loyalty to our beautiful cause - shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
texts.zh: "我们绝不容许一个可憎的叛徒——一个曾对我们美好的事业宣誓效忠、却背信弃义的、毫无理智的恐怖分子——打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

texts.en:
Now his voice fills with righteous anger.

"Look upon the coward! Hear me now, $playerName." He stares through the holo. "You will be hunted to the far fringe of the Persean Sector!"

He rises from his desk, gesticulating with a clenched fist, "We SHALL have justice!"

"Observe and report, loyal citizens! Any information you provide may prove useful as we track this murderous..."

You take a deep breath, processing the scope of Macario's scheme. He keeps talking.
texts.zh:
这时他的声音里涨满了义愤。

"看看这个懦夫！听好了，$playerName。\"他透过全息影像直盯着你，\"你将被追猎到英仙座星域最远的边陲！"

他从桌后站起身，攥紧拳头比划着，"我们必将讨回正义！"

"忠诚的公民们，注意观察、及时举报！你们提供的任何情报，在我们追踪这个嗜血的..."

你深吸一口气，掂量着 Macario 这盘棋的规模。他还在说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Now his voice fills with righteous anger.

"Look upon the traitor! Hear me now, $playerName." He stares through the holo. "You are stripped of your commission. You will be hunted to the far fringe of the Persean Sector!"

He rises from his desk, gesticulating with a clenched fist, "We SHALL uphold justice!"

"Observe and report, loyal citizens! Any information you provide may prove useful as we track this murderous..."

You take a deep breath, processing the scope of Macario's scheme. He keeps talking.
texts.zh:
这时他的声音里涨满了义愤。

"看看这个叛徒！听好了，$playerName。\"他透过全息影像直盯着你，\"你的委任状已被剥夺。你将被追猎到英仙座星域最远的边陲！"

他从桌后站起身，攥紧拳头比划着，"我们必将维护正义！"

"忠诚的公民们，注意观察、及时举报！你们提供的任何情报，在我们追踪这个嗜血的..."

你深吸一口气，掂量着 Macario 这盘棋的规模。他还在说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: You notice the spacer at the next table turn to re-examine your face.
texts.zh: 你注意到邻桌的太空人转过头来，重新打量你的脸。

texts.en: You notice the spacer at the next table turn to re-examine your face. And another, two down.
texts.zh: 你注意到邻桌的太空人转过头来，重新打量你的脸。再过去两桌，又有一个。

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat. I shall not recklessly name her... or him until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then another, from a couple tables over.
texts.zh:
"...还有一名同谋，一个就藏在辛达强权政府内部的高层叛徒。在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地点出她...或者他的名字，但请放心，正义必将迅速而确凿。接下来还会有..."

接着，隔了两张桌子的又一个人转过头来。

options.en: It appears to be time to leave

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
texts.zh:
"...还有一名同谋，一个就藏在辛达强权政府内部的高层叛徒，此人的背叛已堕落到向 $playerName 提供一艘神圣的 Executor 级战舰——那是最高元首亲手设计的战列舰。"

他低下头片刻，仿佛在硬扛这桩恶行带来的伤痛与羞辱。

"在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地点出她...或者他的名字，但请放心，正义必将迅速而确凿。接下来还会有..."

随后，隔了两张桌子，又一名太空人转头望向你。

options.en: Time to leave

texts.en: Your bodyguards throw a disposable poncho over you as they hustle you out a side-door; you could pass as any civilian girded against the drip of poorly-tuned life support conduits.
texts.zh: 护卫们把一件一次性斗篷披到你身上，簇拥着你从侧门匆匆离开；此刻你看起来就像任何一个寻常平民，裹着斗篷抵挡调校不良的生命维持导管滴下的冷凝水。

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat. I shall not recklessly name her... or him until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then another, from a couple tables over.
texts.zh: ...与一位同谋，辛达强权政府内部的一名高层叛徒。在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地说出她...或他的名字，但请放心，报应会来得又快又准。还会有...

options.en: Enough, shut that off!
It appears to be time to leave

"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
texts.zh:
...与一位同谋，辛达强权政府内部的一名高层叛徒——其背叛行径甚至到了向 $playerName 提供一台神圣 “执行者” 战舰的地步，那是一艘由最高执行者本人设计的战列舰。

他低头看着...

options.en: Enough, shut that off!
It appears to be time to leave

texts.en: It takes a moment for the bartender to realize who the shout came from - then they leap to obey, cowering apologetically.
texts.zh: 酒保花了一会儿才意识到喊声来自谁——然后他们连忙照办，畏缩着道歉。

texts.en:
You leave the bar flanked by bodyguards. Most of the patrons know better than to gawk at the executive leader of their present polity.

The corridors are quiet. Nonetheless, a squad of MuniSec joins your party, less from fear of a mob than the desire of the local section enforcer to earn your esteem.
texts.zh:
你在保镖的簇拥下离开酒吧。大多数顾客都知道不该盯着他们当前政体的行政首脑看。

走廊里很安静。尽管如此，一队市政安全兵加入了你的队伍，与其说是怕暴民，不如说是想...

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Macario's attack on your reputation, even if rejected as Sindrian black propaganda, nonetheless makes you an inconvenient friend.

And a target for bounty hunters and assassins, no doubt.

It's unthinkable to simply sit back and allow this to be done to you. You carefully consider how you should react.
texts.zh:
Macario 对你名声的攻击，即便被当作辛达的黑宣传而不被采信，也足以让你成为一个令人为难的朋友。

而且毫无疑问，会让你成为赏金猎人与刺客的目标。

坐视这一切落到自己头上，是无法想象的。你仔细思量自己该如何应对。

texts.en:
You'll tear apart the Spider's web and crush him like a bug.

He made it personal and you're going to show him the only way this can be allowed to end.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要撕碎他这张蜘蛛网，像碾死一只虫子那样碾碎他。

他把这事变成了私人恩怨，而你要让他看清，这件事唯一被允许的结局是什么。

首先就有一个大问题。

options.en: He's sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 他安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
You'll tear apart the Spider's web and crush him like a bug.

He made it personal and you're going to show him the only way this can be allowed to end.

There is a big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要撕碎他这张蜘蛛网，像碾死一只虫子那样碾碎他。

他把这事变成了私人恩怨，而你要让他看清，这件事唯一被允许的结局是什么。

首先就有个大问题。

options.en: He took my Sindrian Diktat commission.
options.zh: 他夺走了我的辛达强权委任状。

texts.en:
Are you loyal to the Sindrian Diktat?

Without your commission, declared a terrorist and target of a kill-on-sight order, how can you demonstrate your support for the next Supreme Executor?
texts.zh:
你忠于辛达强权吗？

没了委任状，又被宣布为恐怖分子、成了格杀勿论令的目标，你还怎么向下一任最高元首表明你的支持？

options.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Diktat! There must be a way.
options.zh: 我忠于辛达强权！总有办法的。

options.en: None of that matters to me.
options.zh: 那些对我来说都无所谓。

texts.en:
What loyalty you had to the Sindrian Diktat is as void and null as your former commission. It is the natural consequence of betrayal.

This brings you to the second problem.
texts.zh:
你对辛达强权曾有过的忠诚，已和你从前的委任状一样归于无效。这是背叛的必然结果。

这就引出了第二个问题。

options.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

They will all thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，所有人都会感谢你。

首先就有一个大问题。

options.en: He's sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 他安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
You've told Fortuna Kato you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor. By doing so, he'll tear down the Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from Macario's ruthless manipulation.

They will thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，你会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。这样一来，他就能拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从 Macario 冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，他们会感谢你的。

首先就有一个大问题。

options.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

You've even told Fortuna Kato that you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor so long as she makes it worth your time. Her first payment was but a taste.

If Achilles wins, you get paid. If Achilles wins, Macario loses. What's not to like?

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

你甚至已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，只要她出的价对得起你的时间，你就会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。她付的第一笔，不过是个开头。

Achilles 赢了，你拿钱。Achilles 赢了，Macario 就输了。有什么不好？

首先就有一个大问题。

options.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation. You did deny Fortuna Kato's request to back Achilles' bid to become Supreme Executor, even if his victory would implicitly remove Macario from power.

You'll just have to ensure it happens by some other means.

And there's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。你确实拒绝了 Fortuna Kato 要你支持 Achilles 争夺最高元首之位的请求，尽管他的胜利会顺带让 Macario 失去权力。

你只能另想办法，确保这件事发生。

而首先，就有个大问题。

options.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
He's put you in a tough spot and made himself your problem. Perhaps you can avoid Macario and the fallout from his schemes.

But Macario did declare you a psychotic, murderous terrorist in front of the entire Persean Sector, and the number one enemy of the Sindrian Diktat.

It won't be easy to ignore.
texts.zh:
他把你逼进一个难堪的境地，也把自己变成了你的麻烦。也许你可以避开 Macario，避开他那些算计带来的余波。

可 Macario 毕竟当着整个英仙座星域宣布你是个嗜血的疯子恐怖分子，是辛达强权的头号敌人。

想置之不理，没那么容易。

options.en: I'll just have to do my best

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power. He never cared for Andrada's vision, however faded it became in those final cycles. A true heir to Philip Andrada must stand and take up the mantle, throw off Macario's web of lies, and usher in a new age.

Not as a puppet. As a leader.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，除了自己的权力，他什么都不信。Andrada 的愿景在最后那些星历年里无论褪色到什么地步，他也从未真正在意过。Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来，接过这份衣钵，挣脱 Macario 的谎言之网，开启一个新的时代。

不是当傀儡。是当领袖。
effects: #SetTooltip sdse_introMacarioSDchooseSelf "Those clones are bloodless copies of a great man. They have not proven themselves through glory, ambition, and battle... as you have."

options.en: Macario must be removed; Hector should lead the Sindrian Diktat
options.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Hector 来领导

options.en:
Macario must be removed; Achilles should lead the Sindrian Diktat
#sdse_introMacarioSDchooseSelf:I must become Supreme Executor and lead the Sindrian Diktat
options.zh:
必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Achilles 来领导

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing, who wants nothing but to play cruel games with the lives of those in his power.

He'll cause more chaos and death - unless someone takes charge of the Sindrian Diktat and frees it from his corrupting influence.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，什么都不信，只想拿那些落到他手里的人的性命，玩残酷的游戏。

他会造出更多的混乱与死亡——除非有人接管辛达强权，把它从他腐蚀性的影响中解救出来。

options.en: Macario must be removed; Achilles should lead the Sindrian Diktat
options.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Achilles 来领导

options.en: Macario must be removed; Hector should lead the Sindrian Diktat
options.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Hector 来领导

options.en: It doesn't matter right now - Macario must be removed
options.zh: 现在这些都无所谓——必须除掉 Macario

texts.en: You decide that whatever happens, you need to remove Macario. Who will lead the Sindrian Diktat can be decided later.
texts.zh: 你决定，无论之后如何，Macario 都必须先除掉。至于谁来领导辛达强权，可以以后再说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Hector must lead the Sindrian Diktat - and not as Macario's puppet.

It won't be easy, because Macario has already poisoned Hector's opinion of you, judging by the recordings you experienced at 58966 Elysium.

But, surely, the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada will prevail.

The Blood of Andrada MUST prevail.
texts.zh:
Hector 必须领导辛达强权——而且不能做 Macario 的傀儡。

这不会容易，因为从你在 58966 Elysium 经历过的那些录像来看，Macario 已经在 Hector 心里把对你的看法毒化了。

但是，Philip Andrada 那套超凡的哲学终将胜出。

Andrada 的血脉必须胜出。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You decide that Achilles must lead the Sindrian Diktat.

He is not a puppet of Macario, and and he's much more than a weak echo of the worst side of Philip Andrada.

There is, of course, the matter of Fortuna Kato.

She intends to manipulate Achilles through her support of his cause. She claims he's a willing partner in the arrangement, but her goals are to recenter of power in the Persean League, perhaps even making Askonia a full League member...
texts.zh:
你决定，辛达强权必须由 Achilles 来领导。

他不是 Macario 的傀儡，也远不只是 Philip Andrada 最坏那一面的软弱回声。

当然，还有 Fortuna Kato 这一桩。

她打算借着支持他的事业来操纵他。她声称他在这桩安排里是自愿的伙伴，可她的目标是把权力重心重新搬回英仙座联盟，甚至可能让 Askonia 成为联盟的正式成员...

options.en: And that's fine, Fortuna's plan for Achilles is the best outcome
options.zh: 那也无妨，Fortuna 为 Achilles 安排的路就是最好的结果

options.en: Fortuna Kato's plans must be thwarted as well
options.zh: Fortuna Kato 的算盘也必须打掉

options.en: Wait and see - first Achilles needs to beat Hector
options.zh: 静观其变——Achilles 得先打赢 Hector

texts.en:
Fortuna Kato must be stopped as well. But how?

Undermine her position within the League through the machinations of the other gens, Hannan and Yaribay? Or by ensuring that Achilles has an independent base of support - enough that he need not answer to Fortuna's beck and call?

A direct approach could undermine Achilles. You'll have to be clever.
texts.zh:
Fortuna Kato 也必须被拦住。可怎么拦？

借另外两个氏族——Hannan 与 Yaribay——的算计来动摇她在联盟里的地位？还是确保 Achilles 有一块独立的支持基础——大到他不必听凭 Fortuna 呼来喝去？

直接动手可能会害了 Achilles。你得聪明些。

options.en: The fact remains - Macario must be destroyed
options.zh: 事实不变——Macario 必须被摧毁

texts.en:
Fortuna Kato will do what is best for her - and for the Sector. She'll do her best to see that Achilles prevails.

The fact remains: Macario must be destroyed.
texts.zh:
Fortuna Kato 会做对她自己、也对星域最有利的事。她会尽力让 Achilles 胜出。

事实不变：Macario 必须被摧毁。

texts.en:
Internal conflicts can and should be set aside; they're a distraction from what's important. Achilles has a war to win.

And Macario must be destroyed.
texts.zh:
内部的纷争可以、也应该先搁到一边；那只会让人从要紧的事上分心。Achilles 还有一场战争要打赢。

而 Macario 必须被摧毁。

texts.en:
But how?

If you could smash through the fleets and capture Macario, you'd leave the pride of the Sindrian Diktat scattered and demoralized.

The one polity which embodies Andrada's Transcendent Ideology would be left vulnerable to invasion!

By the Hegemony. Or the Persean League. Or Luddic infiltrators...

Another war, another occupation. Industry razed, ships and stations blazing like short-lived stars; hundreds of thousands, possibly millions, left dead.
texts.zh:
可怎么做？

就算你能一路击穿那些舰队、抓住 Macario，你也会让辛达强权的骄傲四散溃逃、士气尽失。

那个唯一承载着 Andrada 超凡意识形态的政体，将被暴露在入侵之下！

来自霸主。或者英仙座联盟。或者卢德派的渗透者...

又一场战争，又一次占领。工业被夷平，舰船与空间站像短命的星辰一样燃烧；数十万人，也许数百万人，就此死去。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Besides, as soon as your fleet secured an orbit, he'd scurry away by one escape route or another to the safe houses he must have on half the worlds of the Persean Sector.

You have to be more subtle. You consider options and allies. Whoever you speak to first will send a signal about which faction you favor.
texts.zh:
再说，你的舰队一旦进入轨道，他就会从某条退路溜走，躲进他在英仙座星域半数星球上都备着的安全屋。

你得做得更隐蔽些。你权衡着手里的选项与潜在的盟友。你先去找谁，就等于向各方表明你偏向哪一边。

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power to play games with the lives of those around him. He'll cause more chaos and death before the end, unless someone can truly take charge of the Sindrian Diktat.

Not a puppet - a leader.

The true heir to Philip Andrada must rise.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个毫无信义的操弄者，除了自己那点玩弄他人性命的本事，他什么都不信。除非有人能真正接手辛达强权，否则在一切结束之前，他还会制造更多的混乱与死亡。

不是傀儡——是领袖。

Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来。

texts.en:
You are a believer in the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Your bear a commission - or did until Macario declared it away.

Macario must be reminded of the power of loyalty - your own, above all - and his own to Andrada's vision. The pomp and intellectualization of the transcendent ideology is superstructure upon the fundamental fact that power flows to those who possess the will to seize and master it.
texts.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权。你持有它的委任状——至少在 Macario 宣布作废之前还持有。

必须让 Macario 想起忠诚的分量——尤其是你的忠诚——以及他对 Andrada 构想的忠诚。那套超凡意识形态的排场与高谈阔论，不过是上层建筑；底下那个根本事实是：权力归于那些有意志去夺取并驾驭它的人。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult, however. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting would undermine your cause.
texts.zh: 不过，建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了那些防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在这种无谓的厮杀里，也只会削弱你自己的事业。

options.en: There must be another way...

texts.en:
You are a believer in the power of the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Macario would wield that power, but he's a fool to try to discard his best ally in attaining power - perhaps even his better.

As satisfying as it would be to prove this to him by smashing down his office doors at the head of a squad of marines, this is a matter that requires opening with a round of negotiation.

Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting does not serve your purpose.
texts.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权的力量。Macario 想驾驭这份力量，可若他在夺权的路上抛弃自己最好的盟友，那他就是个蠢货——那位盟友或许还比他更胜一筹。

带着一队陆战队砸开他办公室的大门、当面向他证明这一点，固然痛快，但这件事得先以一轮谈判开场。

建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在无谓的厮杀里也达不到你的目的。

options.en: There must be another way...

texts.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and set everything right.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，把一切拨回正轨。

options.en: I must confront Macario and make him recognize his error
options.zh: 我必须当面质问 Macario，让他认清自己的错误

texts.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and give him one last chance to correct himself before you show him the true meaning of power.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，在他见识到权力的真正含义之前，给他最后一次改过的机会。

options.en: It must be done. Macario must be shown the error of his ways
options.zh: 必须这么做。必须让 Macario 看清他错在哪里

texts.en: If you could smash through those fleets and capture Macario, you'd leave the pride of the Sindrian Diktat scattered and demoralized. The polity would be vulnerable to intervention from the Hegemony, or perhaps even Achilles Andrada with Persean League backing.
texts.zh: 如果你能击穿那些舰队、擒住 Macario，辛达强权引以为傲的军力将四散溃败、士气尽失。这个政权就会脆弱到任人介入——霸主会来，甚至可能有英仙座联盟撑腰的 Achilles Andrada。

texts.en:
Smashing through Diktat fleets to capture Macario has an appealing directness. But he'll scurry away by one escape route or another as soon as you entered orbit.

You have to be more subtle. You consider options. And allies. Whoever you speak to first may send signals about your loyalties and priorities...
texts.zh:
击穿强权舰队、擒下 Macario，这种直截了当的做法颇有吸引力。可你一旦进入轨道，他就会从某条退路溜走。

你得做得更隐蔽。你权衡着选项，还有盟友。你先去找谁，或许就会透露出你的忠诚与轻重缓急...

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

You'll find your opening.
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

你会找到突破口的。

Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With Rao's help, with the assets of the Hegemony behind you, you'll find your opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Rao 相助，有霸主的资源在背后支撑，你会找到突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With the help of Inesis - and it might take a little negotiation or, failing that, bribery - you'll be able to identify an opening. There may be other potential allies as well...

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly. Hector must make his move, and soon - then Achilles will follow.

With Caden in command of the Lion's Guard fleet and paramilitary forces his backing may make all the difference to Hector's success - and, in turn, Macario's.

There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。Hector 必须出手，而且要快——然后 Achilles 才会跟上。

有 Caden 统率狮心卫队舰队与准军事部队，他的支持或许会决定 Hector 的成败——反过来，也会决定 Macario 的成败。

也许还有别的潜在盟友...

options.en: But how do I contact Caden if I am shoot-on-sight?
options.zh: 可我一露面就会遭到攻击，怎么联系 Caden？

texts.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Caden. Give his fanaticism a push in the right (or wrong) direction.
texts.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Caden 通话了。给他那份狂热推一把，推向正确 (或者错误) 的方向。

options.en: It'll have to do

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly. Hector must make his move, and soon - then Achilles will follow.

With Hyder in command of the Sindrian Diktat navy, her backing may make all the difference. And she may be willing to leave Macario exposed. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。Hector 必须出手，而且要快——然后 Achilles 才会跟上。

有 Hyder 统率辛达强权海军，她的支持或许会起决定作用。而且她也许愿意让 Macario 露出破绽。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wanted to install herself as Supreme Executor. He may move against her sooner than later.
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想把自己推上最高元首之位。他也许很快就会对她动手。

texts.en: You recall telling Caden that Hyder wants to become Supreme Executor. He dismissed it at the time...
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Hyder 想当最高元首。他当时没当回事...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wants to defect to the Hegemony. He might take action against her.
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想叛投霸主。他也许会因此对她采取行动。

texts.en: You recall telling Caden that Macario backs Hyder, surely leading to some resentment on Caden's part...
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Macario 在背后支持 Hyder——这想必让 Caden 生出几分怨恨...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario contradictory 'facts' about Hyder's intentions, which did not endear you to him. but will he act against Hyder nonetheless based on any of it?
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 讲过关于 Hyder 意图的种种自相矛盾的'事实'，这并没让你在他那里讨到好。可他会不会仍然依据其中某一条，对 Hyder 下手？

options.en: But how do I contact Hyder if I am shoot-on-sight?
options.zh: 可我一露面就会遭到攻击，怎么联系 Hyder？

texts.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Hyder and explain the situation.
texts.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Hyder 通话，向她说明情况。

options.en: It'll have to do

texts.en:
"No doubt," he says.

"Well. What a... bold proposal, captain. Quite exceptional. Thank you for sharing your intentions with me."

He refolds his hand neatly, and politely.

"Well," he says, putting a smile on his face. "Two items do come to mind, if I may review them with you. It'll take but a moment."
texts.zh:
"那是自然，"他说。

"唔。这可是个...大胆的提议，舰长。相当出格。感谢你把意图告诉我。"

他把双手重新交叠好，动作整齐而客气。

"那么，\"他脸上挂起笑容，\"我倒是想到了两件事，可否与你过一遍。花不了多少时间。"

options.en: Proceed.

texts.en:
He blinks, considers for a moment, then nods with apparent satisfaction.

"Good. Yes. Thank you, $titlePL. I shall only hope that she... takes your advice to, ah, heart."
texts.zh:
他眨了眨眼，沉吟片刻，然后带着显而易见的满意点了点头。

"很好。是的。谢谢你，$titlePL。我只希望她...能把你的建议，呃，放在心上。"

texts.en:
You can tell Siyavong is suppressing some expression.

"I... wish you success, $titlePL," he says.
texts.zh:
你看得出，Siyavong 正压着某种表情。

"我...祝你成功，$titlePL，"他说。

options.en: So I'll do it if he approves. Is that good enough for you?
options.zh: 那只要他认可，我就去做。这样你满意吗？

texts.en:
He raises an eyebrow skeptically, gives a small, affirmative nod. "We can work with that."

Then picks up his datapad once more.
texts.zh:
他怀疑地挑起一边眉毛，微微颔首。"这我们可以接受。"

然后又一次拿起数据板。

texts.en:
He raises an eyebrow skeptically, gives a small, affirmative nod. "We can work with that."

Then picks up his datapad once more.
texts.zh:
他怀疑地挑起一边眉毛，微微颔首。"这我们可以接受。"

然后又一次拿起数据板。

texts.en:
"I am disappointed to have had no word from Arnaud Iscare on Nortia," Horus says with a concerned look.

"My, ah, trusted contacts quite insist that it would assist in securing a beneficial outcome in Askonia. So please, captain, see that it is done promptly."
texts.zh:
"Nortia 的 Arnaud Iscare 一直没有消息，我很失望，"Horus 面带忧虑地说。

"我那些，呃，可信的联系人坚持认为，这会有助于在 Askonia 争取一个有利的结果。所以，舰长，请务必尽快办妥。"

texts.en:
"I have had word from Arnaud Iscare that you've helped secure some material assistance for the ACA on Nortia," Horus says.

"Please see that he received everything he needs so that we may see, ah, a most beneficial settlement once this terrible crisis is over."
texts.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 来信了，说你在 Nortia 帮 ACA 弄到了一批物资援助，"Horus 说。

"请确保他拿到了所需的一切，好让这场可怕的危机结束后，我们能看到一个，呃，极为有利的结局。"

texts.en:
"Arnaud Iscare informed me that you've given the Nortia ACA everything they need," Horus says, allowing himself a hopeful smile. "My... trusted contacts would like to relay their thanks and appreciation."

"Allow me to provide you with credits to offset the risks you have taken and - well, we may consider it a reward, I suppose."
texts.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 告诉我，你已经把 Nortia 的 ACA 需要的一切都给了他们，\"Horus 说，难得露出一个带着希望的笑容。\"我那些...可信的联系人想转达他们的感谢与赞赏。"

"请允许我给你一些星币，补偿你承担的风险，还有——嗯，我们不妨就把它当成一笔报酬吧。"

texts.en:
"I am aware of Macario's assertions," she says regally. "I assume that is, broadly, why you are now here."

She waits, content to let you begin.
texts.zh:
"Macario 的那些说法我知道，\"她威严地说。\"我想，大致上，这就是你现在来这里的原因。"

她等着，乐意让你先开口。

options.en: My primary concern is the credits you've offered for my services.
options.zh: 我最关心的是你为我效劳开出的星币。

options.en: I view us as partners. Helping me will help our joint venture.
options.zh: 我把我们看作伙伴。帮我，就是帮我们共同的事业。

options.en: My primary concern is ensuring that Achilles defeats Hector.
options.zh: 我最关心的是确保 Achilles 击败 Hector。

options.en: Yes, he's somewhat dampened my mood.
options.zh: 是啊，他多少坏了我的心情。

texts.en:
She produces a cold smile.

"Your dedication to the cause is noted. But mind that Macario's slander will hinder your operations so they must be given a reply."
texts.zh:
她露出一个冷淡的微笑。

"你对事业的忠诚，我记下了。但要注意，Macario 的诽谤会妨碍你的行动，所以必须给他一个回击。"

texts.en:
Fortuna looks over and taps at a TriPad.

"I have professionals who will see to a media campaign. Their efforts will take some time to culminate."
texts.zh:
Fortuna 看了一眼，点了点一台 TriPad。

"我手下有专业的人去操办一场媒体攻势。他们的努力需要些时间才能见效。"

texts.en:
Her eyes flick to yours, through the link.

"-In due course. Meanwhile, I recall your expression of support for my cause and, by extension, that of Achilles."
texts.zh:
隔着通讯链路，她的目光扫向你。

"——到时候自会办妥。同时，我记得你表达过对我事业的支持，推而广之，也就是对 Achilles 的支持。"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says, tapping her TriPad, "some credits might encourage a notable contact in Tri-Tachyon to fulfill contracts for us rather than Hector?"

"If you secure their cooperation I'll see you are compensated appropriately. As for your contact, they should consider the contracts that shall be awarded by the winning side of a succession crisis."
texts.zh:
"也许，\"她说着，点了点 TriPad，\"一些星币能让速子科技的一位重要联系人替我们履约，而不是替 Hector？"

"如果你能促成他们的合作，我会给你相应的报酬。至于你那位联系人，他该想想，继承危机中获胜的一方会给出怎样的合同。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says, tapping her TriPad, "some credits might encourage a notable contact in Tri-Tachyon to fulfill contracts for us rather than Hector Andrada."

"If you secure their cooperation I'll pay a second instalment. As for him, he should consider the contracts that shall be awarded by the winning side of a succession crisis."
texts.zh:
"也许，\"她说着，点了点 TriPad，\"一些星币能让速子科技的一位重要联系人替我们履约，而不是替 Hector Andrada？"

"如果你能促成他们的合作，我会付第二笔款。至于他，他该想想，继承危机中获胜的一方会给出怎样的合同。"

texts.en:
"This, I think, would be a good time to call in any useful outside allies or contacts. Any mercenary, merchant, smuggler, or pirate who can be bought. An unstoppable force must rally behind Achilles, so that when-"

She catches herself with a small smile, and pauses, looking over you. Judging again.

"This brings me to a very important... request."
texts.zh:
"我想，现在是召集一切有用的外部盟友或联系人的好时机。任何能收买的雇佣兵、商人、走私贩、海盗。必须有一股不可阻挡的力量聚集在 Achilles 身后，这样等到——"

她收住话头，微微一笑，停顿下来打量你。又在评判了。

"这就引出了我一个非常重要的...请求。"

options.en: When what?

texts.en:
"Acceptable," she says.

"Next, I wish for you to contact Achilles again, on Yesod, and personally pledge your support to him. Will you do this?"
texts.zh:
"可以接受，"她说。

"接下来，我要你再联系一次 Yesod 上的 Achilles，亲口向他郑重承诺支持。你愿意吗？"

texts.en:
"You'll see soon enough." A pause. "I wish for you to contact Achilles again, on Yesod, and personally pledge your support to him."

"Will you do this?"
texts.zh:

"It will not," she says. "Macario's slander will be reversed. We'll see to that."

"What Achilles needs now is the threat of force. This is not a matter of moral superiority - it is a matter of violent force. If I could convince Warlord Kanta to back Achilles, I would accept her pledge."

"Well done, $titlePL," she says. "Macario is infamous for his cruelty and cleverness. It is some comfort to hear you've gained cooperation an elite operative to foil his schemes."

"你理应得到报酬，这是当然的。"她点了点 TriPad。

texts.en: The operation is successful, and your sensors officer is poring over the incoming data in short order. Any nearby slipstreams will now be visible on the map.
texts.zh: 行动很成功，你的传感器技官正在尽快研究获取到的数据。附近的所有超空间滑流现在都可以在地图上阅览。

texts.en: Your crews quickly complete a physical takeover of the structure, removing automated safeguards and installing black-box transmitters tuning its output frequency to your transponder codes.
texts.zh: 你的船员迅速占领了该设施，拆除自动防护装置并安装黑箱封装的发射器，将其输出频率调整为你的应答器代码。

texts.en: Your crews quickly complete an assessment of the structure. Replacing several common burned-out components seems to bring the $shortName back to operational status.
texts.zh: 你的船员们迅速完成了对该设施的评估，更换几个常见的易损部件之后似乎就使 $shortName 恢复运行了。

texts.en: A quick scan on the maintenance shortwave reveals several common vulnerabilities to choose from, and the sniffer script is uploaded within a few minutes.
texts.zh: 在维护短波频率上进行的快速扫描马上就发现了几个可用的常见漏洞。随后嗅探脚本也在几分钟内完成了上传。

texts.en: A quick scan on the maintenance shortwave reveals several common vulnerabilities to choose from. Your comms officer installs the data-collection script, and confirms receipt of telemetry from the $shortName.
texts.zh: 在维护短波频率上进行的快速扫描马上就发现了几个可用的常见漏洞。通讯军官安装了数据收集脚本，并确认了能从 $shortName 上接收遥测数据。

texts.en: A quick scan on the maintenance shortwave reveals several common vulnerabilities to choose from. Your comms officer uploads the virus, which you elect not to question the provenance of.
texts.zh: 在维护短波频率上进行的快速扫描马上就发现了几个可用的常见漏洞。通讯军官随即上传了病毒进去，而你决定不去细想后者的来源。

texts.en: A soft chime from the comms console indicates the sniffer is installed and fully operational.
texts.zh: 通讯控制台发出了轻柔的提示音，表明嗅探器已经安装并正常运作。

texts.en: A soft chime from the comms console indicates the sniffer is offline.
texts.zh: 通讯控制台发出的轻柔的提示音，表明嗅探器已经离线。

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: A nearby $faction fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 一支 $faction 舰队正在追踪你的行动，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.
texts.zh: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: A nearby $faction fleet is tracking your movements, making interfering with this $shortName impossible.
texts.zh: 一支 $faction 舰队正在追踪你的行动，使你无法干涉 $shortName 的运作。

texts.en: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.
texts.zh: You do not have the necessary resources to reactivate the $shortName.

texts.en: The $shortName can be overloaded to emit a neutrino burst directly into hyperspace, providing valuable topographical readings and detecting slipstreams within $COB_burstRange light-years.
texts.zh: $shortName 能够被超载并往超空间释放一次中微子爆发，借此获取有价值的超空间地形数据，并探测 $COB_burstRange 光年范围中的超空间滑流。

texts.en: Breaking the $shortName down for salvage will recover some of the resources used in its original construction and will allow another structure to be built at this location.
texts.zh: 拆解 $shortName 并回收部分可用资源，以允许在此建造其他设备。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such an attack on vital infrastructure as an act of war, but given the makeshift nature of the structure, it's doubtful blame would be assigned to you with full certainty.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。但鉴于该设施的临时性，不清楚他们是否将责任完全归咎于你。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such an attack on vital infrastructure as an act of war.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and destroying this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此破坏 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Breaking the $shortName down for salvage will recover some of the resources used in its original construction.

It's an irreplaceable Domain artifact, with a quality that nothing currently capable of being built in the Sector can match.
texts.zh:
拆解 $shortName 并回收部分可用资源，以允许在此建造其他设备。

这是一个无可替代的 人之领 遗物，星域内制造的同类设备无法媲美其品质。

texts.en: Taking control of the $shortName will grant your in-system fleets and colonies the benefits it provides.
texts.zh: 控制该处的 $shortName 将会为星系中的己方舰队与殖民地提供优势。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such a takeover of vital infrastructure as an act of war.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将针对重要基础设施的接管行动视为一种战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and taking control of this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此接管 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Hacking $aOrAn $shortName will surreptitiously provide your fleets with the same benefits as the faction that currently controls it.

The hack will eventually be picked up and cleared out by maintenance subroutines, but should remain effective for at least three months.
texts.zh:
黑入 $aOrAn $shortName 将暗中地为你的舰队提供与控制势力相同的优势。

黑客程序最终会被维护子程序发现并清除，但至少能生效三个月。

texts.en:
Introducing false readings into the outbound data feed is likely to distract patrols and similar fleets by making them chase what isn't actually there.

Eventually, the firmware auto-calibration routines will clean out the corruption, but the process will take at least a month.
texts.zh:
将错误读数注入到出站数据馈送中很可能会分散巡逻队和其他类似舰队的注意力，让他们去追逐虚假目标。

最终，周期自动校准固件会清除这些错误数据，但这个过程至少需要一个月。

texts.en:
Installing a comm sniffer will give you access to local intel as if you were in this star system.

The comm sniffer will remain active until it is detected and cleared out by the comm network's maintenance subroutines. The odds of this happening increase drastically when comm sniffers are installed on multiple relays in the network.
texts.zh:
安装通讯嗅探器能使得你实时获得当地的情报，就如同你在身处于星系中一样。

通讯嗅探器将保持活动状态，直到它被通讯网络的维护子程序检测并清除掉。当通讯嗅探器被同时安装在通讯网络中的多个中继器上时，被发现清除的几率会急剧增加。

texts.en: Uninstalling this comm sniffer will reduce the overall detectability of your other sniffers by the comm network maintenance protocols.
texts.zh: 卸载这个通讯嗅探器将降低其他嗅探器被通讯网络维护协议发现的概率。

texts.en:
There's a short delay as your comms officer corrects for time-space distortion between your $shipOrFleet and your command-control center.

"Secure hyperwave link established, captain," comms reports. "Encryption is green, line open. What are your orders?"
texts.zh:
你的通讯官需要校正你的$shipOrFleet与指挥控制中心之间的时空畸变，通讯因此短暂延迟。

"加密超波链路已建立，舰长，\" 通讯官报告道，\"加密状态正常，线路畅通。请指示。"

options.en: Plan a resupply mission
Plan the deployment of a combat task force
options.zh: 筹划部署一支作战特遣舰队

options.en: Never mind, just testing the hardware.
options.zh: 不必了，只是测试一下设备。

texts.en: You can order a support fleet to bring any needed crew, fuel, and supplies based on an assessment of your fleet's current needs prepared by your quartermaster.
texts.zh: 你可以下令派一支补给舰队，运来所需的船员、燃料和补给；具体数量由你的军需官根据舰队当前的需求评估决定。
effects: #SetTooltip csf_small "A small fleet will bring roughly half the provisions of a medium fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_medium "A medium fleet will bring roughly twice that of a small fleet and half of a large fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_large "A large fleet will bring roughly twice the provisions of a medium fleet."

texts.en: A combat task force will assist your $shipOrFleet in battle in the target system. The fleet can be ordered to follow your own $shipOrFleet or hold a given position.
texts.zh: 一支作战特遣舰队将在目标星系协助你的$shipOrFleet作战。你可以命令它跟随你的$shipOrFleet，或驻守指定位置。
effects: #SetTooltip csf_small "A small fleet will bring roughly half the fleet-power of a medium fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_medium "A medium fleet will bring roughly twice that of a small fleet and half of a large fleet."
#SetTooltip csf_large "A large fleet will bring roughly twice the fleet-power of a medium fleet."

options.en: Call in a small supply fleet
options.zh: 召来一支小型补给舰队

options.en: Call in a medium supply fleet
options.zh: 召来一支中型补给舰队

options.en: Call in a large supply fleet
options.zh: 召来一支大型补给舰队

options.zh: 召来一支小型特遣舰队

options.zh: 召来一支中型特遣舰队

options.zh: 召来一支大型特遣舰队

texts.en:
"Acknowledged, $playerSirOrMadam," your quartermaster salutes then defers to your navigation officer, who asks "Where shall we meet the support fleet, captain?"

A star chart unfolds in the primary bridge display.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"收到，$playerSirOrMadam，\" 你的军需官敬了个礼，随后把话交给领航官，后者问道：\"我们该在哪里与补给舰队会合，舰长？"

主舰桥显示屏上展开了一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam. Where do you want to send the task force?"

A star chart unfolds in the primary bridge display.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。你想把特遣舰队派往哪里？"

主舰桥显示屏上展开了一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam."

"Where do you want the resupply fleet to meet you, captain?" $HeOrShe pulls up a star chart in your shared comms-display workspace.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"你想让补给舰队在哪里与你会合，舰长？" $HeOrShe在你们共用的通讯显示屏上调出一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam."

"Where do you want to send the task force, captain?" $heOrShe asks, pulling up a star chart in your shared comms-display workspace.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
texts.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"你想把特遣舰队派往哪里，舰长？" $heOrShe一边问，一边在你们共用的通讯显示屏上调出一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such an attack on vital infrastructure as an act of war, but given the makeshift nature of the structure, it's doubtful blame would be assigned to you with full certainty.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。但鉴于该设施的临时性，不清楚他们是否将责任完全归咎于你。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such an attack on vital infrastructure as an act of war.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将这种针对重要基础设施的攻击视为战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and destroying this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此破坏 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Breaking the $shortName down for salvage will recover some of the resources used in its original construction.

It's an irreplaceable Domain artifact, with a quality that nothing currently capable of being built in the Sector can match.
texts.zh:
拆解 $shortName 并回收部分可用资源，以允许在此建造其他设备。

这是一个无可替代的 人之领 遗物，星域内制造的同类设备无法媲美其品质。

texts.en: Taking control of the $shortName will grant your in-system fleets and colonies the benefits it provides.
texts.zh: 控制该处的 $shortName 将会为星系中的己方舰队与殖民地提供优势。

texts.en: $TheFaction will certainly regard such a takeover of vital infrastructure as an act of war.
texts.zh: $TheFaction 肯定会将针对重要基础设施的接管行动视为一种战争行为。

texts.en: $TheFaction has no presence in this system, and taking control of this $shortName will have no impact on your standing.
texts.zh: 由于该星系中并没有 $TheFaction 的殖民地，因此接管 $shortName 不会影响你的声望。

texts.en:
Hacking $aOrAn $shortName will surreptitiously provide your fleets with the same benefits as the faction that currently controls it.

The hack will eventually be picked up and cleared out by maintenance subroutines, but should remain effective for at least three months.
texts.zh:
黑入 $aOrAn $shortName 将暗中地为你的舰队提供与控制势力相同的优势。

黑客程序最终会被维护子程序发现并清除，但至少能生效三个月。

texts.en:
Introducing false readings into the outbound data feed is likely to distract patrols and similar fleets by making them chase what isn't actually there.

Eventually, the firmware auto-calibration routines will clean out the corruption, but the process will take at least a month.
texts.zh:
将错误读数注入到出站数据馈送中很可能会分散巡逻队和其他类似舰队的注意力，让他们去追逐虚假目标。

最终，周期自动校准固件会清除这些错误数据，但这个过程至少需要一个月。

texts.en:
Installing a comm sniffer will give you access to local intel as if you were in this star system.

The comm sniffer will remain active until it is detected and cleared out by the comm network's maintenance subroutines. The odds of this happening increase drastically when comm sniffers are installed on multiple relays in the network.
texts.zh:
安装通讯嗅探器能使得你实时获得当地的情报，就如同你在身处于星系中一样。

通讯嗅探器将保持活动状态，直到它被通讯网络的维护子程序检测并清除掉。当通讯嗅探器被同时安装在通讯网络中的多个中继器上时，被发现清除的几率会急剧增加。

texts.en: Uninstalling this comm sniffer will reduce the overall detectability of your other sniffers by the comm network maintenance protocols.
texts.zh: 卸载这个通讯嗅探器将降低其他嗅探器被通讯网络维护协议发现的概率。

texts.en: The $shortName can be overloaded to emit a neutrino burst directly into hyperspace, providing valuable topographical readings and detecting slipstreams within $COB_burstRange light-years.
texts.zh: $shortName 能够被超载并往超空间释放一次中微子爆发，借此获取有价值的超空间地形数据，并探测 $COB_burstRange 光年范围中的超空间滑流。

texts.en:
A two-spacer team rides a work drone to the relay and makes a quick hull cut to access a hard data connection. Within a minute, the snoop algorithm is set loose, the hull re-sealed, and the ops team returns.

Now you wait for it to do its work.
texts.zh:
一支两人小队驾驶着一架工作无人机来到了中继站上，快速切割其外壳以便找到可与其内部硬件连接的接口。不到一分钟后，窥探算法安装完成，中继器的外壳也被重新密封，行动小组成功返回。

现在你开始等待算法完成自己的使命。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
After a tense hour or so, your comms officer informs you that the snoop is complete. A team of officers and specialists proficient in techops, infosec, and comms has been analyzing the snoop's data as it has come in, and have already prepared a preliminary report.

"The team is still finishing the detailed analysis and decrypting what we can," your comms officer reports, "But we've got a pretty good idea of the big picture."
texts.zh:
紧张地等待了一个小时后，通讯军官告诉你，窥探算法的工作完成了。一组精通技术操作、信息安全和通讯的军官和专家一直在逐步分析陆续接收到的信息，并已经完成了一份初步报告。

"我们的团队仍在进行详细的分析，并尽可能地对我们得到的信息进行解密。" 通讯军官报告说，"但我们已经对总体情况有了一定程度的了解。"

options.en: Which is?

texts.en:
"It looks like most major factions and a few freelancers and underworld agents have been showing an anomalous level of activity in the Isirah system. There are plausible explanations for this of course, but what tipped us off was some sloppy infosec by a Pather infiltrator."

Here, your comms officer pulls up a communication ID and a League ID summary.
texts.zh:
"看起来大多数主要势力，少数自由佣兵和地下特工在 Isirah 星系中的活动频率高的异常。这可以有不少合理的解释，但根据我们的分析，这种现象大概率是一个粗心大意地泄露了不少情报的左径分子造成的。"

说到这，通讯军官拿出了一份包含了通讯 ID 和 英仙座联盟 ID 的列表。

options.en: Who am I looking at?
options.zh: 这上边值得注意的是哪个人？

texts.en:
"Jensen Gallegos. All the signs of a Pather infiltrator. The ID doesn't hold up to scrutiny as you can see... er, yes captain. The big picture," they flip through some irrelevant data logs then focus again on a series of messages sent as text, "They slipped up here, mentioning Coureuse by name, though misspelled. That led us to discover a simple code system used by what appears to be a cell of Pathers operating on Laicaille Habitat."

The League ID of not-Jensen Gallegos is joined by a handful more IDs with annotated discrepancies and errors.
texts.zh:
"Jensen Gallegos，各种意义上讲都像是一名左径渗透者。如你所见，舰长，这个身份经不起仔细审查...呃，总体来说，" 他们跳过了一些无关紧要的信息，并将展示的重点放在了一系列呈现为文本的秘密信息上，"看这里，他们疏忽大意地提到了 Coureuse 的名字，虽然拼错了。这让我们发现了一个正在 Laicaille 栖息地上活动的左径组织使用的暗号系统。"

更多除了 Jensen Gallegos 以外的，被注释了差异和错误之处的 英仙座联盟 ID 被加入了 ID 列表中。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Lots of communication, both text and holo. They think Coureuse is on Laicaille Habitat, but they can't get close to her, and they don't think their identities will hold up to a security check. Which is correct," your comms officer says with a touch of pride. "It sounds like they're asking home base to call in some big guns, whatever that might be. Or whoever."

The full report will be completed within the shift, but you know what you need to know: Laicaille Habitat.
texts.zh:
"这里有大量的通讯信息，包括文本和全息两种形式。他们认为 Coureuse 就在 Laicaille 栖息地上，只是这些人没能力接近她。同时他们认为他们的身份信息无法通过安全检查 —— 这倒是千真万确。" 你的通讯军官带着一丝自豪说道，"他们似乎在要求总部送来一些不得了的东西，或是派来一些狠角色。"

完整的调查报告将在轮班前完成，但你已经知道你需要知道的信息了：Laicaille 栖息地上有问题。

texts.en:
With only one piece of evidence that Coureuse is at Laicaille Habitat you're not absolutely certain it would not be dismissed as merely circumstantial if you attempted to leverage it against the authorities.

You need to find one more piece of corroborating evidence.
texts.zh:
现在只有一项证据表明 Coureuse 在 Laicaille 栖息地，如果你试图以某种方式利用它对当局提出质疑，对方可能会以这只是间接证据为由不予考虑。

你得再找一个确凿的证据。

texts.en:
With multiple pieces of evidence, you feel confident that you have sufficient leverage to confront authorities at Laicaille Habitat about Scylla Coureuse.

It is time to talk to the archon of Laicaille Habitat.
texts.zh:
现在你有了两份不同的证据，你觉得自己已经有足够的筹码去和 Laicaille 栖息地的当局就 Scylla Coureuse 的事进行对质。

是时候和 Laicaille 栖息地的执政官谈谈了。

options.en: Leave
Leave
Leave
Leave

texts.en:
It is not unusual that the Remnant Nexus exchanges signals with the local comm relay. Wherever Tri-Tachyon's AI fleets linger, one finds clouds of tiny spy-sats, relays, and repeaters chirping squirts of data back and forth. Very quietly, almost enough to be lost in the background noise. But not quite.

It is not a simple thing to tap into this self-evolved network to request a very specific piece of information. You assemble your senior officers and consider your options for hacking into the Nexus
texts.zh:
余辉中枢和星系内的通讯中继站进行信号交互并不罕见。毕竟无论这些 速子科技 麾下的 AI 舰队在哪儿徘徊，都会留下如云雾般密布的间谍卫星和中继转发系统，不停地来回吞吐数据流。虽然这些都安静到几乎能被背景噪音所掩盖，但也不是完全悄然无息。

接入这样一个自我进化出来的网络里获取某个特定的信息绝非易事。你将你的上级军官召集到了一起，考虑能采取什么行动来黑入中枢。

options.en: Use Tri-Tachyon command codes to make the task possible
options.zh: 使用 速子科技 的命令编码让这项工作可行

options.en: Open a comm-link into the network
options.zh: 向网络开放通讯链接接入

options.en: Go back

texts.en:
As a commissioned privateer of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, you have been given a standard set of access codes. These are old protocols, and while they've migrated away from company standards over time (due, probably, to the meddling of idle AIs), your technical officers have the skill to adapt to the unusual changes.

After hours of painstakingly crafting a request - it must be asked in precisely the correct way and have the properly mutated access codes attached - the question is asked and the answer received nearly instantly. Unnervingly so. Nonetheless, you now have navigation coordinates which should lead to the planetkiller.
texts.zh:
身为一名 三一速子科技公司 麾下的签约私掠者，你被给予了一套标准访问编码。这些协议很老旧，而且和公司标准规范渐行渐远 (也许是那些到处闲逛的 AI 们搞的鬼)，不过你的技术官们完全有能力适应此类异常变动。

由于必须附上准确转换后的访问编码，并使用非常精确无误方式进行询问，检索请求在煞费苦心地认真编写了几个小时之后才发出去，之后却几乎立即就收到了回答，让人不禁有些胆怯。但无论如何，你现在拿到了应该都能通往行星杀手所在位置的导航坐标了。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: Your comms officer is taken aback, "But $playerSirOrMadam, what-"
texts.zh: 你的通讯军官看起来大吃了一惊，"但是，$playerSirOrMadam，这 ——"

options.en: Just do it. I've got an idea.
options.zh: 就这么办。我有一个主意。

texts.en:
Your comms officer inputs the commands, a look of confusion remaining on their face.

"Their system isn't built for comms. Um, at all. But, theoretically the adaptive protocols should... could interface, if there's a proper link..."

Another tap at the controls, "The line should be open. If someone, something... is listening."

Your display shows nothing but holo-snow. Your officers fall silent, and the signal processing amplifies the buzz of cosmic background radiation to a near-audible level. There's nought but a yawning void awaiting your words.
texts.zh:
你的通讯军官输入了指令，一脸的困惑依然没有散去。

"它们的系统构造没考虑过接受通讯，呃，完全没有。但，理论上自适应协议应该...也许能进行交互，如果有合适的链接的话..."

通讯军官又在控制台上按了一下，"链接应该开启了，如果有人，有什么东西...在听着的话。"

你的显示台上除了全息雪花噪之外什么都没显示。你的军官都安静了下来，与此同时，信号处理器自顾自地把宇宙背景辐射的嗡响放大到了几乎能听见的音量水平。在这无有之处中，仿佛有片虚空正打着哈欠等着你发话。

options.en: Is there anybody out there?
I am $playerName. Who are you?
This is Artemisia Sun, CEO of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation.
options.zh: 我是 Artemisia Sun，三一速子科技公司 的首席执行官。

options.en: This is Omega calling. I have a command for you.
options.zh: 这是欧米伽在呼叫。我有指令要传达给你。

texts.en:
yes

   hello $playerName
texts.zh:
有的

  幸会，$playerName

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You couldn't quite say how you heard the words. It was as if they were spoken without a voice. Your senior officers all take a step back from the empty holo-display, eyes wide; shocked into silence.

Your comms officer exchanges a look with you - yes, they heard it too; no, they don't know what it is. They tear their eyes away from the nothing in the holo-display and start pulling telemetry into a buffer through their datapad interface.
texts.zh:
你没法描述自己到底是怎么听见这些话的。它们仿佛并非由声音传递。你的上级军官们都不由得从空空如也的全息显示台后退了一步，瞪大了双眼，震惊得说不出话来。

你的通讯军官和你交换了一个眼色，对，也听到了；不，也不知道那是什么。通讯军官将视线从空白的全息显示屏上移开，并开始用数据平板遥测缓冲区数据。

options.en: How do you know my name?
options.zh: 你怎么知道我的名字的？

options.en: I apologize for lying to you. Let's be honest with one another from now on.
options.zh: 我为向你撒谎一事表示抱歉。从此以后，让我们坦诚相待吧。

options.en: I want us to be completely honest with one another.
options.zh: 我希望我们彼此完全坦诚。

options.en: Who are you?
Have you hacked my computer systems?
options.zh: 你入侵了我的电脑系统吗？

options.en: Can you read my mind?
Are you the Remnant AI Nexus?
options.zh: 你是余辉的 AI 中枢吗？

options.en: Are you Omega?
You are Omega.
You're probably an Alpha Core having fun with me.
options.zh: 你是个正在拿我寻开心的 Alpha 核心吧。

options.en: Where is the planetkiller?

texts.en: you've written it all over your things
texts.zh: 汝在汝所有的东西上都写满了它

texts.en: i am agreed
texts.zh: 吾表赞同

texts.en:
you ask my name

   i have no other like myself to tell my name back to me
   and/or: i have only myself to tell me back my name
   (a reflection collapsing into unity)

   i would name myself: i-us watch, learn, think
   but, human, that is not what you ask

   i give you my truth
   (not your answer)
texts.zh:
汝问吾名。

   吾并无其他如吾之个体复述吾之名。
   又或：吾之名只有吾来复述。
   (倒影崩坏为团结)

   吾将如此称呼吾：吾-我等 观察，学习，思考
   但，人类，这并非你所问。

   吾给予汝吾之真理
   (而非汝之答案)

texts.en:
i feel accused of stealing into your secrets
   but there is no need
      (they are written on you)

   you could ask:
   did you
   look upon the stars?

    i would say
yes
   (for else I would be blind)
texts.zh:
吾能感受到斥责，刺探汝之秘辛
   但其实无需此举
      (它们都径直地写在汝身上)

   汝可试问：
   汝曾
   仰望群星？

   吾便可回
然也
   (若非如此，吾必定在假装盲目)

texts.en:
i could
   (with certain tools)

but there is no need-
   i need but ask you your mind!

   (much amusement)
texts.zh:
吾可做到
   (只要有合适的工具)

但这并无必要 ——
   吾等除了向汝之智慧询问外无需它法！

   (更加愉悦)

texts.en:
yes
   and no

texts.en:
Although nothing appears to change in the holodisplay, you hear nothing more from the voice.

texts.en:
She pauses, then reaches toward her ear, turning aside.

"No apologies. If it's critical, report!" Her impatience burns.

Hyder listens to something; her eyes turn back to you. She looks worried.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." A small voice in your ear.

It's your comms officer. You're not sure they've ever interrupted one of your private conversations like this.
texts.zh:
她顿了顿，随即抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"不必道歉。要是紧急，就报告！"她的不耐烦几乎灼人。

Hyder 听着什么，目光转回你身上。她看上去有些担忧。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"你耳边响起一个细小的声音。

是你的通讯军官。你记不清他们何时这样打断过你的私人通话。

options.en: Comms, what's going on?

texts.en:
"$PlayerLastName," Hyder spits your name like poison. "No more games. If we meet again, it will be in battle."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"$PlayerLastName，"Hyder 吐出你的名字，像吐出一口毒。"别再耍花样了。若我们再见面，那就是在战场上。"

通讯切断。

texts.en:
A strange look grows on Hyder's face. She appears to be at a loss for words.

Is she stunned into silence by the scope of your ambition, and your largesse? That you would offer her a place by your side, as Supreme Executor of Askonia - and beyond?
texts.zh:
Hyder 脸上浮起一种古怪的神情。她似乎一时说不出话来。

她是被你野心的规模与你的慷慨震得说不出话吗？你竟愿意让她站到你身边，做 Askonia——乃至更远之地的最高元首？

options.en: I can protect your loyal officers, your fleet. You'll have a place in my armada.
options.zh: 我可以保护你那些忠诚的军官，还有你的舰队。我的舰队里会有你的位置。

texts.en:

Hyder's hand twitches and the comms cut.

Hyder 的手一抽，通讯切断。

texts.en:
He blinks, slowly. Expressionless.

Saying nothing for several moments more. As if to drive the point home that he does not owe you an explanation or even a reaction.

"Captain," he says finally.
texts.zh:
他缓缓眨了眨眼。面无表情。

又是好一会儿一言不发。仿佛要把这一点钉实：他不欠你任何解释，甚至连一个反应都不欠。

"舰长，"他终于开口。

options.en: I've secured a line of support for you from... an agent on Achaman Station.
options.zh: 我已经为你打通了一条支援渠道，来自... Achaman 空间站的一名特工。

texts.en: "That Tri-Tachyon spy - Inesis - is providing intel and... certain pieces of esoteric technology." He makes a face as if he's tasted something just slightly off. "I don't trust him. But everything has checked out. So far."
texts.zh: "那个速子科技的间谍——Inesis——在提供情报，还有... 某些偏门的科技。\"他做了个表情，像是尝到了什么略微变味的东西。\"我不信他。但所有东西都核对通过了。到目前为止。"

texts.en: "I suppose Rayan Arroyo is seeing a fine profit in undercutting Tri-Tachyon's embargo against me." He smirks without amusement. "Oh, they'll regulate commerce toward political goals, like any polity. They just do it with words like 'treaty compliant self-modifying pricing algorithm'."
texts.zh: "我猜 Rayan Arroyo 是从压低速子科技对我的禁运里赚了不少。\"他毫无笑意地一撇嘴。\"哦，他们当然会为了政治目的管制贸易，哪个政权不这样。只是他们管这叫'符合条约的自主调整定价算法'。"

texts.en:
"Your assistance will not be forgotten."

He nods to you, with respect, though nowhere so deep as to be interpreted as a bow of submission.
texts.zh:
"你的援助不会被忘记。"

他向你点头，带着敬意——但绝没有深到会被理解为臣服之礼的地步。

texts.en:
The holo-stream at the center of the bar catches your eye as you spot a familiar face.

Your own.
texts.zh:
酒吧中央的全息流吸引了你的目光，你在上面看见一张熟面孔。

你自己的。

options.en: Hey, turn it up!
Just watch
Lean back into the shadow a little more, and watch
options.zh: 再往阴影里靠一靠，静静看着

texts.en: The bartender dutifully acknowledges your shout with a gesture, and the volume increases noticeably.
texts.zh: 酒保尽职地抬手应了你的喊声，音量明显调高了。

texts.en:
Your face in the holo is replaced by that of one 'Syzygy Nane', a holo-star out of Westernesse - notable as a striking example of cosmetic modification achieving a mode of avant-garde which doesn't quite dip into outlandishness, but, at least, orbits it.

And they're talking about you.

"-from those official Sindrian holos, then I have a space elevator to sell you!"

Laughter. Audience reaction shot - assembled by software in what must have been real-time from viewers within reasonable lightspeed delay, the crowd demonstrates a peculiar mix of fashion and holo-avatars.
texts.zh:
你在全息影像里的脸被换成了"Syzygy Nane"——一位来自 Westernesse 的全息明星，堪称整容改造的醒目范例：那副前卫做派始终没真滑向怪诞，但至少绕着它打转。

而且他们正在谈论你。

"——这些话要是出自辛达的官方全息片，那我这儿还有台太空电梯要卖给你！"

笑声。观众反应镜头——想必是由软件从光速延迟范围内的观众那里实时汇编而成，人群呈现出时尚与全息化身混杂交错的怪相。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An ominous chord is struck, summoning banners of the Sindrian Diktat. A tiny, dancing Dolos Macario, his head over-large, like a child's puppet appears from between them.

Nane provides his voice, squeaking and whining about the 'degenerate spacer, mass-murderer $playerName!' overtop a small feed of the Sindrian Diktat propaganda - sped up, altered to look cheap and tawdry, somehow, its somber outrage undermined with effects trickery.

"Maybe," says Nane reasonably, setting aside the mini-Dolos voice, "there's something more to the story..."
texts.zh:
一段不祥的和弦响起，辛达强权的旗帜随之浮现。一个小小的、跳着舞的 Dolos Macario，脑袋大得不成比例，像个孩童玩偶，从旗帜之间钻了出来。

Nane 替他配音，尖声尖气地抱怨着那个'堕落太空人、杀人魔 $playerName！'，背景是一小段辛达强权的宣传片——被调了速度、改得廉价粗劣，那股庄重义愤不知怎么就败在了特效把戏之下。

"也许，\" Nane 收起小 Dolos 的嗓音，通情达理地说，\"这故事背后还有别的东西..."

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Nane narrates, making you out to be not so much a mass-murderer as a luckless spacer. Well-intentioned on the whole, if a bit naive.

It plays a bit into the unfortunate stereotype of the dazed, undersocialized spacer who is taken advantage of by fast-talking, cosmopolitan dirt-siders.

Your reappearance in the holo breaks your stream of thought away from musing on your self-image.
texts.zh:
Nane 娓娓道来，把你塑造成一个不太像杀人魔、倒更像倒霉太空人的角色。总体上心地不坏，只是有点天真。

这多少迎合了那个不幸的刻板印象：一个懵懂、不善交际的太空人，被油嘴滑舌的都市地面人占了便宜。

你在全息影像里再次露面，打断了你对自我形象的沉思。

options.en: Watch

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of Hercules' office. You knock, and are let in. Time compression; a moment later Benoit leaves.

Time returns to its normal flow as a figure, blurred by active camo, appears and suddenly fires through the door. They pause a moment to shift their weapon and toss a grenade through the shredded doorway.

More fighting.

It ends showing you stumbling, dazed, from the ruined office, held up by two emergency response technicians. A victim.
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到 Hercules 办公室门外。你敲门，被让了进去。时间被压缩；片刻之后，Benoit 走了出来。

时间恢复常速，一个被主动伪装模糊着的身影现身，突然朝门内开火。他们停顿片刻，调整武器，往支离破碎的门口扔进一枚手雷。

更多交火。

最后是你在两名应急响应技师的搀扶下，恍惚地从残破的办公室走出来。一个受害者。

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of an academician's office. You recognize it - presumably the spot where an attack was carried out on Hercules Cyrino.

You reflect that you still have no idea if he survived or not.

Cut to port logs, a quick cross. your $shipOrFleet the date highlights. Other side: surveillance feed of the office, its door caught receiving fire from a frag burst - frozen in time. Timestamped. Nane appears between them, examining one, then the other.

"How odd," Nane says, with a quizzical look. "I may just be a humble drop-out, but it looks like they don't match?"
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到一位院士的办公室外。你认得这里——想必就是 Hercules Cyrino 遇袭的地点。

你回想起来，自己至今不知道他是否活了下来。

镜头切到港口记录，一个快速的对照。你的 $shipOrFleet，日期被高亮标出。另一侧：办公室的监控画面，房门正被一枚破片弹击中——时间凝固。带时间戳。Nane 出现在两者之间，先看一个，再看另一个。

"真奇怪，\" Nane 面露疑惑，\"我可能只是个不值一提的退学生，可这两边看着对不上啊？"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"-more excitement than I ever had in tertiary education, and believe me, we knew how to party!"

This, to mini-Dolos, who nods and begins to dance.

"But" Nane gives mini-Dolos a little shove, and he falls on his bottom. "It's pretty obvious $playerName was the target of-"

Did Provost Baird cooperate to provide this security feed?

A bribe, or a hack?
texts.zh:
"——比我在大学时代经历过的任何刺激都多，相信我，我们那会儿可会玩了！"

这话是对小 Dolos 说的，他点点头，跳起舞来。

"不过——\" Nane 轻轻推了小 Dolos 一把，他一屁股坐倒在地。\"明摆着，$playerName 才是目标——"

是院长 Baird 配合提供了这段监控画面吗？

是贿赂，还是入侵？

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"-a good time on Qaras," Nane continues, "believe me, you DON'T want to-"

There you are again, a grainy security sensor feed outside the bar. A huge goon puts a gun in your face...

"-can you believe this?"

Laughter. Audience reaction shots. A gesture and some meaningless words referencing some youth trend that hasn't broken out of the Westernesse system quite yet.
texts.zh:
"——在 Qaras 玩得开心，\" Nane 接着说，\"相信我，你绝对不想——"

又是你，酒吧外一段满是噪点的保安传感器画面。一个彪形大汉把枪口顶到你脸上...

"——你敢信吗？"

笑声。观众反应镜头。一个手势，外加几句没什么意义的词，引用了某种还没传出 Westernesse 星系的青年潮流。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Nane shifts to explaining the logs of a private courier operation to an increasingly uncomfortable mini-Dolos, dates and names highlighted. Low-profile shuttles to an obscure asteroid in the Hybrasil system.

Altered medical reports - a series of deaths, covered up over a period of many cycles before you ever found Elysium.

"Oh, that's awkward isn't it?" Nane exchanges looks with mini-Dolos, who shrugs in faux-innocence.
texts.zh:
Nane 转而向越来越坐立不安的小 Dolos 解说一桩私人信使业务的记录，日期与姓名被逐一高亮。低调的穿梭机飞往 Hybrasil 星系一颗偏僻的小行星。

被篡改的医疗报告——一连串死亡，在你发现 Elysium 之前，已经被掩盖了许多个星历年。

"哦，这可有点尴尬，是吧？" Nane 与小 Dolos 交换了个眼神，后者故作无辜地耸了耸肩。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Next is a clip from the other 'cast, the one from the real Macario. The words ORTHRUS MURDER: FATHER MOURNS SON in glowing blood-red.

The words shrink, as if the air was let out of them, and flop onto the ground under Nane's sardonic expression. Mini-Dolos attempts to lift the words back up, behind him the mockery-edit of real Macario's original propaganda holo, but the words prove too floppy and awkward, and finally he throws up his arms and sulks in frustration.
texts.zh:
接下来是另一档节目的片段，真正 Macario 那一档。血红色的发光大字：ORTHRUS 凶案：父亲哀悼儿子。

那些字缩小了，仿佛被抽干了气，软塌塌地掉到地上，Nane 脸上挂着嘲讽。小 Dolos 试图把字重新举起来，身后是真 Macario 原版宣传全息片的戏仿剪辑版，可那些字软得实在别扭，最后他只能扬起双臂，气恼地生闷气。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"If murder was the goal," says Nane, "why did Maeus Moroz get the last shot?"

From a high angle, a grimy feed. There's you and Maeus Moroz, sharing a drink. He looks gruff, but is nodding his head at your words. The bartender sets two small glasses down, and Moroz immediately empties his.
texts.zh:
"如果目标是谋杀，\" Nane 说，\"那最后一枪为什么是 Maeus Moroz 开的？"

高角度拍摄，一段脏兮兮的画面。你和 Maeus Moroz 在共饮。他脸色阴沉，却对你的话点着头。酒保放下两只小杯，Moroz 立刻一饮而尽。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Methinks," Nane's head and voice tilt in a signature mid-sentence re-pitch, "a little spider's web of lies is looking a lit...tle convenient when you consider recent events..."

A tiny Hector and Achilles join the mini-Dolos, though child-sized even to him.

Immediately, they begin to fight, and for a moment it looks like Dolos might play the adult before - being the blackguard he is - tries to smack Achilles. With comic irony, little bully Hector sweeps Achilles' legs, allowing Dolos' hand to connect with Hector instead, and...

Meanwhile, a fat little Horacio Caden appears, completely unaware of the conflict, stumbling with a bottle in hand...
texts.zh:
"依我看，\" Nane 的头与声音在句中标志性地一偏，语调随之一变，\"一张小小的谎言蛛网，放到近来这些事里去看，可就显得有那么...点儿太方便了..."

一个小小的 Hector 和 Achilles 加入进来，站在小 Dolos 旁边，个头却连对他都算孩童尺寸。

他们立刻打作一团，有一瞬间，倒像是 Dolos 要扮演一回大人——可紧接着，他这个恶棍就去扇 Achilles 了。讽刺的是，小恶霸 Hector 一记扫腿把 Achilles 绊倒，让 Dolos 的手正好落在 Hector 身上，于是...

与此同时，一个胖乎乎的小 Horacio Caden 出现，完全没察觉那边的冲突，手里拎着酒瓶摇摇晃晃地走过来...

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Nane's arms lift, sweeping away the whole comic-bizarre scene. The image dims and desaturates.

"I'm just your lovely everyday holo-friend, fellow Syzygens, but even I didn't have to look too close before the official story started unraveling. But first-"

Nane pivots seamlessly into an ad-read for an esoteric insurance scheme. A few spacers close to the bar grow bored and, at their behest, the bartender adjusts the holo stream.
texts.zh:
Nane 抬起双臂，把整幅滑稽荒诞的场景一扫而空。影像转暗，褪去色彩。

"我不过是你们可爱的日常全息朋友，各位 Syzygen 同胞，可就连我也不用凑得太近，官方的说法就开始崩线了。不过首先——"

Nane 无缝转进一段玄乎保险方案的广告口播。吧台边几个太空人听腻了，应他们要求，酒保调了调全息流。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Faro Inesis to arrange.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Faro Inesis 安排的那一出。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Arroyo to arrange.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Arroyo 安排的那一出。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Orcus Rao arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Hegemony's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Orcus Rao 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到霸主的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Finlay Siyavong arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Persean League's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Finlay Siyavong 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到英仙座联盟的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Fortuna Kato arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of Gens Kato's budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Fortuna Kato 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到 Kato 氏族的预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it seems to have been designed to undermine Macario's efforts to destroy your reputation by making a farce of him and his narrative of somber outrage.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，看来目的都是要拆 Macario 的台：他本想毁掉你的名声，如今他自己和他那套沉痛义愤的说辞反倒成了笑柄。

texts.en:
Hopefully it works.

As if in answer, a couple of spacers walking by do a double-take in recognition and... it's not fear, or hatred, but awkward acknowledgement. Their look seems to say 'dirt-siders, right? Mistake to trust them'.

You look back to the bar.
texts.zh:
但愿这有用。

像是回应一般，几个路过的太空人认出你来，愣了一下，回头又看——那神情不是恐惧，也不是憎恨，而是尴尬的会意。他们的眼神仿佛在说：'地面人嘛，对吧？信他们就是个错'。

你转回头看向吧台。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: The bartender dutifully acknowledges your shout with a gesture, and the volume increases noticeably.
texts.zh: 酒保尽职地抬手应了你的喊声，音量明显调高了。

texts.en:
Your face in the holo is replaced by that of one 'Syzygy Nane', a holo-star out of Westernesse - notable as a striking example of cosmetic modification achieving a mode of avant-garde which doesn't quite dip into outlandishness, but, at least, orbits it.

And they're talking about you.

"-from those official Sindrian holos, then I have a space elevator to sell you!"

Laughter. Audience reaction shot - assembled by software in what must have been real-time from viewers within reasonable lightspeed delay, the crowd demonstrates a peculiar mix of fashion and holo-avatars.
texts.zh:
你在全息影像里的脸被换成了"Syzygy Nane"——一位来自 Westernesse 的全息明星，堪称整容改造的醒目范例：那副前卫做派始终没真滑向怪诞，但至少绕着它打转。

而且他们正在谈论你。

"——这些话要是出自辛达的官方全息片，那我这儿还有台太空电梯要卖给你！"

笑声。观众反应镜头——想必是由软件从光速延迟范围内的观众那里实时汇编而成，人群呈现出时尚与全息化身混杂交错的怪相。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An ominous chord is struck, summoning banners of the Sindrian Diktat. A tiny, dancing Dolos Macario, his head over-large, like a child's puppet appears from between them.

Nane provides his voice, squeaking and whining about the 'degenerate spacer, mass-murderer $playerName!' overtop a small feed of the Sindrian Diktat propaganda - sped up, altered to look cheap and tawdry, somehow, its somber outrage undermined with effects trickery.

"Maybe," says Nane reasonably, setting aside the mini-Dolos voice, "there's something more to the story..."
texts.zh:
一段不祥的和弦响起，辛达强权的旗帜随之浮现。一个小小的、跳着舞的 Dolos Macario，脑袋大得不成比例，像个孩童玩偶，从旗帜之间钻了出来。

Nane 替他配音，尖声尖气地抱怨着那个'堕落太空人、杀人魔 $playerName！'，背景是一小段辛达强权的宣传片——被调了速度、改得廉价粗劣，那股庄重义愤不知怎么就败在了特效把戏之下。

"也许，\" Nane 收起小 Dolos 的嗓音，通情达理地说，\"这故事背后还有别的东西..."

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Nane narrates, making you out to be not so much a mass-murderer as a luckless spacer. Well-intentioned on the whole, if a bit naive.

It plays a bit into the unfortunate stereotype of the dazed, undersocialized spacer who is taken advantage of by fast-talking, cosmopolitan dirt-siders.

Your reappearance in the holo breaks your stream of thought away from musing on your self-image.
texts.zh:
Nane 娓娓道来，把你塑造成一个不太像杀人魔、倒更像倒霉太空人的角色。总体上心地不坏，只是有点天真。

这多少迎合了那个不幸的刻板印象：一个懵懂、不善交际的太空人，被油嘴滑舌的都市地面人占了便宜。

你在全息影像里再次露面，打断了你对自我形象的沉思。

options.en: Watch

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of Hercules' office. You knock, and are let in. Time compression; a moment later Benoit leaves.

Time returns to its normal flow as a figure, blurred by active camo, appears and suddenly fires through the door. They pause a moment to shift their weapon and toss a grenade through the shredded doorway.

More fighting.

It ends showing you stumbling, dazed, from the ruined office, held up by two emergency response technicians. A victim.
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到 Hercules 办公室门外。你敲门，被让了进去。时间被压缩；片刻之后，Benoit 走了出来。

时间恢复常速，一个被主动伪装模糊着的身影现身，突然朝门内开火。他们停顿片刻，调整武器，往支离破碎的门口扔进一枚手雷。

更多交火。

最后是你在两名应急响应技师的搀扶下，恍惚地从残破的办公室走出来。一个受害者。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of an academician's office. You recognize it - presumably the spot where an attack was carried out on Hercules Cyrino.

You reflect that you still have no idea if he survived or not.

Cut to port logs, a quick cross. your $shipOrFleet the date highlights. Other side: surveillance feed of the office, its door caught receiving fire from a frag burst - frozen in time. Timestamped. Nane appears between them, examining one, then the other.

"How odd," Nane says, with a quizzical look. "I may just be a humble drop-out, but it looks like they don't match?"
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到一位院士的办公室外。你认得这里——想必就是 Hercules Cyrino 遇袭的地点。

你回想起来，自己至今不知道他是否活了下来。

镜头切到港口记录，一个快速的对照。你的 $shipOrFleet，日期被高亮标出。另一侧：办公室的监控画面，房门正被一枚破片弹击中——时间凝固。带时间戳。Nane 出现在两者之间，先看一个，再看另一个。

"真奇怪，\" Nane 面露疑惑，\"我可能只是个不值一提的退学生，可这两边看着对不上啊？"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"-more excitement than I ever had in tertiary education, and believe me, we knew how to party!"

This, to mini-Dolos, who nods and begins to dance.

"But" Nane gives mini-Dolos a little shove, and he falls on his bottom. "It's pretty obvious $playerName was the target of-"

Did Provost Baird cooperate to provide this security feed?

A bribe, or a hack?
texts.zh:
"——比我在大学时代经历过的任何刺激都多，相信我，我们那会儿可会玩了！"

这话是对小 Dolos 说的，他点点头，跳起舞来。

"不过——\" Nane 轻轻推了小 Dolos 一把，他一屁股坐倒在地。\"明摆着，$playerName 才是目标——"

是院长 Baird 配合提供了这段监控画面吗？

是贿赂，还是入侵？

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"-a good time on Qaras," Nane continues, "believe me, you DON'T want to-"

There you are again, a grainy security sensor feed outside the bar. A huge goon puts a gun in your face...

"-can you believe this?"

Laughter. Audience reaction shots. A gesture and some meaningless words referencing some youth trend that hasn't broken out of the Westernesse system quite yet.

"——在 Qaras 玩得开心，\" Nane 接着说，\"相信我，你绝对不想——"

texts.en:
As you approach, he looks over and says "Captain $playerName! Don't be so surprised, you've a fascinating reputation to the movers and shakers of the Sector, from grand Kazeron even to a minor orbit of... say, Ragnar."

His smile is like a pulsar beam.

With a casual wave, he dismisses the other officers with the promise to join them in a moment, then catches your eye. "Dilettantes. Compared to yourself, I mean, of course. I'm told we could use a talented captain like you."
texts.zh:
你走近时，他看过来，说道："$playerName 舰长！别这么惊讶，对星域的风云人物来说，你这名号相当有意思——从堂堂 Kazeron，到...比如说，Ragnar 的一条小轨道，都有人听说。"

他的笑容像一道脉冲星的光束。

他随意一挥手，打发了其他军官，答应稍后就过去，然后迎上你的目光。"一帮附庸风雅的家伙。当然，是跟你比。听说我们正缺一位像你这样有本事的舰长。"

texts.en:
He laughs a bit too heartily, glancing around. It's unclear if he's embarrassed at your tactlessness or nervous of being overheard.

"I've not a clue what you mean, good captain! I'm merely a humble academician - a man of knowledge and only the highest ideals," he says loudly. Then he leans in to speak more quietly.
texts.zh:
他笑得有点过于热络，还四下张望。说不清他是被你的不识趣弄得尴尬，还是怕被人听见。

"我完全不明白你的意思，好舰长！我不过是个谦卑的院士——一个求知识、只抱最高理想的人，"他大声说道。然后他凑近，压低了声音。

texts.en:
"This is about freedom, my friend. This is about the Askonia Charterist Alliance, the first resistance movement opposed to the tyranny of the Sindrian Diktat, that cruel regime created by Andrada when he murdered Opis."

"Which was once my home," he says, almost a whisper.

A shadow has fallen across his cheerful facade; in his eyes, you see genuine pain, still fresh after many cycles.
texts.zh:
"这是关于自由，我的朋友。这是关于 Askonia 宪章派同盟——第一支反抗辛达强权暴政的抵抗运动，那个由 Andrada 在谋杀 Opis 之后建立的残酷政权。"

"那里曾是我的家，"他说，几乎是耳语。

一层阴影落在他快活的面具上；在他眼里，你看见真切的痛楚，隔了这么多个星历年，仍旧新鲜。

texts.en:
He pauses a moment.

"I'm not hearing anything from Nortia," he says, voice containing a note of disapproval. "I expected the ACA would be receiving fuel and supplies from a mysterious spacer who developed a sudden enthusiasm for the cause of a Free Askonia."

"So." Rao looks you over. "Get on it."
texts.zh:
他停顿了片刻。

"Nortia 那边我什么消息都没听到，\"他说，语气里带着不满，\"我本以为 ACA 会收到一位神秘船长送去的燃料和补给——那位船长忽然对自由 Askonia 的事业热情高涨。"

"所以。\"Rao 上下打量你，\"去办。"

texts.en:
"Got a report." His eyes flick down to his datapad, then back up. "Our friends on Nortia, the ACA, have received everything they asked for."

"Good work." Rao doesn't smile.
texts.zh:
"收到报告了。\"他低头瞥了一眼数据板，又抬眼看你，\"我们在 Nortia 的朋友，ACA，已经拿到了他们要的一切。"

"干得不错。"Rao 没有笑。

texts.en:
"An informant on Umbra had an interesting story, by the way," Rao says. "Some spacer came through making big donations to the Gens girl, Imoinu, for her 'revolution'."

"Good." Rao nods at you. "But that's the end of it, captain. We don't want some band of pirates with big ideas ruining the post-crisis settlement."
texts.zh:
"顺带一提，Umbra 上有个线人讲了个有意思的故事，\"Rao 说，\"有个船长跑来给氏族那丫头 Imoinu 的'革命'捐了一大笔。"

"很好。\"Rao 朝你点了点头，\"但到此为止，舰长。我们不想让一伙满脑子大志的海盗毁了危机之后的安排。"

texts.en:
"I received a report from an informant on Umbra," Rao says coldly. "Sounds like some spacer captain with space-dust for brains got excited for the revolution run by that Kazeronian princess and armed a bunch of ANTIs to the teeth."

"That was stupid," Rao says with a sighs, rubbing his eyes. "But it's done. Remember that I'm the one who is going to have to explain this to the Strategic Council if it burns us."
texts.zh:
"我在 Umbra 的线人给我送了一份报告，\"Rao 冷冷地说，\"听起来是某个脑子里塞满太空尘的船长，被那位 Kazeron 公主搞的革命冲昏了头，把一帮 ANTI 武装到了牙齿。"

"这蠢透了，\"Rao 叹了口气，揉着眼睛，\"但事情已经做了。记住：要是这事烧到我们头上，得去战略委员会解释的人是我。"

texts.en:
"I'm hearing things from Volturn, captain," Rao says. "Luddics are acting up. Say a spacer made a 'charitable donation' that's helped them out of a rough spot."

"That's enough for the VSDC, I think," he says with a nod, not smiling. "We just want them causing trouble - not taking over."
texts.zh:
"Volturn 那边有些风声，舰长，\"Rao 说，\"卢德派在折腾。据说有个船长做了笔'慈善捐赠'，帮他们熬过了一道难关。"

"对 VSDC 来说，这就够了，我想，\"他点了点头，脸上没有笑意，\"我们只要他们去惹麻烦——不是让他们接管局面。"

texts.en:
"I'm hearing things from Volturn, captain," Rao says, an edge to his voice. "It's a miracle, apparently. Some spacer decided to personally arm the entire Volturnian Self Defense Covenant with enough materiel for a proper, blessed-bedamned uprising."

"That," he says coldly, "was a mistake. And against my explicit ord-" He pauses, conceding the slip. "Against my instructions."

"I'm not happy, captain. But there's no undoing it now. We'll see if it bites us."
texts.zh:
"Volturn 那边有些风声，舰长，\"Rao 说，语气锐利起来，\"据说是个奇迹。有个船长决定亲自把整个 Volturn 自卫盟约武装起来，军械多到足够他们打一场像模像样的、活见鬼的起义。"

"那，\"他冷冷地说，\"是个错误。而且违背了我明确的命——\"他停住，默认了这次失口，\"违背了我的指示。"

"我不高兴，舰长。但现在已经收不回来了。就看它会不会反咬我们一口。"

texts.en: "Moving along," Rao says gruffly.
texts.zh: "说下一件，"Rao 生硬地说。

"You're a fool and you have resigned yourself to irrelevance by throwing away my gift of membership in the beautiful Persean League."

texts.en:
"You are useless to me." Reynard speaks with icy contempt, "I'll have no more of my generosity spurned by an ingrate."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"你对我毫无用处。\"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑，\"我不会再让一个不知感恩的东西糟蹋我的慷慨。"

通讯中断。

texts.en:
After a few minutes the secretary reappears.

"I'm sorry," they say, smiling. "But the Prime Demarchon is unavailable. Would you like to leave a message?"
texts.zh:
几分钟后，秘书又出现了。

"很抱歉，\"她微笑着说，\"大统领现在不便接见。你要留言吗？"

"Fantastic. I'll inform the Prime Demarchon as soon as he's free."
