texts.en:
"The Volturnian so-called 'Self Defense Covenant'," he lowers the TriPad. "But you know of them already, don't you $titlePL. You've given them everything!"

He casually tosses the datapad. You don't hear it land.

"Fantastic. You've anticipated my desire - if only all my clients had such initiative. But then..." He squints. "You're not a praying type, are you? That would surprise me more than anything."

"Anyway," he snaps his fingers at someone and your own TriPad pings. "You've earned this."
texts.zh:
"Volturn 人所谓的'自卫盟约'，\"他放下 TriPad。\"可你早就知道他们了，对吧，$titlePL。你什么都给他们了！"

他漫不经心地把数据板一抛。你没听见它落地的声音。

"妙极了。你连我想要什么都已经提前办了——但愿我所有的门客都有这份主动。不过...\"他眯起眼。\"你不是会祈祷的那种人吧？那可就是最让我吃惊的事了。"

"总之，\"他朝某人打了个响指，你自己的 TriPad 也响了一声。\"这是你挣来的。"

texts.en: He leans back, luxuriating, arms set behind his head.
texts.zh: 他向后靠去，双臂枕在脑后，一副享受的模样。

texts.en:
"Oh, I suppose you'll need her comms as well."

He snaps his fingers without even glancing aside, and your TriPad pings.

"Volturn. You can remember 'Volturn', right?" He doesn't await a response. "Good."
texts.zh:
"哦，我想你还需要她的通讯编号。"

他连看都没往旁边看一眼，只打了个响指，你的 TriPad 便响了一声。

"Volturn。'Volturn' 这名字你记得住吧？\"他没等你回答。\"很好。"

texts.en:
He looks upward, idly, as if staring at the stars.

"You've an opportunity in Askonia, $titlePL. Raid, plunder, and loot. I'll ensure your reputation is respected in the post-war settlement so you can enjoy the spoils of war. You'll earn it, I'm sure."

He gives you a little wave.
texts.zh:
他百无聊赖地抬眼向上看，仿佛在凝望群星。

"你在 Askonia 有个机会，$titlePL。袭击、劫掠、搜刮。我会确保战后和谈时你的名声得到尊重，好让你享用到手的战利品。我确信，你会挣到这些的。"

他冲你轻轻挥了挥手。

texts.en:
"You gave the Luddic fanatics of Volturn their weapons." He snaps his fingers.

"Your reward."
texts.zh:
"你把武器交给了 Volturn 的卢德狂信徒。"他打了个响指。

"你的奖赏。"

texts.en:
"You gave Fortuna Kato's wayward granddaughter her revolution on Umbra." He snaps his fingers.

"For your service."
texts.zh:
"你帮 Fortuna 那个走上歧途的孙女在 Umbra 搞成了她的革命。"他打了个响指。

"给你的酬劳。"

texts.en: "You served me well and carried out my instructions," he says, quite satisfied - with himself, mostly, from his tone and expression.
texts.zh: "你为我办得不错，把我的吩咐都执行了，"他说，相当满意——从他的语气和神情看，多半是对他自己满意。

texts.en: "You appear to have had difficulty carrying out my complete instructions," he says, frowning. "If you only half-arm an already doomed insurrection, it doesn't have quite the same effect."
texts.zh: "看来你执行我的完整吩咐时遇到了点困难，\"他皱着眉说，\"一场本就注定失败的暴动，你只给它武装一半，效果可就差得远了。"

texts.en: "You appear to have had difficulty carrying out my complete instructions," he says, frowning. "If you only half-arm an already doomed insurrection, it doesn't have quite the same effect."
texts.zh: "看来你执行我的完整吩咐时遇到了点困难，\"他皱着眉说，\"一场本就注定失败的暴动，你只给它武装一半，效果可就差得远了。"

texts.en:
"You appear to have difficulty following instructions," he says coldly. "You failed to fully outfit even a single doomed uprising."

"What use are you?"
texts.zh:
"看来你不太会照吩咐办事，\"他冷冷地说，\"连一场注定失败的起事，你都没能给它配齐装备。"

"你还有什么用？"

Continue

texts.en:
"I must be honest, the results were somewhat more... explosive than ever I thought possible." He looks over his fingernails, which are flawless.

"...Sindria as well as Opis?" He tsk-tsks.
texts.zh:
"实话说，结果比我预想的...要火爆得多。"他端详着自己的指甲，那指甲完美无瑕。

"...Sindria，还有 Opis？"他啧啧了两声。

texts.en:
"It's a pity about the Achilles clone, of course. He never did manage to quite throw off Fortuna's overbearing manipulation."

Reynard speaks dismissively, but there's some bitter undercurrent he cannot, or will not, conceal.
texts.zh:
"当然，Achilles 那个克隆体的事很可惜。他到底没能彻底摆脱 Fortuna 那套专横的摆布。"

Reynard 说得漫不经心，可底下压着一股苦涩，他藏不住，或者说不愿藏。

texts.en: "I ought to offer my congratulations to Achilles. He exceeded expectations," Reynard says. "And even managed to throw off Fortuna's fussy oversight. Good for him."
texts.zh: "我该向 Achilles 道个贺。他超出了预期，\"Reynard 说，\"甚至还甩掉了 Fortuna 那套处处插手的监管。他有本事。"

texts.en: "I ought to offer my congratulations to that clone, Hector. He exceeded anyone's expectations."
texts.zh: "我该向那个克隆体道个贺，Hector。他超出了所有人的预期。"

texts.en: "I'd offer my congratulations to that Hector clone, but," Reynard shrugs. "He made a bit of a mess of things, didn't he."
texts.zh: "我本想向那个 Hector 克隆体道个贺，不过，\"Reynard 耸了耸肩，\"他把事情弄得有点糟，不是吗。"

texts.en: "And the Sindrian Diktat remains a useful buffer." He smirks. "For the security of the Persean League."
texts.zh: "而辛达强权仍然是一道有用的缓冲。\"他得意地一笑。\"为了英仙座联盟的安全。"

texts.en: "Pity about the Sindrian Diktat," he says. "It was useful, very useful, for a time."
texts.zh: "辛达强权的事很可惜，\"他说，\"它曾经很有用，非常有用，有那么一阵子。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You played your part well, $titlePL."

He gifts you with an approving smile, though it is just a little too bright, his teeth just a little sharper than they ought to be.

"Perhaps if you prove that wasn't a fluke... well, the generosity of Gens Hannan is not casually granted, but I assure you it is... substantial."
texts.zh:
"你这一角演得不错，$titlePL。"

他赏了你一个赞许的笑容，只是亮得有点过头，牙也尖得有点不该。

"也许，等你能证明那并非侥幸...嗯，Hannan 氏族的慷慨从不轻许，但我向你保证，它...相当丰厚。"

texts.en:
"You did a poor job given even the simple, straightforward tasks I tasked you to perform."

He sits up now, an expression of displeasure growing.

"I gave you such opportunity, showed such generosity. What did you provide in return?"

"Mediocrity."
texts.zh:
"我交给你的都是简单直白的差事，你办得却很糟。"

他坐直了身子，脸上的不悦一点点加深。

"我给了你那样的机会，待你那样慷慨。你回报了我什么？"

"平庸。"

Continue

texts.en: "We will do great things for Gens Hannan, $titlePL," his voice is warm, yet somehow possessive. "We will make history together."
texts.zh: "我们要为 Hannan 氏族成就一番大业，$titlePL，\"他的声音温和，却不知怎地带上了占有的意味，\"我们要一起创造历史。"

texts.en:
"We will do great things for Gens Hannan, $titlePL," his voice is warm, yet somehow possessive. "We will make history together."

"But I'm forgetting something."

Reynard pauses, quite self-aware.
texts.zh:
"我们要为 Hannan 氏族成就一番大业，$titlePL，\"他的声音温和，却不知怎地带上了占有的意味，\"我们要一起创造历史。"

"不过我忘了一件事。"

Reynard 顿了顿，显然心里有数。

Say nothing
Dolos Macario.

texts.en:
"Dolos Macario, yes," he says.

"Contact the man who calls himself K-O Jove, on Qaras. I know you've met him already. He's been given instructions as well as payment for the service he shall provide. He will arrange matters to suit your requirements."

"Enjoy yourself," he says, attention wandering elsewhere. "I'm sure Dolos won't."
texts.zh:
"Dolos Macario，对，"他说。

"去 Qaras 联系那个自称 K-O Jove 的人。我知道你已经见过他。他既拿到了指令，也拿到了他即将提供的服务的报酬。他会把事情安排得合乎你的要求。"

"好好享受，\"他说，注意力已经飘到别处，\"我确信 Dolos 不会。"

texts.en: You detect the barest flash of annoyance for ruining his timing but Reynard recovers his poise immediately.
texts.zh: 你捕捉到他脸上一闪而过的不快——你坏了他的节奏——但 Reynard 立刻恢复了那副从容。

texts.en:
He looks away. "My patience has been tried. Good day."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
他移开目光。"我的耐心已经耗尽了。告辞。"

通讯断了。

texts.en:
"Does it matter what got him?"

He manages the suggestion of a shrug; not easy in his pose.

"I'm saying it could be done. And if I wanted to live a long, happy life - and I do - then I wouldn't go around making major powers of the Persean Sector my enemy."
texts.zh:
"他是怎么倒下的，有区别吗？"

他勉强做出一个耸肩的样子——以他这个姿势，可不容易。

"我是说，这种事办得到。而我要想长命百岁、过得舒坦——我确实想——那我就不会到处把英仙座星域的大势力都树成敌人。"

texts.en: "I think we're done with that." He picks up a TriPad. "Anything else?"
texts.zh: "我看这事就到此为止吧。\"他拿起 TriPad，\"还有别的事？"

options.en: This is important. What's your read on the situation?
options.zh: 这事很重要。你怎么看眼下的局面？

options.en: Don't you think this is important?
options.zh: 你不觉得这事很重要吗？

options.en: Why aren't you surprised by the clones?
options.zh: 你为什么对克隆体一点也不意外？

options.en: Can you profit from this?
So what should I do?
I think we're done with this subject.
options.zh: 这个话题就到此为止吧。

texts.en:
"Never said it wasn't," he says. "If you detect a certain exasperation in my manner credit it to your recklessness."

He takes a steady, calming breath.

"And I can't say I'm the least bit surprised Andrada had this scheme cooking for... since the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. Makes sense given his fundamentals."
texts.zh:
"我可没说过它不重要，\"他说，\"你要是在我身上瞧出一股不耐烦，那得记在你自己的鲁莽账上。"

他稳稳吸了一口气，把心气压下去。

"而且我一点也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅计划...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候就在炖了。以他的基本面，这很说得通。"

texts.en: "Sure," he says. "And I'm not surprised Andrada had something like this cooking... from the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. It makes sense given his fundamentals."
texts.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"我也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅东西...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候起就在炖了。以他的基本面来看，这很合理。"

texts.en:
"Imagine you're an egotistical maniac," he gives you a look. "Not merely egotistical a normal, justified amount, like me. Imagine a real loose fitting."

"If you really needed a backup, you could create children. Clones are a step better, though. More control. A more perfect vessel because you can count on them looking like you, more or less. Appeals to the ego, right?"

"Setting that aside, your first option would be life-extension, of course. But what if you're a paranoid dictator under tech restrictions and constant threat of hostile covert ops? Hard to find life-extension care you can trust."
texts.zh:
"想象你是个自大狂，\"他瞥了你一眼，\"不是像我这样，只自大到正常、合理的分量。想象一个彻底脱了缰的。"

"如果你真需要一个备份，你可以生孩子。克隆体要更进一步：更好控制。也更像一件完美的容器——你差不多能指望他们长得像你。这对自大狂很有吸引力，对吧？"

"撇开这个不谈，你的首选当然是延寿手段。可要是你是个偏执的独裁者，受着技术管制，还时刻面临敌对秘密行动的威胁呢？你很难找到信得过的延寿医疗。"

options.en: Why?

texts.en:
He rubs his fingers through his beard, thoughtful.

"They're delicate operations, potentially long recovery time. Need to stay awake to make sure no one gets any ideas. So do it quick and sophisticated. Domain-era tech like that has a limited pool of practitioners, and they're closely watched."

"Imagine if even one technician was compromised. Could do it subtle, switch a few codes in a custom protein-nanite top-up... built-in delay, make whatever went wrong look natural. Or like the fault of someone else."

Arroyo puts his hands behind his head, and leans back in his luxurious chair.

"Glad I'm not him."
texts.zh:
他手指捋过胡须，若有所思。

"那些手术都很精细，恢复期可能很长。你得保持清醒，好确保没人动歪心思。所以要做得又快又精。那种人之领时代的技术，能上手的人本来就没几个，而且都被盯得很紧。"

"想想看，只要有一个技师被人拿住了。动手可以很隐蔽：在定制的蛋白纳米补剂里换掉几个编码...设好延迟，让出问题的地方看起来是自然发生，或者像是别人的过失。"

Arroyo 双手枕到脑后，往他那张奢华的椅子里一靠。

"幸好我不是他。"

options.en: Are you saying Philip Andrada was murdered by a life extension treatment?
options.zh: 你是说 Philip Andrada 是被人用延寿治疗害死的？

"我是说，这种事办得到。而我要想长命百岁、过得舒坦——我确实想——那我就不会到处把英仙座星域的大势力都树成敌人。"

texts.en:
"Oh yes," he says confidently.

"And I'll consider my advice to you in this conversation to be sufficient payment for the tip-off. So don't try angling for a cut. You've got to do the work yourself."

He smirks.
texts.zh:
"哦，那当然，"他答得很笃定。

"至于这次谈话里给你的这些建议，我就当作够付你那份情报的钱了。所以别想着再从我这儿分一杯。活儿得你自己去干。"

他嘴角一撇，笑了。

texts.en:
"If I were you," he says, "I'd forget about all of it, sell my fleet, and invest in something stable so I could live a long, comfortable life."

He glares at you pre-emptively. "And if you don't like that advice, you shouldn't have asked in the first place."
texts.zh:
"要是我是你，\"他说，\"我就把这一切都忘掉，把舰队卖掉，投点稳当的产业，好让自己长长久久、安安稳稳地过完这辈子。"

他抢先瞪了你一眼。"你要是不爱听这建议，当初就不该来问。"

texts.en:
"Good. Me too." He picks up a TriPad.

"Anything else going on? Maybe something nice? Something that won't get poison slipped in my dinner or get me arrested by a covert-ops snatch-squad?"
texts.zh:
"很好。我也一样。"他拿起 TriPad。

"还有别的事吗？来点好消息？那种不会有人往我晚饭里下毒、也不会害我被秘密行动组的抓人小队逮走的事？"

texts.en:
Judging by the ostentatious uniform and spray of glittering decorations, the chair is a prominent Sindrian Diktat officer of Hector Andrada's Absolutist faction. One of the old guard who managed to keep his head on his shoulders and his lungs full of atmo through purges and civil war.

Hector Andrada has managed to seize control not only of the Sindrian Diktat, but of the peace settlement process.
texts.zh:
看那身招摇的制服与一片闪烁的勋饰，主席是 Hector Andrada 绝对派中一位显要的辛达强权军官。此人是老派人物中的一员，在一次次清洗与内战中既保住了脑袋，也始终没缺过一口气。

Hector Andrada 不仅夺取了辛达强权的控制权，连和谈进程也一并握在了手里。

The chair speaks, voice authoritative.

"We begin with the matter of Sindria..."

* * *

主席开口，语气威严。

"我们先从 Sindria 的事说起..."

After a moment, quiet settles over the commission.

The chair speaks, voice authoritative.

"We shall begin with a moment of silence for the dead of Sindria..."

主席开口，语气威严。

"开始之前，我们先为 Sindria 的死者默哀片刻..."

texts.en:
Words are spoken.

A "tragic repetition of the destruction of Opis" is invoked, and "all the Persean Sector mourns," among other phrases that can't but fail to capture the enormity and senselessness of death.
texts.zh:
话已说出口。

有人援引这"如同 Opis 毁灭的悲剧重演"，有人宣称"整个英仙座星域都在哀悼"——诸如此类的辞令，终究无法承载死亡的规模与毫无意义。

texts.en:
Images of chaos on Sindria. Food riots, soldiers abandoning their posts, banditry in the corridors of hive-arcologies.

With the collapse of any effective institution of the Sindrian Diktat, the interfactional commission recognizes the so-called "New Administration", an ad-hoc coalition of rebels, First Askonia Crisis refugees, and a few turncoast Diktat officers as the official ruling government.

Various factions have pledged aid and deployment of gendarmerie to assist in maintaining order as the new polity is organized - and investment concessions parcelled out.

The presumptive 'Supreme Executor' is nowhere to be found despite his hasty declaration of victory.
texts.zh:
Sindria 上的混乱画面。抢粮暴动，士兵弃岗，蜂巢穹顶城的走廊里匪盗横行。

辛达强权的有效机构尽数崩溃，跨势力委员会遂承认所谓的'新行政当局'为正式执政政府——那是一个由叛军、第一次 Askonia 危机难民和少数倒戈的辛达强权军官临时拼凑的联盟。

随着新政权组建，各方势力已承诺提供援助、派遣宪兵协助维持秩序——同时把投资特惠一块块分了出去。

那位自封的'最高元首'尽管匆匆宣布了胜利，此刻却踪影全无。

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Hector Andrada, victorious, resplendent in the uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"-total victory of the Sindrian Diktat, renewed, and with clarity of purpose, more powerful than ever! This is but a beginning of a great-"

His speech continues on themes of revenge and renewal.

Rank upon rank of officers, soldiers, crew in crisp uniforms. The golden statue of Philip Andrada looms over the infamous plaza before the headquarters of the Lion's Guard.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Hector Andrada 得胜，身着最高元首的制服，光鲜夺目。

"...辛达强权的彻底胜利，焕然一新、目标明确，比以往任何时候都更强大！这不过是一个伟大——"

他的讲话继续围绕着复仇与复兴。

一列列军官、士兵与船员，制服笔挺。Philip Andrada 的黄金雕像俯瞰着狮心卫队总部前那座声名狼藉的广场。

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Hector Andrada, victorious, eyes red and overactive, in the uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"-total victory of the Sindrian Diktat, renewed, and with clarity of purpose, more powerful than ever before! This is but a beginning of-"

His speech continues on themes of revenge and renewal.

Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew stand. There is smoke in the atmo, a slight haze that picks up the targeting lasers of security drones. The golden statue of Philip Andrada looms over the famous plaza before the headquarters of the Lion's Guard. Your eyes catch on an off-color patch; damage from an insurrectionist's bomb?
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Hector Andrada 得胜，双眼发红、亢奋过度，身着最高元首的制服。

"...辛达强权的彻底胜利，焕然一新、目标明确，比以往任何时候都更强大！这不过是一个——"

他的讲话继续围绕着复仇与复兴。

一列列军官、士兵与船员站得笔直。空气里有烟，薄薄的雾霭被安保无人机的瞄准激光一照，显出光路。Philip Andrada 的黄金雕像俯瞰着狮心卫队总部前那座著名的广场。你的目光被一块颜色不对的补丁吸住——是叛乱分子炸弹留下的损伤？

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat: Hector Andrada stands alone, eyes red and looking tired, yet alert - combat stims - in the uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"-total victory of the Sindrian Diktat, renewed!" His shout is manic. "With a clarity of purpose! More powerful than ever! This is but a beginning of-"

His speech continues on themes of revenge and renewal, somewhat rambling as he works himself into a rage. Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew watch stiffly. There is smoke in the atmo, a slight haze picking up the targeting lasers of the circling security drones.

A golden statue of Philip Andrada looms over him, and over the famous plaza before the headquarters of the Lion's Guard. Your eyes catch on an off-color patch; damage from an insurrectionist's bomb?
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像：Hector Andrada 独自站着，双眼发红，神情疲惫却又异常警醒——是战斗兴奋剂——身着最高元首的制服。

"...辛达强权的彻底胜利，焕然一新！\" 他这一声喊得近乎癫狂。\"目标明确！比以往任何时候都更强大！这不过是一个——"

他的讲话继续绕着复仇与复兴打转，越说越激动，渐渐语无伦次。一列列军官、士兵与船员僵直地站着。空气里有烟，薄雾被盘旋的安保无人机瞄准激光一照，显出光路。

Philip Andrada 的黄金雕像俯瞰着他，也俯瞰着狮心卫队总部前那座著名的广场。你的目光被一块颜色不对的补丁吸住——是叛乱分子炸弹留下的损伤？

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Achilles Andrada, victorious and stern, a fresh and young face of leadership in a minimally adorned uniform.

"-ew dawn upon a new age for the Sindrian Diktat! A dawn whose light shall burn away the corruption of the old ways, a light which heralds a new prosperity, a new beginning for-"

His speech continues on the theme.

Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew in uniform, cheering at every opportunity. Behind them, a small crowd of civilians. Marching white banners with tyrian insignia hang over an enormous starship bay.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Achilles Andrada 得胜而严肃，一身装饰极简的制服，是一张新鲜年轻的面孔。

"...辛达强权新时代的黎明！这道黎明的光将烧尽旧路的腐败，昭示新的繁荣，一个新的开端——"

他的讲话继续着同一个主题。

一列列军官、士兵与船员穿着制服，一有机会就欢呼。他们身后是一小群平民。缀着泰尔紫徽记的白色旗帜悬在一座巨大的星舰船坞上方。

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Achilles Andrada, victorious and stern, but tired, in a minimally adorned uniform.

"-ew dawn upon a new age for the Sindrian Diktat. A dawn whose light shall burn away the corruption of the old ways, a light which shall herald a new prosperity, a new beginning of-"

His speech continues on the theme. Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew in uniform. Behind them, a small crowd of civilians. Several white banners with tyrian insignia hang over an enormous starship bay. You note it is still cluttered with munitions pallets and a few damaged fighter-craft draped in forgecloth as if to hide the cost of war.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Achilles Andrada 得胜而严肃，却面带倦色，一身装饰极简的制服。

"...辛达强权新时代的黎明。这道黎明的光将烧尽旧路的腐败，昭示新的繁荣，一个新的开端——"

他的讲话继续着同一个主题。一列列军官、士兵与船员穿着制服。他们身后是一小群平民。几面缀着泰尔紫徽记的白旗悬在一座巨大的星舰船坞上方。你注意到，船坞里仍堆满弹药托盘，还有几架受损的战机盖着锻布，像是要遮住战争的代价。

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Achilles Andrada, victorious but tired, in a minimally adorned uniform. He looks to have aged by many cycles.

"-ew dawn upon a new age for the Sindrian Diktat. A dawn whose light shall burn away the corruption of the old ways, which heralds new prosperity, a beginning of-"

His speech continues on the theme, though it lacks the fire of his proclamation from the orbit of Yesod. Officers, soldiers, crew in uniform attend. Behind them, a small crowd of haggard-looking civilians.

A white banner with tyrian insignia hangs limp over an enormous starship bay. You note that the bay is cluttered with munitions pallets and damaged fighter-craft, the decking a mosaic of quick-fix plates installed by damage control teams.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Achilles Andrada 得胜，却满面倦容，一身装饰极简的制服。他看上去老了许多个星历年。

"...辛达强权新时代的黎明。这道黎明的光将烧尽旧路的腐败，昭示新的繁荣，一个新的开端——"

他的讲话继续着同一个主题，却已没有当初在 Yesod 轨道上那番宣言的火气。军官、士兵与船员身着制服列席。他们身后是一小群面容憔悴的平民。

一面缀着泰尔紫徽记的白旗软软地垂在一座巨大的星舰船坞上方。你注意到，船坞里堆满弹药托盘与受损的战机，甲板成了一张拼图，尽是损管队临时补上的快修板。

texts.en:
The last reliable reports available to the commission place Hector Andrada on a fast shuttle from his personal fleet to Sindria. He was scheduled to oversee a grand victory parade.

He is presumed dead.

So is his clone-twin, Achilles, presumed to have perished in space battle, or due to treachery in its aftermath at the hands of fleeing mercenaries.
texts.zh:
委员会手上最后一份可靠报告显示，Hector Andrada 正乘一艘快梭，从他本人的舰队前往 Sindria。按计划，他要去主持一场盛大的胜利阅兵。

他已被推定死亡。

他的克隆孪生兄弟 Achilles 也一样——据推测死于太空战，或是在战后被溃逃的雇佣兵反咬一口，死于背叛。

texts.en:
Achilles looks as though he has not slept for days, far older than the cycles he's lived.

His voice is flat as he declares his victory over his clone-brother, Hector, who is presumed dead.

He then announces the transfer of the capital of the Sindrian Diktat to Volturn and gives strained but outwardly gracious thanks to Fortuna Kato. He announces acceptance of Gens Kato sponsorship to expedite the process of becoming a full member of the Persean League.

Despite his victory, Achilles sounds defeated.
texts.zh:
Achilles 看上去像好几天没合眼，比他的年纪苍老得多。

他语调平板地宣布自己战胜了克隆兄弟 Hector——后者已被推定死亡。

随后他宣布将辛达强权的首都迁往 Volturn，并向 Fortuna Kato 道谢，言辞勉强，表面却还算得体。他宣布接受 Kato 氏族的资助，以加快成为英仙座联盟正式成员的进程。

明明赢了，Achilles 听起来却像个败者。

texts.en:
Achilles looks as though he has not slept for days, far older than the cycles he's lived.

His voice is flat as he declares his victory over his clone-brother, Hector, who is presumed dead.

Achilles announces the transfer of the capital of the Sindrian Diktat to Volturn. Despite his victory, he sounds defeated.
texts.zh:
Achilles 看上去像好几天没合眼，比他的年纪苍老得多。

他语调平板地宣布自己战胜了克隆兄弟 Hector——后者已被推定死亡。

Achilles 宣布将辛达强权的首都迁往 Volturn。尽管得胜，他听起来却像个败者。

texts.en:
Both Hector and Achilles Andrada are presumed dead, whether in battle or in the following chaos of scattering war-fleets that found themselves serving no polity that could shield them from war-crime investigations.

There will be many more mercenaries, pirates, and brigands hiding in dark orbits of the Persean Sector's fringe in the coming cycles.

The commission recommends a full investigation to quash rumors of living heirs of Andrada, and to find and disarm the fleeing fleets of the former Sindrian Diktat. Funding for these measures is still a matter of negotiation between the major factions.
texts.zh:
Hector 与 Achilles Andrada 都被推定死亡——或死于战斗，或死于随后四散奔逃的战争舰队所引发的混乱：那些舰队效忠的政权都已不存在，没人能护着它们躲过战争罪调查。

接下来的许多个星历年里，英仙座星域边陲的阴暗轨道上，会藏着更多雇佣兵、海盗与匪帮。

委员会建议展开全面调查，以平息 Andrada 尚有继承人活着的传言，并寻获前辛达强权那些溃逃的舰队、解除其武装。相关经费仍需各主要势力之间协商。

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

You should not see this fallback option. This occurred because ownership of Volturn is doing something strange?
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

你不该看到这个兜底选项。出现这种情况，是因为 Volturn 的归属出了什么怪事？

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The commission acknowledges and affirms the Sindrian Diktat's claim, recognizing that the new Supreme Executor has 'committed to humanitarian reforms' and has agreed to form a judicial group to 'investigate the alleged abuses of the previous regime'.

The Luddic faithful are not mentioned.

These proclamations are not made without objection in the commission chamber, but the feed cuts quickly onward.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

委员会承认并确认辛达强权的主张，认可新任最高元首'致力于人道改革'，并已同意组建一个司法小组，'调查前政权被指控的滥权行为'。

卢德信徒只字未提。

这些宣布在委员会会场里并非没有反对之声，但转播画面很快便切走了。

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The commission acknowledges and affirms the Sindrian Diktat's claim to Volturn with all the understated irony of bureaucratic procedure.

With Sindria destroyed, Achilles has elected to relocate his government to Volturn. The Sindrian Diktat itself remains an independent polity, though barely.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

委员会以官僚程序特有的、不动声色的讽刺，承认并确认辛达强权对 Volturn 的主张。

Sindria 既已毁灭，Achilles 选择把政府迁往 Volturn。辛达强权本身仍是一个独立政权——只是勉强还算得上。

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The commission acknowledges and affirms the Sindrian Diktat's claim to Volturn (though not without dissent judging by a few awkward, atemporal jumps in the chair's speech).

A statement from the Supreme Executor, Hector Andrada, is cast, promising to "stamp out Luddic terrorism for all time" and laying the blame for failure to do so in previous cycles at the feet of "treasonous and corrupt officials who lacked the conviction to use appropriate force".

There will be additional purges.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

委员会承认并确认辛达强权对 Volturn 的主张 (不过从主席讲话里几处突兀的、不合时宜的跳接来看，并非没有异议)。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 的声明随即播出，他承诺要"永远根除卢德恐怖主义"，并把过去几个星历年未能做到这一点归咎于"那些叛国而腐败的官员，他们缺乏动用适当武力的决心"。

还会有更多清洗。

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The commission recognizes a new, nominally unaligned civilian administration; a motley polity split between leaders of the local uprising and former refugees from the First Askonia Crisis.

The Knights of Ludd, Hegemony, and Persean League - with some contention - have offered security guarantees and made token, temporary, deployments of surface forces to ensure an orderly reconstruction.

Economic and political concessions are not directly elaborated.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

委员会承认一个新的、名义上不结盟的文人政府；这个杂色的政体由当地起义的领袖与第一次 Askonia 危机的旧难民分掌。

卢德骑士团、霸主与英仙座联盟——其间不乏争执——已提供安全保证，并象征性地、临时性地部署了地面部队，以确保重建有序进行。

至于经济与政治上的让步，则没有直接说明。

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The interfactional commission recognizes a staged disarmament of the Volturnian Self Defense Covenant and transfer of administration authority to a new ruling body backed by the Church of Galactic Redemption.

A lance of Knights of Ludd has already landed, you see via holo feed, and accepted custody of certain prominent prisoners taken by the VSDC.

It feels as though the observing factions breathe a collective sigh of relief at avoiding the fall of another world to the Path.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

跨势力委员会承认 Volturn 自卫盟约将分阶段解除武装，行政权移交给一个由银河救赎教会支持的新统治机构。

全息画面里，你已经看到一队卢德骑士团的人马登陆，接收了 VSDC 抓获的几名要犯。

看样子，旁观各方都暗暗松了口气：又一颗星球没有落入左径之手。

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

Achilles has moved his government to Volturn and submitted to League membership, thus becoming Demarchon of the Sindrian Diktat of the Askonia System.

The commission has no choice to recognize this state of affairs as the best of many worse possibilities. It is thought that a strong leader, humbled though he is, may keep the Luddic uprisings in check - and above all suppress the influence of the Luddic Path.

Achilles looks tired in the holo-feed, aged by cycles, and his victory speech lacks energy. The Andrada steel is tarnished, it seems.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

Achilles 已将政府迁往 Volturn，并接受加入联盟，从而成为 Askonia 星系辛达强权的统领。

委员会别无选择，只能承认这一局面已是诸多更坏可能中最好的一个。人们的想法是：一个强有力的领袖，哪怕已被折了锐气，或许仍能压住卢德派的暴动——尤其是遏制卢德左径的势力。

全息画面里的 Achilles 面带倦色，被星历年催老了；他的胜利演说也提不起劲。Andrada 家的钢铁，看来也锈了。

texts.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

A representative of the Sindrian Diktat appears, one of the earliest proclaimers for the Absolutist faction: Laverna Tell, whose dark reputation precedes her. By her black uniform and peaked cap she displays her peculiar position in the Internal Security Ministry.

Tell announces an expansion of the Cruror prison system, seven new penal trains with expectations of increased output pending a system-wide sweep for "traitorous elements".
texts.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

一位辛达强权代表出现，她是绝对派最早的拥趸之一：Laverna Tell，此人的恶名早已先她而至。从她那身黑色制服与带檐军帽，便可看出她在内部安全部的特殊地位。

Tell 宣布扩建 Cruor 监狱系统，新增七列囚犯列车，并预计在全星系范围内清扫"叛国分子"之后，产出还将进一步提高。

texts.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

A representative of the Reformed faction of the Sindrian Diktat appears, their uniform conspicuously less ostentatious than the previous regime, to announce the intention of the Transitional Oversight Committee of the Internal Security Ministry to implement an expedited sentence review process for so-called "legacy" prisoners.

In the meantime, however, economic and social stability must be secured, so it is "regrettably necessary" for prisoners to continue fulfilling their work-sentences.

The Diktat representative emphasizes that it will be a difficult process for everyone.
texts.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

一位辛达强权改革派代表出现，其制服明显不如前政权那般招摇；此人宣布，内部安全部过渡监督委员会打算对所谓"遗留"囚犯实行加速刑期复核。

然而在此期间，经济与社会的稳定必须得到保障，因此囚犯继续服劳役乃是"令人遗憾的必要之举"。

这位辛达强权代表强调，这对所有人来说都将是一个艰难的过程。

texts.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

The commission recognizes Cruor as effectively under control of Achilles Andrada's reduced Sindrian Diktat - in effect becoming a sub-polity of the Persean League. The Commission expresses hope that the "excesses" of the previous administration might be curbed by League influence.

It is noted that Prime Demarchon Reynard Hannan has released a statement emphasizing that he has full confidence that the League's newest demarchon does not require intervention from the All-League council to carry out appropriate reforms.
texts.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

委员会承认 Cruor 实际上已在 Achilles Andrada 那个缩水后的辛达强权控制之下——实质上成了英仙座联盟的附属政体。委员会表示，希望联盟的影响能遏制前政权的"过度之举"。

另据提到，大统领 Reynard Hannan 已发表声明，强调他完全相信联盟这位最新入列的统领无需全联盟议会干预，自会推行适当的改革。

texts.en:
The tortured moon, Cruor, appears.

Following the devastation of the Second Askonia Crisis, the reigning governor fled as local authority crumbled. The private paramilitary corporations operating the prison-trains, left unpaid and directionless, turned bandit and either conscripted their prisoners or abandoned them to a rapid (but not instant) death on the hellish surface.

The chair explains that the commission has approved a framework for aid and enforcement, but it is up to in-system authorities to take action.

The lack of any named entities to carry out this aid is conspicuous.
texts.zh:
受尽折磨的卫星 Cruor 浮现出来。

第二次 Askonia 危机之后，当地政权崩解，在任总督出逃。运营囚车的私营准军事公司拿不到钱，也没了指挥，索性落草为寇——要么把囚犯强征入伙，要么把他们丢在那地狱般的表面，任其速死 (倒也不是立刻就死)。

主席解释说，委员会已批准一套援助与执法的框架，但具体行动要由星系内当局自行采取。

这份援助最终由谁来执行，通篇没有一个具名实体——这一点颇为扎眼。

texts.en:
The tortured moon, Cruor, appears.

Following the devastation of the Second Askonia Crisis, the governor fled and local officers charged with supervising the private paramilitary corporations overseeing the prison-trains were left unpaid and directionless. Most turned to warlordism and either conscripted their prisoners or abandoned them to a rapid (but not instant) death on the hellish surface.

The chair describes that the commission has agreed upon a framework for aid and enforcement, but it is up to in-system authorities to first take action. No concrete funding mechanism for this interfactional anti-piracy initiative has been agreed upon... yet.
texts.zh:
受尽折磨的卫星 Cruor 浮现出来。

第二次 Askonia 危机之后，总督出逃，负责监管那些运营囚车的私营准军事公司的当地军官断了饷，也没了方向。多数人索性做起了军阀，要么把囚犯强征入伙，要么把他们丢在那地狱般的表面，任其速死 (倒也不是立刻就死)。

主席说，委员会已就一套援助与执法的框架达成一致，但首先得由星系内当局采取行动。至于这项跨势力反海盗行动的具体经费机制，各方尚未谈成...暂时还没有。

texts.en:
The commission recognizes the "long overdue" claim of the Sindrian Diktat over Nortia, per the victorious Supreme Executor's demands.

Hector promises more purges and a widespread hunt for traitors and terrorists. New methods are to be used based on new technologies purchased from Tri-Tachyon. Drones and surveillance technology will extend the manpower of the Sindrian Diktat, which must give first priority toward rebuilding a grand navy in pursuit of greater ambitions...
texts.zh:
委员会按照得胜的最高元首的要求，承认辛达强权对 Nortia 那项"早该兑现"的主张。

Hector 承诺将展开更多清洗，并大举搜捕叛徒与恐怖分子。他还打算采用从速子科技购得的新技术、以新手段行事。无人机与监控技术将弥补辛达强权的人力不足；而辛达强权必须把重建一支庞大海军列为头等要务，以图更大的抱负...

texts.en:
The commission recognizes the victorious Supreme Executor's proclamation that Nortia shall be placed under the 'stewardship' of the Sindrian Diktat.

Achilles Andrada announces clemency for non-combatant members of the ACA and promises a 'considered justice' for the rest who lay down arms and turn themselves in voluntarily.

Those who do not, however, shall still be considered terrorists and pirates and treated as such.
texts.zh:
委员会承认得胜的最高元首所发布的公告：Nortia 将置于辛达强权的'监管'之下。

Achilles Andrada 宣布对 ACA 的非战斗人员予以宽赦，并承诺对其余主动放下武器、前来自首者给予'经审慎考虑的公正处置'。

至于不肯投降的人，则仍将被视为恐怖分子与海盗，并按此对待。

texts.en:
After much deliberation, the commission begrudgingly recognizes the victorious Supreme Executor's proclamation that Nortia shall be placed under the 'stewardship' of the Sindrian Diktat.

The issue appears to have been settled only due to Achilles' recognition as demarchon by the Persean League's All-League Council. It is not quite said outright that the Commission hopes that association with the League will temper the excesses of Diktat policy - and that Achilles' broad domestic authority might suppress the rebels and smugglers who have long used Nortia as their base.

Achilles Andrada proclaims provisional clemency for non-combatant members of the ACA and promises a 'considered justice' for the rest who lay down their weapons and turn themselves in.
texts.zh:
经过反复商议，委员会才不情不愿地承认得胜的最高元首的公告：Nortia 将置于辛达强权的'监管'之下。

此事之所以能了结，看来只因英仙座联盟的全联盟议会承认了 Achilles 的统领身份。委员会未曾明说，但它希望与联盟的联合能缓和辛达强权政策的过度之处——也希望 Achilles 手中宽广的国内权力能压住那些长期以 Nortia 为基地的叛军与走私者。

Achilles Andrada 宣布对 ACA 的非战斗人员给予临时宽赦，并承诺对放下武器、前来自首的其余人等给予'经审慎考虑的公正处置'。

texts.en:
After much deliberation, the commission begrudgingly recognizes that Nortia shall be placed under the 'stewardship' of the Persean League.

The issue appears to have been settled only due to Achilles' recognition as demarchon by the Persean League's All-League Council. The fact that Achilles has not been seen since the end of the conflict has not stopped the establishment of a 'transitional' administration. It is not quite said outright that the Commission - over Hegemony objection - hopes that association with the League might suppress the rebels and smugglers who have long used Nortia as their base.

Provisional clemency for non-combatant members of the ACA is given, and a 'considered justice' is promised for the rest who lay down their weapons and turn themselves in.
texts.zh:
经过反复商议，委员会才不情不愿地承认 Nortia 将置于英仙座联盟的'监管'之下。

此事之所以能了结，看来只因英仙座联盟的全联盟议会承认了 Achilles 的统领身份。Achilles 自冲突结束以来再未露面，这并未妨碍一个'过渡'政府的建立。委员会未曾明说，但它在霸主的反对声中仍希望：与联盟的联合或许能压住那些长期以 Nortia 为基地的叛军与走私者。

ACA 的非战斗人员获得了临时宽赦，其余放下武器、前来自首者则被许诺以'经审慎考虑的公正处置'。

texts.en:
As it happens, a coalition of front companies majority-owned by senior Tri-Tachyon executives quietly bought up most of the industry of Nortia just before the chaos of the Second Askonia Crisis truly erupted into civil war.

Citing the right to protect investments, the commission has agreed to recognize a Tri-Tachyon sponsored defense corporation's stewardship of Nortia. Left unspoken is a hope that assertive domestic suppression may quell the rebels and smugglers who have long made Nortia their base of operations.

It appears some among the Opis diaspora have become very rich from this arrangement, or soon will. Others condemn them as traitors who have profited from the death of their homeworld.
texts.zh:
事情是这样的：就在第二次 Askonia 危机的混乱真正演成内战之前，一批由速子科技高层主管持有多数股权的空壳公司联手悄然买下了 Nortia 的大部分产业。

委员会援引保护投资的权利，同意承认一家由速子科技资助的防务公司对 Nortia 的'监管'。未曾说出口的是：他们希望这种强硬的本土镇压能平息那些长期以 Nortia 为据点的叛军与走私者。

看来 Opis 侨民中有一些人已靠这番安排大发其财，或很快就要发财。另一些人则斥之为叛徒——靠故乡的毁灭牟利。

texts.en:
After what appears to be a palace coup within the Charterist-dominated civilian government of Nortia, a request for overt Hegemony military assistance was made and immediately granted by a small task force which happened to be on maneuvers just outside the Askonia system.

The commission recognizes Hegemony stewardship of Nortia's internal safety and interstellar defense - so long as the civilian government approves the agreement.

They do, of course. And it is unclear what authority would oust Hegemony forces if Nortia renounced the arrangement, but that is not a problem for the Commission to solve.

A typical Hegemony arrangement, in other words.
texts.zh:
在 Nortia 那个由宪章派主导的文人政府内部发生了一场看似宫廷政变的变故之后，有人提出了公开请求霸主军事援助的要求，而一支恰好在 Askonia 星系外演习的小型特遣舰队立即予以批准。

委员会承认霸主对 Nortia 内部安全与星际防务的'监管'——前提是文人政府批准这项协议。

他们当然批准了。假如 Nortia 日后废除这项安排，又有哪个机构能把霸主军队赶走，这倒说不清楚——不过这可不是委员会要解决的问题。

换句话说，典型的一桩霸主式安排。

texts.en:
The situation on Nortia has devolved considerably as various splintering resistance groups - and opportunists - have turned to infighting and begun making alliances with various mercenaries and even pirate gangs as the fragile governing framework continues to break down into violence.

The commission signs off on a statement of concern and calls on major factions to allocate funds toward a joint anti-piracy taskforce.

It remains to be seen what, if anything, will be done.
texts.zh:
Nortia 的局势已大幅恶化：各路分裂的抵抗组织——还有投机分子——转而内斗，并开始与形形色色的雇佣兵乃至海盗帮派结盟；那套脆弱的管理框架正不断崩解为暴力。

委员会签署了一份表示关切的声明，并呼吁各主要势力拨款组建一支联合反海盗特遣队。

至于究竟会做些什么——甚至会不会做——尚待分晓。

texts.en:
Nortia's dark surface is sprinkled with pinpoints of light, suggestive of a particularly lively patch of the night sky.

The commission calls upon major factions to recognize the independent Charterist administration of Nortia - though the response from factional representatives is typically noncommittal.

Nonetheless, the independent civilian polity has received financial guarantees from elite members of the First Askonia Crisis exodus and an extension of the previous security guarantee from the Hegemony itself which concedes a "temporarily deferral of oversight to the local executive due to a proven record of responsible governorship".
texts.zh:
Nortia 漆黑的表面撒着点点灯火，像一片格外热闹的夜空。

委员会呼吁各主要势力承认 Nortia 独立的宪章派政府——不过各方代表的回应照例含糊其辞。

尽管如此，这个独立的文人政体还是得到了第一次 Askonia 危机流亡者中精英人士的财政担保，以及霸主本身对既有安全保证的延期——霸主在文中承认"鉴于其治理负责的记录已获证实，监督权暂时下放给当地行政机构"。

texts.en:
The feed returns to the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

The display in the center of the makeshift meeting chamber shows a lumpy celestial sphere, ringed in the blood-red iconography of hostile patrols buzzing in erratic orbits.

Umbra.

The chair stands, face grim, and declares that the commission could not come to an enforcement agreement regarding 'the Umbra situation', despite drafting several compelling statements of intent.

The unspoken implication is that Umbra will remain under de-facto control of rebels and pirates, though perhaps more now the latter as the ARC's cause withers for another generation and the planet is flooded with unemployed mercs.
texts.zh:
画面切回跨势力调解委员会。

临时会场中央的显示屏上，一颗坑洼不平的天体悬在那里，周围环着一圈血红色的敌对巡逻队图标，在不规则的轨道上嗡嗡打转。

Umbra。

主席起身，面色阴沉，宣布委员会未能就'Umbra 局势'达成任何执行协议——尽管已经起草了好几份措辞有力的意向声明。

言下之意再明白不过：Umbra 仍将处于叛军与海盗的实际控制之下——不过如今多半是后者占上风，因为 ARC 的事业又要再沉寂一代人，而这颗星球上已挤满了失业的雇佣兵。

texts.en:
The chair explains that the commission's foremost purpose is to avoid Sector-wide war, a process which requires compromise despite the objections of certain parties to the commission.

As such, Hector Andrada's declaration of Sindrian Diktat conquest of Umbra is recognized. It is understood that a strong authority will suppress piracy, and lacking an interfactional initiative, Hector has provided a solution that will benefit the entire Sector, in the long run.

A vanguard of battle-hardened Diktat shock marines has already been dispatched to assault the most ostentatious pirate holdouts. Meanwhile, privately commissioned security forces are being recruited in nearby systems. Steady pay and lax requirements are welcome to those who cannot find steady work elsewhere, for whatever reason.
texts.zh:
主席解释说，委员会的首要目的是避免全星域范围的战争，而这一进程需要妥协，哪怕委员会中某些方面有所反对。

因此，Hector Andrada 关于辛达强权征服 Umbra 的宣告获得承认。各方都明白，一个强有力的权威会镇压海盗；既然跨势力层面拿不出方案，Hector 便提供了一个从长远看将使整个星域受益的解决办法。

一支身经百战的辛达强权突击陆战队先锋已经派出，去攻打那些最招摇的海盗据点。与此同时，私营的安全部队正在附近星系招募。稳定薪水加上宽松的条件，对那些在别处找不到稳定工作的人来说——不管出于什么原因——总是受欢迎的。

texts.en:
The chair explains that the commission's foremost purpose is to avoid Sector-wide war, a process which requires compromise despite the objections of certain parties to the commission.

As such, Achilles Andrada's declaration that the Sindrian Diktat's volume of interest encompasses Umbra is recognized. It is understood that a strong authority will suppress piracy to benefit commerce throughout the sector.

A vanguard of battle-hardened mercenary shock marines - freshly inducted as a guard unit directly under the office of the Supreme Executor - has already been dispatched to assault the most ostentatious pirate holdouts. Meanwhile, privately commissioned security forces are being recruited from nearby systems. Steady pay and lax requirements are welcome to those who cannot find steady work elsewhere.
texts.zh:
主席解释说，委员会的首要目的是避免全星域范围的战争，而这一进程需要妥协，哪怕委员会中某些方面有所反对。

因此，Achilles Andrada 关于 Umbra 属于辛达强权利益范围的宣告获得承认。各方都明白，一个强有力的权威会镇压海盗，从而惠及全星域的商贸。

一支身经百战的雇佣兵突击陆战队先锋——刚刚被收编为直属最高元首办公室的卫队单位——已经派出，去攻打那些最招摇的海盗据点。与此同时，私营的安全部队正在附近星系招募。稳定薪水加上宽松条件，对那些在别处找不到稳定工作的人来说总是受欢迎的。

texts.en:
In a surprise move, several mercenary companies sponsored by the Askonian Charterist government-in-exile managed to infiltrate Umbra and, through a combination of bribery and quick action, seized control of key infrastructure centers.

The siege of several pirate strongholds and bunkers continues, but the ARC revolutionary cadres have been left without space access or firepower to effectively oppose occupation by outside PMCs.

The commission eagerly recognizes this new, legitimate government in the interest of reducing piracy and ANTI-style insurgency in the Persean Sector. The chair expresses satisfaction that the question on Umbra could be settled so quickly, and relatively bloodlessly.
texts.zh:
出人意料的是，几家由 Askonia 宪章派流亡政府资助的雇佣兵公司成功潜入 Umbra，靠行贿与迅疾行动，夺取了几处关键基础设施的控制权。

对几处海盗堡垒与地堡的围攻仍在继续，但 ARC 的革命骨干已失去太空通道与火力，无法有效抵抗外部军事承包商的占领。

委员会欣然承认这个新的合法政府，以图减少英仙座星域的海盗活动和 ANTI 式的叛乱。主席表示满意：Umbra 的问题竟能如此迅速地、相对不流血地得到解决。

texts.en:
The dark face of Umbra flickers sullenly in the center of the commission chamber.

In light of a surprise Hegemony "anti-piracy" operation performed with the backing of prominent members of the post-Opis diaspora, the commission recommends recognition of the newly established civilian government of Umbra.

This new government has rapidly agreed that Umbra shall be placed under Hegemony occupation 'until order is restored and a good government is properly re-established'.

A minor bureaucrat steps forward to announce that there will be expedited processing of investigations into claims regarding capital investments made by refugees of the First Askonia Crisis so that 'property may be restored to rightful owners'.
texts.zh:
Umbra 阴暗的面孔在委员会会场中央阴沉地闪动。

鉴于霸主在 Opis 后裔侨民中显要人士的支持下发动了一场出人意料的"反海盗"行动，委员会建议承认 Umbra 新成立的文人政府。

这个新政府迅速同意：Umbra 将置于霸主的占领之下，'直至秩序恢复、良善政府正式重建'。

一名小官僚走上前来宣布，将加快处理第一次 Askonia 危机难民就资本投资提出的申诉，好让'财产归还合法所有者'。

texts.en:
The dark face of Umbra flickers sullenly in the center of the commission chamber.

The Second Askonia Crisis provided an opportunity for a group of front-companies owned by a Tri-Tachyon executive group to 'make an offer' to the leading pirate bosses of Umbra. With the assistance of an elite mercenary company - and the requisite bribery and assassination campaign - opposition both piratical and political was driven into either deep space or deep underground.

In light of redevelopment financing embraced by prominent members of the post-Opis diaspora who lost important capital investments to both piracy and ANTI-style insurgency, the Commission has recognized the Tri-Tachyon sponsored PMC which now asserts authority over the small planet.

An armed occupation is, sadly, necessary "until order and good government is restored".
texts.zh:
Umbra 阴暗的面孔在委员会会场中央阴沉地闪动。

第二次 Askonia 危机给了速子科技一个高管集团旗下的一批空壳公司一个机会，向 Umbra 的海盗头目们'提了个条件'。在一家精锐雇佣兵公司的协助下——再加上必不可少的行贿与暗杀——海盗方面与政治方面的反对力量，或被赶进深空，或被逼入地下深处。

鉴于 Opis 后裔侨民中那些因海盗与 ANTI 式叛乱而损失了重要资本投资的显要人士欣然接受重建融资，委员会已承认这家由速子科技资助、如今对这颗小行星主张管辖权的军事承包商。

遗憾的是，武装占领是必要的——'直至秩序与良善政府恢复'。

texts.en:
The dark face of Umbra flickers sullenly in the center of the commission chamber.

A fiery debate erupted in the commission concerning a surprise proclamation from the victorious yet beleaguered new Supreme Executor, Achilles Andrada. The Sindrian Diktat, it seems, "invites the All-League Council to carry out anti-piracy operations in the interest of securing safe commerce and travel in the volume of Umbra and greater Askonia."

A small Persean League task force performing maneuvers in nearby hyperspace was quick to accept the invitation to invade.

In light of the generous redevelopment financing enthusiastically embraced by a group of well-to-do families of the post-Opis diaspora (in a junior partnership with a prominent Gens of Kazeron), the Commission has agreed by narrow vote to recognize the existing state of affairs.
texts.zh:
Umbra 阴暗的面孔在委员会会场中央阴沉地闪动。

一场激烈的辩论在委员会中爆发，起因是新任最高元首 Achilles Andrada 一项出人意料的宣告——他虽得胜，却已四面受困。辛达强权似乎"邀请全联盟议会在 Umbra 及大 Askonia 空域开展反海盗行动，以保障商贸与航行的安全"。

一支正在附近超空间演习的英仙座联盟小型特遣舰队，很快就接受了这份入侵的邀请。

鉴于 Opis 后裔侨民中一群富裕家族 (与 Kazeron 一个显赫氏族结成下级合伙关系) 热情拥抱了慷慨的重建融资，委员会以微弱多数同意承认既成事实。

texts.en:
The chair proceeds to deliver a speech extolling the success of interfactional compromise without even a slip of dark sarcasm.

Having heard the important parts, you allow your thoughts to turn inward.
texts.zh:
主席接着发表讲话，盛赞跨势力妥协的成果，连一丝阴沉的讥讽都没有流露。

重要的部分都听过了，你任由思绪转向内心。

texts.en: You once contemplated the downfall of Philip Andrada and his whole rotten Diktat - and now you've seen it done. The once immortal empire of the Supreme Executor is reduced to burning rubble and painful memories.
texts.zh: 你曾盘算过让 Philip Andrada 和他那整个腐朽的强权垮台——如今你亲眼看着它成真。最高元首那曾经不朽的帝国，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的回忆。

texts.en: Hector Andrada, heir to Philip and a fitting renewal of the blood of the Lion, reigns as Supreme Executor. Just as you intended.
texts.zh: Hector Andrada，Philip 的继承人，也是雄狮血脉一次恰如其分的延续，如今以最高元首之尊统治。一如你所谋划。

texts.en: Achilles Andrada, heir to Philip, but perhaps something more, now reigns as Supreme Executor. Just as you intended.
texts.zh: Achilles Andrada，Philip 的继承人，或许还意味着更多，如今以最高元首之尊统治。一如你所谋划。

texts.en: The Sindrian Diktat is destroyed, wiped from the face of the Sector, reduced to burning rubble and memories of pain.
texts.zh: 辛达强权已被摧毁，从星域版图上抹去，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的记忆。

texts.en:
You've seen the Sindrian Diktat destroyed, reduced to burning rubble and memories of pain. Where is Achilles, the promised reformer, the Supreme Executor?

Rumors abound. The official story references a counter-mutiny by twice-turncoat mid-level officers; a bomb set on the bridge of his flagship.

His body has not been found.
texts.zh:
你亲眼看着辛达强权被摧毁，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的记忆。Achilles 呢？那位被许诺的改革者、那位最高元首，如今在哪里？

流言四起。官方说法提到的是一场由二度倒戈的中层军官发动的反叛变；还有一枚安在他旗舰舰桥上的炸弹。

他的遗体至今未被找到。

texts.en: You've seen the Sindrian Diktat destroyed, reduced to burning rubble and memories of pain.
texts.zh: 你亲眼看着辛达强权被摧毁，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的记忆。

texts.en: You've seen the Sindrian Diktat reduced and purged and reformed in the crucible of civil war - Philip's world-vision reified through violence, though not quite as he imagined it.
texts.zh: 你亲眼看着辛达强权在内战的熔炉里被削弱、清洗、重塑——Philip 的世界构想借暴力成了实体，只是不太像他当初想象的样子。

texts.en: You've seen the Sindrian Diktat reduced, though not destroyed. The hulks burning in far orbits will smolder to the cold of night, the hearts of their weapons and reactors slowly scavenged. Meanwhile long-remembered pains find new life, multiplied and renewed.
texts.zh: 你亲眼看着辛达强权被削弱，却未被摧毁。远轨道上燃烧的残骸会慢慢熄成夜的冷灰，它们武器与反应堆的心脏将被一点点拆走。而与此同时，那些被记了很久的伤痛又活了过来，成倍地翻新。

options.en: What about Dolos Macario?

texts.en:
The name 'Dolos Macario' is buried deep in the supplementary files attached to the broadcast, in a long list of rogue Diktat officers (and other terrorists, agitators, criminals, and seemingly completely random people) declared 'persons of interest' by the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

Macario is wanted for questioning concerning a long list of alleged acts which violate the Persean Sector Interfactional Agreement on Human Rights, circa cycle 101.

There is a good chance he died in the murder of Sindria.
At Caden's hand.
texts.zh:
"Dolos Macario"这个名字深埋在转播附带的补充文件里，夹在一长串被跨势力调解委员会列为"重点关注对象"的强权叛变军官 (以及别的恐怖分子、煽动者、罪犯，还有些看上去完全是随机抓来的人) 之中。

Macario 因一长串涉嫌违反【英仙座星域跨势力人权协定】的行为而被通缉受审，该协定约订立于星历 101 年。

他很可能死于 Sindria 的那场大屠杀。
死在 Caden 手上。

texts.en:
From what you can tell, reading between the lines of official pronouncements, he's safe and secure in Hector Andrada's revitalized Sindrian Diktat.

And you haven't seen his face once since the end of hostilities.

Macario seems to have withdrawn to the shadows, content to be a manipulator behind the scenes. The Spider of Sindria, safe in his secret tunnels and bunkers wormed through the flesh of that world.
texts.zh:
从官方声明的字里行间推断，他在 Hector Andrada 重振后的辛达强权里安稳无虞，位子稳当。

而自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过他的脸。

Macario 似乎退回了暗处，甘心做个幕后操盘手。辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛，安然待在他那些钻透那颗星球血肉的密道与地堡里。

texts.en:
From what you can tell, reading between the lines of official pronouncements... it's hard to say if he's dead or alive, hidden or missing.

You haven't seen his face once since the end of hostilities.

Macario seems to have withdrawn to the shadows, the Spider of Sindria being content to be a manipulator behind the scenes. Or he's a cooling corpse in some secret tunnels or bunker-complex wormed through the flesh of Sindria.
texts.zh:
从官方声明的字里行间推断...很难说他究竟是死是活，是藏起来了还是失踪了。

自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过他的脸。

Macario 似乎退回了暗处，辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛甘心做个幕后操盘手。又或者，他已经是一具渐渐冷掉的尸体，躺在某条密道里，或某个钻透辛达瑞亚血肉的地堡群中。

texts.en:
There's an odd appendix to the Commission's findings - the name 'Dolos Macario' is buried deep in the supplementary files attached to the broadcast, in a long list of rogue Diktat officers (and other terrorists, agitators, criminals, and seemingly completely random people) declared 'persons of interest' by the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

And co-signed by Supreme Executor Hector Andrada himself.

You haven't seen Macario's face since the end of hostilities. The contributions of the Ministry of Internal Security have been downplayed, and a quick analysis of the purge lists suggest that there have been enormous upheavals in staffing. Any sign of Macario's former prestige seems to have been erased, and his organization rooted out from the secret tunnels and bunkers wormed through the flesh of Sindria.
texts.zh:
委员会的调查结论后附着一份古怪的附录——"Dolos Macario"这个名字深埋在转播附带的补充文件里，夹在一长串被跨势力调解委员会列为"重点关注对象"的强权叛变军官 (以及别的恐怖分子、煽动者、罪犯，还有些看上去完全是随机抓来的人) 之中。

而且由最高元首 Hector Andrada 本人联署。

自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过 Macario 的脸。内部安全部的功劳被淡化了，粗略分析那些清洗名单就能看出，人事上有过天翻地覆的变动。Macario 昔日威望的任何痕迹似乎都被抹去，他的组织也被从那些钻透辛达瑞亚血肉的密道与地堡里连根拔起。

texts.en:
There's an odd appendix to the Commission's findings - the name 'Dolos Macario' is buried in the supplementary files attached to the broadcast, in a long list of rogue Diktat officers (and other terrorists, agitators, criminals, and seemingly completely random people) declared 'persons of interest' by the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

Co-signed by Supreme Executor Achilles Andrada himself.

You haven't seen Macario's face since the end of hostilities. A quick analysis of the purge lists suggest that there have been enormous upheavals in the civic and intelligence apparatus of the newly-unified Sindrian Diktat. Any sign of Macario's former influence seems to have been erased, and his organization rooted out from the secret tunnels and bunkers wormed through the flesh of Sindria.
texts.zh:
委员会的调查结论后附着一份古怪的附录——"Dolos Macario"这个名字埋在转播附带的补充文件里，夹在一长串被跨势力调解委员会列为"重点关注对象"的强权叛变军官 (以及别的恐怖分子、煽动者、罪犯，还有些看上去完全是随机抓来的人) 之中。

由最高元首 Achilles Andrada 本人联署。

自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过 Macario 的脸。粗略分析清洗名单就能看出，新近统一的辛达强权在民政与情报机构里经历过天翻地覆的变动。Macario 昔日影响力的任何痕迹似乎都被抹去，他的组织也被从那些钻透辛达瑞亚血肉的密道与地堡里连根拔起。

texts.en:
The name 'Dolos Macario' is buried deep in the supplementary files attached to the broadcast, in a long list of rogue Diktat officers (and other terrorists, agitators, criminals, and seemingly completely random people) declared 'persons of interest' by the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

He is wanted for questioning concerning a long list of alleged acts which violated the Persean Sector Interfactional Agreement on Human Rights, circa cycle 101.

What's clear is he's disappeared and none of the major factions know where he went. And, judging by the fact that the committee hasn't made a Sector-wide manhunt a centerpiece of the commission's report, the situation is considered 'embarassing' and will therefore be buried.

Someone might even be hiding him.
texts.zh:
"Dolos Macario"这个名字深埋在转播附带的补充文件里，夹在一长串被跨势力调解委员会列为"重点关注对象"的强权叛变军官 (以及别的恐怖分子、煽动者、罪犯，还有些看上去完全是随机抓来的人) 之中。

他因一长串涉嫌违反【英仙座星域跨势力人权协定】的行为而被通缉受审，该协定约订立于星历 101 年。

清楚的是，他消失了，各大势力都不知道他去了哪里。而从委员会没把全星域搜捕写进报告核心来看，这事被视为"难堪"，因此会被压下去。

说不定还有人在藏着他。

It is clear only that Macario disappeared at some point and none of the major factions know where he went.

Judging by the fact that the commission hasn't made a Sector-wide manhunt a centerpiece of the final report, the situation is presumably considered 'embarassing' and will therefore be buried.

能确定的只有一点：Macario 在某个时候消失了，各大势力都不知道他去了哪里。

从委员会没有把全星域搜捕当作最终报告的重头戏来看，这事多半被当成"难堪"，于是就这么压下去了。

options.zh: 别管 Macario 了。都结束了。

texts.en:
He's a loose end. A single, shimmering thread that could threaten everything.

Again.
texts.zh:
他是个没收拾干净的尾巴。一根微微发亮、足以拖垮一切的线头。

又一次。

texts.en:
Andrada's glorious dream is dead because of him.

As the last true believer in the Great Project, you know what you must do.
texts.zh:
Andrada 那场辉煌的梦，因他而死了。

作为这项伟业最后一名真正的信徒，你知道自己该做什么。

texts.en:
Reynard Hannan promised you a gift - Dolos Macario - in exchange for your support.

It would be a good time to make an inquiry to the office of the Prime Demarchon.
texts.zh:
Reynard Hannan 许诺送你一份礼物——Dolos Macario——以换取你的支持。

现在是向大统领办公室问一声的好时候。

texts.en: This is personal. Whatever the Interfactional Resolution Commission says, the crisis is not over until you find him and deal with him.
texts.zh: 这是私仇。不管跨势力调解委员会怎么说，在你找到他、了结他之前，这场危机都没有结束。

texts.en: Whatever the Interfactional Resolution Commission says, the crisis is not over until he's found. The Sector is not safe until he's found. And if no one else is going to do it, you will.
texts.zh: 不管跨势力调解委员会怎么说，只要没找到他，这场危机就没有结束。只要没找到他，星域就不安全。要是没别人肯动手，那就你来。

texts.en: Whatever the Interfactional Resolution Commission says, the crisis is not over until he's found.
texts.zh: 不管跨势力调解委员会怎么说，只要没找到他，这场危机就没有结束。

You tap your control surface and the feed dies to black. Everyone, your bridge officers and crew, is silent and frozen for a moment - processing.

They begin to move, returning attention to system status.

Nav bravely breaks the silence and speaks up.

"Course, $PlayerSirOrMadam?"

他们开始动起来，把注意力转回系统状态。

导航官壮着胆子打破沉默开口。

"航向，$PlayerSirOrMadam？"

You tap your control surface and the feed dies to black. Everyone, your bridge officers and crew, is silent and frozen for a moment - processing.

They begin to move, returning attention to system status.

Nav bravely breaks the silence and speaks up.

"Orders, $PlayerSirOrMadam?"

你点了点控制面板，转播熄灭成一片黑。舰桥上的军官与船员全都沉默地僵了一瞬——在消化。

他们开始动起来，把注意力转回系统状态。

导航官壮着胆子打破沉默开口。

"请下命令，$PlayerSirOrMadam？"

options.en: Proceed on current heading.
Maintain orbit.

texts.en:
If no spymaster of a major faction can or will help, there is someone you know illegitimate enough to accept credits to solve a mystery.

An information broker on Qaras. Self important, shady, and even annoying. You rejected his offer of assistance outright, and for good reason.

But maybe...
texts.zh:
要是哪个大势力的间谍头子都不能、或不肯帮忙，你还认识一个人，底细够不干净，愿意收星币去解开一桩谜案。

Qaras 上的一个情报贩子。自命不凡、来路不正，甚至还很烦人。你当时断然拒绝了他的协助提议，理由充分。

不过也许...

texts.en:
If no one else, if no spymaster of a major faction can or will help, there is one person you know will accept credits to solve a mystery of sufficient interest.

An information broker on Qaras. Self important, shady, and perhaps even annoying.

But he's proven trustworthy. So far.
texts.zh:
要是没别人，要是哪个大势力的间谍头子都不能、或不肯帮忙，你还知道一个人，只要谜案足够有趣，他就肯收星币办事。

Qaras 上的一个情报贩子。自命不凡、来路不正，也许还很烦人。

但他证明过自己靠得住。到目前为止。

texts.en: You've already made an agreement with K-O Jove to keep an eye on Macario's escape routes in anticipation of this exact situation.
texts.zh: 你早已和 K-O Jove 约好，让他盯住 Macario 可能的逃跑路线，正是为了防备眼下这种局面。

texts.en:
From what you can tell, from reading between the lines, he's been quietly removed from Hector Andrada's revitalized Sindrian Diktat.

You haven't seen his face once since the end of hostilities. The contributions of the Ministry of Internal Security have been downplayed, its functions increasingly taken on by the Lion's Guard, and a quick analysis of the purge lists suggest that there have been enormous upheavals in staffing. Any sign of Macario's former prestige seems to have been erased, and his organization rooted out from the secret tunnels and bunkers wormed through the flesh of Sindria.

Is he dead? Perhaps he is as good as.
texts.zh:
从字里行间推断，他已经被悄悄地从 Hector Andrada 重振后的辛达强权里除掉了。

自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过他的脸。内部安全部的功劳被淡化，其职能越来越多地由狮心卫队接手；粗略分析清洗名单就能看出，人事上有过天翻地覆的变动。Macario 昔日威望的任何痕迹似乎都被抹去，他的组织也被从那些钻透辛达瑞亚血肉的密道与地堡里连根拔起。

他死了吗？也许跟死了也没什么两样。

options.en: I'm going to find Dolos Macario.
Forget about Macario. It's over.
options.zh: 别管 Macario 了。都结束了。

texts.en:
The face of Hector appears. It is an archival holo.

There are unconfirmed reports that Hector was killed while attempting to re-assert order among his scattered fleets in the confusion following his 'victory' over his clone-brother Achilles.

The commission recommends further investigation so that the issue may be resolved conclusively. Funding for this initiative is under negotiation between major factions.
texts.zh:
Hector 的面孔浮现出来。那是一段档案全息影像。

有未经证实的报告称，Hector 在'战胜'克隆兄弟 Achilles 之后的混乱中，试图重整四散的舰队、恢复秩序时被杀。

委员会建议进一步调查，以便彻底了结此事。相关经费正由各主要势力协商。

texts.en:
The face of Achilles appears. It is an archival holo.

There are unconfirmed reports that Achilles was killed while attempting to re-assert order among his scattered fleets of rogue turncoats and mercenaries in the confusion following his 'victory' over his clone-brother Hector.

The commission recommends further investigation so that the issue may be resolved conclusively. Funding for this initiative is under negotiation between major factions.
texts.zh:
Achilles 的面孔浮现出来。那是一段档案全息影像。

有未经证实的报告称，Achilles 在'战胜'克隆兄弟 Hector 之后的混乱中，试图重整那些由叛变者与雇佣兵组成的四散舰队、恢复秩序时被杀。

委员会建议进一步调查，以便彻底了结此事。相关经费正由各主要势力协商。

texts.en:
Hector, reigning from the familiar podium from which Philip Andrada gave endless proclamations, presides over the ceremony re-affirming his leadership of the Sindrian Diktat.

One by one senior officers, administrators, prominent business leaders pledge themselves to his blood. Then squads of middle-ranks, then a seemingly endless parade of soldiers, weapons held high. Crew in naval dress, INTSEC paramilitaries in black. Assault marines in heavy armor.

Prisoners - traitors and rebels - are marched through the main boulevard as Hector's voice proclaims terrible retribution.
texts.zh:
Hector 站在那座熟悉的讲台上——当年 Philip Andrada 就是在这里一遍遍发布公告——主持这场重新确认他对辛达强权领导权的仪式。

高级军官、行政官员、显赫的商界领袖，一个接一个向他血脉宣誓效忠。接着是成队的中层军官，再接着是仿佛没有尽头的士兵队列，武器高举。穿海军礼服的船员，一身黑衣的 INTSEC 准军事部队。身着重甲的突击陆战队。

囚犯——叛徒与叛军——被押着走过主干道，Hector 的嗓音宣布着骇人的清算。

options.en: Continue
Continue
Continue

texts.en:
The chair is a prominent Sindrian Diktat officer of the Reformer faction led by Achilles Andrada. Their uniform is traditional Diktat in its lines, but appears oddly spare due to a dearth of medals and ribbons.

This was, once, a prominent officer of the original mutiny and the navy of Philip Andrada's subsequent regime. The symbolism of their new loyalty cannot be missed.

The room is filled with voices as they step forward, stern and stoic, and make a simple, unemotive declaration that the findings shall begin.
texts.zh:
主席是 Achilles Andrada 所率改革派中一位显要的辛达强权军官。此人的制服剪裁仍是辛达强权的传统样式，却因稀少的勋章与绶带而显得格外素净。

此人当年曾是那场叛乱中的显要军官，后来又效力于 Philip Andrada 政权的海军。如今他转而效忠新主，这其中的象征意味不容错认。

会场里人声四起。此人迈步上前，神色严峻冷硬，只平平淡淡地宣布一句：调查结论即刻开始。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The last reliable reports available to the commission place Hector Andrada on a fast shuttle from his personal fleet to Sindria. He was scheduled to oversee a grand victory parade.

He is presumed dead.

So is his clone-twin, Achilles, presumed to have perished in space battle, or due to treachery in its aftermath at the hands of fleeing mercenaries.
texts.zh:
委员会手上最后一份可靠报告显示，Hector Andrada 正乘一艘快梭，从他本人的舰队前往 Sindria。按计划，他要去主持一场盛大的胜利阅兵。

他已被推定死亡。

他的克隆孪生兄弟 Achilles 也一样——据推测死于太空战，或是在战后被溃逃的雇佣兵反咬一口，死于背叛。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Achilles looks as though he has not slept for days, far older than the cycles he's lived.

His voice is flat as he declares his victory over his clone-brother, Hector, who is presumed dead.

He then announces the transfer of the capital of the Sindrian Diktat to Volturn and gives strained but outwardly gracious thanks to Fortuna Kato. He announces acceptance of Gens Kato sponsorship to expedite the process of becoming a full member of the Persean League.

Despite his victory, Achilles sounds defeated.
texts.zh:
Achilles 看上去像好几天没合眼，比他的年纪苍老得多。

他语调平板地宣布自己战胜了克隆兄弟 Hector——后者已被推定死亡。

随后他宣布将辛达强权的首都迁往 Volturn，并向 Fortuna Kato 道谢，言辞勉强，表面却还算得体。他宣布接受 Kato 氏族的资助，以加快成为英仙座联盟正式成员的进程。

明明赢了，Achilles 听起来却像个败者。

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Hector Andrada, victorious, resplendent in the uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"-total victory of the Sindrian Diktat, renewed, and with clarity of purpose, more powerful than ever! This is but a beginning of a great-"

His speech continues on themes of revenge and renewal.

Rank upon rank of officers, soldiers, crew in crisp uniforms. The golden statue of Philip Andrada looms over the infamous plaza before the headquarters of the Lion's Guard.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Hector Andrada 得胜，身着最高元首的制服，光鲜夺目。

"...辛达强权的彻底胜利，焕然一新、目标明确，比以往任何时候都更强大！这不过是一个伟大——"

他的讲话继续围绕着复仇与复兴。

一列列军官、士兵与船员，制服笔挺。Philip Andrada 的黄金雕像俯瞰着狮心卫队总部前那座声名狼藉的广场。

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Hector Andrada, victorious, eyes red and overactive, in the uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"-total victory of the Sindrian Diktat, renewed, and with clarity of purpose, more powerful than ever before! This is but a beginning of-"

His speech continues on themes of revenge and renewal.

Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew stand. There is smoke in the atmo, a slight haze that picks up the targeting lasers of security drones. The golden statue of Philip Andrada looms over the famous plaza before the headquarters of the Lion's Guard. Your eyes catch on an off-color patch; damage from an insurrectionist's bomb?
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Hector Andrada 得胜，双眼发红、亢奋过度，身着最高元首的制服。

"...辛达强权的彻底胜利，焕然一新、目标明确，比以往任何时候都更强大！这不过是一个——"

他的讲话继续围绕着复仇与复兴。

一列列军官、士兵与船员站得笔直。空气里有烟，薄薄的雾霭被安保无人机的瞄准激光一照，显出光路。Philip Andrada 的黄金雕像俯瞰着狮心卫队总部前那座著名的广场。你的目光被一块颜色不对的补丁吸住——是叛乱分子炸弹留下的损伤？

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat: Hector Andrada stands alone, eyes red and looking tired, yet alert - combat stims - in the uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"-total victory of the Sindrian Diktat, renewed!" His shout is manic. "With a clarity of purpose! More powerful than ever! This is but a beginning of-"

His speech continues on themes of revenge and renewal, somewhat rambling as he works himself into a rage. Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew watch stiffly. There is smoke in the atmo, a slight haze picking up the targeting lasers of the circling security drones.

A golden statue of Philip Andrada looms over him, and over the famous plaza before the headquarters of the Lion's Guard. Your eyes catch on an off-color patch; damage from an insurrectionist's bomb?
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像：Hector Andrada 独自站着，双眼发红，神情疲惫却又异常警醒——是战斗兴奋剂——身着最高元首的制服。

"...辛达强权的彻底胜利，焕然一新！\" 他这一声喊得近乎癫狂。\"目标明确！比以往任何时候都更强大！这不过是一个——"

他的讲话继续绕着复仇与复兴打转，越说越激动，渐渐语无伦次。一列列军官、士兵与船员僵直地站着。空气里有烟，薄雾被盘旋的安保无人机瞄准激光一照，显出光路。

Philip Andrada 的黄金雕像俯瞰着他，也俯瞰着狮心卫队总部前那座著名的广场。你的目光被一块颜色不对的补丁吸住——是叛乱分子炸弹留下的损伤？

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Hector, reigning from the familiar podium from which Philip Andrada gave endless proclamations, presides over the ceremony re-affirming his leadership of the Sindrian Diktat.

One by one senior officers, administrators, prominent business leaders pledge themselves to his blood. Then squads of middle-ranks, then a seemingly endless parade of soldiers, weapons held high. Crew in naval dress, INTSEC paramilitaries in black. Assault marines in heavy armor.

Prisoners - traitors and rebels - are marched through the main boulevard as Hector's voice proclaims terrible retribution.
texts.zh:
Hector 站在那座熟悉的讲台上——当年 Philip Andrada 就是在这里一遍遍发布公告——主持这场重新确认他对辛达强权领导权的仪式。

高级军官、行政官员、显赫的商界领袖，一个接一个向他血脉宣誓效忠。接着是成队的中层军官，再接着是仿佛没有尽头的士兵队列，武器高举。穿海军礼服的船员，一身黑衣的 INTSEC 准军事部队。身着重甲的突击陆战队。

囚犯——叛徒与叛军——被押着走过主干道，Hector 的嗓音宣布着骇人的清算。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Achilles Andrada, victorious and stern, a fresh and young face of leadership in a minimally adorned uniform.

"-ew dawn upon a new age for the Sindrian Diktat! A dawn whose light shall burn away the corruption of the old ways, a light which heralds a new prosperity, a new beginning for-"

His speech continues on the theme.

Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew in uniform, cheering at every opportunity. Behind them, a small crowd of civilians. Marching white banners with tyrian insignia hang over an enormous starship bay.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Achilles Andrada 得胜而严肃，一身装饰极简的制服，是一张新鲜年轻的面孔。

"...辛达强权新时代的黎明！这道黎明的光将烧尽旧路的腐败，昭示新的繁荣，一个新的开端——"

他的讲话继续着同一个主题。

一列列军官、士兵与船员穿着制服，一有机会就欢呼。他们身后是一小群平民。缀着泰尔紫徽记的白色旗帜悬在一座巨大的星舰船坞上方。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Achilles Andrada, victorious and stern, but tired, in a minimally adorned uniform.

"-ew dawn upon a new age for the Sindrian Diktat. A dawn whose light shall burn away the corruption of the old ways, a light which shall herald a new prosperity, a new beginning of-"

His speech continues on the theme. Ranks of officers, soldiers, crew in uniform. Behind them, a small crowd of civilians. Several white banners with tyrian insignia hang over an enormous starship bay. You note it is still cluttered with munitions pallets and a few damaged fighter-craft draped in forgecloth as if to hide the cost of war.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Achilles Andrada 得胜而严肃，却面带倦色，一身装饰极简的制服。

"...辛达强权新时代的黎明。这道黎明的光将烧尽旧路的腐败，昭示新的繁荣，一个新的开端——"

他的讲话继续着同一个主题。一列列军官、士兵与船员穿着制服。他们身后是一小群平民。几面缀着泰尔紫徽记的白旗悬在一座巨大的星舰船坞上方。你注意到，船坞里仍堆满弹药托盘，还有几架受损的战机盖着锻布，像是要遮住战争的代价。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An official recording from the Sindrian Diktat. Achilles Andrada, victorious but tired, in a minimally adorned uniform. He looks to have aged by many cycles.

"-ew dawn upon a new age for the Sindrian Diktat. A dawn whose light shall burn away the corruption of the old ways, which heralds new prosperity, a beginning of-"

His speech continues on the theme, though it lacks the fire of his proclamation from the orbit of Yesod. Officers, soldiers, crew in uniform attend. Behind them, a small crowd of haggard-looking civilians.

A white banner with tyrian insignia hangs limp over an enormous starship bay. You note that the bay is cluttered with munitions pallets and damaged fighter-craft, the decking a mosaic of quick-fix plates installed by damage control teams.
texts.zh:
一段来自辛达强权的官方录像。Achilles Andrada 得胜，却满面倦容，一身装饰极简的制服。他看上去老了许多个星历年。

"...辛达强权新时代的黎明。这道黎明的光将烧尽旧路的腐败，昭示新的繁荣，一个新的开端——"

他的讲话继续着同一个主题，却已没有当初在 Yesod 轨道上那番宣言的火气。军官、士兵与船员身着制服列席。他们身后是一小群面容憔悴的平民。

一面缀着泰尔紫徽记的白旗软软地垂在一座巨大的星舰船坞上方。你注意到，船坞里堆满弹药托盘与受损的战机，甲板成了一张拼图，尽是损管队临时补上的快修板。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The commission acknowledges and affirms the Sindrian Diktat's claim, recognizing that the new Supreme Executor has 'committed to humanitarian reforms' and has agreed to form a judicial group to 'investigate the alleged abuses of the previous regime'.

The Luddic faithful are not mentioned.

These proclamations are not made without objection in the commission chamber, but the feed cuts quickly onward.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

委员会承认并确认辛达强权的主张，认可新任最高元首'致力于人道改革'，并已同意组建一个司法小组，'调查前政权被指控的滥权行为'。

卢德信徒只字未提。

这些宣布在委员会会场里并非没有反对之声，但转播画面很快便切走了。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The commission acknowledges and affirms the Sindrian Diktat's claim to Volturn with all the understated irony of bureaucratic procedure.

With Sindria destroyed, Achilles has elected to relocate his government to Volturn. The Sindrian Diktat itself remains an independent polity, though barely.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

委员会以官僚程序特有的、不动声色的讽刺，承认并确认辛达强权对 Volturn 的主张。

Sindria 既已毁灭，Achilles 选择把政府迁往 Volturn。辛达强权本身仍是一个独立政权——只是勉强还算得上。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

The commission acknowledges and affirms the Sindrian Diktat's claim to Volturn (though not without dissent judging by a few awkward, atemporal jumps in the chair's speech).

A statement from the Supreme Executor, Hector Andrada, is cast, promising to "stamp out Luddic terrorism for all time" and laying the blame for failure to do so in previous cycles at the feet of "treasonous and corrupt officials who lacked the conviction to use appropriate force".

There will be additional purges.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

委员会承认并确认辛达强权对 Volturn 的主张 (不过从主席讲话里几处突兀的、不合时宜的跳接来看，并非没有异议)。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 的声明随即播出，他承诺要"永远根除卢德恐怖主义"，并把过去几个星历年未能做到这一点归咎于"那些叛国而腐败的官员，他们缺乏动用适当武力的决心"。

还会有更多清洗。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The tempestuous waters of Volturn appear, Salus looming.

Achilles has moved his government to Volturn and submitted to League membership, thus becoming Demarchon of the Sindrian Diktat of the Askonia System.

The commission has no choice to recognize this state of affairs as the best of many worse possibilities. It is thought that a strong leader, humbled though he is, may keep the Luddic uprisings in check - and above all suppress the influence of the Luddic Path.

Achilles looks tired in the holo-feed, aged by cycles, and his victory speech lacks energy. The Andrada steel is tarnished, it seems.
texts.zh:
Volturn 翻涌的海面浮现出来，Salus 悬在其上。

Achilles 已将政府迁往 Volturn，并接受加入联盟，从而成为 Askonia 星系辛达强权的统领。

委员会别无选择，只能承认这一局面已是诸多更坏可能中最好的一个。人们的想法是：一个强有力的领袖，哪怕已被折了锐气，或许仍能压住卢德派的暴动——尤其是遏制卢德左径的势力。

全息画面里的 Achilles 面带倦色，被星历年催老了；他的胜利演说也提不起劲。Andrada 家的钢铁，看来也锈了。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

A representative of the Sindrian Diktat appears, one of the earliest proclaimers for the Absolutist faction: Laverna Tell, whose dark reputation precedes her. By her black uniform and peaked cap she displays her peculiar position in the Internal Security Ministry.

Tell announces an expansion of the Cruror prison system, seven new penal trains with expectations of increased output pending a system-wide sweep for "traitorous elements".
texts.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

一位辛达强权代表出现，她是绝对派最早的拥趸之一：Laverna Tell，此人的恶名早已先她而至。从她那身黑色制服与带檐军帽，便可看出她在内部安全部的特殊地位。

Tell 宣布扩建 Cruor 监狱系统，新增七列囚犯列车，并预计在全星系范围内清扫"叛国分子"之后，产出还将进一步提高。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

A representative of the Reformed faction of the Sindrian Diktat appears, their uniform conspicuously less ostentatious than the previous regime, to announce the intention of the Transitional Oversight Committee of the Internal Security Ministry to implement an expedited sentence review process for so-called "legacy" prisoners.

In the meantime, however, economic and social stability must be secured, so it is "regrettably necessary" for prisoners to continue fulfilling their work-sentences.

The Diktat representative emphasizes that it will be a difficult process for everyone.
texts.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

一位辛达强权改革派代表出现，其制服明显不如前政权那般招摇；此人宣布，内部安全部过渡监督委员会打算对所谓"遗留"囚犯实行加速刑期复核。

然而在此期间，经济与社会的稳定必须得到保障，因此囚犯继续服劳役乃是"令人遗憾的必要之举"。

这位辛达强权代表强调，这对所有人来说都将是一个艰难的过程。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

The commission recognizes Cruor as effectively under control of Achilles Andrada's reduced Sindrian Diktat - in effect becoming a sub-polity of the Persean League. The Commission expresses hope that the "excesses" of the previous administration might be curbed by League influence.

It is noted that Prime Demarchon Reynard Hannan has released a statement emphasizing that he has full confidence that the League's newest demarchon does not require intervention from the All-League council to carry out appropriate reforms.
texts.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

委员会承认 Cruor 实际上已在 Achilles Andrada 那个缩水后的辛达强权控制之下——实质上成了英仙座联盟的附属政体。委员会表示，希望联盟的影响能遏制前政权的"过度之举"。

另据提到，大统领 Reynard Hannan 已发表声明，强调他完全相信联盟这位最新入列的统领无需全联盟议会干预，自会推行适当的改革。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The commission recognizes the "long overdue" claim of the Sindrian Diktat over Nortia, per the victorious Supreme Executor's demands.

Hector promises more purges and a widespread hunt for traitors and terrorists. New methods are to be used based on new technologies purchased from Tri-Tachyon. Drones and surveillance technology will extend the manpower of the Sindrian Diktat, which must give first priority toward rebuilding a grand navy in pursuit of greater ambitions...
texts.zh:
委员会按照得胜的最高元首的要求，承认辛达强权对 Nortia 那项"早该兑现"的主张。

Hector 承诺将展开更多清洗，并大举搜捕叛徒与恐怖分子。他还打算采用从速子科技购得的新技术、以新手段行事。无人机与监控技术将弥补辛达强权的人力不足；而辛达强权必须把重建一支庞大海军列为头等要务，以图更大的抱负...

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The commission recognizes the victorious Supreme Executor's proclamation that Nortia shall be placed under the 'stewardship' of the Sindrian Diktat.

Achilles Andrada announces clemency for non-combatant members of the ACA and promises a 'considered justice' for the rest who lay down arms and turn themselves in voluntarily.

Those who do not, however, shall still be considered terrorists and pirates and treated as such.
texts.zh:
委员会承认得胜的最高元首所发布的公告：Nortia 将置于辛达强权的'监管'之下。

Achilles Andrada 宣布对 ACA 的非战斗人员予以宽赦，并承诺对其余主动放下武器、前来自首者给予'经审慎考虑的公正处置'。

至于不肯投降的人，则仍将被视为恐怖分子与海盗，并按此对待。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
After much deliberation, the commission begrudgingly recognizes the victorious Supreme Executor's proclamation that Nortia shall be placed under the 'stewardship' of the Sindrian Diktat.

The issue appears to have been settled only due to Achilles' recognition as demarchon by the Persean League's All-League Council. It is not quite said outright that the Commission hopes that association with the League will temper the excesses of Diktat policy - and that Achilles' broad domestic authority might suppress the rebels and smugglers who have long used Nortia as their base.

Achilles Andrada proclaims provisional clemency for non-combatant members of the ACA and promises a 'considered justice' for the rest who lay down their weapons and turn themselves in.
texts.zh:
经过反复商议，委员会才不情不愿地承认得胜的最高元首的公告：Nortia 将置于辛达强权的'监管'之下。

此事之所以能了结，看来只因英仙座联盟的全联盟议会承认了 Achilles 的统领身份。委员会未曾明说，但它希望与联盟的联合能缓和辛达强权政策的过度之处——也希望 Achilles 手中宽广的国内权力能压住那些长期以 Nortia 为基地的叛军与走私者。

Achilles Andrada 宣布对 ACA 的非战斗人员给予临时宽赦，并承诺对放下武器、前来自首的其余人等给予'经审慎考虑的公正处置'。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
After much deliberation, the commission begrudgingly recognizes that Nortia shall be placed under the 'stewardship' of the Persean League.

The issue appears to have been settled only due to Achilles' recognition as demarchon by the Persean League's All-League Council. The fact that Achilles has not been seen since the end of the conflict has not stopped the establishment of a 'transitional' administration. It is not quite said outright that the Commission - over Hegemony objection - hopes that association with the League might suppress the rebels and smugglers who have long used Nortia as their base.

Provisional clemency for non-combatant members of the ACA is given, and a 'considered justice' is promised for the rest who lay down their weapons and turn themselves in.
texts.zh:
经过反复商议，委员会才不情不愿地承认 Nortia 将置于英仙座联盟的'监管'之下。

此事之所以能了结，看来只因英仙座联盟的全联盟议会承认了 Achilles 的统领身份。Achilles 自冲突结束以来再未露面，这并未妨碍一个'过渡'政府的建立。委员会未曾明说，但它在霸主的反对声中仍希望：与联盟的联合或许能压住那些长期以 Nortia 为基地的叛军与走私者。

ACA 的非战斗人员获得了临时宽赦，其余放下武器、前来自首者则被许诺以'经审慎考虑的公正处置'。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The chair explains that the commission's foremost purpose is to avoid Sector-wide war, a process which requires compromise despite the objections of certain parties to the commission.

As such, Hector Andrada's declaration of Sindrian Diktat conquest of Umbra is recognized. It is understood that a strong authority will suppress piracy, and lacking an interfactional initiative, Hector has provided a solution that will benefit the entire Sector, in the long run.

A vanguard of battle-hardened Diktat shock marines has already been dispatched to assault the most ostentatious pirate holdouts. Meanwhile, privately commissioned security forces are being recruited in nearby systems. Steady pay and lax requirements are welcome to those who cannot find steady work elsewhere, for whatever reason.
texts.zh:
主席解释说，委员会的首要目的是避免全星域范围的战争，而这一进程需要妥协，哪怕委员会中某些方面有所反对。

因此，Hector Andrada 关于辛达强权征服 Umbra 的宣告获得承认。各方都明白，一个强有力的权威会镇压海盗；既然跨势力层面拿不出方案，Hector 便提供了一个从长远看将使整个星域受益的解决办法。

一支身经百战的辛达强权突击陆战队先锋已经派出，去攻打那些最招摇的海盗据点。与此同时，私营的安全部队正在附近星系招募。稳定薪水加上宽松的条件，对那些在别处找不到稳定工作的人来说——不管出于什么原因——总是受欢迎的。
