texts.en:
The chair explains that the commission's foremost purpose is to avoid Sector-wide war, a process which requires compromise despite the objections of certain parties to the commission.

As such, Achilles Andrada's declaration that the Sindrian Diktat's volume of interest encompasses Umbra is recognized. It is understood that a strong authority will suppress piracy to benefit commerce throughout the sector.

A vanguard of battle-hardened mercenary shock marines - freshly inducted as a guard unit directly under the office of the Supreme Executor - has already been dispatched to assault the most ostentatious pirate holdouts. Meanwhile, privately commissioned security forces are being recruited from nearby systems. Steady pay and lax requirements are welcome to those who cannot find steady work elsewhere.
texts.zh:
主席解释说，委员会的首要目的是避免全星域范围的战争，而这一进程需要妥协，哪怕委员会中某些方面有所反对。

因此，Achilles Andrada 关于 Umbra 属于辛达强权利益范围的宣告获得承认。各方都明白，一个强有力的权威会镇压海盗，从而惠及全星域的商贸。

一支身经百战的雇佣兵突击陆战队先锋——刚刚被收编为直属最高元首办公室的卫队单位——已经派出，去攻打那些最招摇的海盗据点。与此同时，私营的安全部队正在附近星系招募。稳定薪水加上宽松条件，对那些在别处找不到稳定工作的人来说总是受欢迎的。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: You once contemplated the downfall of Philip Andrada and his whole rotten Diktat - and now you've seen it done. The once immortal empire of the Supreme Executor is reduced to burning rubble and painful memories.
texts.zh: 你曾盘算过让 Philip Andrada 和他那整个腐朽的强权垮台——如今你亲眼看着它成真。最高元首那曾经不朽的帝国，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的回忆。

texts.en: Hector Andrada, heir to Philip and a fitting renewal of the blood of the Lion, reigns as Supreme Executor. Just as you intended.
texts.zh: Hector Andrada，Philip 的继承人，也是雄狮血脉一次恰如其分的延续，如今以最高元首之尊统治。一如你所谋划。

texts.en: Achilles Andrada, heir to Philip, but perhaps something more, now reigns as Supreme Executor. Just as you intended.
texts.zh: Achilles Andrada，Philip 的继承人，或许还意味着更多，如今以最高元首之尊统治。一如你所谋划。

texts.en: The Sindrian Diktat is destroyed, wiped from the face of the Sector, reduced to burning rubble and memories of pain.
texts.zh: 辛达强权已被摧毁，从星域版图上抹去，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的记忆。

texts.en:
You've seen the Sindrian Diktat destroyed, reduced to burning rubble and memories of pain. Where is Achilles, the promised reformer, the Supreme Executor?

Rumors abound. The official story references a counter-mutiny by twice-turncoat mid-level officers; a bomb set on the bridge of his flagship.

His body has not been found.
texts.zh:
你亲眼看着辛达强权被摧毁，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的记忆。Achilles 呢？那位被许诺的改革者、那位最高元首，如今在哪里？

流言四起。官方说法提到的是一场由二度倒戈的中层军官发动的反叛变；还有一枚安在他旗舰舰桥上的炸弹。

他的遗体至今未被找到。

texts.en: You've seen the Sindrian Diktat destroyed, reduced to burning rubble and memories of pain.
texts.zh: 你亲眼看着辛达强权被摧毁，只剩燃烧的瓦砾与痛苦的记忆。

texts.en: You've seen the Sindrian Diktat reduced and purged and reformed in the crucible of civil war - Philip's world-vision reified through violence, though not quite as he imagined it.
texts.zh: 你亲眼看着辛达强权在内战的熔炉里被削弱、清洗、重塑——Philip 的世界构想借暴力成了实体，只是不太像他当初想象的样子。

texts.en: You've seen the Sindrian Diktat reduced, though not destroyed. The hulks burning in far orbits will smolder to the cold of night, the hearts of their weapons and reactors slowly scavenged. Meanwhile long-remembered pains find new life, multiplied and renewed.
texts.zh: 你亲眼看着辛达强权被削弱，却未被摧毁。远轨道上燃烧的残骸会慢慢熄成夜的冷灰，它们武器与反应堆的心脏将被一点点拆走。而与此同时，那些被记了很久的伤痛又活了过来，成倍地翻新。

texts.en:
From what you can tell, reading between the lines of official pronouncements, he's safe and secure in Hector Andrada's revitalized Sindrian Diktat.

And you haven't seen his face once since the end of hostilities.

Macario seems to have withdrawn to the shadows, content to be a manipulator behind the scenes. The Spider of Sindria, safe in his secret tunnels and bunkers wormed through the flesh of that world.
texts.zh:
从官方声明的字里行间推断，他在 Hector Andrada 重振后的辛达强权里安稳无虞，位子稳当。

而自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过他的脸。

Macario 似乎退回了暗处，甘心做个幕后操盘手。辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛，安然待在他那些钻透那颗星球血肉的密道与地堡里。

options.en: Forget about Macario. It's over.
options.zh: 别管 Macario 了。都结束了。

texts.en:
From what you can tell, reading between the lines of official pronouncements... it's hard to say if he's dead or alive, hidden or missing.

You haven't seen his face once since the end of hostilities.

Macario seems to have withdrawn to the shadows, the Spider of Sindria being content to be a manipulator behind the scenes. Or he's a cooling corpse in some secret tunnels or bunker-complex wormed through the flesh of Sindria.
texts.zh:
从官方声明的字里行间推断...很难说他究竟是死是活，是藏起来了还是失踪了。

自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过他的脸。

Macario 似乎退回了暗处，辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛甘心做个幕后操盘手。又或者，他已经是一具渐渐冷掉的尸体，躺在某条密道里，或某个钻透辛达瑞亚血肉的地堡群中。

options.en: Forget about Macario. It's over.
options.zh: 别管 Macario 了。都结束了。

texts.en:
There's an odd appendix to the Commission's findings - the name 'Dolos Macario' is buried deep in the supplementary files attached to the broadcast, in a long list of rogue Diktat officers (and other terrorists, agitators, criminals, and seemingly completely random people) declared 'persons of interest' by the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

And co-signed by Supreme Executor Hector Andrada himself.

You haven't seen Macario's face since the end of hostilities. The contributions of the Ministry of Internal Security have been downplayed, and a quick analysis of the purge lists suggest that there have been enormous upheavals in staffing. Any sign of Macario's former prestige seems to have been erased, and his organization rooted out from the secret tunnels and bunkers wormed through the flesh of Sindria.
texts.zh:
委员会的调查结论后附着一份古怪的附录——"Dolos Macario"这个名字深埋在转播附带的补充文件里，夹在一长串被跨势力调解委员会列为"重点关注对象"的强权叛变军官 (以及别的恐怖分子、煽动者、罪犯，还有些看上去完全是随机抓来的人) 之中。

而且由最高元首 Hector Andrada 本人联署。

自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过 Macario 的脸。内部安全部的功劳被淡化了，粗略分析那些清洗名单就能看出，人事上有过天翻地覆的变动。Macario 昔日威望的任何痕迹似乎都被抹去，他的组织也被从那些钻透辛达瑞亚血肉的密道与地堡里连根拔起。

options.en: I need to be sure that he's gone. Like Reynard Hannan promised.
options.zh: 我得确认他真的不在了。就像 Reynard Hannan 承诺的那样。

options.en: Forget about Macario. It's over.
options.zh: 别管 Macario 了。都结束了。

texts.en:
There's an odd appendix to the Commission's findings - the name 'Dolos Macario' is buried in the supplementary files attached to the broadcast, in a long list of rogue Diktat officers (and other terrorists, agitators, criminals, and seemingly completely random people) declared 'persons of interest' by the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

Co-signed by Supreme Executor Achilles Andrada himself.

You haven't seen Macario's face since the end of hostilities. A quick analysis of the purge lists suggest that there have been enormous upheavals in the civic and intelligence apparatus of the newly-unified Sindrian Diktat. Any sign of Macario's former influence seems to have been erased, and his organization rooted out from the secret tunnels and bunkers wormed through the flesh of Sindria.
texts.zh:
委员会的调查结论后附着一份古怪的附录——"Dolos Macario"这个名字埋在转播附带的补充文件里，夹在一长串被跨势力调解委员会列为"重点关注对象"的强权叛变军官 (以及别的恐怖分子、煽动者、罪犯，还有些看上去完全是随机抓来的人) 之中。

由最高元首 Achilles Andrada 本人联署。

自战事结束以来，你一次也没见过 Macario 的脸。粗略分析清洗名单就能看出，新近统一的辛达强权在民政与情报机构里经历过天翻地覆的变动。Macario 昔日影响力的任何痕迹似乎都被抹去，他的组织也被从那些钻透辛达瑞亚血肉的密道与地堡里连根拔起。

options.en: I need to be sure that he's gone. Like Reynard Hannan promised.
options.zh: 我得确认他真的不在了。就像 Reynard Hannan 承诺的那样。

options.en: Forget about Macario. It's over.
options.zh: 别管 Macario 了。都结束了。

texts.en:
The name 'Dolos Macario' is buried deep in the supplementary files attached to the broadcast, in a long list of rogue Diktat officers (and other terrorists, agitators, criminals, and seemingly completely random people) declared 'persons of interest' by the Interfactional Resolution Commission.

He is wanted for questioning concerning a long list of alleged acts which violated the Persean Sector Interfactional Agreement on Human Rights, circa cycle 101.

What's clear is he's disappeared and none of the major factions know where he went. And, judging by the fact that the committee hasn't made a Sector-wide manhunt a centerpiece of the commission's report, the situation is considered 'embarassing' and will therefore be buried.

Someone might even be hiding him.
texts.zh:
"Dolos Macario"这个名字深埋在转播附带的补充文件里，夹在一长串被跨势力调解委员会列为"重点关注对象"的强权叛变军官 (以及别的恐怖分子、煽动者、罪犯，还有些看上去完全是随机抓来的人) 之中。

他因一长串涉嫌违反【英仙座星域跨势力人权协定】的行为而被通缉受审，该协定约订立于星历 101 年。

清楚的是，他消失了，各大势力都不知道他去了哪里。而从委员会没把全星域搜捕写进报告核心来看，这事被视为"难堪"，因此会被压下去。

说不定还有人在藏着他。

options.en: It's over.

texts.en: This is personal. Whatever the Interfactional Resolution Commission says, the crisis is not over until you find him and deal with him.
texts.zh: 这是私仇。不管跨势力调解委员会怎么说，在你找到他、了结他之前，这场危机都没有结束。

options.en: But how?

texts.en: Whatever the Interfactional Resolution Commission says, the crisis is not over until he's found. The Sector is not safe until he's found. And if no one else is going to do it, you will.
texts.zh: 不管跨势力调解委员会怎么说，只要没找到他，这场危机就没有结束。只要没找到他，星域就不安全。要是没别人肯动手，那就你来。

options.en: But how?

texts.en:
"I am disappointed, very disappointed, to have heard that you provided nothing for the ACA uprising on Nortia," Horus says. "My... trusted contacts agree. It was a missed opportunity, and materially hindered our efforts."

"You failed me in this." He spreads his hands. "There's no other way to put it."
texts.zh:
"听说你对 Nortia 上 ACA 的起事什么也没提供，我很失望，非常失望，\"Horus 说。\"我...信得过的联系人也是这么看的。那是个错失的机会，而且在实际上拖累了我们的行动。"

"这件事上你辜负了我。\"他摊开双手。\"没有别的说法。"

texts.en:
"I had word from Arnaud Iscare that you helped secure some material assistance for the ACA on Nortia," Horus says. "But not enough."

"My... trusted contacts agree. This was a missed opportunity, and I am disappointed with the outcome." He spreads his hands. "There's nothing more to say."
texts.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 传话来，说你在 Nortia 帮 ACA 弄到了一些物资援助，\"Horus 说。\"但不够。"

"我...信得过的联系人也是这么看的。那是个错失的机会，这个结果让我失望。\"他摊开手。\"没什么可多说的了。"

texts.en:
"You helped secure full material assistance for the ACA on Nortia, and for that I thank you - and my... trusted contacts would like to relay their appreciation for your efforts."

"This Second Askonia Crisis was a terrible situation, but I am proud to have done what little I could to steer the Sector toward a more hopeful future." He looks self-conscious, then clears his throat. "Allow me to provide you with credits to offset the risks you have taken and - well, we may consider it a reward, I suppose."
texts.zh:
"你在 Nortia 帮 ACA 落实了足额的物资援助，为此我感谢你——我...信得过的联系人也很想转达对你这些努力的赞赏。"

"这第二次 Askonia 危机是场可怕的局面，但我为自己尽了绵薄之力、把星域引向一个更有希望的未来而自豪。\"他显得有些不好意思，随即清了清嗓子。\"请允许我提供一笔星币，补偿你承担的风险，还有——嗯，我们不妨就把它算作报酬吧。"

texts.en:
"Your guy didn't work out," he says. "Too bad. And too bad for me, I can't turn those connections into contracts."

"Still. Lots of folks out there now have navies to rebuild. And plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."

He rubs his hands together. "Lower margins, but also less oversight. There may be some opportunities to turn this whole operation back into the black."
texts.zh:
"你那位没成事，\"他说。\"可惜。对我更可惜——那些人脉我换不成合同了。"

"不过呢。现在外面多少家都得重建舰队。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

他搓了搓手。"利润是低些，但监管也松些。这整桩买卖，说不定还有机会做回盈利。"

options.en: Continue
I am not your enemy! I have come to pledge my loyalty to you.
options.zh: 我不是你的敌人！我是来向你宣誓效忠的。

options.en: I am not your enemy! I have come to pledge my loyalty to you.
options.zh: 我不是你的敌人！我是来向你宣誓效忠的。

options.en: It is you who will be destroyed, Hector.
I came to offer you the chance to surrender, Hector. End the chaos.
options.zh: 我是来给你投降的机会的，Hector。结束这场混乱吧。

options.en: I am not your enemy! Dolos Macario has been telling you lies for his own purposes.
options.zh: 我不是你的敌人！Dolos Macario 一直在为自己的目的对你说谎。

options.en: Achilles is the better man. It's so obvious when you speak.
options.zh: Achilles 才是更好的人。你一开口，这就再明显不过。

options.en: I wish to pledge my loyalty... but I must end my commission. I shall return.
options.zh: 我愿宣誓效忠于你...但我必须先了结另一份委任。我会回来的。

options.en: I wish to pledge my loyalty... and retain my other commission.
options.zh: 我愿宣誓效忠于你...同时保留我另一份委任。

texts.en:
He tilts his head back and laughs.

"So eager you are, so bold despite Macario's kill-order."

Hector examines you now, closely, with a sort of predatory interest that the holos of 58966 Elysium could not capture.

"I like this," he says, relishing the moment. "It's interesting."

"So you're loyal? Prove it."
texts.zh:
他仰头大笑。

"你可真急切，顶着 Macario 的格杀令还敢这么大胆。"

Hector 现在细细打量着你，那是一种捕食者般的兴趣——58966 Elysium 的全息影像可捕捉不到这种东西。

"我喜欢这样，\"他说，品味着这一刻，\"有意思。"

"那么，你忠诚？证明给我看。"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
He laughs.

"You're weak. Polluted and bound by sentiment. You do not yet realize that my will alone produces right and wrong."

"And when the time comes to claim final victory I shall not hesitate to execute my enemy, whether it is you, or my own blood corrupted by the weak-willed merchant-warriors of the League."

He looks down, his voice rich with cruelty like wine. "Your existence is... an impurity."

"Goodbye, captain. You'll die well at my pleasure."
texts.zh:
他大笑。

"你软弱。被情感污染，被情感束缚。你还没明白：是非对错，只由我的意志而定。"

"等到夺取最终胜利的时候，我会毫不犹豫地处决我的敌人——不管是你，还是我自己那被联盟那些意志薄弱的商贾武士腐蚀了的血亲。"

他垂下目光，嗓音醇厚如酒，却浸满残酷。"你的存在...是一种杂质。"

"再见了，舰长。你会死得漂亮，全凭我高兴。"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"Dolos is so confident, so sure, that he's smarter than everyone around him. But he has never fooled me."

Hector laughs.

Then his eyes fix on you. "Don't bore me with what I already know. Why do you dare speak to me?"
texts.zh:
"Dolos 太自信，太笃定自己比身边所有人都聪明。可他从来没有骗过我。"

Hector 大笑。

然后他的目光钉住你。"别拿我早就知道的事来烦我。你凭什么敢跟我说话？"

texts.en:
He laughs.

"You're weak. You're weak like he is weak - bound up in sentimental rules and traditions. You do not yet realize that my will alone produces right and wrong."

"And when the time comes to claim final victory? I shall not hesitate to execute my enemy, whether it is you, or my own clone-brother, my own blood corrupted by the soft cosmopolitanism of the Persean League."

He looks down, his voice rich with cruelty like wine. "He is a... a profanity, a sacrilege, an impurity." Hector fixes you with his gaze once more.

"Goodbye, captain. You'll die well at my pleasure."
texts.zh:
他大笑。

"你软弱。你和他一样软弱——被感伤、规矩和传统捆住了手脚。你还没明白：是非对错，只由我的意志而定。"

"等到夺取最终胜利的时候呢？我会毫不犹豫地处决我的敌人——不管是你，还是我的克隆兄弟，我自己的血亲，被英仙座联盟那套软绵绵的世界主义腐蚀了。"

他垂下目光，嗓音醇厚如酒，却浸满残酷。"他就是个...一个渎神之物，一桩大不敬，一种杂质。"Hector 的目光再次锁住你。

"再见了，舰长。你会死得漂亮，全凭我高兴。"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"What great fool comes to pledge themselves while bearing the commission of a rival?" he asks, mocking you for the unseen advisors and hangers-on that surround him on the bridge of his flagship.

"What is loyalty that does not place myself at its head? You'll have one last chance to correct yourself."

He seems to contemplate drawing his sword, but relents.

"Get out of my sight."
texts.zh:
"什么样的蠢货会带着对头的委任状跑来宣誓效忠？"他问道，这话是问给他旗舰舰桥上那些你看不见的谋臣与随从听的，拿你来取笑。

"不把我放在首位的忠诚，算什么忠诚？你还有最后一次机会改口。"

他似乎考虑过拔剑，但终究作罢。

"滚出我的视线。"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"Ingrate," he spits. "What rotten offering is this? What is loyalty that does not place myself at its head?"

He seems to contemplate drawing his sword, but relents.

"Get out of my sight."
texts.zh:
"不知感恩的东西，\"他啐道，\"这算什么烂供品？不把我放在首位的忠诚，算什么忠诚？"

他似乎考虑过拔剑，但终究作罢。

"滚出我的视线。"

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en:
"The anti-Macario initiative appears to have been successful in light of Hector's... disemployment of the man." He shrugs, turns his palms up. "I hope you've leveraged this outcome toward a profitable outcome."

His half-smile grows slightly. "I have."
texts.zh:
"从 Hector 把那个人...解职这件事看，反 Macario 行动似乎成功了。\"他耸耸肩，翻起掌心。\"我希望你已经把这个结果撬成了有利可图的回报。"

他的半笑稍稍加深。"我确实这么做了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"In any event, I believe my investment in the Nortia acquisition will pay off handsomely once the commercial situation is normalized."

He pauses, then raises his eyebrows in an open expression of congratulation.

"Whatever your intent, the company is pleased with this outcome."
texts.zh:
"无论如何，我相信等商业秩序恢复正常，我在 Nortia 收购案上的投资会带来丰厚的回报。"

他顿了顿，然后挑起眉毛，毫不掩饰地作出祝贺的神情。

"不管你的意图是什么，公司对这个结果很满意。"

texts.en:
"In any event, I believe my investment in the Umbra acquisition will pay off handsomely once the commercial situation is normalized."

He pauses, then raises his eyebrows in an open expression of congratulation.

"Whatever your intent, the company is pleased with this outcome."
texts.zh:
"无论如何，我相信等商业秩序恢复正常，我在 Umbra 收购案上的投资会带来丰厚的回报。"

他顿了顿，然后挑起眉毛，毫不掩饰地作出祝贺的神情。

"不管你的意图是什么，公司对这个结果很满意。"

texts.en:
"In any event, I believe my investment in the Nortia and Umbra acquisitions will pay off handsomely once the commercial situation is normalized."

He pauses, then raises his eyebrows in an open expression of congratulation.

"Whatever your intent, the company is pleased with this outcome."
texts.zh:
"无论如何，我相信等商业秩序恢复正常，我在 Nortia 与 Umbra 两桩收购案上的投资会带来丰厚的回报。"

他顿了顿，然后挑起眉毛，毫不掩饰地作出祝贺的神情。

"不管你的意图是什么，公司对这个结果很满意。"

texts.en: "In any event, new opportunities abound. I am eager to find the profits in this new Persean Sector."
texts.zh: "无论如何，新机会遍地都是。我已迫不及待要在这个新的英仙座星域里找出利润所在。"

options.en: And Leonidas. How is he?
And Leonidas. The body has proved useful?
options.zh: 还有 Leonidas。那具躯体证明有用了吗？

options.en: So am I.
I too am eager to discover new, profitable opportunities.
options.zh: 我也一样渴望发现新的、有利可图的机会。

options.en: I'll get what I want - for Macario to get what he deserves.
options.zh: 我会得到我想要的——让 Macario 得到他应得的下场。

options.en: I got what I wanted. Macario will get what he deserves.
options.zh: 我得到了我想要的。Macario 会得到他应得的下场。

options.en: I got what I wanted. Macario got what he deserved.
options.zh: 我得到了我想要的。Macario 也得到了他应得的下场。

options.en: All that matters is it's over.

texts.en:
"His body lives," Inesis says. His expression grows vacant as he accesses some remote information. "Prospects for recovery remain... ambiguous."

His eyes, suddenly sharp, return to you.

"Captain. I consider our agreement inviolable under reasonable conditions, of course, but I would like to propose a modification to the terms."
texts.zh:
"他的身体还活着，\"Inesis 说。当他调取某处远程信息时，神情变得空茫。\"康复的前景仍然...不明确。"

他的目光骤然锐利，重新落回你身上。

"舰长。当然，在合理的条件下，我认为我们的协议不可侵犯，但我想提议对条款做一处修改。"

options.en: In what sense?

texts.en:
"You put Leonidas in my care with... charitable aims. But given that odds of successful rehabilitation are poor, perhaps your credits could be put to better use. I believe I could find an interested party to acquire the subject who - let us be clear - is unlikely to ever awaken into consciousness and coherence."

"You gave me 100,000 credits for our deal. Let me repay you that, and an additional 100,000 for a total of 200,000 credits, and you rescind the conditions of our deal."
texts.zh:
"你把 Leonidas 交给我照管，抱着...慈善的目的。但既然成功康复的希望渺茫，也许你的星币可以用在更划算的地方。我想我能找到一个有兴趣的买家来接手这个对象——我们说清楚——他几乎不可能再醒过来，恢复意识与神智。"

"你为我们的交易付了我 100,000 星币。让我把这笔钱还给你，再加 100,000，合计 200,000 星币，而你撤销我们交易中的那些条件。"

options.en: You want to sell Leonidas to... someone? To do what?
options.zh: 你想把 Leonidas 卖给...某个人？要干什么？

options.en: Deal.
I think his value has increased considerably, don't you?
options.zh: 我想他的价值已经涨了不少，你不觉得吗？

options.en: Your proposal is inhuman. I reject it unambiguously.
options.zh: 你的提议毫无人性。我明确拒绝。

options.en: No.

texts.en: "I seek only profit and place no conditions upon purchases," he says mildly.
texts.zh: "我只求利润，对买主不设条件，"他温和地说。

texts.en:
"A pleasure dealing with you, captain," he says brightly.

You receive the ping of an incoming credits transfer almost instantly.
texts.zh:
"跟你做生意很愉快，舰长，"他轻快地说。

几乎立刻，你就收到了星币转账到账的提示音。

texts.en:
"A pleasure dealing with you, captain," he says brightly.

You receive the ping of an incoming credits transfer almost instantly.
texts.zh:
"跟你做生意很愉快，舰长，"他轻快地说。

几乎立刻，你就收到了星币转账到账的提示音。

texts.en: "A tranchant insight, captain." His smile grows. "Let me instead propose a payment of 300,000 credits."
texts.zh: "好一句锋利的见解，舰长。\"他的笑容加深。\"那我改提一笔 300,000 星币的付款吧。"

texts.en:
Inesis' pleasant expression is solidly fixed.

"What I suggest is more human than you may wish to admit, captain, but let me assure you that I am a man who honors his contracts."

He nods, expression unchanged.
texts.zh:
Inesis 那副和悦的神情牢牢地凝在脸上。

"我的建议比你愿意承认的要更合乎人性，舰长。不过请放心，我是个守合同的人。"

他点了点头，神色不变。

texts.en:
Inesis shrugs.

"I merely presenting you with opportunity."
texts.zh:
Inesis 耸了耸肩。

"我不过是在给你一个机会。"

texts.en: "Yes," Inesis says.
texts.zh: "是的，"Inesis 说。

options.en: And?

texts.en: "I'm afraid I'm contractually forbidden to elaborate any further on the subject," he says, making a good show of appearing regretfully helpful.
texts.zh: "恐怕按合同我不能就此事再多说了，"他说，颇为到位地摆出一副既遗憾又乐于相助的样子。

texts.en: His smile glistens.
texts.zh: 他的笑容油亮地绽开。

texts.en:
His smile glistens.

"I am happy for you, captain."
texts.zh:
他的笑容油亮地绽开。

"我为你高兴，舰长。"

texts.en:
His smile glistens.

"I anticipate your success, captain."
texts.zh:
他的笑容油亮地绽开。

"我期待你的成功，舰长。"

texts.en: His smile glistens.
texts.zh: 他的笑容油亮地绽开。

texts.en:
"One wonders at the value of the anti-Macario initiative considering Hector's failure to maintain control of the Sindrian Diktat." He shrugs, turning his palms up.

"It was your investment to make." His habitual half-smile grows slightly. "I made my own, of course."
texts.zh:
"考虑到 Hector 未能稳住辛达强权的控制权，反 Macario 行动究竟有多少价值，不免让人掂量。"他耸耸肩，翻起掌心。

"那是你该做的投资。\"他惯常的半笑稍稍加深。\"当然，我也做了我自己的。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"This has turned out to be a profitable venture, captain."

His usual smile is fixed, as usual. But is there a hint of pleasure, of human warmth in his tone? It is difficult to say.
texts.zh:
"事实证明，这是一笔有利可图的生意，舰长。"

他一贯的笑容照旧凝固着。但语气里是否藏着一丝愉悦、一丝人情味？很难说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "This has not turned out to be a profitable venture, captain," he says, smile fixed. It is difficult to read how much, if any, disappointment or reprimand, if any, he intends to express. "But such is the risk we undertake."
texts.zh: "事实证明，这并不是一笔有利可图的生意，舰长，\"他说，笑容不变。很难看出他究竟想表达几分失望或责备——如果有的话。\"但这就是我们承担的风险。"

texts.en:
"Although, as they say, 'our' side has won, it is on terms that I had wished to avoid. And if the venture is not profitable, then it is, of course, a loss."

His usual smile is fixed, as usual. But it is difficult to read how much, if any, disappointment or reprimand, if any, he intends to express. "But such is the risk we undertake."
texts.zh:
"虽说，如他们所言，'我们'这一方赢了，可赢的条件却是我本希望避开的。而一笔生意若不赚钱，那自然就是亏损。"

他一贯的笑容照旧凝固着。很难看出他究竟想表达几分失望或责备——如果有的话。"但这就是我们承担的风险。"

texts.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief.

"And Fortuna's gambit worked. Is that not incredible? You were right, $titlePL. Stars above, at last this is over and we can return to business."
texts.zh:
"Askonia 和平了！"Horus 摇了摇头，仿佛难以置信。

"而且 Fortuna 的赌局成了。这不是不可思议吗？你说对了，$titlePL。群星在上，这事总算结束了，我们可以回去做生意了。"

texts.en:
"This is the closing of an ugly chapter in the history of the Sector, I think," Horus says hopefully. "I am pleased to see the end of it and, I hope, the glimmer of a brighter future."

He smiles unconvincingly.
texts.zh:
"我想，这是星域历史上一个丑陋篇章的终结，\"Horus 满怀希望地说，\"我很高兴看到它落幕，也希望能看到更光明的未来透出一线微光。"

他挤出一个毫无说服力的笑容。

texts.en:
"And now the Hegemony has begun to rebuild something of its legitimacy in Umbra."

He nods. "This is good. An indicator of how things are to be. If the Hegemony can compromise, then so can we.""
texts.zh:
"而现在，霸主已开始在 Umbra 重建它的一部分合法性。"

他点点头。"这很好。这预示着未来的局面该是什么样。如果霸主能让步，那我们也能。"

texts.en:
"And now the Hegemony has begun to rebuild something of its legitimacy in Nortia."

He nods. "This is good. An indicator of how things are to be. If the Hegemony can compromise, then so can we.""
texts.zh:
"而现在，霸主已开始在 Nortia 重建它的一部分合法性。"

他点点头。"这很好。这预示着未来的局面该是什么样。如果霸主能让步，那我们也能。"

texts.en:
"And now the Hegemony has begun to rebuild something of its legitimacy in both Nortia and Umbra."

He nods. "This is good, very good. An indicator of how things are to be. If the Hegemony can compromise, then so can we."
texts.zh:
"而现在，霸主已开始在 Nortia 和 Umbra 两地重建它的一部分合法性。"

他点点头。"这很好，非常好。这预示着未来的局面该是什么样。如果霸主能让步，那我们也能。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony - and the rebels - have taken less out of the Sindrian Diktat than I might have hoped, $titlePL," Horus admits. "I can only hope that this is not an indicator of... well, there is more to the Persean Sector than the Askonia System, right?"

He puts on an unconvincing smile. "We simply must do better next time."
texts.zh:
"霸主——还有那些叛乱者——从辛达强权身上啃下的东西，比我期望的要少，$titlePL，"Horus 承认道，"我只能希望这并不预示着...呃，英仙座星域可不止一个 Askonia 星系，对吧？"

他摆出一个毫无说服力的笑容。"下次我们非得做得更好不可。"

texts.en:
"The Hegemony - and the rebels, mostly through them - have taken more out of the Sindrian Diktat than anyone might have expected," Horus says, allowing a hint of cheer to enter his voice.

"This is good. An indicator of the future."
texts.zh:
"霸主——还有叛乱者，多半是借霸主之手——从辛达强权身上取得的战果，超出了所有人的预料，"Horus 说，语气里透出一丝欢快。

"这很好。这是未来的征兆。"

options.en: Keep your head down, I say. There'll be more chances.
options.zh: 要我说，先低头忍着。往后还有的是机会。

options.en: Achilles is not his father. And whatever he is, he's not Hector.
options.zh: Achilles 不是他父亲。不管他是什么人，他都不是 Hector。

options.en: Achilles is a better man than Hector. And Philip. He's League.
options.zh: Achilles 比 Hector 更像个人，也比 Philip 强。他是联盟的人。

options.en: It's going to get a lot worse before it gets better, Horus.
options.zh: Horus，事情在好转之前，还会糟糕得多。

options.en: I hope this brings about your vision for the future - a unified Sector!
options.zh: 我希望这能实现你那份对未来的愿景——一个统一的星域！

options.en: With this victory - and it is - will you be able to dethrone Reynard?
options.zh: 凭着这场胜利——这确实是场胜利——你能把 Reynard 拉下台吗？

options.en: I hope so too.
Well put, sir.

texts.en:
"Indeed, indeed," Horus says automatically, nodding.

"Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
texts.zh:
"确实，确实，"Horus 机械地点着头说。

"你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

texts.en:
"Indeed, indeed." Horus nods automatically and unenthusiastically. "Time shall tell."

He sighs, thinking for a long moment.

At last, he says, "Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
texts.zh:
"确实，确实。\"Horus 机械地点着头，兴致缺缺，\"时间会给出答案。"

他叹了口气，思忖良久。

最后他开口道："你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

texts.en:
"Then you are a cynic, $titlePL," Horus says with a desperate air of amusement.

"Now perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
texts.zh:
"那么你是个愤世嫉俗的人，$titlePL，"Horus 说，带着一种近乎绝望的玩味。

"那么现在，你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

texts.en: "I as well, $titlePL," he says nodding. "May we live to see that cycle when humanity is re-united."
texts.zh: "我也一样，$titlePL，\"他点头道，\"愿我们活着看到人类重归一统的那一天。"

texts.en:
"$TitlePL, you speak boldly," he says, taken aback. But not displeased.

"There is much still to be settled. But I hope I do not speak too soon when I declare that I feel the beginning of the winds of change..."

He allows himself a fleeting smile at this thought.
texts.zh:
"$TitlePL，你说话可真大胆，"他说，吃了一惊，但并不见怪。

"还有许多事悬而未决。但我宣布自己已感到变革之风初起时，希望这话没说得太早..."

念及此处，他放任自己露出一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

texts.en:
"Indeed," Horus says automatically, nodding.

"So. Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
texts.zh:
"确实，"Horus 机械地点着头说。

"那么。你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

texts.en:
"Thank you," Horus says automatically, nodding.

"So. Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
texts.zh:
"谢谢你，"Horus 机械地点着头说。

"那么。你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

texts.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief.

"And Fortuna's gambit failed, I'm afraid. I am not of the opinion that Kazeron, much less the League entire, is a zero-sum struggle. But Gens Hannan is positioned to take much of what Gens Kato once had; influence, prestige, property... power, above all."

His expression is grim.

"If nothing else, Achilles seems amenable to outside investment, commerce, and some loosening of Philip's military discipline upon all Askonian society... this is better, isn't it? We can get back to business."
texts.zh:
"Askonia 和平了！"Horus 摇了摇头，仿佛难以置信。

"可惜 Fortuna 的赌局失败了。我并不认为 Kazeron——更不用说整个联盟——是一场零和博弈。但 Hannan 氏族如今占据有利位置，将攫取 Kato 氏族昔日拥有的大部分东西：影响力、声望、产业...最重要的是权力。"

他神情阴沉。

"至少 Achilles 似乎愿意接受外来投资、商业往来，也愿意稍微放松 Philip 强加于整个 Askonia 社会的军事纪律...这样更好，不是吗？我们可以回去做生意了。"

texts.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief. "Though it is a difficult state of affairs to call 'peace', but I must."

"Reynard's gambit worked. It was a trap - and Fortuna's bid fell into it, and failed. Is that not incredible? You were right, $titlePL. Stars above, at last this is over and we can return to business."

He sighs, seemingly relieved at the prospect.

"The Persean League is not a zero-sum struggle, you know. Though Gens Hannan grows more powerful, I have given my gens security and stability."
texts.zh:
"Askonia 和平了！"Horus 摇了摇头，仿佛难以置信。"虽然这局面很难称之为'和平'，但我必须这么说。"

"Reynard 的赌局成了。那是个陷阱——Fortuna 的图谋一头栽了进去，败了。这不是不可思议吗？你说对了，$titlePL。群星在上，这事总算结束了，我们可以回去做生意了。"

"你知道，英仙座联盟不是一场零和博弈。尽管 Hannan 氏族愈发强大，我至少给我的氏族带来了安全与稳定。"

texts.en:
"The mutiny in Askonia has collapsed," Horus says, as if in wonderment. "At least as an effective independent power."

"They're the League's problem now," he says with a sniff. "Fortuna, oh Fortuna. You've quite upset things."
texts.zh:
"Askonia 的叛乱已经瓦解了，\"Horus 说，语气像是惊叹，\"至少作为一个有效的独立势力是完了。"

"现在他们成了联盟的麻烦。\"他嗤了一声，\"Fortuna 啊 Fortuna。你可把局面搅得不轻。"

texts.en:
"The mutiny in Askonia persists under the leadership of Achilles Andrada. Fortuna's gambit succeeded, I'm afraid," he admits.

"Though I am not of the opinion that Kazeron, much less the League entire, is a zero-sum struggle, Gens Kato is positioned to take much from Gens Hannan; influence, prestige, property... power, above all."

His expression is grim. "At least the fighting is over. Achilles seems in favor of investment and commerce... perhaps we can return to a sort of business as usual."
texts.zh:
"Askonia 的叛乱在 Achilles Andrada 的领导下延续了下来。可惜，Fortuna 的赌局成了，"他承认道。

"虽然我并不认为 Kazeron——更不用说整个联盟——是一场零和博弈，但 Kato 氏族如今占据有利位置，将从 Hannan 氏族手中夺走许多东西：影响力、声望、产业...最重要的是权力。"

他神情阴沉。"至少仗打完了。Achilles 似乎赞成投资与商业...也许我们能回到某种照常做生意的状态。"

"The mutiny in Askonia persists under the leadership of Hector Andrada. It is a difficult state of affairs to call it 'peace', but I must. Fortuna's gambit failed."

"Though I am not of the opinion that Kazeron, much less the League entire, is a zero-sum struggle, Gens Hannan is positioned to take much from Gens Kato; influence, prestige, property... power, above all. Reynard favors a combative polity in Askonia for it draws the Hegemony's attention from his own ambitions."

His expression is grim. "At least the fighting is over and we can return to business."
texts.zh:
"Askonia 的叛乱在 Hector Andrada 的领导下延续了下来。这局面很难称之为'和平'，但我必须这么说。Fortuna 的赌局失败了。"

"虽然我并不认为 Kazeron——更不用说整个联盟——是一场零和博弈，但 Hannan 氏族如今占据有利位置，将从 Kato 氏族手中夺走许多东西：影响力、声望、产业...最重要的是权力。Reynard 中意 Askonia 出现一个好斗的政权，因为那能把霸主的注意力从他自身的野心上引开。"

他神情阴沉。"至少仗打完了，我们可以回去做生意了。"

"Sir," he begins. "Uh, Supre- yes, immediately! Glory t-"

"长官，\"他开口道，\"呃，最高——是，马上！荣耀归——"

texts.en:
Supreme Executor Hector Andrada appears before you, uniform pristine, chest filled with medals. His tyrian cape hangs off one shoulder.

"Oh, hello $PlayerName."

One booted foot is on his desk. A sword, unsheathed, is laid across the surface.
texts.zh:
最高元首 Hector Andrada 出现在你面前，制服一尘不染，胸前挂满勋章。他那件提尔紫的披风搭在一侧肩上。

"哦，你好啊，$PlayerName。"

他一只穿着靴子的脚踩在办公桌上。一柄出了鞘的剑横在桌面。

options.en: Let us speak of the Sindrian Diktat...
options.zh: 我们来谈谈辛达强权吧...

options.en: Let us speak of the war - and your victory!
options.zh: 我们来谈谈这场战争——还有你的胜利！

options.en: How may I serve you, Supreme Executor?
options.zh: 我该如何为你效劳，最高元首？

texts.en:
He ignores your words, speaking instead at you.

"You have served me, $playerLastName," he says. "With more loyalty than most."

Hector turns his eyes upon you, expression withheld. He seems to savor the state of uncertainty.
texts.zh:
他无视你的话，径自对着你说下去。

"你曾为我效劳，$playerLastName，\"他说，\"比大多数人更忠诚。"

Hector 把目光投向你，脸上不露分毫。他似乎很享受这种让人捉摸不透的状态。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He stands unsteadily, then lifts the sword. Your instincts from cycles in space revolt against the sight of a blade held loosely, wobbling through the air.

"And this!" He waves his off-hand in a wide arc. "This is... utterly-"

Hector slams the sword into the desk, sending objects flying - half a TriPad, from the looks of it, the glint of a sidearm and a few rounds of archaic ammunition.

The wood - and it is real wood - is solid. The blade sticks.
texts.zh:
他摇摇晃晃地站起身，然后举起那把剑。你在太空里摸爬许多星历年养成的本能，对眼前这一幕极为排斥：那柄剑被松松地握着，在空中晃晃悠悠。

"还有这个！\"他用空着的那只手划了个大弧，\"这简直...彻底——"

Hector 把剑狠狠砸进桌面，桌上的东西四散飞起——看那半截 TriPad，还有一柄手枪的金属反光，以及几发老式弹药。

那木头——是真木头——结实得很。剑刃卡在了里面。

texts.en:
He lifts the sword, and stands. Your instincts born of cycles of spacefaring revolt against the sight of a naked blade wielded capriciously.

"This is... pathetic."

Hector slams the sword into the desk, sending objects flying - half a TriPad, from the looks of it, and the glint of a sidearm and a few rounds of archaic ammunition. The wood - and it is real wood - is solid, and the blade sticks.
texts.zh:
他举起剑，站起身来。你在星海间闯荡多年养成的本能，对这样一柄被人任意挥弄的出鞘利刃极为排斥。

"这真是...可悲。"

Hector 把剑狠狠砸进桌面，桌上的东西四散飞起——看那半截 TriPad，还有一柄手枪的金属反光，以及几发老式弹药。那木头——是真木头——结实得很，剑刃卡在了里面。

texts.en:
He stands, then lifts the sword.

Hector eyes the desk, as if contemplating whether to chop it in half. Instead, thankfully, he hefts the blade deftly into a ready position.

"Mere 'victory' is not enough," he says. "I am given what my father conquered. An inheritance. Not a victory."

Hector begins to pace, sword still held ready to strike. A turn, then he stops to examine the edge, almost touching it with his off-hand.
texts.zh:
他站起身，然后举起剑。

Hector 盯着那张桌子，像是在琢磨要不要把它劈成两半。好在他到底没有，只是轻巧地把剑提成了出招的架势。

"仅仅'胜利'还不够，\"他说，\"我拿到的是我父亲征服下来的东西。那是一份遗产。不是胜利。"

Hector 开始踱步，剑仍举在随时能劈下的位置。走了一个来回，他停下来端详刃口，空着的那只手几乎要碰上去。

texts.en:
He stands, and lifts the sword. A smile flickers about his lips. Hector eyes the desk, as if contemplating whether to chop it in half. Instead, thankfully, he hefts the blade lightly into a ready position.

"I have achieved victory. I have claimed all that my father conquered."

He begins to pace, the blade of the sword held delicately by his off-hand. Then stops to examine the edge.
texts.zh:
他站起身，举起剑。一抹笑意在他唇边掠过。Hector 盯着那张桌子，像是在琢磨要不要把它劈成两半。好在他到底没有，只是轻轻把剑提成了出招的架势。

"我取得了胜利。我父亲征服的一切，如今都归我所有。"

他开始踱步，剑身被他用空着的那只手轻轻托着。随后他停下来端详刃口。

texts.en:
He stands, and lifts the sword. A smile flickers about his lips. Hector eyes the desk, as if contemplating whether to chop it in half. Instead, thankfully, he hefts the blade lightly into a ready position.

"My victory is... glorious. I have claimed all my father conquered and beyond. I am proven worthy, and more than worthy: greater."

He begins to pace, the blade of the sword held delicately by his off-hand. Then stops to examine the edge.
texts.zh:
他站起身，举起剑。一抹笑意在他唇边掠过。Hector 盯着那张桌子，像是在琢磨要不要把它劈成两半。好在他到底没有，只是轻轻把剑提成了出招的架势。

"我的胜利...无比光荣。我父亲征服的一切，还有更多，都已被我收入囊中。我已证明自己配得上，而且远远不止配得上：我比他更伟大。"

他开始踱步，剑身被他用空着的那只手轻轻托着。随后他停下来端详刃口。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"But I am surrounded by lesser men. Weak, thin-blooded."

Hector's face twists with emotion; he pauses, speaking quietly, "They poisoned my father, you know. Cowards. He should never have waited so long. He should never have tried to, to-" Through gritted teeth, "Protect. Me."

He wipes his face with his sleeve, bedecked with gold braid.

With his off-hand, Hector pulls his sidearm from his belt, then is still - he holds it, aiming as if to execute a traitor kneeling before him.
texts.zh:
"可我身边尽是些庸碌之辈。软弱，血统稀薄。"

Hector 的脸因情绪而扭曲；他顿了顿，压低声音说："你知道吗，他们毒死了我父亲。那些懦夫。他本不该等那么久。他本不该试图去，去——"他咬紧牙关，"保护。我。"

他用缀着金色绶带的袖子抹了把脸。

Hector 用空着的那只手从腰间拔出配枪，然后一动不动——他端着枪，像是在瞄准一个跪在面前、等待处决的叛徒。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"And Macario. That lying... that lying spider."

Hector barks a desperate laugh, and begins pacing furiously.

"A Luddie liar. That's how he wormed his way into my father's good favor. He had to be a good liar - better than good, the best - to deceive my father. And everyone else, for so long."
texts.zh:
"还有 Macario。那个谎言连篇的...那个谎言连篇的蜘蛛。"

Hector 迸出一声绝望的干笑，开始狂躁地来回踱步。

"一个卢德佬，一个骗子。他就是这么钻进我父亲的宠信里的。他必须是个高明的骗子——不止高明，得是最顶尖的——才能骗过我父亲。还有所有人，骗了那么久。"

texts.en:
"And Hyder. That lying... that lying Heggie traitor."

Hector barks a desperate laugh, and begins pacing furiously.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start. A Heggie liar. Typical case, lacking strength of will and instead appearing weak... using trickery and manipulation. And fed, always fed by the Hegemony."

"I knew it! I always knew it." His eyes go wide. "I knew the hand of Orcus Rao."
texts.zh:
"还有 Hyder。那个谎言连篇的...那个谎言连篇的霸主佬叛徒。"

Hector 迸出一声绝望的干笑，开始狂躁地来回踱步。

"从一开始就是霸主的叛徒。一个霸主佬骗子。典型的货色，没有意志力，就装出一副软弱相...靠诡计和操纵行事。而且有人喂着他，一直是霸主在喂。"

"我就知道！我一直就知道。\"他双眼圆睁，\"我早就知道幕后是 Orcus Rao 的手。"

texts.en:
"And Hyder. That lying... that lying Heggie traitor."

Hector barks a desperate laugh, and begins pacing furiously.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start until the end. A plant. A Heggie liar. Typical case, lacking strength of will and instead appearing weak... using trickery and manipulation. And fed, always fed by the Hegemony."

"I knew it! I always knew it." His eyes go wide. "I knew the hand of Orcus Rao."

texts.en:
"Hyder!" He sweeps some debris from the top of the desk, circling like a frustrated carnivore.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start. I saw the signs, but I was advised to not act."

"TO. NOT. ACT."

He swings his arm and fires a round, aimless. You hear the start of a shrill alarm.
texts.zh:
"Hyder！"他一把扫掉桌上的碎屑，像一头受挫的食肉兽那样来回打转。

"从一开始就是霸主的叛徒。我看到了迹象，可有人劝我别动手。"

"别。动。手。"

他挥臂开了一枪，漫无目标。你听见一阵尖利的警报声开始响起。

texts.en:
"Hyder!" He sweeps some debris from the top of the desk, circling like a frustrated carnivore.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start and 'til the end. Sabotaging my conquest... I saw the signs, but I was advised to not act."

"TO. NOT. ACT."

He swings his arm and fires a round, aimless. You hear the start of a shrill alarm.
texts.zh:
"Hyder！"他一把扫掉桌上的碎屑，像一头受挫的食肉兽那样来回打转。

"从头到尾都是霸主的叛徒。破坏我的征服大业...我看到了迹象，可有人劝我别动手。"

"别。动。手。"

他挥臂开了一枪，漫无目标。你听见一阵尖利的警报声开始响起。

texts.en:
"And Macario. That vermin, that spider."

He sweeps some debris from the top of the desk, circling like a frustrated carnivore.

"A Luddie liar. That's how he wormed his way into my father's good favor. He had to be a good liar - better than good, the best - to deceive my father. And everyone else, for so long. He told me 'to not act too soon'."

"TO. NOT. ACT."

He swings his arm wildly and fires a round. You hear a shrill alarm begin.
texts.zh:
"还有 Macario。那只鼠辈，那只蜘蛛。"

他一把扫掉桌上的碎屑，像一头受挫的食肉兽那样来回打转。

"一个卢德佬，一个骗子。他就是这么钻进我父亲的宠信里的。他必须是个高明的骗子——不止高明，得是最顶尖的——才能骗过我父亲。还有所有人，骗了那么久。他还对我说'别动手太早'。"

"别。动。手。"

他狂乱地挥臂开了一枪。你听见一阵尖利的警报声响起。

options.en: Continue
Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"And Caden! That fat fool."

Hector kicks something on the ground that dutifully flies off-link with a clatter. "How did my father ever tolerate his simpering incompetence?"
texts.zh:
"还有 Caden！那个肥胖的蠢货。"

Hector 踢飞了地上的什么东西，那东西很听话地哐当一声飞出了通讯画面。"我父亲究竟是怎么容忍他那副谄媚无能的样子？"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"And you."

He turns toward the link, meeting your eyes as if he stood before you.

"Macario's poisoned dagger... in my back."

He laughs, desperately, sweating off the combat stims he must have taken earlier.
texts.zh:
"还有你。"

他转向通讯画面，直直迎上你的目光，仿佛就站在你面前。

"Macario 的毒匕首...插在我的背上。"

他绝望地笑起来，浑身是汗，像是正把先前服下的战斗兴奋剂从体内逼出来。

texts.en:
"Serve me honorably and you shall be rewarded. Betray me..." His hand wanders back to his sidearm.

Hector gives you a warning look, then turns away.

He raises one hand without looking back, a dismissal. "Now leave me. I've much to do."
texts.zh:
"忠诚地为我效劳，你就会得到奖赏。背叛我..."他的手又摸回了配枪。

Hector 警告地看了你一眼，然后转过身去。

他头也不回地抬起一只手，示意你退下。"现在离开我吧。我还有很多事要做。"

texts.en:
He steadies his breathing, and looks back into the link, as if seeing you for the first time.

"Serve my Sindrian Diktat and you shall be rewarded. Betray me and you will stamped out with the rest of the vermin," he says, glowering.

"When the Supreme Executor has use for you, you'll be told."

Hector turns away, head hanging.

"Now leave me alone. I've... much to do." His voice is almost a whisper.
texts.zh:
他稳住呼吸，重新望向通讯链接，仿佛第一次看清了你。

"为我的辛达强权效命，自有封赏。若是背叛我，你就和其余虫子一起被碾碎，"他怒视着说。

"等最高元首用得着你，自会通知你。"

Hector 转过身去，垂着头。

"现在让我一个人待着。我还有...很多事要做。"他的声音轻得近乎耳语。

texts.en:
"I swore loyalty 'til death- and beyond, that my actions may live forever in glorious history."

"Degenerate spacers like yourself will never understand greatness! I have risen above traitors and weakness, through eternal war I shall demonstrate my eternal devotion to the Great Movement!"

You see now the mania and gleam of combat stim abuse; $heOrShe proceeds to rant about your forthcoming destruction, providing no sign that he will listen to reason.
texts.zh:
"我曾宣誓效忠，至死 —— 乃至死后，好让我的事迹永载光荣的史册。"

"像你这种堕落的太空佬，永远不懂何谓伟大！我已超越叛徒与软弱，我要通过永不停歇的战争，向伟大运动证明我永恒的忠诚！"

你这才看清他眼中那股狂躁，还有滥用战斗兴奋剂的异样光泽；$heOrShe接着喋喋不休地预言你的灭亡，全无半点听得进道理的样子。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe laughs a laugh found somewhere beside madness.

"Of course you don't understand! You could never understand, for you are a degenerate spacer - lost, lost from blood and greatness. I serve unto death, and beyond death. Sindria is become a glorious beacon of death to an unworthy Sector, an unworthy galaxy; an unworthy species - plagued by weakness, brought down by treachery! My actions, a shadow, an echo of Andrada's genius, will join the others of the Glorious Movement and burn through history like-"

You see now the mania and gleam of combat stim abuse; $heOrShe proceeds to rant about your forthcoming destruction, giving little sign of listening to reason.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe笑了，那笑声像是从疯狂边上某处捡来的。

"你当然不明白！你永远也不会明白，因为你是个堕落的太空佬 —— 失落了，从血脉与伟大中彻底失落了。我效忠至死，直至死后。Sindria 已经成了一座死亡的光辉灯塔，照向这个不配的星域、不配的银河、不配的物种 —— 被软弱所困，被背叛所毁！我的作为，是 Andrada 天才的一道影子、一声回响，它将汇入光荣运动其他人的行列，如..."

你这才看清他眼中那股狂躁，还有滥用战斗兴奋剂的异样光泽；$heOrShe接着喋喋不休地预言你的灭亡，几乎全无听得进道理的样子。

texts.en:
"On behalf of the Lion's Guard, I bring you the justice of Supreme Executor Philip Andrada!"

"Surrender now and your crew may be spared immediate execution. For you, however," the Diktat $post sneers, "there will be no such mercy. You will be shackled, limb by limb, first paraded before the loyal assembly of-"

$HeOrShe proceeds to rant about your forthcoming destruction.
texts.zh:
"我以狮心卫队的名义，为你带来最高元首 Philip Andrada 的正义！"

"现在投降，你的船员或许还能免于立即处决。至于你，\"强权的$post冷笑道，\"绝不会有这种仁慈。你身上的每一节都会被锁链拴住，先押到忠诚的集会前 ——"

$HeOrShe接着喋喋不休地讲起你即将迎来的灭亡。

texts.en:
"I shall not hear the lies from spacer scum. You know nothing of the will of the Lion of Sindria and shall have no part in his glorious future. You will be cleansed from existence by purifying annihilation of anti-matter weaponry. I shall have no mercy, none! And-"

$HeOrShe continues describing your forthcoming destruction at tedious length.
texts.zh:
"我不会听太空佬渣滓的谎言。你对辛达瑞亚之狮的意志一无所知，也休想在他的光辉未来里占一席之地。你将被反物质武器的净化之威从存在中抹去。我绝不仁慈，绝不！还有 ——"

$HeOrShe继续不厌其烦地描述你即将迎来的灭亡。

texts.en:
"I swore loyalty 'til death- and beyond, that my actions may live forever in glorious history."

"Degenerate spacers like yourself will never understand greatness! I have risen above traitors and weakness, through eternal war I shall demonstrate my eternal devotion to the Great Movement!"

You see now the mania and gleam of combat stim abuse; $heOrShe proceeds to rant about your forthcoming destruction, providing no sign that he will listen to reason.
texts.zh:
"我曾宣誓效忠，至死 —— 乃至死后，好让我的事迹永载光荣的史册。"

"像你这种堕落的太空佬，永远不懂何谓伟大！我已超越叛徒与软弱，我要通过永不停歇的战争，向伟大运动证明我永恒的忠诚！"

你这才看清他眼中那股狂躁，还有滥用战斗兴奋剂的异样光泽；$heOrShe接着喋喋不休地预言你的灭亡，全无半点听得进道理的样子。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe laughs a laugh found somewhere beside madness.

"Of course you don't understand! You could never understand, for you are a degenerate spacer - lost, lost from blood and greatness. I serve unto death, and beyond death. Sindria is become a glorious beacon of death to an unworthy Sector, an unworthy galaxy; an unworthy species - plagued by weakness, brought down by treachery! My actions, a shadow, an echo of Andrada's genius, will join the others of the Glorious Movement and burn through history like-"
